11202315.label: Major findings and research outcome
11202315.value: We designed and implemented Expeditus, a novel congestion-aware load balancing protocol in the data plane. It features a scalable congestion information collection mechanism that only monitors local switch port information. It relies on a distributed congestion-aware path selection protocol that piggybacks congestion information from different switches to the sender/receiver to make a path selection decision. The path selection is done in two stages. We find that our design overcomes the scalability challenge of congestion-aware load balancing in data center networks with potentially hundreds of thousands of paths between each pair of hosts, and delivers significant performance gains in terms of flow completion time compared to state-of-the-art protocols. The work was published in ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing in 2016, a top conference on cloud computing, and then in IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking in 2017, the top journal in computer networking. We then proposed Luopan, another congestion-aware load balancing protocol to improve the path selection mechanism to better deal with failures and network asymmetry. It relies on random sampling instead of information piggybacking to make path selections and is much easier to implement. Random sampling also works for general topologies including asymmetric ones that resulted from link faliures. We find that Luopan is able to deliver close-to-optimal performance gains while being robust to link failures. Luopan was published in IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems, a top-tier journal in distributed systems. In additions to publications, our work also leads to a series of practical patents. Specifically, based on Expeditus, we have successfully obtained a U.S. patent in 2019, and filed several patent applications in China, U.S., and Europe.

11202315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11202315.value: This project has potential for both further research and technology transfer. The use of random sampling is particularly interesting due to its simplicity and close-to-optimal performance that we find in this project. Further understanding about the sampling frequency and sampling granularity would be very helpful to develop a more dynamic approach for congestion-aware load balancing. Our designs are also practical enough to attract organic attention from industry (HP Enterprise, Huawei), and has potential to be applied in production switching ASICs.

11202315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11202315.value: Traditional wisdom says the network data plane ought to be as simple as possible for packet forwarding at line rate. This principle has been followed in data center networks, which provide a large number of equal-cost paths and abundant bandwidth between server machines. To load balance flows switches run ECMP which relies on simple hashing to determine the output port. It's well-known that a dumb data plane with ECMP cannot satisfy the increasingly stringent performance requirements of data center networks, including low latency both on average and at the tail, and high throughput. This project developed congestion-aware load balancing protocols that strategically select the best network path to route a flow based on the instantaneous congestion information in the network. We proposed and evaluated two novel protocols: Expeditus which relies on the topological characteristics, and Luopan which relies on random sampling, to overcome the scalability challenge of collecting instantaneous congestion information for all paths between a pair of end-hosts in a large-scale data center. Testbed implementation and extensive simulation reveal that they deliver salient performance gains compared to state-of-the-art. Our work has great potential for future research and potential industry adoption, and has led to several patents granted already.

11202715.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202715.value: Closer economic relationships between Hong Kong (HK) and Mainland China (ML) have developed since 2004. It is a common phenomenon for HK expatriate construction professionals (HKExCPs) extending their work to the Mainland. In recent years, there is a rapidly increasing for HK construction professionals ‘Moving North’ to work in ML (around 28.5% are working in ML, Census & Stat. Dep’t [CSD] 2011b). HK people have altered/adopted western cultural values (e.g., team spirit, prudence, resistance), while Chinese people still maintain Chinese social values involving power distance, moderation, protecting ‘face’, emphasizing relationships, etc. Although the ML market has been opened to outsiders for over 10 years, it is still very difficult for HKExCPs to work in a place with different cultural values (China), and thus they are subject to a great deal of cultural stress while working on complicated construction projects. The challenges HKExCPs face are the competitive environment in ML (e.g., socialism, social market economics, and bureaucracy within a hierarchical authority), demanding construction projects (mega project size, complicated design, and tight time frame), and complex social networking (home-work conflict, language barriers, suboptimal living standards, and difficulty in cooperating with local workers). It causes HKExCPs in ML with great level of stress and high expatriate failure rate (CSD 2011b; Leung et al. 2010a; Lorange 2003) in the industry. These challenges have had significant influences on the performance of HKExCPs in ML and hence on the profitability of construction companies. Clinical studies show that a reasonable level of stress can stimulate an individual’s output; however, excessive stress may seriously worsen performance. The proposed research thus aims to optimize the performance of HKExCPs in the competitive ML construction market through proactive Cross-cultural Stress Management (CCSM). The objectives are (1) to update previous findings on cross-cultural values and stress; (2) to identify stress-related components and performance indicators of HKExCPs; (3) to establish the relationships between cultural values, stressors, stress, coping behaviours, and performance of HKExCPs; (4) to develop an integrated Cross-cultural Stress Management (CCSM) structural equation model for HKExCPs; (5) to verify the model through longitudinal case studies; and (6) to propose CCSM guidelines for optimizing the practical performance of HKExCPs in ML. It is envisaged that our findings will help in devising a proactive Individual CCSM model for HKExCPs and that it will be continued to develop an integrated proactive Organizational CCSM model for HKExCPs in the huge Mainland market and other Asia countries. Although the Mainland (ML)market has been opened to outsiders over 10 years, it is still very difficult for Hong Kong Expatriate Construction Professionals (HKExCPs) to work in a place with different cultural values (China), and thus they are subject to a great deal of cultural stress while working on complicated construction projects. The proposed research thus aims to optimize the performance of HKExCPs in the ML construction market through proactive Cross-cultural Stress Management (CCSM). The objectives are (1) to update previous findings on cross-cultural values and stress; (2) to identify stress-related components and performance indicators of HKExCPs; (3) to establish the relationships between cultural values, stressors, stress, coping behaviours, and performance of HKExCPs; and (4) to develop an integrated Cross-cultural Stress Management structural equation model for HKExCPs. It is envisaged that our findings will help in devising a proactive Individual CCSM model for HKExCPs in ML. 盡管中國內地市場已經對外開放超過10年，在內地工作的香港建築專才仍然很難適應內地文化。文化的差異和復雜的工程項目導致香港建築專才在工作中承受很大的壓力。因此，本研究旨在通過建立跨文化的壓力管理模型來優化香港建築專才在中國內地的工作績效。 本研究的目標包括：1）更新和總結前人關於跨文化價值與壓力的研究成果；2）確定香港建築專才的壓力源，壓力，壓力應對行為，以及他們的工作績效因子；3）建立壓力源，壓力，壓力應對行為和工作績效因子之間的關系；和 4）發展一個整合的跨文化壓力管理模型。 我們相信，本研究可以為在內地工作的香港建築專才設計一個實用的跨文化壓力管理模型

11202715.label: Realisation of objectives
11202715.value: During the data collection, most of the respondents were working in Mainland China. It was really difficult to contact them for the survey and meet a possible time for conducting the interview. Therefore, the research team also need to visit their office in various cities of the Mainland. The project was finally successfully completed with a number of publications. Thanks for the funding. In fact, we also further extend the stress management from construction professionals to construction workers. However, it has not yet be funded for a large-scale survey with various specific cases for the stress/health management of construction workers. Hope the study can be further supported by the government in the future.

11202715.label: Major findings and research outcome
11202715.value: 1. To update previous findings - Please see my publications listed in the Research Outputs (part C). 2. To identify cultural stress-related components and performance for HKExCPs in ML Factor analysis and reliability tests revealed 11 stressors for expatriated construction professionals (ExCPs): work-home conflict and language fluency as personal stressors; professional ability of locals, personal traits of locals, and poor workgroup relationships as interpersonal stressors; heavy workload as a task stressor; organizational formalization, organizational centralization, and pay differential as organizational stressors; and poor transportation system and poor medical services as physical stressors. The two analyses also confirmed two kinds of stress (emotional and physical stress) three main constructs for motivation (coping behaviours-to-stress expectancy, stress-to-performance expectancy, and valence of performance), five coping behaviours (planful problem solving, instrumental support seeking, emotional support seeking, escapism, and emotional discharge), and two types of performance (task performance and early return intention) (Chan et al. 2016, 2018; Leung et al. 2016a, 2017a,b, 2018; Liang 2018). 3. To establish relationships between cultural stress-related components and performance of HKExCPs. A quantitative questionnaire survey and a qualitative interview study were administered among HKExCPs working in three Mainland cities (Beijing, Shanghai and Macau). The results both revealed significant different stress-related components of ExCPs in the three cities, and significant relationships among various stress-related components of ExCPs in China (Chan et al. 2016, 2018; Leung et al. 2017a,b, 2018). (1) stressors (work-home conflict, heavy workload, and organizational centralization) predict ExCPs’ emotional stress, while poor transportation exacerbate and language fluency relieve ExCPs’ physical stress; (2) there is a vicious cycle between emotional stress and physical stress for ExCPs; (3) physical stress impairs ExCPs’ overall performance, further resulting in reduced intention to stay; and (4) poor transportation directly reduced ExCPs’ intention to stay in MC. (5) coping behaviors have a direct impact on the stress of ExCPs and on their subsequent tasks and organizational outcomes. (6) there are both negative linear and inverted U-shaped relationships between same pair of stress and performance for ExCPs, namely frustration decreases their intention to stay. (7) unhappiness negatively reduces belongingness, but it affects trust among colleagues in an inverted U-shaped manner. 4. To develop an integrated Cross-cultural Stress Management model for HKExCPs in ML. An integrated cross-cultural stress management model (Stressor–Motivation–CopingBehavior–Stress–Performance) has been developed based on a Motivation–CopingBehaviours–Stress model (Chan et al.2018) and a Stressor–Stress–Performance model (Leung et al. 2017a).

11202715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11202715.value: Because only the main effect on the relationships among stressors, stress, performance, and intention to stay were examined, it is recommended that moderating and mediating effects should be examined in future studies. This would definitely enhance the understanding of how stress results in poor performance and poor outcomes among ExHKCPs. On the other hand, this study used a quantitative research method to investigate the relationship between stressors, stress, performance, and intention to stay for ExHKCPs. Qualitative studies, such as case studies, are recommended for future studies, which can serve as cross validation of quantitative research results (i.e., between-method triangulation). This can enhance the understanding of the interactions between stress management and the success of expatriate assignments. To manage the expatriated CPs' stress and improve their performance, the construction organizations are recommended to adopt flexible work schedules, provide counselling, therapy and other stress management program like mindfulness-based stress management program (Leung and Ahmed 2019; Leung et al.2016b). It is valuable to conduct a further study with intervention stress management program to the expatriate HKCPs in China. Hopefully, it will finally practically optimize their stress and improve their professional /managerial job performances in overseas.

11202715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11202715.value: Expatriating employees is a common and significant practice that organizations use to manage business in other districts. Expatriate assignments bring about a lot of problems to expatriates and companies, while stress is still prominent among construction professionals, especially during expatriate assignments. This study adopted a scientific research methodology including both questionnaire survey and 22 in-depth interviews to the Hong Kong ExCPs in mainland China.. A Stressors–Motivation–CopingBehaviours–Stress–Performance model was developed. It clearly displays the interaction among stressors, stress, performance, and intention to stay for ExCPs. To motivate construction professionals to use adaptive coping and/or prevent them from applying maladaptive strategies, cognitive-behavioral interventions are essential. Based on the findings, several recommendations are proposed for construction organizations and ExCPs to manage ExCPs’ stress, improve their performance, and enhance their intention to stay, such as encouraging online meetings and teleconference for daily work, adopting flexible work schedules to avoid morning and evening peak traffic, providing language training courses before expatriate assignments, applying family-responsive management interventions to prevent work-home conflict, and organizing mindfulness-based stress reduction training program. This work provides an alternative perspective to understand the causes of ExCPs’ poor performance and their intention to stay expatriate.

11203115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11203115.value: 現在完全是由於過去30年非常密集的全基因組測序工作, 破譯許多物種的基因組。我們現在有能力重建整個基因組的三維結構，，將推動我們的染色體相互作用。 為實現這一目標，社區積聚了非常大的集合染色體相互作用的數據。這些數據將的處理和分析將提出許多挑戰生物信息學領域。在這個項目中，我們的目的是確定並解決其中的一些挑戰。 我們希望為解決第一個問題是關於結構推斷。我們假設高分辨率數據的可用性。1千字節人類基因組中的分辨率需要TB級的計算機內存。時間提出了另一個問題。最快的方法目前有O（N3）的時間複雜度。我們提出了一種新的算法基於分而治之的降維。該算法顯示出實際的運行時間在最初的測試，解決一萬點結構〜30分鐘。以提高精度，我們還試驗新表示模型納入附加信息，如轉錄，非編碼RNA，基因表達，等等進我們推斷。 我們所考慮的第二個問題是染色體結構比較。這樣做將使我們來分析染色體的變化，從細胞到細胞，或者發現相關的物種之間染色體的差異。現有結構比對工具大多指用於比較的蛋白質結構，其中有一些幅度較小。在染色體上規模，〜10K一個非常粗略的分辨率已經導致〜30萬個; 蛋白質結構對準任務只有幾百點對準電流的方法效果不佳，即使在幾千分點。需要比對的染色體規模完全不同的方法。我們過去的經驗表明，兩種類型的索引，本地和遠程的，行之有效的結構性調整。我們計劃開發圍繞這些索引的染色體結構對齊問題的算法。 我們計劃建立一個圍繞我們的算法工具來研究兩個重要的生物學問題。首先，我們計劃研究在哺乳動物的X染色體所帶來的重排的染色體改變。已知的是，在哺乳動物中X染色體相對保守。因此，已經提出的差異，例如，在人類和小鼠X染色體之間只是進化的過程中重排。作為試點研究中，我們希望在染色體，由於這些重排的結構變化進行研究可以揭示了重排燈亮的原因，或效果。我們也將研究由致癌HPV（人乳頭瘤病毒）所帶來的染色體改變。期間在人體組織長期延遲，HPV持續導致組織變化在宿主細胞的基因組中，或簡單地集成到它。檢測HPV整合位點已成為宮頸癌研究的一個重要分析。 HPV的整合到宿主基因組中可導致多種效果，包括附近的綜合位置的變化的染色體結構。我們將在本項目中的這些影響。 該項目的預期成果包括高質量的研究論文，算法，軟件，染色體結構推斷，對齊和他們的應用程序。此外，該項目將為研究生提供了有趣和值得研究的課題。

11203115.label: Realisation of objectives
11203115.value: First, we define methods to infer the chromosome structures from high resoution data. For our method, we assume the availability of high-resolution data, which gives us more information at the expense of larger problem size. We anticipate that data will be at the level of kilobase pairs (kbp). Existing strategies have difficulties with such data. In particular, distance matrix-based methods require huge amounts of memory to work; a resolution of one kbp for the human genome would require terabytes of memory. Processing time presents another issue. We propose a progressive multi-dimensional scaling (MDS) approach for structure reconstruction from Hi-C data. We introduce a succinct representation of the distance matrix to reduce space consumption. The proposed approach progressively infer the coordinates to allow more flexible control of runtime. We model the sequence as a continuous linear polymer. For example, human chromosome 1 can be modelled as ∼25,000 bins at a resolution (number of base pairs per bin) of 10 kbp (kilo base pairs). We use each bin to represent a locus within the chromosome. During the structure reconstruction step, the determination of each locus’s location is simplified to that of determining the 3D position of the locus’s centroid. Although this model omits the local structures at each locus, it is the most widely accepted representation and is considered the most accurate model achievable by the resolution of current 3C-based techniques. The 3D positions of all the loci are referred to as a structure or a configuration. In this work, we let n denote the number of loci. We represented the contacts from Hi-C can succinctly in the form of a distance matrix. Computing shortest-path distance is, however, both time- and space-consuming since it requires the computation of all-pairs shortest-paths. Hence we propose a method to approximate this distance. We randomly choose ℓ (ℓ≪n) loci as pivots, and denote this set of loci as P. After that, we compute the single source shortest-path distances with each pivot locus as the source to all the n loci. Denote the shortest distance from pivot p to a vertex v as dp(v). With these shortest-path distances from the pivots we approximate the remaining shortest-path distances. Given a pair of loci i, j, if i or j is a pivot, we can obtain their shortest distance from the computed shortest-path distances. Otherwise, we use minp∈Pdp(i)+dp(j) to approximate the shortest distance between i and j. By increasing the number of pivots, the approximate shortest-path distance can be made arbitrarily close to the true shortest-path distance. The reconstruction works by assigning coordinates to chromosome loci progressively. After all the coordinates are assigned, we refine and sharpen the coordinates iteratively through local search. To reduce the space consumption, while computing the shortest-path distances, we adopt an adjacent list representation for the distance matrix derived from Hi-C dataset. Also, the approximated distances are not stored; we merely store the ℓ sets of shortest-path distances from the pivots — the approximated distances are computed on the fly. This data structure reduces the space complexity from O (n2) to O(ln+e) (e is the number of significant Hi-C contacts) to store a distance matrix with n×n dimensions. We randomly split all loci into k overlapping subsets. In order to combine two 3D sets successfully, we need to select at least 4 points not lie on the same plane (points on the same plane cannot identity a structure in 3D space), additionaly, a small number of loci may lead to a poor estimation of the rotation and translation matrix. Hence, we need to choose enough loci in Ii. In practice, we set the number of loci in Ii as 50, which is large enough for successive combinations in a three dimensional space. To efficient alignments of chromosome structures, we model the the structure as rigid structures, which is a sequence of 3D point. Then the aligment of two structures is to align the two sets of 3D point; that is, to find two subsets of points to minimize their root mean squared distance. To study on X chromosome rearrangements, we created a conjugated graphical model, which can capture the strucutre rearrangements. We also applied the methods to HPV. This leads the doctoral disertation of Dr, Wenlong Jia. We havve developed the web-based systems to access to chromosome data and analysis tools. We have applied the tools and result in the research work SCDevDB: A Database for Insights Into Single-Cell Gene Expression Profiles During Human Developmental Processes and Genome-Wide Investigation and Functional Analysis of Sus scrofa RNA Editing Sites across Eleven Tissues. 11203115.label: Major findings and research outcome
11203115.value: We propose a succinct representation of the distance matrices which tremendously reduces the space requirement. We give a complete solution, called SuperRec, for the inference of chromosomal structures from Hi-C data, through iterative solving the large-scale weighted multidimensional scaling problem. we propose a progressive multi-dimensional scaling (MDS) approach for structure reconstruction from Hi-C data. We introduce a succinct representation of the distance matrix to reduce space consumption. The proposed approach progressively infer the coordinates to allow more flexible control of runtime. On the benchmark dataset which consists of simulated data of 100 to 30,000 loci, our approach (implemented as a program called SuperRec) performed 5 to 435 times faster compared to ShRec3D. In particular, it demonstrated a speedup of more than 400 times in reconstructing a structure of 30,000 loci, a length sufficient for us to analyze the longest human chromosome at a resolution of 10 kbp. When accessed with normalized root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient (SRCC) and Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC), we found no loss of accuracy in the results obtained by SuperRec. SuperRec runs 40 time faster than earlier systems without compromising on result accuracy. We have also built the system which to hold the single cell gene expression profiles, which can help the cell development studies. , we developed a database to investigate single-cell gene expression profiling during different developmental processes (SCDevDB). In this database, we collected 10 human single-cell RNA-seq datasets, split these datasets into 176 developmental cell groups, and constructed 24 different developmental pathways. Users of SCDevDB are easy to view the expression changes of their interested genes showed with a boxplot. In addition, users can also download differentially expressed (DE) genes during each developmental pathway, the T-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) map constructed with these genes, Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analysis results of these differentially expressed (DE) genes. This database is publicly available at https://scdevdb.deepomics.org. It helps researchers within the fields of developmental biology to facilitate gene expression studies in human single cells. Also, we have created a website for Sus scrofa RNA Editing Sites across Eleven Tissues. Except the published papers, the results can also be found via www.deepomics.org

11203115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11203115.value: There are several possible developments. First, our method is using the shortest path to denoise the data. If the values of some links are much less than the actual value, it can lead to all the pairwise distances underestimated, and this will result in a collapsed structure. This problem can be rectified with the Poisson models. Second, at this moment, the Hi-C matrix contains the signals from two copies of chromosome---the maternal copy and the paternal copy. Most of the methods treat them as identical. However, they can fold differently, which results in different expression or replication patterns. This issue may be solved by modeling the problems as an optimization problem; that is, we model the contact matrix as the mixture of the 3D structures. Also, The Hi-C matrix is a contact map. The noise can be high, and the problem may suffer from the dropouts. This problem may be solved by a matrix factorization approach or by a deep learning approach. We have collected the database to study the developments of cells. However, the chromosome conformation can be different through the path of cell development. We need a model to capture the dynamics of chromosome conformations.

Our proposed method can reduce the 14 days to 40 minutes under the same circumstance. The proposed and implemented method will significantly reduce the computational resources required to infer the structures and their conformation changes. It may help us to understand the disorder diseases or cancers. Also, the single-cell studies can help us to understand the development of tissues, and even to understand the cancers. We build a database to store and access the single-cell data. The integrated database will help researchers to study tissue development.

11203615.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11203615.value: In the case of a fire outbreak in a building, an inefficient evacuation system could lead to high levels of fatality by exposing the evacuees to an excessively smoke-filled environment. The evacuation system should be designed to allow the evacuees to reach a place of safety (e.g., a protected staircase) before their compartments become untenably dangerous. Therefore, evacuation bottleneck areas should be avoided in the spatial design of a building. Currently, macroscopic and microscopic evacuation models are widely used to simulate the movements of individual evacuees. Macroscopic models use a network graph approach to compute the evacuation times for different areas and for the whole building. The computational speed of macroscopic models is generally higher than that of microscopic models. However, these macroscopic models do not consider the evacuees’ movement patterns. These models are therefore difficult to determine the bottleneck areas in the building layout. Microscopic models use an agent-based approach to simulate the movements of the evacuees and their interactions with each other inside the building environment. These models provide a very useful tool for discerning the details of evacuation patterns and allow building designers to visually identify the bottleneck areas. The designers can then adjust the building layout to improve the overall efficiency of building evacuation. The major shortcoming of these microscopic models is the length of time they require, as they involve extensive computation to predict the detailed movements of all evacuees. We propose to develop a grid-based mesoscopic evacuation model. The grid size of this model will be larger than that of the microscopic models (e.g., cellular automata models) because it will compute the flow of evacuee density instead of the individual movements of each evacuee. A density flow model based on the density-speed correlation will be developed. This proposed mesoscopic model will also allow local grid refinement for areas that require detailed analysis. When the grid size is reduced to 0.43 m x 0.43 m, the mesoscopic model will become a general cellular automata model (i.e., a microscopic model). When the grid size is enlarged to occupy a whole room or corridor, the mesoscopic model will become a general node-and-link model (i.e., a macroscopic model). The proposed mesoscopic evacuation model will run faster than the traditional microscopic models, and provide more local detail in terms of pedestrian movement than the traditional macroscopic model. 在建筑物发生火灾的情况下，低效率的疏散系统，可能导致因过久暴露于充满烟雾环境下的高死亡率。逃生系统的设计可让人员在当场未达到不能生存条件前可撤离火场㸒到达安全的地方（例如走火楼梯）。因此，建筑物内空间设计应避免有任何逃生瓶颈区域。目前，宏观和微观人流疏散模型已被广泛用于模拟建筑物逃生。宏观模型使用网格的方法来计算不同地区和整个建筑的疏散时间。宏观模型的计算速度一般比微观模型高。然而，这些宏观模型没有考虑个别撤离人员的运动模式。因此这些模型皆无法确定建筑布局的瓶颈区域。微观模型基于代理的方法来模拟建筑环境内撤离人员的动作和它们之间的相互作用。这些模型为疏散设计提供了详细信息，并提供了一​​个非常有用的工具让建筑设计师来确定布局中的瓶颈区域。然后，设计者可以调整建筑布局以提高建筑物疏散的整体效率。这些微观模型的主要缺点是花相当时间计算，因为它们涉及大量的计算来预测所有撤离人员的具体动作。我们建议开发一个基于网格的介观疏散模型。该模型的网格大小会比微观模型（例如，细胞自动机模型）的大，因为它会计算疏散者的密度，而不是每一个撤离者的个别运动的流动。我们将发展基于密度速度相关的密度流模型。此模型也可作区域性的网格细化作领域详细分。当网格尺寸减小到0.4米乘0.4m时，介观模型将成为一种普遍的微观模型。当网格尺寸被放大占据了整个房间或走廊，细观模式将成为一个普通节点和链路模型（即宏观模型）。这可以使细观疏散模型的运行速度比传统的微观模型速度更快，而且在人流方面比传统的宏观模型提供更多的局部细节。

11203615.label: Realisation of objectives
11203615.value: 1. The grid-based floor field scheme has been successfully developed. We applied this floor field model to create the field of our adaptive grid system to guide the evacuees getting out of the fire room. Evacuees are supposed to move from a grid to one of its neighboring grid with the lowest floor field value. Traditional floor field schemes are developed for evenly distributed structured grids. The novelty of our proposed scheme is purposed to create floor field on the map with uneven grids. Since the uneven grid system largely reduced the number of grid of the traditional scheme, it works much faster than the traditional floor field schemes. 2. The evacuee density model in form of a set of differential equations has been developed. The most novel feature of the evacuation model is not simulating the movement of individuals but the movement of the evacuees' density. Traditionally, scientists and engineers developed evacuation models to track the movements of all evacuees so that the movement patterns and overall evacuation time can be estimated. The final results are usually required to be converted to density contours on the map for building management to identify the bottleneck areas. Instead, our model directly calculate the density flow of the evacuees. The grid size of less dense area is enlarged to save the computational time which the grid size of high density area is reduced to observe the movement of individuals. 3. The developed mesoscopic model has been implemented into MATLAB platform for simulation. 4. The simulation results of our developed mesoscopic model were compared with the simulation results obtained from Anylogic. It was found that the results are similar but the computational time is greatly reduced.

11203615.label: Major findings and research outcome
11203615.value: Instead of the traditional approaches to simulate the detail movements of all evacuees, calculating the evacuees' density flow on the layout has proven to be much more efficient. In order not to sacrifice the feature of identification of bottleneck area, the grid size of our model at bottleneck areas is reduced to capture the individual movements. Therefore, our developed mesoscopic evacuation model not only owns the merit of fast computation but also is able to capture the bottleneck areas of the architecture layout. The model development and also the evaluation of model performance are reported in the published paper listed in Part C.

11203615.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11203615.value: The current model focuses on evacuees' movement with traditional floor field implemented. In future, the floor field will be modified to reflect the route choice behavior of the evacuees which should be related to the distances to the exits, densities of evacuees in front of the exits and also the queuing times of the exits, etc. All these considerations will be implemented into the adjusted floor field scheme which will be able to dynamically change in the whole course of building evacuation.

11203615.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11203615.value: The design of building evacuation system is one of the major factor to the overall building fire safety. Traditional approaches simulate the movements of all evacuees to estimate the overall evacuation time and also identification of bottleneck area of the architectural layout of the building. However, such models becomes inefficient when the building is mega scale of super-high-rise. We successfully developed a building evacuation simulation model which puts large grid size at less dense areas and small grid at high density area. It does not track the evacuees' movements but calculate the density flow of the evacuees which dramatically improves the computation efficiency for simulating large area evacuation. Since small grids are put at high density areas, the movement patterns at the bottleneck areas can also be captured.

11203815.value: 多態可修系統的可靠性分析及維修

11203815.label: Project Objectives
11203815.value:  Develop realistic and dynamic MSS reliability models  Study component importance measures for dynamic MSS  Investigate repair and maintenance strategies for dynamic MSS
rows:  Develop realistic and dynamic MSS reliability models
 Study component importance measures for dynamic MSS
 Investigate repair and maintenance strategies for dynamic MSS

11203815.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11203815.value: This research aims to investigate several important problems associated with the reliability analysis and maintenance modeling of multi-state repairable systems. Research on multi-state systems (MSSs) is becoming increasingly important because traditional binary-state system models are simplistic and cannot address the degradation and maintenance issues of complex systems. This research aims to study some of these pressing issues. First, we will examine common dynamic systems to explore their full potential. We will mathematically formulate the dynamic process of MSSs in operation for reliability evaluation. Markov and semi-Markov processes will be utilized to develop dynamic multi-state reliability analysis models. One important problem in this aspect is to construct reliability models based on statistical uncertainty, component reliability, and system structure. Second, we will employ uncertainty importance measures through reliability modeling of dynamic MSSs to determine the components that are most likely to cause uncertainty in the system’s unreliability and will reduce this uncertainty by improving the unreliability estimation of these components. In the reliability analysis, uncertainty importance measures will be utilized to quantify the contribution of a component to system performance at a nominal point. Uncertainty (global) sensitivity measures are related to output uncertainty, whereas probabilistic (local) importance measures are related to the output itself. Uncertainty importance measures quantify the contribution of the uncertainty of component reliability to the uncertainty of system performance. Finally, according to the most important component, we will investigate several practical decision-making issues related to the maintenance of multi-state repairable systems (e.g., selective maintenance of MSS under imperfect maintenance). We will then study the issue of preventive selective maintenance scheduling over a finite planning horizon to reduce the maintenance cost and improve system reliability. Overall, the proposed MSS reliability models will involve the reliability evaluation and modeling of dynamic MSS, uncertainty importance measures of components in dynamic MSS, and maintenance strategies for dynamic MSS. A world-class manufacturing company will support the project by providing all the necessary data for the simulation, testing, and implementation of the newly developed methods to determine the industrial implications of the project. A reliability software company will also provide life data for verification from its wide client base, including oil and gas, mining, and chemical process industries. 本研究旨在探討多狀態可修系統的可靠性分析與維護建模相關的幾個重要問題。由于傳統基于系统成败的二態模型已經无法应对複雜系統的退化和維護問題。多狀態系統（MSS）研究的重要性日益凸显，本研究旨在研究其中的一些緊迫問題. 首先，我們將针对一般動态系統来研究其潛在應用。我們將建立MSS動態過程的数学模型用於可靠性評估。用马氏过程和半馬氏過程來建立動態的多狀態可靠性分析模型。在這方面的一個重要問題是構建基於統計不確定性，部件的可靠性，以及系統結構的可靠性模型。 其次，我們將对動態MSS的不確定性做重要度分析，以確定最有可能在系統中引起的可靠性问题的元部件，并將通過提高這些部件的不可靠性估計來減少這種不確定性。在可靠度分析中，不確定性重要度將用於量化在元件对系統性能的貢獻。不確定性重要度與輸出不確定性有关，而概率重要度則描述輸出本身的取值范围。不確定性重要度主要用于量化部件可靠度的不確定性对系統性能的不確定性的影响。 最後，根據最重要的元部件，我們將研究與多態可修系統相關的幾個實際的決策問題 (如 MSS的不完善選擇性維護）。我們亦將研究在有限規劃週期内的選擇性檢修計劃，來降低維護成本以及提高系統的可靠性。 綜上所述，本项目的研究包括動態MSS的可靠性評估及建模，動態MSS元件的不確定性重要度測度，以及動態MSS 的維修策略问题。某世界级制造企业将为本研究项目提供所必需的模拟、测试数据，以及所提出新方法的实施，从而验证该项目的工业应用潜能。某可靠性软件公司也将从其石油燃气、采矿、化工等行业的广泛客户资源中提供所需的寿命数据用于验证。

11203815.label: Realisation of objectives
11203815.value: The research objectives are fully achieved and we have accomplished much more, together with some excellent students and postdocs. A number of good papers are published in leading journals in the field. Four students are partially funded and involved in this research, and they have received their PhD. Some have received faculty positions in UK or Australian university. A couple of students will submit their thesis soon. The research activities in relation to the project objectives that were carried out during this reporting period are described below. (The research papers are corresponding to Section 7: journal publications) (1). Develop realistic and dynamic multi-state system reliability models. In the research proposal, we propose “The system state can be dynamically assessed by involving the time variable and assuming that the Markov chain captures the movement of the component (system) state. The dynamic process of MSSs can be presented with Markov or semi-Markov models.” The corresponding research activities are as in the following.  We used Markov processes or Semi-Markov processes to describe the dynamic behaviors of multi-state systems. The paper was published with the postoc Hongyan Dui (2018). The dynamic behaviors are described by the random transitions among system states. Based on the models, the time-varying state probabilities of the multi-state systems can be obtained and their reliabilities over time can be derived taking into account the statistical uncertainty.  With another postdoc, Lin et al (2016) consider the reliability of systems experiencing both degradation and random shock processes. The dependencies between degradation processes and random shocks, and among degradation processes are explicitly modeled. The degradation processes of system components are modeled by multi-state models (MSMs) and physics-based models (PBMs). The piecewise-deterministic Markov process modeling framework is employed to combine MSMs and PBMs, and for incorporating degradation and random shocks dependencies taking into account the system structure and component reliability.  With a PhD student, Wang et al. (2016) study an interval analysis for solving cold-standby system reliability optimization problems with considering parameter uncertainty. A definition of interval order relation reflecting decision makers’ preference is proposed for comparing interval numbers. Based on a discrete approximation approach of time-to-failure distributions of system components, a technique of interval universal generating function was introduced to evaluate the system reliability and the expected mission cost. Then, a sequencing optimization problem for a heterogeneous cold-standby system was studied for the purposes of illustration. Then a genetic algorithm-based approach was developed to solve the optimization problem. The results have shown that the interval analysis is a useful tool to deal with cold standby system optimization problems with parameter uncertainty. (2). Study component importance measures for dynamic multi-state systems. In the research proposal, we investigate advanced methods of calculating system reliability. These methods might be revised to calculate the importance measures of individual, pairs, or groups of components. The corresponding research activities are as in the following. We (in Dui et al, 2015) extend the integrated importance measure (IIM) to the semi-Markov processes, and present several propositions of the IIM for semi-Markov processes in the typical series and parallel structures. Some of these propositions give the condition that one component state is more important than another. The results are useful for designers and maintenance managers to identify which component state generates more improvement considering transition rates and state probabilities. In a follow-up paper, Dui et al. (2018) analyze the Birnbaum importance measure, integrated importance measure, composite importance measure with respect to the changes of optimal system structure in the system lifetime. (3). Investigate repair and maintenance strategies for these models. In the research proposal, we investigate the problem of MSS preventive and selective maintenance scheduling over a finite planning horizon. The corresponding research activities are as in the following. Wang and Yam (2016) study the issue of preventive selective maintenance scheduling over a finite planning horizon. Since the repair effect may be varying with the number of repairs, we propose a generalized geometric process (GGP) to model the deteriorating process of a repairable system. For a GGP, the geometric ratio changes with the number of repairs rather than a constant. Based on the GGP, three repair-replacement models are studied. Firstly, assuming that the consecutive operating times of a system after repair constitute a decreasing GPP and the successive repair times form an increasing GPP, the long-run average cost rate of the system is derived, and the optimal replacement policy is determined by minimizing the long-run average cost rate. Secondly, a periodic preventive repair model is addressed, since preventive repair is more economic than corrective repair. A new maintenance model based on the geometrical deterioration of the system after both preventive and corrective repairs is confirmed. The optimal maintenance policies are obtained. Finally, because the system deteriorates after repair, the schedule times to preventive repair should also decrease with the number of repairs.  We also proposed to “Multiple resources (cost and time) in the selective maintenance modeling of an MSS and their effect on maintenance decisions will also be considered.” The corresponding research activities are as in the following. Dui et al. (2017b) discuss the optimization of different preventive maintenance policies by means of the use of cost-based IIM. When a component fails, a preventive maintenance may be performed on some other components. Importance measures can be used to identify the most important component for maintenance. However, there are two problems: a) the preventive maintenance time of the selected component may be bigger than the maintenance time of the failed component; b) the component with the larger importance may have the biggest maintenance cost. Considering the joint effect of component maintenance cost and time on the system reliability, a cost-based IIM is proposed to identify which component or which group of components may be selected for preventive maintenance. Dao and Zuo (2016) studied the sequential preventive maintenance problem for a piece of equipment used under varying loading conditions. The failure rate function has an increasing trend over time and it is also affected by the loading level. The proportional hazard model is used to capture the effects of loading on the failure rate function. When an imperfect maintenance is performed on the equipment, the age reduction model is used to capture the effects of the maintenance activity. If a sudden failure is experienced by the equipment, minimal repair is performed. Replacement may be performed on equipment if needed. An optimization model is developed for determination of preventative maintenance and replacement time points for the equipment whose service is needed in a given finite planning horizon.

11203815.label: Major findings and research outcome
11203815.value: The major findings and research outcome are as follows. (1) The system state can be dynamically assessed by involving the time variable and assuming that the Markov chain captures the movement of the component (system) state. The dynamic process of MSSs can be presented with Markov or semi-Markov models. The reliability evaluation for large dynamic MSSs are investigated to consider that component state distributions change overtime. (2) Recognizable patterns for the change in minimal path and/or minimal cut vectors may exist depending on the degradation behavior (a few patterns of such degradation can be formulated). We utilize these patterns to establish efficient system state distribution evaluation algorithms. (3) We investigate advanced methods of calculating system reliability. These methods might be revised to calculate the importance measures of individual, pairs, or groups of components. The components that are most likely to cause uncertainty in system unreliability must be determined, and such uncertainty should be reduced by improving the unreliability estimation of these components. This condition leads to the study of the uncertainty importance measures of components. Uncertainty importance measures quantify the contribution of the uncertainty of component reliability to the uncertainty of system performance. (4) We investigate the problem of MSS preventive and selective maintenance scheduling over a finite planning horizon. Multiple resources (cost and time) in the selective maintenance modeling of an MSS and their effect on maintenance decisions will also be considered. The desired component state after maintenance can be determined based on the state of the components before maintenance, system demand during the next mission, and available resources.

11203815.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11203815.value: In the applications of industrial systems, the components are dependent. Thus, in order to strengthen the scientific value of the proposal in the real applications, we will study the multi-state systems with multi-state dependent components and the modelling and analysis of such complex scenario is challenging. Furthermore, we intend to propose some new importance measures to identify the most influential components when considering maintenance policies adopted in the system life cycle. Joint analysis of maintenance and spare parts is one of the most important aspects in elevating the operational performance of a repairable system to the required level. To improve system performance, decision makers should take account for the maintenance, storage and allocation of spare parts. We will consider applying for another GRF or CRF as the scope will have to be extended.

11203815.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11203815.value: System performance levels gradually deteriorate when systems become old, and decisions on whether to replace a system or continue to maintain and repair it must be made. This research considers multistate systems instead of binary state system. It incorporates repair and maintenance policies to develop analytical solutions that are practical for realistic system operation. Some new importance measures differ from traditional importance measures, which are utilized to quantify the contribution of a component to system performance The new approaches for the dynamic evaluation and prediction of system state reliability are developed. Environmental shocks, maintenance efficiency, and aging impact are considered. Dynamic evaluation and prediction of the system state result in improved time-saving and cost-saving maintenance decisions.

11204115.value: 世界衛生組織近日將柴油廢氣列為“明確的致癌物質”。然而，因為顆粒物產生的確切的潛在健康損傷機制在很大程度上仍然未知。其中，關鍵的半揮發性顆粒物組分起到至關重要的作用。本項目主要目的是要了解半揮發性顆粒物組分在路邊環境的物化轉換及其對行人曝露受到的影響。我們也將研究半揮發性物種對活性氧的形成導致顆粒物毒性的貢獻。該項目的結果將深入了解半揮發性顆粒物組分在城市路邊環境的作用及對行人健康的影響。

11204115.label: Realisation of objectives
11204115.value: The proposed study was carried out at a roadside site in comparison with a background site, representing traffic-driven and ambient environments, respectively. The objectives set for the study were achieved in a chronology of experiments such as diurnal profiles of particulate matter (PM), role of temperature in gas-particle partitioning, and their contribution towards cellular oxidative stress. In brief, the diurnal profiles of PM carried over 24 hours, included real-time measurements of black carbon (BC), particle-bound polyaromatic hydrocarbons (p-PAHs) and their effect on oxidative potential was measured in-line in real-time. This approach, identified the varying specific trends of these pollutant concentrations and effects at roadside and background sites across summer and winter seasons. Further, a thermodenuder (TD) was employed in determining the role of a controlled temperature (in the range 50 - 200oC) in the interaction of semi-volatile (SVOCs) components with particles, where BC, p-PAHs and oxidative potential changes were noted in real-time. In addition, time-integrated filter sampling was carried out to collect particles (Solid-PM) and SVOCs individually for stipulated time intervals across 24 hours, which further led to the investigation of the degree of oxidative stress in cell cultures that resulted in postulation of a new toxicity mechanism. Firstly, in diurnal profile study, the air quality monitoring was conducted at two sampling sites one each representing urban background (lat. 22.33498873; long. 114.1735967) and roadside (lat. 22.328126; long. 114.1614786), both located within 1.5 km range. The measurement period was during 7 Jan 2016 - 17 Oct 2016 that included both sites and seasons. The real-time diurnal measurements of BC, p-PAHs and particle size distribution were carried out using AE33/AE51 (Magee), PAS2000 (EcoChem) and SMPS with DMA 3081 (TSI) over a period of 24 hours a day, and is repeated for 6 days, though on alternate days, spanning two weeks at each sampling location, which resulted in sampling of 4 weekdays and 2 weekends. In addition, the change in oxidative potential measured through the quantitation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) was measured in real time using Particle-into-Liquid-Sampler (PILS) every 2 hours during the sampling period for both total PM2.5 and gas phase PM. The PILS was indigenously designed in-lab at Queensland University of Technology, Australia. A new profluorescent nitroxide probe (BPEAnit) was employed in the real time measurement of ROS. The particle concentration at both sites, had a high degree of variation over 24 h sampling time. The background site recorded 0.5- to 1-fold higher (n=6; p<0.05) than the roadside site, especially during winter, suggesting possible coagulation processes with aerosol particles. The sub-micron particle size distribution too varied between the two sites, with background site noting greater variation in the size range 17.5 nm to 40 nm at different intervals. While roadside site has shown good agreement in BC and p-PAHs diurnal trends, background site had comparable trends for fewer data points. Both their concentrations peaked during 8:00 to 18:00 h at background site compared to roadside's 8:00 to 22:00 h. In addition, speciation between weekdays and weekends show higher variation in diurnal patterns of these emissions. The diurnal trends of ROS, recorded with every two-hour interval, didn't show any significant change between the studied time intervals. These aspects have addressed partly all the three objectives set for this study. Secondly, the role of temperature can influence the presence of semi-volatile species in the particle phase, which was investigated utilizing the BPEAnit probe for a continuous real-time identification of ROS in gas PM and total PM2.5 using Particle-into-Nitroxide-Quencher (PINQ, upgraded version of PILS) at various temperatures to study the dynamics of semi-volatile species and their possible role of driving particle phase induced-oxidative potential. For this, the above stated urban background site was selected. The ROS measurements were carried out in real-time using PINQ. The sampling periods were during 14 Nov 2016 - 18 Nov 2016. The thermodenuder (TD) was designed in the laboratory based on the principles of earlier reports. The TD was operated at four different temperatures - RT (25oC), 50oC, 100oC and 200oC to analyze the effect of temperature gradient on ROS changes, BC, p-PAHs and PM size distribution (measured in real-time as stated earlier). In addition, a dusttrak (DT8532, TSI) was employed to quantify PM2.5 passing through the TD (herein called as TD-PM2.5). On the other hand, another dusttrak (DT8530, TSI) was employed separately to measure the ambient PM2.5 mass concentration (herein called as Ambient-PM2.5) to determine comparative evaporation of VOCs in TD. A characteristic decreased trend of BC and p-PAHs with decrease in ambient- and TD-PM2.5 mass concentration was noted when analysed per m3 of air. However, when analyzed per TD-PM2.5 mass the evaporation of VOCs was noted through increased determinations of p-PAHs and BC. A loss of 7% PM2.5 was noted in TD, followed by losses of 13%, 21% and 34% TD-PM2.5 at temperatures 50, 100 and 200oC, respectively, compared to the ambient PM2.5 suggestive of evaporation of particle coatings. The ROS was measured in real time for both incoming TD-PM2.5 (herein after called as total aerosol) and for gas phase. The total aerosol has consistently induced more ROS quantification than its corresponding gas phase, at each temperature, by 16% (at ambient condition), 17% (at TD-RT), 21% (at 50oC), 23% (at 100oC) and 35% (at 200oC). In summary, the impact of temperature on the gas-particle partitioning of semi-volatile species was analyzed to address the specific role of semi-volatile species in eliciting real-time oxidative potential changes as listed in Objective 2 & 3 completely. Lastly, the time-integrated filter sampling was carried out at the same two sampling sites representing roadside and urban background, employing a high flow rate sampler of 50 lpm. Two samplers each installed with two 47 mm quartz filters were used to facilitate the collection of particulate solid-PM and gaseous semi-volatile PM (SV-PM) on front and back filters, respectively. The PM2.5 sampling was carried at both sites during 12 September 2016 to 2 January 2017 spanning summer and winter seasons, comprising of 6 sampling days for a given season-site combination. Each sampling day was divided into three sampling intervals of 6 h each - 4 to 10 AM, 12-6 PM and 8 PM to 2 AM, representing morning rush hours, afternoon and sublime late evening to night periods, respectively. A total of 288 quartz filters were employed for the particulate PM2.5 and SV-PM sampling. The PM and ECOC mass concentrations were measured and related to cell exposure studies later. Two cell lines namely RAW 264.7 murine macrophages and A549 alveolar epithelial cells were employed in the determination of effect of type of PM extract (water or organic solvent) on cell toxicity. A 100% viable cells were considered for the experiments namely cell viability, endogenous ROS (endo-ROS), Hemoxygenase-1 (HO-1) and Tumour necrotic factor - alpha (TNF- ) assays. While the cell viability assay was helpful in determining PM dose level to cells, the endo-ROS measurements revealed the status of cellular oxidative potential following the PM exposure. The relative effect of cellular oxidative potential on various stages of cellular toxicity such as cellular anti-oxidative defense and inflammatory responses were studied using HO-1 and TNF- respectively to address mainly the objective 3, which concluded the overall study. Moreover, these experiments employing different cell lines helped in proposing a new toxicity mechanism.

11204115.label: Major findings and research outcome
11204115.value: From the diurnal studies it was found that oxidative potential in particle phase correlated well with the PM2.5 and with lower concentrations of BC at the roadside during working week. However, these correlations were weaker during weekend. As profiles of PM2.5 and BC were very similar on a busy roadside site, it was concluded that the traffic was the main source of BC in PM. Higher correlation between ROS and primary pollutants as well as lower correlation with ozone, used as a marker for secondary pollutant formation, indicated that most of the ROS in both particle and gas phase is coming from fresh emissions from the traffic during both summer and winter seasons. These accomplished results were transformed into a couple of publications. Subsequently, in the temperature-ROS effect studies, the ROS concentration was noted decreased with increase in the temperature of TD. It is in good agreement with the reduced mass concentrations of PM2.5, PM0.5, and p-PAHs with an increase in the temperature. It concludes that the particles which contain a greater quantity of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) display a concomitant increase in their ROS measurements (as seen in non-heated ambient PM2.5) compared to heated particles (at 200oC) which are noted to have a reduced VOC concentration. While the total aerosol and the gas phase induced ROS had no significant difference between them at no-heating condition, the gas phase induced ROS was significantly less than its corresponding total aerosol-induced ROS at 200oC and is conclusive of partitioning of semi-volatiles between particle phase and gas phase and was adequately discussed in the attached research publication. This was further evident from the in vitro cellular toxicity analysis. It was noted that the RAW264.7 macrophages are more susceptible to PM compared to A549 epithelial cells given their variations in cell membrane makeup. The SV-PM fraction was noted many folds capable of inducing oxidative stress in cells compared to its counterpart Solid-PM considering the quantity of PM available, especially during summer season. Of the two sampling, Roadside is able to cause significantly increased oxidative stress compared to background sites. Also, while the oxidative stress is noted high during afternoons at roadside, background site has seen night times as more influential period. The in vitro toxicity mechanism is being discussed in a research article that is still under preparation. So, in total, four research articles have arisen from this funded research work.

11204115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11204115.value: The ozone concentrations acquired from the environmental and protection department, government of Hong Kong, showed rise in their concentrations similar to that of the formation of new particles suggesting signature of secondary photochemical reaction products. When compared with BC concentrations, we have realized that these newly observed particles are mostly likely secondary. Interestingly, at the same time when ozone levels were rising with particle number, measured ROS concentrations were going down. We do not have an adequate explanation for this observation. However, we find it very interesting and a further, more detailed research is necessary to understand the influence of ROS during particulate growth and aging. The result may be due to the depletion of ROS used for secondary transformation of primary particles, process which did not change overall oxidative potential significantly, or it may mean that these particles did not have any, by our real-time ROS measuring technique. On the other hand, the time-integrated filter sampling has allowed us to hypothesize a novel cell toxicity mechanism, which further has a potential to study in deep by assessing the hydroxylation status of nucleic acids following inflammation. The nucleic acid hydroxylation can lead to onset of genetic-mutation finally resulting in carcinogenesis.

11204115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11204115.value: The airborne particulate matter (PM), which in association with volatile organic compounds, transitional metals, and etcetera poses adverse pulmonary and cardiovascular health effects, whose complexity increased with source and spatial apportionment. In a city like Hong Kong, where more than 7 million people densely populated are prone to different levels of PM exposure based on living standards. This study is aimed at comparing time-resolved trends of PM induced oxidative potential at an urban background and vehicle-influenced roadside sites, during the winter and summer seasons in the year 2016. The PM mass concentration alongside the black carbon and polyaromatic hydrocarbons were generally noted in high quantities during 8 AM to 8 PM at roadside compared to background site, especially in working days but with no significant comparisons between summer and winter seasons. The PM when speciated into particulate and semi-volatile fractions, the latter was found to induce comparably significant oxidative stress in cells over the particulate fraction suggesting the gaseous semi-volatile PM fraction can't be ignored because the phospholipid cellular membrane makeup facilities immediate interaction with these semi-volatiles rather than with particulate PM, and a similar mechanism can be implied to human respirator system that could results adverse health effects.

11204215.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204215.value: As the advent of cloud computing and cloud storage systems, more and more people and organizations chose to outsource their data to the cloud servers. Since the cloud servers are not fully trustable, to protect data privacy, people usually encrypt the data before outsourcing it to the cloud. As search has become a most primary way for users to retrieve the data they want, but it is extremely difficult to do search on encrypted data in the cloud. The existing works on searchable encryption can be classified into two categories: exact keyword search and similarity keyword search. Both types of search limit the power of search for users. The principal goal of this project is to develop a scheme that facilitates Generalized Pattern-matching String-search on Encrypted data (GPSE for short). GPSE is a powerful search function, which can support SQL-like queries and give users great flexibility to specify targeted search. The project consists of three major tasks: 1) Design a framework for GPSE. We will design a general framework for GPSE, such that a wide range of search operations defined by various pattern matching rules can be realized in it. 2) Design algorithms to support commonly used pattern matching rules in GPSE. We will focus on the commonly used matching rules for search, such as substring matching, prefix matching, suffix matching, and design algorithms to realize them in the framework of GPSE. 3) Design schemes to support joint queries in GPSE. We will design schemes in GPSE to support search by joint queries that consist of multiple subqueries joint by logical operations, such as AND, OR, or NOT. 搜索已经成为用户获取所需数据的重要途径，然而搜索加密的云数据是极其困难的技术。可搜索的加密技术的研究现状分为两类：精确词搜索和近似词搜索。然而这两种搜索技术限制了用户搜索数据的范围。本项目在于研发一种针对加密数据的基于模式匹配的字符串搜索机制（简称GPSE）。GPSE不仅能够支持SQL模式的查询，而且能支持用户灵活地指定搜索目标。本项目的研究内容分为如下三项： 1） GPSE的框架设计：支持多样化模式匹配规则定义的搜索操作。 2） GPSE的算法设计：支持普遍使用的模式匹配规则，例如子字符串匹配，前缀匹配，后缀匹配。 3） 支持联合查询语句的机制：GPSE的查询支持联合查询语句。该联合查询语句由多个子查询语句用逻辑连接符（例如AND, OR, NOT）连接而成。

11204215.label: Realisation of objectives
11204215.value: The project is successfully executed and we have achieved all the objectives specified in the proposal. The major achievement in related objectives are summarized as below. 1) We developed generalized string matching scheme over encrypted data. The first scheme was developed for task matching (recommendation) over encrypted data in crowdsourcing systems. In Crowdsourcing platform, task owners publish their tasks and requirements to the server, and the workers who would like to take tasks from the platform submit their interests/qualifications to the server. Due to the security concern, both task owners and workers can encrypt their data before submitting to the server, and the server has to recommend the tasks to the best matched workers. We first assume both task requirements and workers’ interested are in keywords (strings). We proposed a new proxy-encryption method to solve the problem of encrypted string search of tasks in a multiple task owners and multiple workers setting. 2) We further developed an efficient and generalized geometric range search on encrypted spatial data in the cloud. Geometric range search over encrypted spatial data is a more difficult problem than the string search. We proposed an efficient scheme by utilizing the advance SSE (symmetric searchable encryption) primitives to search encrypted spatial database without revealing the location of the user to the server. We further proposed a value matching scheme over encrypted range of values for the application of outsourced firewall packet inspection (see next point). 3) We proposed a secure and dynamic packet inspection scheme in outsourced middleboxes. Nowadays, many organizations outsource their firewall functions to cloud servers. However, cloud servers are not fully trusted. Therefore, the organizations encrypt the traffic filtering rules of firewalls and outsource the encrypted firewall rules to the cloud servers, and the servers will be able to filter out the packets by inspecting the packet header against the encrypted firewall rules. The traffic filtering rules are often expressed in joint Boolean conditions, such as AND, OR, and NOT. We proposed the efficient schemes for fast matching of packets over encrypted filtering rules.

11204215.label: Major findings and research outcome
11204215.value: The project is a fruitful one. We have achieved all the project goals through the development of three major technologies as following: 1) We developed an efficient and generalized geometric range search on encrypted spatial data in the cloud. Geometric range search over encrypted spatial data is a more difficult problem than the string search. A string search over encrypted data can be achieved through deterministic encryption and the matching of ciphertext. But, to compare whether a value is within a range over encrypted data is a lot more difficult. We proposed an efficient scheme by utilizing the advance SSE (symmetric searchable encryption) primitives to search encrypted spatial database without revealing the location of the user to the server. The work was published IEEE/ACM Annual Conference IWQoS 2017. 2) We developed a task matching (recommendation) scheme over encrypted data in crowdsourcing systems. In Crowdsourcing platform, task owners publish their tasks and requirements to the server, and the workers who would like to take tasks from the platform submit their interests/qualifications to the server. Due to the security concern, both task owners and workers can encrypt their data before submitting to the server, and the server has to recommend the tasks to the best matched workers. The general framework of privacy-preserving task matching was published in IEEE GlobeCom 2016. A more sophisticated scheme for encrypted request-requirement matching in a multiple task owners and multiple workers setting was published in IEEE Trans on Service Computing, Jan 2018. 3) We proposed a secure and dynamic packet inspection scheme in outsourced middleboxes. Nowadays, many organizations outsource their firewall functions to cloud servers. However, cloud servers are not fully trusted. Therefore, the organizations can encrypt the traffic filtering rules of firewalls and outsource the encrypted firewall rules to the cloud servers, who will be able to filter out the packets by inspecting the packet header against the encrypted firewall rules. The challenging issue is to perform this encrypted matching in a high speed (packet-switching speed). The general string matching scheme over encrypted rules was published in ACM Asia CCS 2018. Another scheme that matches the packet over encrypted range values was published in IEEE/ACM Annual Conference IWQoS 2018.

11204315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204315.value: Coordination control of networked dynamic systems has been extensively studied with many applications in multiple mobile robots, multiple biomedical devices, unmanned aerial vehicles, and so on. In many applications, the number of subsystems in a networked dynamic system could be very large to strengthen reliability, scalability, and robustness of the whole system. An economical design in hardware realization of such networked systems would equip each subsystem with a simple embedded micro-processor and low-cost communication and actuation modules. This low-cost hardware design would normally yield limited onboard energy resources and low-level capabilities, which thus present new challenges in control of such networked dynamic systems. One of the key challenges is to design appropriate communication protocols and control strategies for such networked systems so that their limited onboard energy resources can be saved and their operational life-span can be prolonged. This motivates researchers to investigate and develop event-based schemes instead of current periodic sampling schemes for those networked dynamic systems. It has been shown that event-based schemes could potentially save a large amount of energy for control systems and thus prolong their operational life-span significantly. However, the recent literature review has revealed that many critical issues on analysis and synthesis of event-based control of networked dynamic systems, such as heterogeneous subsystem dynamics, switching toplogies, robustness to uncertainties and environmental disturbances, communication constraints, have not been well addressed. These issues, if not well addressed, would greatly degrade the performance of networked dynamic systems. Thus more advanced theories, techniques, and tools addressing those issues for event-based control of networked dynamic systems are warranted. This project will investigate and develop novel approaches to event design, stability analysis, and event-based distributed controller synthesis of networked dynamic systems with heterogeneous subsystem dynamics, switching toplogies, uncertainties, environmental disturbances and communication constraints. The outcome of this project is expected to enrich the theoretical foundation and also provide more solid analysis and synthesis tools in study of networked dynamic systems. 網絡化動態系統的協調控制問題已在多移動機器人、多生物醫學裝置、無人駕駛飛行器等應用領域中被廣泛研究。在很多應用中，網絡中子系統的數量可能會相當龐大，以便增強整個網絡的可靠性、可擴展性和魯棒性。從硬件實現角度來看，這類大規模網絡化系統較爲經濟的設計方式是爲每個子系統配備簡單的嵌入式微處理器和低成本的通信和驅動模塊。然而，低成本的硬件設計將給系統帶來有限的可攜帶能源和較低水平的工作能力，對系統的控制提出了新的挑戰。其中壹項重要的挑戰是如何設計合適的通信協議和控制策略，使得子系統能節約有限的源能，延長其工作壽命。這促使科研人員深入研究並開發基于事件的采樣控制策略來取代當前的周期性采樣控制策略。已有研究表明，基于事件的控制方法能爲控制系統節約大量的能源，從而顯著延長系統的工作壽命。然而，現有的文獻顯示，基于事件觸發方法的網絡化動態系統中，系統分析和控制律設計有許多關鍵性問題，如異質子系統動態、切換網絡拓撲、系統不確定性、對環境擾動的魯棒性、通信限制等，仍沒有較好的解決。顯然，如果這些問題不能很好解決，將大大降低網絡化系統的性能。因此，對于具有上述各類限制的網絡化系統，亟待提出更加先進的理論、技術和工具。本項目針對帶有異質子系統動態、切換拓撲、不確定性、環境擾動和通信限制的網絡化系統，將深入研究並開發新的事件設計和穩定性分析方法，以及基于事件觸發的分布式控制器綜合方法。項目的成果將有望豐富網絡化系統研究的理論基礎，並爲該類系統提供更加堅實的系統分析和控制器綜合方法和工具。

11204315.label: Major findings and research outcome
11204315.value: we have investigated event-based control of heterogeneous networked dynamic systems with environmental disturbances, model uncertainties, and/or communication constraints. We have developed a number of novel event-based control approaches. The key idea is to embed an internal model for each subsystem if disturbances can be described by a dynamic model and then use the cooperative output regulation framework to deal with them; and to apply robust cooperative control approaches if the disturbances cannot be described by a dynamic model or if the subsystem is subject to unmodeled dynamics/communication constraints. Several novel event-triggering mechanisms have also been developed with which the critical Zeno behavior can be excluded. The proposed approaches have been applied to several typical examples including coordination of mobile robot networks. As a result, several top-tier papers have been published.

11204315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11204315.value: It has been found that event-based approaches can be utilized to reduce the number of samplings in control of networked dynamic systems, in particular, the communication load between neighboring subsystems or agents, and thus save resources of the underlying systems. However, the current results are more or less qualitative. It is interesting to further investigate the same event-based systems in terms of quantitative results in future.

11204315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11204315.value: Coordination control of networked dynamic systems has been extensively studied with many applications in multiple mobile robots, unmanned aerial vehicles, and so on. In many applications, each subsystem would be equipped with low-cost hardware which yields limited on-board energy resources and low-level capabilities. This motivates researchers to investigate and develop event-based schemes instead of current periodic sampling schemes for those networked dynamic systems. In this project, we have investigated several critical issues on analysis and synthesis of event-based control of networked dynamic systems, such as heterogeneous subsystem dynamics, switching toplogies, robustness to uncertainties and environmental disturbances, communication constraints. Several novel event triggering mechanisms and novel event-based control approaches have been developed for coordination control of networked dynamic systems. The critical issue of Zeno behavior has been successfully addressed. The outcome of this project is expected to enrich the theoretical foundation of analysis and synthesis of event-based networked dynamic systems and also provide control engineers in practice with more solid analysis and synthesis tools in study of networked dynamic systems. These approaches are also expected to have wide application in practical networked dynamic systems.
