11601415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11601415.value: This project intends to examine the impacts of the neighbourhood in an increasingly mobile world. The neighbourhood is an important arena, not only to peoples’ creation of identity and social networks, but also to many government policies that aim at solving social problems. Yet as people are increasingly mobile and the need to interact with neighbours decreases, it begs the question of whether the neighbourhood is still significant to individuals. There is, however, ample evidence that patterns of mobility are highly varied among people of different backgrounds and mobility differentials may be widening. Thus, it is possible that the neighbourhood may continue to be significant but its impacts may not be the same for different groups of people. This project will employ a smart phone app which has been newly developed by the research team to track people’s mobility and activity patterns. Such data will be combined with information on personal attributes that are collected from a survey and with neighbourhood attributes derived from a variety of sources in order to examine the impacts of mobility on people’s sense of neighbourhood and neighbouring interaction. This research will cover 1250 residents in 25 neighbourhoods in Hong Kong. Hong Kong, with its popular and efficient public transport system as well as a large but relatively mixed public housing sector offers a distinct research site for comparison with the findings of similar research which has been conducted in the very different urban contexts of US cities. The research will offer valuable inputs to social mix and neighbourhood-based social policy as well as inform and extend theoretical debate on neighbourhoods within the new mobilities perspective. 本研究希望探討在高度移動的社會對住宅社區的影響。住宅社區是一個重要的領域，它不僅影響人們的身份認同與社會網路，也與很多社會政策與社會問題息息相關。但當人們越來越移動時，他們與鄰居的互動的需要越不重要，這衍生一個疑問：住宅社區對人們是否仍有意義？在這裏，我們也知道，不同背景的人的移動規律其實很多元化。有可能住宅社區對很多人仍然重要，但對不同人的影響就更明顯。借助本研究團隊新開發的智能電話程式，追蹤及收集人們移動與活動的模式。這些數據將結合從問卷調查收集的個人數據，及不同來源的社區數據，研究移動規律對人們的社區歸屬感及鄰里互動的影響。這研究計劃將在25個社區訪問1250人；香港高效率的公共交通網路及規模龐大但相對混合的公共房屋社區，提供了一個獨特的環境，對比在國外完全不同的都市環境下的相關研究。本研究可以為社會融合與社區為本的社會政策，提供有用的數據；這同時有助發展「新移動社會」理論下的住宅社區研究。

11601415.label: Realisation of objectives
11601415.value: Literature review and innovation in research methodology Integrating mobility in the study of neighbourhood is a relatively new research areas. In this project, we amalgamate knowledge on the sociology and social psychology of the neighbourhood with cutting edge data collection and data analysis techniques in geography in tracking and manipulating movement of the individual with the aid of GPS. This research exploits the timely availability of accurate GPS records in ordinary mobile phones which greatly reduces the cost of data GPS collection which used to rely on expensive equipment. This research pioneers the integration of GPS information with data from traditional survey methods which greatly improves on coverage and precision of data collection. This project starts by conducting a thorough review on literature on both mobility and neighbourhood. It also worked in the beginning stage of the project to refine the data collection strategies and worked on initial approach in data analysis. Mobile app in tracking mobility and interaction In realising objective one “on mobility-activity patterns and the impacts of the associated mobility-activity patterns”, this research has carefully redesign the mobile app. In order to achieve a random sample of participants but at the same time gathered sufficient participants in one neighbourhood, a multi-stage stratified sampling strategy to select participants was adopted. From a sample frame of all public and private buildings in Hong Kong, a large sample of addresses were chosen by Region-district-residential estate (or tertiary planning units)- block - flat. Invitation letters were sent to the selected samples asking for their participation. A short questionnaire was sent to participants to have a screening process in order to achieve a balanced profile of age, education and economic status of the participants. Participants after the screening were invited to install an mobile app on their mobile phone and had it turned on for seven days to collect their daily movement. The app would prompt them to fill in information of their activities (with whom, doing what) if they stationed in one place for more than half an hour. A total of 87,000 invitation letters and pamphlets were distributed which successfully recruited 709 participants to the mobile app. The response rate of 0.8% was much lower than the rate of 1.33% we had in the pilot study. Yet there were only 445 participants who could eventually completed the seven day data collection on the app. Despite the mobile app we used in this research had been tested in a previous pilot study (supported by internal funding) but because of the frequent updating of the mobile phone operational system and the additional information we would like to collect, the app had to be redesigned. We had commissioned the AppLab in CityU which was the designer for the pilot study. Yet owing to some internal issues, the AppLab had frequent turnover of their RA and this greatly dragged the progress and quality of the app. This is further exacerbated by the problem of frequent updating of both the android and ios operation system as well as slight variation of android on different brands of mobile phones. Not only did it drag the progress of our recruitment but also seriously affected the enthusiasm of the participants as many of them continually encountered small but non-trivial issues in operating the app. This explains the relatively high dropout rates of the participants as they were often stuck in various stages of data collection. Even with 445 participants who had completed the 7 days of data collection (together with partial data collected from the 264 participants who dropped out), a large amount of data were generated. Yet issues in the app also makes the data checking and cleaning a difficult task and the progress was much slower than expected. We are still working on the mobility and activity data which were combined to generate the mobility-activity patterns of an individual over the seven days of data collection. This will result in the creation of mobility-activity maps for each individual participants. Telephone surveys on neighbourliness and sense of neighbourhood To address objective two on “the sense of community and neighbouring activities being moulded by patterns of mobility-activity”, a follow-up telephone survey was conducted to collect information on neighbourly activities and on their attitude towards their neighbourhood for participants who have completed the 7 days of activity mobility data collection. A total of 95 completed questionnaires were completed. There were also substantive dropout as we needed to spend time tediously checking their completion of the mobility-activities data. The long waiting time made some of the participants impatient. Surveys and indepth interviews with participants who did not have a mobile phone Yet the mobile app and telephone survey would miss out people who are not active user of mobile phone. Thus, to address objective three on “how people with different personal background and mobility-activity patterns conceptualise their neighbourhood”, further data collection on non-active mobile phone users is necessary. This is achieved by a face-to-face survey and indepth interviews. A professional survey organisation was commissioned to conduct a stop-by face-to-face interviews on randomly selected residential neighbourhoods that covered the public rental, private residential and subsidised homeownership estates. As the rate of non-possession of mobile phones in Hong Kong is very low (about 10% at the time of the survey), it is considered to be more cost-effective by conducting a non-random sampling strategy by approaching people at main entrances of the selected. A total of 255 successful interviews were completed. To further explore details of their daily mobility patterns and routines as well as their attachment to their neighbourhood and neighbours, indepth interviews were carried out. Subjects of interviews were residents of the neighbourhoods in which we have conducted the face-to-face interviews. They were identified by purposeful sampling methods, either via the elderly social centres or resident organisations or being identified by RA of the project in open space in the relevant neighbourhood. A total of 25 elderly people were interviewed, either individually or in small groups. Long interviews which lasted one to two hours were conducted to explore, with the help of a map of the neighbourhood and the wider district, their daily mobility patterns as well as their views towards their neighbourhood and their neighbours. A few of them who possess a smart phone were also asked to install the mobile app in offering a triangulation on their mobility-activity patterns. A total of 25 elderly people with age from 65 to 80 were interviewed. Additional work (not supported by this funding) was carried out in New York City (by a former RA of the project) using the same interview guides in Hong Kong with the intension to collect comparable data for a comparative study between Hong Kong and New York City. A total of 11 interviews were conducted in New York City.

11601415.label: Major findings and research outcome
11601415.value: With the improved public and private transport, people in city are increasingly mobile. This means they, on the average, stay less time in their residential neighbourhood. This is evident in our study with people in Hong Kong who are under the age of 60. Most of them would spend most of their time out of their residential neighbourhood (output #1 and #6). For these people their activity spaces are in fact quite limited as what would be expected. These spaces cover mostly the commuting trips between their work / study places and their home in week days but have a variety of activity-mobility patterns over the week ends (output #1, output #6). However, for students (output #1) and older people (output #3 and #4), they stay much longer in their residential neighbourhoods and interact more with their acquittances and friends. For the middle age cohorts, neighbourly interaction is almost irrelevant (output #6). Few of them know their neighbours and even if they do, the interaction is very brief. Yet on the contrary, for elderly people, the connection between mobility, sense of neighbourhood and social interaction is more interesting. Unless it is limited by their health or poor weather, they are very mobile and active, both within and beyond their neighbourhood. Their daily mobility routines around their neighbourhood maintain an important mooring function in reinforcing a sense of security. At the same time, channelled through their participation in the neighbourhood elderly social centres, they are able to preserve and create the weak ties they needed for casual helps. The cheap and efficient transport system in Hong Kong does facilitate their upkeeping of strong ties with close friends and family members outside of their neighbourhood (output#3). Compared with elderly people in New York City, elderly people is Hong Kong is much more mobile and being able to retain a healthy social life (output #4). With data from our pilot study, we found that mobility does enhance people who live in richer and poorer areas to interact, at least having the opportunities of brief encounter though the movement is more likely for people who lived in rich areas moving to areas where poorer people live but not vice versa (output #1). Initial analysis with a bigger sample also support such findings despite further examination on the connection between mobility and activities has to be carried out (output #6).

11601415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11601415.value: There are several areas which have potential for further development. First young people and the elderly groups show diversity in their patterns of mobility, social interaction and sense of belonging to the neighbourhood. The current study has uncovered some general patterns and more detailed ethnographic study would help to reveal the meaning underlying such patterns. Second, the current study which uses an app to tracks people’s mobility and a survey to explore their “off-line” social interaction. An extension of the current study to study their on-line activities and behaviour would extend our understanding of social interaction and belonging in the virtual world. Third, a large scale study using information of mobile phone usage would offer us big data in study people’s mobility and interaction at a larger scale. Such study has been experimental in some countries (like Estonia) though our current privacy laws may set hurdle to access such data. Yet techniques in randomising and anonymising data may help to s

11601415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11601415.value: This study examines the impacts of people’s movement within the city on their activity patterns and sense of belonging to their local neighbourhood using a combination of cutting edge technology on GPS on mobile phones and traditional social science data collection methods. It employs an app on mobile phones to track people’s movement within the city and enables the collection of a large amount of mobility data with unprecedented accuracy. Such data would help the researchers to make deeper understanding of the information they collected from surveys and indepth interviews on the patterns of social interaction and sense of belonging to local neighbourhood. This research found that the sense of belonging and interaction with neighbours have a big variety among people with different social background and personal attributes. Increased mobility within the city appears to be some negative impacts on social interaction and sense of neighbourhood attachment for middle age or young people. Yet for elderly people, the chance to be more mobile has positive impacts in extending their social circle and create a sense of mobile belonging while at the same time not having a negative impact on their attachment to the local community and their neighbours.

11601915.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11601915.value: 近地飞行器时空轨迹的直观视觉化研究

11601915.label: Project Objectives
11601915.value: To investigate visual strategies for better cognitive and perceptual understanding of multi-tiered spatiotemporal data through a study using stratified aerial traffic. To understand and interpret existing semiotic visual strategies and taxonomies for depicting multiple, interrelated datasets of spatiotemporal movement. To explore how effective visualization of complex systems can assist in bridging technologically separated industries and sciences for understanding and safety through analysis of how aerospace proliferation can be effectively relayed to those unfamiliar with the developments and their dangers. To respond to the rapidly emerging Asian presence in aerospace by exploring design strategies specific to aesthetic traditions influenced by the region’s heritage and culture. To produce 10-15 animated visualizations of multiple aerial strata using established industry datasets and commercially available modeling and mapping software. To disseminate both the data and videos to a larger community for further exploration as well as contribute to the broader theoretical base of data visualization and information display through this case study’s publication in academic journals and conference presentations.

11601915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11601915.value: 亚洲对“太空竞赛”的强势参与促进了高速的技术发展 (Guardian 2014; Blume 2007)。在近地球圈里，难以计数的无人机、廉航客机、直升机和天气采集装置，以及别的玩意儿在时刻飞舞。这些飞行器材究竟规模如何、数量多寡、占据的海拔高度飞行速度，海量的数据如果不进行视觉化处理，我们人类根本无法理解和预测，这就是为何视觉化技术正变得越来越重要 (Craglia et al. 2012)。然而我们已有的追踪系统都相互独立各不相干，只对各自相对应的飞行器负责，没有任何一个可视化模型能够同时追踪显示所有的飞行器。正因为如此，亚洲入军太空界将会继续扩大这个动态系统，而我们对其细况却一无所知。 制图学经过多年发展，早已将来自知觉心理学 (Kraak 2014)、有效设计和色彩策略(Bertin 1981)、互动学 (Rosling 2009)和现实主义与抽象 (MacEachren 2001)的多方面元素融入它们的4D数据视觉语言。新兴的信息艺术领域对数据的表现方式需要更精确，亦或是更为感性亦摇摆不定，随之而来的是更多更深入的研究(Garlandini et al. 2009)。尽管亚洲的强势入局，现有制图设计体系也并没有加入更符合亚洲传统的表现形式 (Kwan et al. 2014)。 现有的航空航天软件只显示自己的行业的资产，不同的海拔高度对他们来说就像是一条条车道。然而海拔之间的无形边界正在消失，2009年发生了由于飞行器数量过多导致的第一次太空灾难，两颗通讯卫星发生碰撞，致命的碎片在整个低轨道飞舞。中国在2007年至2010年间发射了用于摧毁监视卫星的天基武器​​，这给近地空间带来了更多的垃圾和碰撞。这两个重大事件由于当前的时空跟踪可视化系统不完善，均未能成功预测。而一个改进版的多层空间视觉模型对于飞行器的安全、公众理解、全球政策、环境讨论、艺术资源与政治经济的正常运行是至关重要的。 该项目旨在探索能更好地帮助我们感知多层次空间数据的视觉化策略。这些分层环绕地球的飞行器可以用经过视觉化数据糅合信息艺术来标注吗？我们能把符号学策略和分类轮廓合并成一种新的、跨文化的简明易懂视觉语言，把飞行器们的危险性清晰呈现出来吗？创意设计工具帮助我们看穿动态数据中的深层意义，进而更好了解其他的大数据集。 对科学数据的艺术化视觉化处理将为之带来新的含义。美国航空航天局最近的洋流动画是由他们的“梵高”设计师团队，利用从艺术史中借鉴的绘制法作成 (MIT Video, 2012)。该项目将研究现有的可视化科学数据，参考其中较为成功的图像表达。选择的飞行器轨迹数据将会被计算映射到其正确位置，并根据其不同背景、设计、速度、行为模式、视角等配以动画效果对预测轨迹一一进行标注。我们将以面向小团体公众和科学界的问卷调查形式对其结果进行测试。其公布的结果和在线视频等，将帮助我们揭示出针对复杂动态系统最为有效的视觉化方案，并将呈现于国际性会议如SIGGRAPH和ISEA，以及在Leonardo和the Journal of Aesthetics and Art Criticism等指导性刊物上刊登。

11601915.label: Realisation of objectives
11601915.value: The GRF grant has produced models, animations, technical drawings, cost estimates, course materials, scholarly research data, public talks and four exhibitions. One published and one pending journal paper resulted as well as two academic papers presented at international peer-reviewed conferences. 11601915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11601915.value: A juncture in the history of aerial traffic is occurring in which 1) private companies are replacing government agencies as the funding and technical leads and 2) artificial intelligence is replacing human visual response to safety issues. Further development would require access to data that is now secretive and privately held. The transition to data collected illegally by private citizens and released online against corporate directives will change both the tone and accuracy of the visualizations. However, the PI is currently producing a short film in partnership with Astos Solutions and historical datasets from NASA. Although not funded by this grant, it is the result of partnerships formed. The film recreates all 6,600 rocket launches that have passed the Karman Line (100km) since Sputnik in 1957. Using NASA’s data on weight, engine type, trajectory angle and payload, the PI and Astos recreated each launch and mapped them onto a globe based on launchpad location. Celestial Mechanics V: Reaching represents the first 70 years of space travel from a new perspective—showing the ‘Space Race’ as a series of launch trajectories occurring worldwide—and will be released online in Fall 2020.

11601915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11601915.value: Aerial congestion has become a problem that can potentially hinder safety and diminish the ability for space travel. The research identified the need for a multivariant visual system that accurately represents the current aerial reality. The history of visualization illustrates humanity’s innate need to organize information and represent reality. Rooted in the idea of ‘networks of networks’ and speculative design, each iteration of Celestial Mechanics visualizes different aspects of the aerial space—from the high number of aerial objects to the distance between them to eventually the movement of the objects and their trajectory. While on a quest to create the perfect representation of aerial space, Celestial Mechanics has become a snapshot that demonstrates the shifting away from data visualizations and moving towards data expression. Though the representation of aerial space may become less important with the advent of advanced technologies in artificial intelligence and machine learning, the human desire to capture trajectory and movement will live on in the form of emotion-evoking information arts for the years to come.

11602215.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602215.value: 錢穆先生指出，朱熹不僅是宋代理學的集大成者，也是宋代經史文章的集大成者。近年來，從文學角度研究朱熹大受關注。但是，研究者爲了彰顯朱熹著述中被忽視的文學因素，往往過多依賴于現代的文學觀念；研究者或重視文學與理學的關係，但是大多局限于理學對于文學的單向影響。可以說，現有研究缺乏一個宋代文學文化整體觀的視角。所以，本研究計劃以詩學觀念與唐宋思想變遷的關係為歷史背景，將朱熹放回到宋代整體文學文化的背景中，循此內在視角，重新思考朱熹在解釋《詩經》、《楚辭》、唐宋詩文時所秉持的觀念與方法，幷從朱熹本人的文學觀念出發，重新考察其創作實踐。本計劃不僅關注經學與理學的話語脈絡，還希望還原宋代詩文觀念對朱熹的影響，從而在朱熹的文學批評與寫作實踐中，揭示出宋代各種文學文化話語的互動關係。 As Qian Mu said, Zhu Xi not only integrated different tendencies of Neo-Confucianism, but also integrated classics studies, historiography and literature in Song China. More attention has recently turned to Zhu Xi’s literary achievements and literary thought. However, researchers rely on the modern concept of literature too heavily, or only observe the one-way influence of Neo-Confucianism over literature. Thus they seem to have overlooked the dynamics of historical and cultural context. We need a holistic view of literary culture in Song dynasty, considering the interrelationship between different discourses. This project aims to put Zhu Xi’s literary ideas and writing practices back to the dynamic background of literary culture in Song dynasty, and to expose the subtle interaction between philosophy, exegesis, aesthetic writing and literary criticism in Song Dynasty. To be specific, PI will re-examine some crucial concepts Zhu Xi used to interpret Shijing, Chuci and other literary works, re-examine Zhu Xi’s literary writing practices, with a view to tracing the dynamics of different discourses behind Zhu Xi’s criticism and practice. We will look at not only how philosophy tamed literature, but how literature continued to inform philosophy. In so doing, a panorama of literature culture in Song China and its inner logic could be eventually grasped. Ultimately, it is hoped that the project could contribute to our rethinking the intellectual transition of Tang and Song period.

11602215.label: Realisation of objectives
11602215.value: 本研究計劃的目標，已經全部完成。在細讀朱熹的《詩集傳》、《楚辭集注》及詩文批評的過程中，重點考察了比興、淫詩兩個概念（自然平淡概念的研究已經放在比興概念的論述中）。圍繞比興概念，完成了三篇論文，其中一篇專論《楚辭集註》中的比興詮釋體系，另分兩篇討論朱熹比興觀的時代語境，分別從唐代和宋代兩個時間段切入；圍繞《詩集傳》中的淫詩概念，完成了一篇論文，提出了朱熹的淫詩概念與宋詞文化的淵源關係；還有一篇總論朱熹文學觀念與宋代文學文化語境的整體關係，另有一篇總結朱熹比興觀念與宋代文化語境的關係，指出朱熹比興觀不僅根源於理學和詩學背景，還與宋代印刷文化的興盛有一定的關係。在總論朱熹文學觀念與宋代文學文化語境整體關係的文章、以及總結朱熹比興觀念與宋代文化語境關係的文章中，進一步梳理了宋代經學、理學、詩學等不同話語脈絡的互動關係，也關注到朱熹文學實踐與文學觀念之間的聯繫，及其與南宋詩文創作風氣的聯繫。本計劃所產生的論文，最初大多以會議論文的形式，在學術會議上宣讀，並聽取不同的意見而做了較大的修改，其中有兩篇論文，後以修改稿的形式再次宣讀。所有的研究成果，已被綜合成一部專著，書名為《朱熹與比興傳統》，已被上海古籍出版社接受並將於2019年下半年出版。在提交了書稿的大綱和初稿之後，又接受了編輯的意見，對初稿進行了大幅度的修改。書稿以朱熹的比興觀為核心，淫詩說因與比興寄託觀念密切相關，成為專著中重要的一章。最終的研究成果，突出了比興概念這個因素，令整個成果可以圍繞一個核心，充分實現了細緻而踏實的個案分析，最終又升華到宋代的整體文化語境，更好地體現出以小見大的研究理念。 後來的幾篇論文，因綜合各方意見，進行了較多的修改，定稿比較遲，加之審稿時間長，可能要到今年年底或明年才能正式在刊物上刊出。

11602215.label: Major findings and research outcome
11602215.value: 〈重探朱熹《楚辭集註》中的賦比興詮釋體系〉一文指出，朱熹《楚辭集注》賦比興論的系統性，未得到足夠的重視，其實朱熹建立了一個詮解意脈的賦比興體系，其原則是一個完整章節之內的不同語脈形式，而不僅僅是三種具體的修辭手法，朱熹論“脈絡次第”、“綱領”、“文詞指意”，論章節之內的“上下相承，首尾相應之大指”，都是在論述賦比興體系的根本原則。在探討唐代和宋代比興觀的兩篇文章中，突出了朱熹比興觀的時代語境及其特殊意義。〈重探朱熹比興觀的意義及其背景〉一文，強調了朱熹的比興觀是建立在語言形成層面的基礎之上，但其本質並不是指向修辭技巧，而是指向了一個完整藝術單位之內的意義本身的運行脈絡，這源自他本人思想體系中對於讀書方法的重視，也與宋代印刷文化的興盛有一定關係。討論朱熹淫詩說的文章，則發現朱熹淫詩說與傳統的比興寄託說的衝突，並嘗試從詞為艷科的時代語境和宋詞文化的發展角度來解釋朱熹淫詩說的淵源。〈宋代文學文化視野中的朱熹〉則是從整個宋代文化文化的宏觀視野，總結了朱熹文學觀念的意義和價值。

11602215.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11602215.value: 本計劃探討朱熹比興觀的部分，可以進一步發展，去考察比興觀在整個中國文學傳統中的演變。本計劃探討朱熹淫詩說的部分，可以進一步發展，去考察淫詩說在後代引起的回應，這個想法已經寫成完整的研究計劃，並獲得RGC的資助，項目名稱為“朱熹淫詩說在中國詮釋史和閱讀史的影響”，項目編號為CityU11600217。朱子學曾盛行於日本江戶時代，還可以進一步考察日本學者對於朱熹《詩集傳》中的比興或淫詩的各種意見，進行中日學術的比較研究，這是下一步的計劃。

11602215.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11602215.value: 現有的對於朱熹文學觀念的研究，缺乏一個整體文化觀的視角，因此本研究計劃以詩學觀念與唐宋思想變遷的關係為歷史背景，將朱熹放回到宋代整體文學文化的背景中，重新思考朱熹在解釋《詩經》、《楚辭》時所秉持的觀念與方法。本計劃提出，朱熹解釋《詩經》、《楚辭》所用的比興觀，還有他解釋《詩經》時提出的淫詩說，都可以從整個宋代文化文化的宏觀視野來考察，由此揭示出宋代各種文學文化話語的互動關係。

11602915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602915.value: The public perception of media credibility (or trust in the news media) is a frequently studied, albeit much contested concept in mass communications research. To develop a media credibility scale of high validity and reliability is a first step to understanding the complicated social interactions between the media and audience. However, a set of agreed-upon operational definitions for constructing a measure of media credibility is currently lacking. Some studies have used single items, such as “to what extent do you trust newspapers,” whereas others have adopted multi-dimensional scales based on the view that people consider multiple factors in formulating their impressions of the media. We argue that the recent measures of media credibility tend to overemphasize the role of journalistic professionalism. In other words, these measures assume that people only consider factors such as objectivity, fairness, and accuracy when they evaluate the media. However, empirical research has demonstrated that the public do not always process information systematically when judging the credibility of the media and that people are often influenced by their political identity, heuristic cues, and macro-societal factors. The primary goal of this proposed project is to develop a solid theoretical understanding of the factors influencing people’s trust in the news media and to produce a comprehensive empirical scale that is capable of capturing the rational and emotional processes through which people develop particular perceptions of the news media. To achieve this, we will first conduct a series of in-depth interviews and focus group discussions to gain a broad understanding of the factors that influence trust in the news media from the audience’s perspective. Based on the insights gained from the interviews and focus group discussions, we will then conduct a two-wave longitudinal audience survey in Hong Kong and use the results to construct a multi-dimensional model of trust in the news media. Our project will make a theoretical contribution to the field by shedding conceptual insight on the cognitive and emotional factors that influence the public’s judgment of media credibility. We expect that the measurement scale developed in this project will be applicable to a wide range of future academic studies on media credibility. The study will also help the media industry to better understand its relationship with the audience. 在大眾傳播領域，傳媒公信力或可信度的研究不勝枚舉，但“傳媒可信度”這一概念卻未有一個公認的內涵與定義。這一概念隱含了兩個主體：媒體和受眾。傳媒可信度不僅仰賴媒體本身的特徵，也在很大程度上反應了受眾對媒體特徵的感知和評價。因此若要從“媒體—受眾”關係的角度出發，厘清傳媒可信度研究中的諸多問題，首先需要一套學界認可且擁有較高測量信度和效度的量表。然而目前學界尚未在這一基礎性問題上達成共識。有些研究使用單一問題進行測量，詢問被訪對象“你在多大程度上信任報紙”。而有些研究則採用多維量表，以期勾勒出受眾綜合考量媒體各方面專業表現並做出可信度判斷的內在評價體系。然而，本研究認為,既有的量表在可信度測量中，過於強調新聞專業主義的重要性，長期忽視受眾的世俗經驗、主觀期待與新聞職業操守之間可能存在的認知錯位。在以往的研究中，人們通常從新聞專業主義的角度出發，綜合人們對媒體報道的客觀性、公正性、準確性等方面的評價作為該媒體的可信度得分。然而，經驗數據表明，在評價媒體可信度時，公眾並不總是全面考量媒體的諸多方面。心理學研究已經反復指出，人腦的信息處理能力有限，在做價值判斷時往往依賴有啟發性的個別信息做出評判。政治傳播和社會學的研究也表明，從微觀的政治興趣、黨派傾向到宏觀的社會結構因素等，均會影響人們對特定媒體的可信度評價。 本研究致力於完善傳媒可信度研究的理論框架，並旨在發展出一套切實可行的量表，將可信度評價過程中涉及的理性、感性等多個維度的因素納入到媒體可信度的評價體系中來。為實現這一目標，我們將首先採用深度訪談和焦點小組方法，對受眾視角下媒體可信度的評判標準做一初步探索。之後，我們將以深度訪談和焦點小組的結果為依據，對香港受眾進行兩輪的問卷調查，以期通過這種量化、質化相結合的方法，深化我們對受眾視角下的媒體可信度評價體系的理解。在此基礎上，我們將進一步修正傳媒可信度的有關理論，並提出一套新的、易於操作的多維量表。本研究的貢獻主要體現在以下三個方面：首先，通過對傳媒可信度評價過程中涉及的認知、情感等因素的系統梳理，修正傳媒可信度的相關理論。其次，本研究中提出的新的量表，將對未來的傳媒可信度研究有重要的指導意義。最後，通過將傳媒單一視角下的可信度研究還原到“媒體—受眾”的互動過程中進行考量，本研究將有助於媒體從業者重新審視他們與受眾的關係。

11602915.label: Major findings and research outcome
11602915.value: Most of the existing measures of perceived media credibility share a common assumption that journalistic professionalism is the primary determinant of the perception of media credibility. The key argument we advance is that the public also rely on emotional and heuristic factors to assess trust in news. In this study, we developed a multidimensional model of news media credibility, the expertness-trustworthiness model, and empirically tested it using confirmatory factor analysis. The model fits a panel data well and shows stable patterns across different news media, including newspaper, radio, TV, independent online media and social media. Overall speaking, our model shows high reliability and validity. Data analyses have shown that 1) this multidimensional scale measure is highly related to a single item measure of news media trust, 2) this multidimensional scale measure is robustly related to theoretical constructs that are supposedly related to perceived media credibility such as media use and political participation, and 3) this multidimensional scale measure explain more variance than a single item measure does. More specifically, our data demonstrated that trust in news media could be very well measured with two dimensions: expertness and trustworthiness. Under trustworthiness, there are two more dimensions: perceived user oriented consideration and perceived external influence over news media. After reliability and validity test, our measurement scale is composed of the following items. For expertness, we included accuracy, objectivity, fairness, believability, completeness, genuineness, authenticity, consistency, professionality, open-mindedness, and authority. For expertness, we included protecting democracy, concerning for users’ interests, liberalism, driven by money, and driven by political pressures. Our data analysis suggests that a third-order model fits the data better than the second-order model. Although we modified the original model, the study still reveals that news media trust is indeed a multidimensional concept. In addition, our study demonstrates that people do rely on heuristic information to formulate their trust in news media.

11602915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11602915.value: The further development of this research lies in two aspects. First, the multidimensional scale we developed is purely based on Hong Kong data. Despite the fact that the theoretical framework we rely upon is not country or culture specific, it is true that we only empirically tested this in Hong Kong. Is the outcome of this study only fits Hong Kong or it could be generalized to other societies? This remains to be seen. It is hoped that more studies will replicate what we have done in Hong Kong so that the validity and the reliability of this scale will be tested in multiple societies with different social and political contexts. Second, the main purpose of this study is measurement development. Although we did a few analysis on validity check, the relationship between news media trust and other communication variables are not fully explored. With this new multidimensional scale, we wish to move to the examination of the theoretical relationship between audience’s news media trust and other outcome variables.

11602915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11602915.value: The public perception of media credibility (or trust in the news media) is a frequently studied concept in communications research. To develop a media credibility scale of high validity and reliability is a first step to understanding the complicated social interactions between the media and audience. However, a set of agreed-upon operational definitions for constructing a measure of media credibility is currently lacking. The primary goal of this proposed project is to develop a solid theoretical understanding of the factors influencing people’s trust in the news media and to produce a comprehensive empirical scale that is capable of capturing the rational and emotional processes through which people develop particular perceptions of the news media. This study made at least three main contributions. First, the research makes a theoretical contribution to the field by shedding conceptual insight on the cognitive and emotional factors that determine the public’s perception of media credibility. Second, our empirical multi-dimensional measurement scale can be used in future academic studies on media credibility. Finally, this study also helps the media industry to understand its relationship with the audience better.

Publish an article presenting the project’s theoretical innovations, as well as its contributions to the literature on “historical institutionalism,” in a general journal in the fields of political science or sociology. 11603915.value: 2014年5月22日在泰國軍隊上演一場軍事政變，這是從1932年以來第十三次發動成功的政變，也是自70年代中期以來對公民及政治權利設下從未有過的限制。執政軍政府打壓異見人士、肅清公務員團隊、加強審查工作、任意拘留、搜查、扣押活躍民運及知識分子。似乎軍政府要確保能預防萬一民選政府再一次挑戰非民選機關的權力，才有意將泰國恢復文人統治，而其支持者誓要讓普通百姓重新融入社會而進入「歸順文化」(詳見The Nation, 25 July 2014)。一個人回到過去幾十年是為了尋找那種保皇主義制度的高壓政權，絕非巧合；尤其在泰國，由君主、軍隊、官僚及曼谷在50年代的舊有產階級所產生的聯盟。他們從來沒有經歷過像在2006年廢除受歡迎的總理他信那樣的一個深刻或廣泛性的信心危機。泰國保皇派的政治任命從未經歷過像在2006年廢除受歡迎的總理他信那樣的一個深刻或廣泛性的信心危機。為了力壓頑抗的百姓去服從保皇派成立的監管，自2006年以來，採取強硬措施的嚴重程度不斷升級，這反映保皇派的逐漸失去執政的合法性和道德權威。這是由於瓦解了階級的「皇家民族主義」 的文化霸權 ── 曾經一度讓保皇派盡量減少（以該地區的標準）訴諸他們的人身威脅。未能跟上選民不斷變化的步伐，泰國保皇主義會受到威脅，這也使86歲的普密蓬泰王（世界上任職時間最長的國家元首）的繼任遭到破壞。 此提擬計劃是在研究權力的合法性和去合法性，是著重闡明泰國保皇黨政治任命的掘起、廷伸、和衰退。從廣義上來說，此計劃的貢獻是雙重的。首先，這計劃會撰文於「歷史制度主義」這方面，這是跨越政治學和社會學的領域，通過植根於「權力動態」和「合法化的動力」的自我強化過程的運作，在使機構的繁殖和腐爛的意識上力求意義 (詳見 Mahoney 2000)。我們會在(甲)「微觀基礎」上提供制度的繁殖和腐敗的機制，是建基於「基本的心理反應」(詳見 Elster 2007: 42)去解釋個人的價值觀、喜好和信念是由他們的生活模式所形式；(乙)識別在繁殖與腐敗模式，以及是多與少可能的啟動條件；和(丙)探索權力動熊和合法性動力如何可以互動，即是：在一個相互加強或相互費力以有利於繁殖和腐敗的慣例。其次，這計劃會撰文於泰國的政治發展，是超越了大部分現在的研究而去探索保皇黨任命週期性波動的合法性，是由國家監管的意識形態灌輸的有效性的功能，去組裝一個社會科學的解釋。這個研究泰國的計劃所帶出的實證意義和創新理論都是依靠大量的官方檔和統計證據，也有深度訪談，由此去查明推動體系的繁殖和腐敗的心理機制過程進行評估。

11603915.label: Realisation of objectives
11603915.value: By the time the project officially started on 1 January 2016, most of the data collection efforts specified in the Project Timetable featured in the GRF application (Section 2(c)) under "Phase 1 (pre-grant)" were completed. With regard to "theory development," however, the project took something of a detour. Specifically, while it was originally expected that the effort to "improve upon existing explanations for the processes of institutional reproduction and institutional decay" (see Objective 1 above) would result in a single chapter/journal article (see Objectives 2 and 6 above), the theory development work conducted in the pre-grant phase grew so expansive as to convince the P.I. that the subject matter was sufficiently important- and the work's potential contribution to the general literature sufficiently promising--to warrant its own book-length treatment. The P.I. resolved to work on a book manuscript that theorizes processes of institutional reproduction, institutional decay, and institutional change first--while simultaneously supervising the collection of data related to Thailand (Objective 4 above)--before turning to the theory's application to the rise and decline of Thailand's royalist order (see Objectives 3, 5, and 6). Broadly speaking, therefore, the P.I.'s activities on both of these aspects of the project may be summarized as follows: 1. The P.I. has drafted a monograph dedicated to the specification of an improved general theory of institutional reproduction, institutional decay, and institutional change (see Objectives 1 and 2), whose working title is: "The Development of Political Institutions: A Synthesis of Power-Based and Ideas-Based Explanations." At present, the P.I. has completed each of the manuscript's five chapters, comprising roughly 80,000 words. The P.I. is currently in the process of finding a publisher for the manuscript, targeting first-tier academic presses rated A* or A for the purposes of PBPR. 2. The P.I. hired an experienced Senior Research Assistant, who spent over a year gathering evidence related to Thailand (see Objective 4). Aside from collecting and compiling much of the documentary evidence described in the original application, the SRA conducted dozens of detailed interviews with opposition activists living in Thailand as well as exiled dissidents residing in Cambodia (as described in the original application's "Project Timetable," Table 1, Section 2(c), under Phases 2-3). Some of the evidence gathered by the SRA is featured in two forthcoming publications, which feature a partial application of the project's theoretical framework to the case of Thailand (Objectives 3 and 5 above): -Ferrara, Federico. 2020. “The Logic of Thailand’s Royalist Coups d’État.” In Pavin Chachavalpongpun (ed.), The Routledge Handbook of Contemporary Thailand. London: Routledge, forthcoming. -Ferrara, Federico. 2019. “Understanding Thailand’s Domestic Political Conflict: Democracy, Social Identity, and the ‘Struggle for Recognition’.” In Pavin Chachavalpongpun (ed.), Coup, King, Crisis: Thailand’s Dangerous Interregnum. Singapore: NUS Press, forthcoming (exp. October 2019). A preliminary version of the first chapter was presented at a two-day workshop held at Stanford University in late January 2017. The evidence collected as part of the project will also aid the P.I. in the drafting of the planned monograph on Thailand (see Objective 6), the completion of which was delayed as a result of the project's unexpected turn. The P.I. will focus on that next, upon securing the publication of the book manuscript described above.

11603915.label: Major findings and research outcome
11603915.value: The main outcome of the research was the drafting of an 80,000-word book manuscript provisionally titled "The Development of Political Institutions: A Synthesis of Power-Based and Ideas-Based Explanations." The manuscript, which is currently being considered by a few academic presses, develops the project's theoretical framework, taking a “historical institutionalist” approach to theorize dynamic processes of institutional reproduction, institutional decay, and institutional change. A partial application of the project's theoretical framework to the case of Thailand is featured in two additional, article-length publications, which will appear in edited volumes set to be published in late 2019/20. Finally, the project resulted in the collection of dozens of detailed, hours-long interviews with Thai opposition activists, which were completed in spite of the fact that the country was under martial law for the entire duration of the project. A monograph based on the interviews in question is next on the P.I.'s research agenda.

11603915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11603915.value: The greatest potential for further development is in the hundreds of hours of recorded interviews of Thai opposition activists collected as part of the project. The interviews, which are currently in the process of being transcribed and translated, will serve as the centrepiece of a book manuscript to be drafted in the next year or two.

11603915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11603915.value: The project's major accomplishments include: (i) Assisting in the development of a social-scientific, general explanation for the development of political institutions, focusing on the processes by which political regimes acquire a measure of staying power, as well as processes of institutional decay and institutional change; (ii) Assisting in the compilation of hundreds of hours of recorded interviews of Thai opposition activists, some living in Thailand and some living in exile, providing a treasure-trove of evidence on the rise and decline of the country's royalist political order.

11604515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11604515.value: Access to water is a basic human right: it is essential for the full enjoyment of all other rights as well as to life itself. However, limited water resources worldwide, together with increasing aridization and desertification brought on by climate change, will likely engender many disastrous water conflicts around the globe in the absence of timely and effective cooperation. This project aims to examine the proper distribution and equitable use of Indus Water Basin (IWB), which traverses China, India, and Pakistan, and the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) between India and Pakistan, from multidisciplinary perspective. Although there are international law principles regulating such use, they cannot resolve disputes on their own. Rather, what is needed is increased cooperation between stakeholders on an international scale, which can be achieved by the negotiation of binding trans-boundary water agreements Indeed, the United Nations General Assembly designated 2013 as the ‘International Year of Water Cooperation’ to promote the equitable use of water. The premise of this research is that effective water cooperation requires an interdisciplinary approach and the involvement of all stakeholders. It aims to explore comprehensive inventory of variables that can become a basis of negotiation and determine the scope of cooperation between the stakeholders keeping in view the international watercourse principles, previous institutional aspects of IWT and conflicting national interests of China, India and Pakistan. The ultimate goal of this project is to provide a model framework for the use of the IWB as an instrument of peace. This study will examine all of the parameters, dilemmas and concerns of stakeholders that are relative to this region and need consideration in reaching a legal agreement. In doing so, the relative significance of each identified parameter will be measured to evaluate how far they can determine the scope of future solution on the IWB. 用水是一項基本人權：它是享受包括生命權在內的其他權利的基礎。然而，在缺乏及時、有效的溝通合作的情況下，世界水資源缺乏以及氣候變化引致的乾旱化與沙漠化加劇將可能導致許多全球範圍內的災難性水資源衝突。 本研究旨在從跨學科角度討論印度河流域（該流域穿越中國、印度與巴基斯坦三國）水資源的合理分配與公平使用問題，以及印度與巴基斯坦在1960年簽訂的《印度河水協定》。儘管現存國際法原則規範了此類資源使用，它們卻無法自行解決爭端。事實上，我們亟需在國際範圍內增進相關人士的合作，而這類合作可以透過磋商談判具有約束性的跨領域水資源協議達成。事實上，聯合國大會將2013年指定為 “國際水資源合作年”來促進水資源的公平使用。 本研究預設：有效的水資源合作必須牽涉所有相關人士，並且透過跨學科的方式實現。本計劃希望探討可成為相關磋商談判基準的綜合變量，且在全盤考慮國際水道原則、《印度河水協定》的制度方向以及中國、印度與巴基斯坦的國家利益衝突的情況下決定相關合作的範圍。研究的最終目的是為和平使用印度河水資源提供一個樣板框架。這一研究將考察涉及這一區域、或達成法定協議所需要納入考慮範圍的所有參數、兩難情況以及相關人士意見。與此同時，所有被指明的變量參數之相關重要性將在研究中得到評估，以探明它們將在未來印度河流域的問題解決中起到的作用。

11604515.label: Realisation of objectives
11604515.value: The objectives were achieved in the following ways: scholarly exchanges, particularly an international conference organized for this purpose at the City University of Hong Kong entitled ‘Frameworks for Shared Indus/Transboundary Waters: A Multidisciplinary Dialogue’ (henceforth, ‘Frameworks Conference’) and a subsequent Special Issue of the Journal of Water Law, with key contributors from the Frameworks Conference, on the 60th anniversary of the IWT: Patricia Wouters and Fozia Nazir Lone (Guest Editors), Transboundary Water Governance In Asia – Examining Regional Practice Through Multidisciplinary Perspectives, 26 Journal of Water Law 2020 (‘Special Issue’), contributing variables from international law, climate change, geography and foreign policy as determinants that can expand the scope of co-operation between the stakeholders, beyond the treaty framework of the IWT. Taking objectives 1 – 4 individually: 1. The travaux préparatoires of the IWT 1960 and other material have been gathered through a research trip to the British National Archives (British Library and National Archives (Kew)), as well as through literature review, which helped to clarify its objectives and purpose it served at the time it was created. This allows reflections on the limitations of the IWT while recognizing its success in withstanding the subsequent decades since its founding. The expertise of Professor Patricia Wouters, through the Frameworks Conference and co-guest editing the Special Issue, has been a key contribution, as she was consulted in an advisory capacity on the ILA Berlin Rules on Water Resources and her input is cited in the officially notes to the UN Convention on the Non-Navigational Uses of International Watercourses 1997. 2. A multidisciplinary review was undertaken, which included expertise from geographic/hydrological perspectives and national perspectives, to explore all parameters and conflicting national interests. The research project brought this role of China as an upper riparian in the Indus river system to the fore, developing discourse beyond the limited conceptualization of it being a dispute being India and Pakistan. Issues related to China were also addressed in a separate issue of the Journal of Water Law (F. N. Lone, (2020) ‘China’s International Water Law Policy: Some Reflections” Issue 26/4 Journal of Water Law 53-66). 3. The issues identified by the scholars at the Frameworks Conference and the Special Issue comprises legal, policy and practice-based analyses – deploying a multidisciplinary approach to evaluate the IWT in a contemporary setting. These were evaluated through 11 presentations and group discussions. In addition to the presentations that, after collaborative discussions, led to the papers published in the Special Issue, other multidisciplinary insights were offered at the Frameworks Conference as follows: ‘Revisiting the Regulation of the Indus – The 1960 Treaty and Beyond’ by Prof. Philippe Cullet (SOAS University of London; Centre for Policy Research, New Delhi); ‘Indus Water Treaty: Addressing Emerging and Common Concerns through Cooperation’ by Prof. Shakil Ahmad Romshoo (Head of Department of Geoinformatics, University of Kashmir); ‘Climate Change and Governance Challenges in the Indus Basin in Pakistan’ by Mr. Ahmad Rafay Alam (Environmental Lawyer and Activist, Pakistan); ‘Climate Change and the Right to Escape from a Transboundary River Agreement’ by Dr. Fan Zhang (Wuhan University China Institute of Boundary and Ocean Studies, China); ‘Geopolitical Imaginations of the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Mechanisms’ by Dr. Raymond Yu Wang (School of Government, Sun Yat-sen University, China). The discussions included consideration of China’s existing water sharing treaty agreements with other countries. 4. Through a legal lens, these multidisciplinary insights have been viewed as broadly relating to the ratione personae (the jurisdictional reach) and ratione materiae (the subject matter) of the transboundary water regimes across the region. As stated in the research proposal, it was the hypothesis of this research that geographical problems would not be handled by arbitrary man-made provisions or hybrid legal regimes. (Patricia Wouters & Fozia Nazir Lone, Introduction, 26 Journal of Water Law, 193-197, 2020 (Special Issue).) This research contributes to a solution based on conflicting variables could be changed into tools of peace. The Special Issue contains insights from experts and is an authoritative contribution to policy-makers. Given the findings, it is clear that a model solution would feature a prominent role for upper riparian China, integrating state (China, Afghanistan) and non-state (Kashmiri) stakeholders, integrating developments in international water law and best practice standards into a regional cooperation framework, and taking on climate adaptive measures. Regional models and precedents were evaluated. 5. Summarizing the Special Issue, the first two papers explore some of the important legal issues related to the IWT. Wouters study, ‘Longstanding Model, or Imperfect Agreement? Cotemporary Challenges for Regional Transboundary Cooperation’ uses a legal analytical framework to evaluate the treaty in light of global best practice (referring to the two UN Water Conventions), highlighting the similarities and differences in a comparative examination. In ‘Damming the Indus Waters: Thoughts on the Future of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty and Himalayan Water Security’, Lone discusses how the Treaty fails to take into account important riparian interests related to Kashmir; China’s absence from the agreement is also examined. Carty takes the discussion into the regional context examining China’s approach to international law as it relates to transboundary water governance. In ‘The Fundamentals of China’ Approaches to Dispute Settlement: An Asian International Water Law Regime in the Context of the Chinese Belt and Road Initiative’, Carty explores the premises of international water law and its interplay with the issue of state sovereignty. In ‘Scalar Water Politics and Competing Development Visions in Transboundary River Basins: What Role for International Water Law? An Examination of China’s Upstream Position in the Himalayan River Basins’, Hensengerth looks at China’s role as an upstream riparian and the implications of hydro-hegemony on water governance using a multidisciplinary approach. Selecting the Mekong as a case study, the author suggests that China’s transboundary water diplomacy depends directly on its domestic and foreign policy agendas. In ‘Producing the Indus Basin? Examining the Politic-Legal Building Blocks’, Mustafa and Kuemmerle utilize a ‘critical legal geographies’ analysis to explore the scalar dynamics of the basin, especially at the sub-national level. In ‘Assessing the Role of Legal Documentation in Transboundary Collaborations: A Comparative Analysis of Water Supply Projects in Hong Kong and Singapore’ the authors, Xu and Zhao examine the implications of regional power imbalances in the creation and implementation of water-supply related agreements, considering the Dongshen Water Supply Project. It reviews the relevant water rights, management and dispute resolution mechanisms to evaluate the impact these legal agreements might have on the relative power of the key regional parties. 6. This research project is also a contribution to cutting-edge cross-disciplinary research approaches. This allows us to take a wider view of a situation, thereby avoiding pre-conceptualizing problems, and developing a more accurate view. A purely legal approach to the IWB would miss the difficulties in its operationalization, factors that limit its scope (i.e. the environmental and human security factors that need to be incorporated) and the international relations/regional politics that inevitably need to be taken into account. Therefore, the multidisciplinary aspect of this project allowed it to ask broader questions and produce more reflective normative content, not constrained by existing concepts but taking operational and functional aspects into account to create new conceptual understanding. It also means that the scholarly output has a wider audience in a variety of fields.

rows: The travaux préparatoires of the IWT 1960 have been reviewed. It is expected that a research trip will be undertaken in early next year to review the official records of negotiation for the IWT in the British Archives, which will clarify its objectives and purpose it served at the time it was created and will reflect on whether it is outdated in the contemporary geopolitical circumstances.

Water treaties signed by China and its neighbours after the founding of PRC in 1949 have been generally reviewed. We found that China was influenced by Confucianism in the past, while international law was introduced as a result of the foreign pressure. As an upstream state, China did not welcome the Water Convention which restricts the rights of upstream states. The principle of absolute sovereignty was used as a justification. China preferred bilateral treaties to multilateral agreements because the former is more flexible and able to cope with Chinese's interests. Water treaties signed by China, and its neighboring states were usually concluded after the territorial matters have been solved. India and China are rapidly developing themselves and need water resources. However, the long-lasting territorial conflicts become the major obstacle to a water treaty between these two emerging powers. This aspect will be reviewed more thoroughly in the future.

From the perspective of geopolitics, the upper riparian position has been a major factor for China for not having water treaties with its neighbours. However, history, as we found, shows that China was also willing to sign treaties with North Korea, Russia, Mongolia and Kazakhstan. We see that scholars are hoping that the Kazakhstan model can be adopted by China when dealing with India in the future. Conversely, we learn that the problem is not as straightforward when the diplomatic complexity is considered. For example, the Sino-Soviet agreements were signed in the context of the economic support by USSR, while the long-lasting friendship between China and North Korea enabled them to have water agreements. As long as the Sino-Indian territorial conflicts remain it seems difficult for both states to have a water treaty. The further research would review how this obstacle could be overcome while considering the other parameters.

In the foreseeable future, the territorial conflicts have to be solved in order to initiate a negotiation for Sino-Indian trans-boundary waters. Another important finding is the Indian participation in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), which aimed at eliminating, the ‘three evils: terrorism, separatism and religious extremism. Further research on SCO is expected to be done in the future.

11604515.label: Major findings and research outcome
11604515.value: The Frameworks Conference provided an opportunity to gain further insight into, and evaluate, approaches to the Indus water governance issue. The cross-fertilization of knowledge ultimately contributed to the insights published in the Special Issue of the Journal of Water Law. The contributions from Wouters and Lone and the joint paper by Kuemmerle and Mustafa, amount to a specialist set of papers on this issue. These were collectively published with other contributions in the Special Issue to provide the insights in a single place, as an authoritative contribution to scholarly discourse on the 60th Anniversary of the Indus Waters Treaty 1960. It addressed ratione personae gaps (the non-inclusion of China (as the uppermost riparian) in the IWT– especially given the considerable water development projects along the basin. Other challenges such as the non-participation of key stakeholders across the basin, the territorial/water conflict over Kashmir, and a range of water security issues are explored as well) and ratione materiae gaps (especially the dearth of environmental protection provisions in the Treaty, increasing populations, growing water scarcity and climate change. While some of these gaps may be addressed through treaty interpretation, it was made clear that constraints exist – ‘… the agreement … expressly limits the extent to which the Court may have recourse to, and apply, sources of law beyond the Treaty itself.’ (The Permanent Court of Arbitration in the Kishenganga decision)). The Frameworks Conference and Special Issue papers illustrate how different disciplinary approaches contribute to a more complete understanding of the issues related to the Indus and regional transboundary governance. As revealed in this collected work there remain serious challenges to the Treaty in terms of its legal reach, normative content, implementation practices, and volatile geo-politics. The development of this multidisciplinary methodology to inform legal approaches could provide a springboard for improved transboundary water cooperation across Asia. The research output includes holistic multidisciplinary reflections on solutions to go into a model framework to complement and expand beyond the existing IWT structure; in the Special Issue, published on the 60th Anniversary of the IWT, the contributions form the basis of a model solution for the limitations in the IWT that primarily relies on drawing in China as an upper riparian, taking into account the territorial tensions and needs of the people in the disputed territories in Kashmir, and reflects developments in international water law and best practice in the past decades.

11604515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11604515.value: The research output is relevant for scholars in multiple fields and there is potential to conduct further research and disseminate views at domestic, regional and global levels to add to the necessary multidisciplinary dialogue on the sharing of transboundary watercourses. Due to the dynamic geopolitical situation in the COVID-19 era, including the escalating Sino-Indian border dispute, the insights on how the Indus Waters Treaty 1960 has remained in place despite conflict and other key insights from this research will form the basis for future research into the necessary work of achieving greater equitable usage of transboundary waters. Water treaties signed by China, and its neighboring states were usually concluded after the territorial matters have been solved so the escalations in the long-lasting territorial conflicts are a major obstacle India and China’s water cooperation. This aspect will be reviewed more thoroughly in the future. This research opens avenues to review Chinese water law policy as a upper riparian on another major river that it shares with India (Yarlung-Tsangpo River), a flashpoint situation where there is no existing treaty framework, and where there is an urgent need to study its relationship with India while considering their pending disputes.

11604515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11604515.value: The Indus Waters Treaty 1960 was, as demonstrated through this research project, was created for the immediate needs of its time with compromises made, and key stakeholders were excluded. International water law and policy has developed significantly, as have scientific findings regarding the implications of climate change and pollution in shared watercourses. Solutions have to be sought through a multidisciplinary methodology because of the complexities of the factors, including those relating to human security, affecting the river basin. The project ultimately sought to develop frameworks for peaceful solutions to problems with the existing Indus water governance system, examining the parameters, dilemmas and concerns of stakeholders that are relative to this region through multidisciplinary inputs through the international conference and Special Issue of the Journal of Water Law, and building a foundation for future discourse to understand the scope that needs to be covered in transboundary water governance in the modern era, assisting in reconciling the conflicting national interests and parameters of all the riparian states in the Indus water. It also adds value through its contribution to the understanding of the changing role of upper riparian China (including through the Lancang Mekong Cooperation and One Belt One Road).

11605115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11605115.value: 1949年中共建政之后，政府决意在毛泽东的领导下走社会主义 道路。在建筑设计领域，私营的设计公司逐渐消失，代之以的是 公私合营或公营的“建筑设计院”。设计院是共产国家机器的一 部分，实现社会主义建设的政治宏图。从首都省会、沿海都市 到地县乡镇，大部分建设的蓝图是由部属、省市级的设计院绘 制的。随着国家外交政策的开展，中国的设计院在第三世界发展 中国家也完成了几百项“援外”工程任务。1978年后，中国实行改 革开放政策，城市和乡村都经历了巨量的建设。1990年代，私营 建筑设计事务所开始运行，私营设计回到了中国市场。大量私营 和海外建筑公司参与了中国的大小建设项目。在这种情况下， 国有设计院仍然占据主导地位。 国际上的主流设计公司，都是私营体制。中国的其他服务行业 如律师和会计师，已经全面私营，而设计院依然大多国有。 关于中国现代建筑，已经有大量文献，但关于设计院体制的研究 却寥寥无几。本项研究拟探讨关于中国设计院的几个突出问题。 （1）1950年代国营设计院的创立，以及私营事务所的消失； （2）意识形态和设计的关系； （3）1980年代改革开放后的设计院情况； （4）个人和大设计院的关系； （5）中国设计院的援外工程。 申请人在大中华地区建筑研究已经发表了多本专著和百余篇文章 ，此项研究将深入到设计实践体制，在中国的政治和文化制度下 ，系统研究国有设计院的发生、发展和转型。本项研究将显示 国营大设计院的特别意义和价值，对建筑历史和政策制定做出 理论和实践的贡献。

11605115.label: Realisation of objectives
11605115.value: For Objective 1, we have investigated the history and activities of design institutes in China from 1950 up to now. The history is written into several papers and a monograph book. For Objective 2, we particularly study the contribution of design institutes in the multi-layer era of the open door policy and in the 21st century, for example, their works in sustainable development and urban design. For Objective 3, we have identified a series of excellent individual architects in the state-owned design institutes in large Chinese cities. For Objective 4, we have investigated the works and history of design institutes in construction aid activities in the developing world, especially in Asia, Africa, the Oceania and Latin America.

11605115.label: Major findings and research outcome
11605115.value: Through four years' study, we have systematically discovered and concluded the contributions of state-owned design institutes in China in the past 70 years. These include the initiation of design institutes in China during the earlier period of socialist construction, fulfilling government's tasks in Mao's era, floating and swimming in the ocean of market economy, individual studios within big design institutes, university run design institutes and construction aid in foreign countries. The state-owned design institutes develop in the dichotomy of integrating collectivism and individualism, mediating between embeddedness and emancipation, and balancing pragmatism and commitment. In the 21st century, the other professions, like law and accounting, are gradually privatized. However, the state still controls the large scale design institutes. Through market merging, some design institutes are staffed with over 5,000 people and their annual turnover can be compared with international giant firms. If state still plays a strong role in economy, state-owned design institutes will exist and develop further as a machine and tool for the country's progression.

11605115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11605115.value: As a continuous action of the project, we plan to investigate how individual architects grow in different periods in the 1950s, 1990s and the 21st century. We will carry on study of design institutes' works in overseas, especially how the gift works displaying role for a civic and fair environment in the developing countries.

11605115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11605115.value: Through four years' study, the team has systematically discovered and revealed the contributions of state-owned design institutes in China in the past 70 years. These include the initiation of design institutes in the People's Republic of China during the earlier period of socialist construction, fulfilling government's tasks in Mao's era (1950-1966), floating and swimming in the ocean of market economy, individual studios within big design institutes, university run design institutes and construction aid in foreign countries. The state-owned design institutes develop in integrating collectivism and individualism, mediating between embeddedness and emancipation, and balancing pragmatism and commitment. If state still plays a strong role in economy, state-owned design institutes will exist and develop further as an effective machine and tool for the country's progression and modernization.

11606215.label: Major findings and research outcome
11606215.value: 1. In jurisdiction where classification of claims for the purposes of schemes of arrangement is relevant, in dealing with classification issues, (i) the concept of "commercially different right" is unnecessary (ii) there is no need to place, in a separate class, claimants who are wholly owned subsidiaries of the scheme proponent, if the rights of the wholly owned subsidiaries are similar with other claimants, and (iii) the reasonable and rational person test that Hildyard J put forward in the Re Apcoa case on claimants' ability to consult is efficient and should be endorsed. 2. Courts should have the power to sanction a proposed scheme even if the scheme meetings are incorrectly classed. This can be done on the basis of the rules on procedural irregularity. 3. Given that the Hong Kong Court of Appeal's obiter in the Legend International Resorts case, which is negative on the rescue roles of provisional liquidators, makes no doctrinal or policy sense, the provisional liquidation under Hong Kong's Companies Ordinance should be able to be deployed as a moratorium tool. For research outcome, please be referred to Part C.

11606215.value: 1. Questions posed under objectives 5.3 and 5.4 are still worth pursuing. 2. Research on how companies having connections with Singapore may take advantage of Singapore's new restructuring rules will be useful. I will be conducting research on the above mentioned topics.

11606215.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11606215.value: This project has answered a number of questions on how schemes of arrangement as a corporate rescue device may be deployed at a higher level of flexibility. The scheme of arrangement is a company law procedure that can be used to restructure the company's relationship with its shareholders or creditors. Creditors' schemes, which functions to change the creditors' rights without the creditors' unanimous consent, is a useful statutory tool to save companies in financial distress.

11606515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606515.value: This project is a substantial development from the PI’s previous research output: (1) a combined experimental corpus of the complete 544 poems by Wang Wei and Meng Haoran; (2) a theory-informed conceptual framework for (3); (3) a hierarchical tree-structure of ontological-cognitive entries under four rubrics: Entities, Events, (material) Attributes, and (subjective/mental) Values, supported by dictionary-like term-banks of single-/multi-character words and allusions found in the corpus; (4) an online data-annotation platform; and (5) semantic annotation and tagging of the 4000+ words in the corpus, with proper nouns and context-sensitive metaphors/allusions identified and annotated to make their semantic properties and/or cultural/contextual/metaphorical implications of all the words computer-readable. Task 1 of the proposed project is therefore to design a search engine that integrates all the modules listed above, to perform (a) basic data search, e.g., by author and/or subject, (b) advanced search including computation of semantic elements to reveal their logical relations at word/verse/ text levels, and (c) in-depth and integrated concordancing at the level of underlying semantic elements to generate cognitively or poetically related collections of words/verses/poems with their bibliographic sources and annotations readily accessible. For example, by entering search words ‘window’, ‘spring’ and ‘sad’, the system will gather all the verses/poems that have been annotated to match these semantic elements for poetically or cognitively meaningful investigations, no matter ‘window’ is expressed in the actual texts as 窗, 軒or牖, ‘spring’ as 春, 柳絮or 花, and ‘sad’ as 悲, 哀, 傷or 愁, for instance. Task 2 is thus to realize the potential of this innovative methodology for poetry studies. It will search the corpus by specific combinations of search words to generate collections of data for observing relevant imagery configurations in a particular (groups of) text(s) as empirical support for an in-depth study on the ‘poetic vision’ (意境) in terms of interactions between: 1) ‘scene’ (景) and ‘emotion’ (情); 2) time and space; 3) the actual (實) and the virtual/mental (虛); 4) the static (靜) and the dynamic (動), all being fundamental yet (so far) elusive concepts in Chinese poetics. Findings will be published to report on advances in such research as well as to illustrate the applicability of our system and methodology, e.g. in (collaboratively) studying other (Chinese) poets and/or poetic concepts beyond the scope of this project in an empirically more rigorous manner.

11606615.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606615.value: 標題：在成果導向的香港精神健康系統下結合傳統精神康復治療與用戶個人康復療效計量 背景：包括香港在內，全世界的精神醫療系統的發展都在迅速走向一種「康復模型」，然而人們並未注意到這其中對「康復」一詞的重新定義。服務用戶定義下的個人恢復（擁有激勵、希望、自我感知、人生意義和目標）正在逐漸取代傳統康復定義（比如不再復發、癥狀緩和、良好作用）。事實上對這兩種康復計量非常普遍的需求并未得到重視，且這兩種恢復類型應如何互相聯繫也並不為人所知。因此，爲了使香港“成果導向的精神健康系統”包含更多個人康復計量的信息，我們迫切需要進行探究傳統療法和個人療法間關係的研究。 研究目標： 1. 探究個人康復與康復促進環境計量工具的心理測量學特性及跨文化適用性。 2. 探究傳統康復和個人康復之間的關係。 3. 取得服務用戶對個人康復計量法的評估。 4. 辨認分組下的服務用戶曾接受過兩種療法、還是任意一種、抑或是兩者皆無。 5. 確定辨認分組的預測因子。 方法：參與調查的服務用戶（N=375）將會依照康復階段被分為三組：「思覺失調」服務計劃的參與者（N=125）,醫院管理局門診患者（N=125），以及精神健康綜合社區中心的服務對象（N=125）。受訓后的研究助理將會使用一份由五項個人康復測量、一項康復促進環境測量、和世界衛生組織生活品質問卷組成的用戶調查問卷來評估傳統康復療效，並對其心理計量學性能（內部一致性，因素結構）進行評估。就文化關聯性和吸引力方面的問題詢問受調查用戶：a.是否有遺漏或不適當的項 b.給每項計量工具打分。建構聯合個人康復計量、傳統康復和世界衛生組織生活品質問卷（WHOQOL-BREF）的有效性。獲得結果的最大四分位數將會用來幫助判斷用戶是接受了傳統療法，還是個人療法，或是二者皆有或皆無。使用二項和多項對分數模型來研究不同療法分組下用戶的特徵、服務類型、以及康復促進環境預測因子。 重要性： 對兩種精神健康治療的普遍性、共存性及預測因子的全面探究目前只在發達國家有已知研究。這是在香港的相關研究中第一次同時評估所有指導性的個人康復計量工具，也是目前已知唯一的在個人療法效果評估中徵求服務用戶反饋的研究。

11606615.label: Realisation of objectives
11606615.value: A total of 368 service users have been recruited for three different types of community psychiatric services including early intervention service, general adult outpatient service and local integrated mental wellbeing centers. Objective 1 The psychometric properties of all the five objective recovery questionnaires have been tested and the reliability of all five personal recovery scales and RSA was found to be good (Cronbach’s alpha >0.90 for all scales). All five personal recovery measures were found to be significantly correlated with each other, ranging between r = 0.681, p<.01, and r = 0.837, p<.01. We have also found the all five measured of personal recovery were correlated with the recovery promoting environment in Hong Kong measured with a qeustionnaire (RSA). Objective 2 Relationship between the objective recovery and clinical recovery including clinical remission and functional recovery was explored using both univariate analysis and hierarchical multiple regression analysis to control for the demographic variables and the clinical diagnosis. We found the RAS and SRS were the two objective recovery measures significantly related with CGI (clinical remission) and SRS was significantly related with SOFAS (functional recovery) in the hierarchical multiple regression analysis. The variance ranged from 21 to 25 % in explaining the clinical recovery. All five objective recovery measures were also correlated with the quality of life (QoL)measure. Objective 3 A qualitative statement was added to each of the subjective recovery questionnaire to explore the views of the service users about these measurements. All measurements were considered as user friendly. There seems to have no differentiation between the different measurements. Objective 4 The current set of data allows for the analysis which will be conducted later. Objective 5 We found that patients who are female with religion and were in the early intervention service have better subjective recovery.

11606615.label: Major findings and research outcome
11606615.value: Our study observed statistically significant correlation between all five measures of personal recovery, as well as between the personal recovery measures and scales measuring symptom remission and functional recovery, self-reported quality of life and recovery-oriented service environment. The Stage of Recovery Scale (SRS) was the only personal recovery measurement significantly associated with both CGI (β = -0.284) and SOFAS (β = 0.184) after controlling for diagnosis and the model was significant in explaining 25.7% variance of CGI and 21.8% variance of SOFAS. This did not change with the inclusion of diagnosis as a control variable. A manuscript has been prepared with this results and have been submitted for publication.

11606615.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11606615.value: The relationship between a recovery-oriented environment and measures of personal recovery highlights the need for workplace and organisational transformation to provide evidence-based, service-user level (e.g., one-to-one interactions, relationship building) and multidisciplinary level (e.g., intervention skills, therapeutic approaches) interventions to achieve better recovery outcomes for individuals with mental health conditions. The overlap between the clinical recovery and subjective recovery is relatively small. This suggest that subjective recovery could be consider an important outcome measure for service development.

11606615.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11606615.value: The current study look at how people with mental illness view their own recovery and what is the relationship between this subjective view of recovery and objective measure of recovery, that symptoms and functional recovery rated by others. There are different subjective recovery measurement developed over the years. This is the first study using all five measures on different aspects of subjective recovery in a group of people with different types of mental conditions receiving different community psychiatric services. Results suggests that clinical (symptom and functional) and personal recovery overlap only at moderate levels thus different interventions and specific outcome measurements are needed to measure different recovery outcomes. Both are legitimate and valuable components of getting well. The relationship between a recovery-oriented environment and measures of personal recovery highlights the need for workplace and organisational transformation to provide evidence-based, service-user level (e.g., one-to-one interactions, relationship building) and multidisciplinary level (e.g., intervention skills, therapeutic approaches) interventions to achieve better recovery outcomes for individuals with mental health conditions.

11606715.value: To examine how age affects the relationship between memory bias and child/adolescent anxiety. To investigate the patterns of intentional forgetting of words with different emotional valence in anxious and non-anxious children and adolescents.
