14103315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103315.value: In Asian countries, men-having-sex-with men (MSM) are becoming increasingly affected by the HIV epidemic, a trend following closely that of Western Europe and USA. Assessment of the transmission patterns of HIV in MSM is crucial, both for understanding the spreading characteristics and for informing interventions. Currently, HIV surveillance carries a largely static portfolio that emphasizes on the reported number of cases, incidence and/or prevalence. There is the urgent need of an epidemiological framework for assessing how HIV is spreading in contexts of space and time. With these backgrounds we propose to examine the transmission dynamics of HIV in Hong Kong, where HIV prevalence stands at 4% and transmission clusters continue to be identified. Modelled on a new approach applied for studying information diffusion through the internet and social media, an epidemiologic study is planned to be rolled out in three phases. In Phase I, an archived dataset would be established, which comprises available clinical and sequence data of over 1500 HIV infected MSM reported in Hong Kong over a 15-year period from 1998 to 2013. In Phase II, through the application of network and phylogenetic analyses, the lineages and sub-lineages of HIV circulating in MSM would be delineated. Specifically, the diffusion pattern would be assessed using a newly designed set of metrics for explaining the speed, scale and range of HIV transmission. In Phase III, a network-based behavioural survey on MSM diagnosed with HIV in 2014/2015 will be administered, complemented by the linkage of these results with HIV sequence data. The new data obtained would be integrated with those in the archived dataset set up in Phase I to explore the transmission of HIV in MSM subgroups from 1998 to 2015, by phylogenetic lineages and diffusion metrics. Finally, a compartment model would be designed to project the impacts of treatment-as-prevention (TASP) and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) in the future control of HIV diffusion in the population. The study would carry the following impacts: Firstly, a new schema for describing HIV diffusion would be in place, which can facilitate the interpretation of transmission dynamics of the virus at city/country level; secondly, newly designed diffusion metrics would be available for enhancing surveillance; thirdly, the epidemiology of HIV in MSM would be reviewed in terms of its longitudinal trend and network pattern; and fourthly, the new knowledge would contribute to the planning of PrEP and TASP targeting MSM communities.

14103315.label: Realisation of objectives
14103315.value: OBJECTIVE 1: We conducted a cohort study on over 500 newly diagnosed HIV patients in Hong Kong to collect their behavioural data (including social networking pattern and risk profiles), clinical data, and blood samples for HIV sequencing. By applying phylogenetic network analysis, sub-lineages of HIV in men who have sex with men (MSM) in Hong Kong were identified as network clusters. Each pair’s social network and behavioural characteristics were tested to extract dyadic determinants for clustering by maximum pseudolikelihood estimation implemented in ergm package in R. OBJECTIVE 2: Transmission cascades were extracted from genetic clusters by their infection time using Prim’s algorithm with genetic distance as weight. Information diffusion metrics: scale, speed and range, were measured and described per cascade. In context of HIV transmission, the highest outdegree within a cascade was defined as its "scale"; the longest directed path along the cascade was its "range"; whereas "speed" was defined by the number of nodes within a cluster divided by the duration of transmission potential, which was the difference between first infection and last diagnosis plus one. Emerging clusters were assessed by the number of recently linked nodes in the past k years. Information diffusion metrics, along with other network metrics, were compared between HIV subtypes. OBJECTIVE 3: Temporal pattern of HIV transmission was characterised by the combination of past and new HIV sequences. Archived HIV sequences were collected and analysed with newly diagnosed cases to assess temporal linkages between past and new infections and growth of genetic clusters over time. Sequences from two data sets were pooled to construct the genetic network. Cluster-level and individual-level attributes associated with growth of clusters were examined. Cluster network and information diffusion metrics were tested between clusters with new cases and those without. Nodal level analyses were assessed from two perspectives: from past infections and from newly diagnosed cases. Archived sequences having links with newly diagnosed patients were tested with those without by HIV subtype, epidemiological and clinical variables. On the other hand, newly diagnosed patients having connections with archived sequences were differentiated from those without such connections by similar attributes. To adjust for the year of diagnosis in assessing the effect of variables in characterising past infections having connections to newly diagnosed cases, generalised linear model was used, by permutation of all statistical significant variables as input to derive the simplest model by AIC. OBJECTIVE 4: PrEP (pre-exposure prophylaxis, primary prevention) and TasP (Treatment-as-Prevention, secondary prevention) are currently two important biomedical forms of HIV prevention strategy. To predict their impacts on HIV transmission among MSM, blocking effect was assessed from transmission cascades. To assess the effect of different targeted intervention approaches, we compared the blocking effect of targeted nodes. Assuming the transmission cascade ends at one intermediate node (blocker), all subsequent nodes along the transmission cascade would not be infected albeit the existence of other sources of infection. The number of descendent nodes, a function of scale and range derived from the diffusion metrics, was counted and averaged within the cascade to infer the effect of passive protection after blocking the transmission path. All analyses were conducted using R. An agent-based simulation was separately conducted with parameters attributed from the newly HIV diagnosed cohort study and HIV-negative MSM cross-sectional study. Contact network was constructed by a bottom-up approach considering their networking pattern and preferences when seeking partners. The contact network is an intersection of sex networking network and demographic constraint network. Empirical data from a HIV-negative MSM cross-sectional study and new HIV cases cohort study were used to parametrise the model. Force of infection related factors were collected from literature. Transmission simulation was based on independent cascade model in information diffusion model, that is, each node has an independent probability to infect a neighbouring uninfected node. In this simulation, each uninfected node has an independent probability to be infected, one edge at a time. After 100 iterations, resultant networks were merged. Each edge therefore meant at least 1% of transmission risk.

14103315.label: Major findings and research outcome
14103315.value: From the cohort study, we have shown that MSM newly diagnosed with HIV infection were younger, more likely to be infected within the territory of Hong Kong instead of Mainland China or other places and to have a higher CD4 level at diagnosis. The 2 most rapidly growing clusters were: one subtype CRF01_AE cluster comprising primarily heterosexuals and one subtype B MSM cluster [IAS2017 abstract]. Two emerging clusters were identified both composing of MSM but not belonging to the subtype B of growing clusters. The pattern suggested that multiple sources of HIV infection were in existence, causing continuing spread of teh virus in Hong Kong. Applying information diffusion metrics, emerging clusters were characterised by a higher speed of transmission [Lancet-CAMS2017 abstract] and a larger cluster size. Clusters with new cases also had a wider age range within the clusters. Sequences of newly diagnosed patients who had connections with archived sequences, comparing with those who only had connections with other newly diagnosed patients, were more likely subtype B and aged 30 years old or below. Chemsex, the use of drugs in sexual context was identified as an important form of behaviour in recent years. Clusters with new cases were also less likely subtype CRF01_AE and engaged in chemsex the year before infection. Marginal difference was observed in their year of diagnosis. On the other hand, past infections linked with new cases were more likely ethnic Chinese, subtype B, infected through men-to-men sexual contact, younger, diagnosed younger, and got infected, diagnosed and treated in later years. They also had a higher scale as measured by degree centrality and betweenness centrality. Dyadic level attributes contributed to genetic network formation included: specific networking channels, age difference, body image type and chemsex practice [accepted for presentation at VEME2019]. The impact of targeted PrEP delivery was assessed. A strategy targeting all MSM could reduce an average of 0.45 onward transmission per blocker. Slightly higher blocking effect was observed in strategies targeting different networking channels, except mobile app users which did not have a better result than a random strategy. Targeting MSM at high risk of HIV infection, including those having STI diagnosis and engaging in chemsex in the year before infection could prevent additional 44% and 31% onward transmission than random strategy. Strategies targeting younger MSM, either aged 25 or 30 years or below, could give better results than random targets (52% and 22%, respectively).

14103315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14103315.value: The method for genetic network construction could be expanded so as to incorporate intra- or inter-subtype recombinants which contributed to about one-fifth of new HIV cases in Hong Kong. In a followup sub-study, exploration had been performed with preliminary results showing that some missing links between nodes may be identified and the connectedness in different regions may be associated with various risk profiles [APACC2019 abstract]. Apart from an expansion of the current study, the approach used in the project could be potentially useful in two ways: firstly, adoption an enhancement of current HIV epidemiologic investigation to inform public health, and secondly, application in the study of other related infections like HCV and selected sexually transmitted infections. In concluding this project, investigators are pursuing the following actions (a) further analyses for generating two other new publications on the results of the study; (b) development of a longer term cohort study for collecting data (sequence, clinical and behavioural) over a total of 6 years to better delineate the temporal trend of the HIV epidemics in Hong Kong , (c) documentation of the methods for use in training courses and for sharing with infectious disease researchers at conferences and meetings.

14103315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14103315.value: HIV transmission in Hong Kong is highly concentrated among men who have sex with men (MSM), a pattern shared by many other countries. HIV transmission is a dynamic process which is likened to information diffusion. To improve our understanding of the HIV epidemics, a clinical cohort was established, which enabled us to conduct analyses founded on the integration of clinical, behavioural and virus sequence data. A new approach was designed to define clusters and to examine virus transmission by deriving a set of newly designed diffusion metrics. In the study involving more than 500 newly diagnosed HIV patients, emerging clusters were delineated the molecular characteristics of which differed from previous and other existing infections. The range, speed and scale of transmission clusters varied by their compositions. Chemsex, the use of drugs in sexual context, was one important factor associated with recent virus transmission. With the new nodel, biomedical means of HIV prevention through pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and treatment-as-prevention (TasP) were investigated. To predict their impacts on HIV transmission among MSM, blocking effect was assessed from transmission cascades. The new methods designed in the study could be applied in enhancing epidemiologic investigations of HIV and other infections.

14104415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104415.value: With our long-term research interests in unveiling the biology of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) and the roles of Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV) infection in molding NPC cancer behaviors, we demonstrated abundance expression of BART-derived miRNAs in primary NPC tissues, implying the pathological importance of these molecules in NPC tumorigenesis. In this regard, we demonstrated the functional roles of BART-derived miRNAs in controlling apoptotic responses via targeting LMP-1 and PUMA in NPC cells. Most recently, our preliminary data indicated that miR-BART12 and miR-BART2-3p are abundantly expressed and could suppress BRCA1 protein expression in NPC cells, shedding light into the impacts of EBV infection on DNA damage repairs and radiosensitivity of NPC cells. In addition, cellular miR-182 that is over-expressed in NPC also down-regulate BRCA1 expression in NPC cells, inferring the co-operative roles of viral and cellular miRNAs in controlling critical gene expression. Notably, no BRCA1 protein expression was detected in all EBV-positive NPC cells and xenografts, denoting that the cancer cells may be homologous recombination (HR) deficiency for repairing DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs). It was demonstrated that BRCA-deficient tumor cells with dysfunctional HR-mediated DNA repairs are unable to fix the replication-associated DSBs that are induced and potentiated by DNA damaging agents and Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition, resulting in genetic instability and eventually promotion of cell death. In contrast, the DSBs are effectively repaired by HR in normal cells. These differential DNA repairs capacities in BRCA1/2-deficient cancer versus BRCA1/2-intact normal cells provide a therapeutic window for development of effective NPC therapies. We hypothesize that EBV infection, via BART-derived miRNAs to suppress BRCA1 expression and disrupt HR function, sensitizes NPC cells to PARP inhibition that potentiates cytotoxic effects of DNA-damaging agents on NPC cells. In this proposal, we will comprehensively investigate the relationships among BART-derived miRNAs, miR-182, BRCA1, and HR-mediated DNA repair activity in NPC cells and the functional paths by which EBV infection disrupts HR repairs to promote DNA damages will be explored. To improve the treatment efficacy of radio- and radiochemo-therapies, we will evaluate the cytotoxic and potentiating effects of PARP inhibitors on NPC. The knowledge generated from this proposal promises to enhance our understanding of the impacts of EBV infection on NPC carcinogenesis and the controls of cancer behaviors. Importantly, it opens entirely new avenues of NPC treatment strategies by concurrent PARP inhibition with radio- and radiochemo-therapies to reduce the effective doses of these highly toxic agents, eventually minimizing the related side-effects. 鼻咽癌的發生與EBV病毒感染密切相關。所有惡性的鼻咽上皮細胞均表達病毒RNAs、蛋白、及miRNAs，此結果提示EBV可能通過這些病毒產物參與鼻咽癌的腫瘤發生。由於腫瘤細胞具有很高的放射線敏感性，適形調強放射治療（IMRT）是鼻咽癌最主要的治療手段。關於鼻咽癌的發生機制仍有待研究。 關於鼻咽癌的生物學行為及EBV感染在其行為中的作用，我們對此做了長期的研究，發現在原發性鼻咽癌組織中存在包括ebv-miR-BART-12和ebv-miR-BART-2-3p在內的BART來源的miRNAs的大量表達，並且揭示了BART來源的miRNAs在通過結合LMP1和PUMA介導的凋亡反應中的意義。此外，我們的初步數據顯示ebv-miR-BART-12和 ebv-miR-BART-2-3p可以抑制鼻咽癌細胞中BRCA1蛋白的表達，此結果提示EBV編碼的miRNAs在調控DNA損傷修復和放射敏感性方面可能存在一定影響。 有趣的是在所有EBV陽性的鼻咽癌細胞和異種移植物中均未見BRCA1蛋白的表達，提示此腫瘤中DNA雙鏈斷裂(DSBs)修復時同源重組的缺失。研究顯示BRCA缺失的腫瘤細胞不具備同源重組介導的DNA修復能力，其不能夠修復由DNA損傷因子引起及抑制PARP活動的與復制相關的DNA雙鏈斷裂(DSBs) ，最終導致基因的不穩定性和細胞的死亡。相反，在正常細胞中同源重組可以有效的修復DNA雙鏈的斷裂。在腫瘤細胞和正常細胞中DNA修復能力的不同，為發展更有效的腫瘤治療方法提供了可能。 我們假設EBV感染是通過BART來源的miRNAs來抑制BRCA1的表達及同源重組功能的丟失，使鼻咽癌細胞對PARP抑制劑敏感，從而加強DNA損傷因子包括電離輻射和鉑類混合物等的細胞毒性作用。在此方案中，我們將全面研究鼻咽癌細胞中BART來源的miRNAs、BRCA1和同源重組在DNA損傷修復中的作用之間的關系，並且探索同源重組在BRCA1介導的DNA損傷修復中的功能通路。為了提高放療和放化療的治療效果，我們通過同時實施PARP抑制劑治療來發展更有效的鼻咽癌治療策略。通過這個方案希望能提高我們對EBV感染在鼻咽癌發生中的影響的認識並且弄清它的腫瘤性行為，最重要的是通過PARP抑制劑對鼻咽癌病人的治療打開全新的道路。

14104415.label: Realisation of objectives
14104415.value: In Objective 1: In our preliminary work, we identified putative BART2-3p and BART12 binding sites on the BRCA1-3’UTR. However, low expression levels of BART2-3p and BART12 in NPCs were detected, they totally constituted < 2% of the total miR-BARTs in our small RNA-sequencing analysis. For this reason, we loosened the stringency for target prediction analysis and several putative of BART17-5p and BART19-3p binding sites were additionally suggested. These two miR-BARTs were highly expressed in NPCs (~2.6% of BART17-5p and ~6% of BART19-3p of the total miR-BART reads). Moreover, they were the two most abundant “active” miR-BARTs in our PAR-CLIP assay on C666-1 cells, in which they occupied ~ 9% of the total Ago2-associated miRNAs. In regard to cellular miRNAs, we proved by RT-qPCR in primary NPCs (4 NP and 42 NPC cases) that miR-182-5p, a well-known miRNA modulator of BRCA1, is up-regulated in NPCs. Hence, we would investigate the miR-182-5p effect in BRCA1 regulation in part of our project. The downregulation of BRCA1 in primary NPCs was confirmed by immunohistochemical (IHC) staining (30 normal nasopharyngeal epithelia (NP) and 40 NPC cases, p < 0.001). And western blot was employed to measure the BRCA1 expression in NPC cell lines and xenografts. To compare with the normal NP cell line (NP69), BRCA1 expression was consistently downregulated in all tested NPC xenografts (X666, X2117, C15 and C17) and 2 of the 3 EBV-positive NPC cell lines (NPC-43T and C17-C, but not C666-1). Reversely, high BRCA1 expression was detected in 2 EBV-negative NPC cells (HK1 and NPC-53T). The high BRCA1 expression in C666-1 NPC cell line is unexpected. It is known that miR-BARTs and miR-182-5p are highly expressed in this cells. Moreover, no mutation of the known miR-182-5p and the predicted miR-BART-binding sites was detected on the BRCA1 transcript. Thus, other unknown mechanisms which minimize the miRNA effect on BRCA1 expression may be present in C666-1. The direct interaction between the miRNAs and the BRCA1 transcript was examined in a series of luciferase reporter assays in the 293FT cells. The BART2-3p, BART12, BART17-5p and miR-182-5p, but not BART19-3p exerted significant inhibitory effect on the reporter that carrying the full-length BRCA1-3’UTR. Nevertheless, suppression was canceled if the reversed full-length 3’UTR sequence was cloned into the reporter. We subsequently tested 19 individual predicted binding sites in the assays and validated one BART2-3p, one BART12, three BART17-5p and two miR-182-5p binding sites on the BRCA1-3’UTR and one BART19-3p binding site on the coding DNA sequence (CDS). By using PAR-CLIP method, other researchers also recognized this BART19-3p binding site in B-cells. To examine the repressive effect of miR-BARTs on BRCA1, we introduced miRNA mimics into the BRCA1-expressing cells and analyzed the BRCA1 expression by western blot. Our results illustrated that all 4 miR-BARTs and miR-182-5p could suppress endogenous BRCA1 expression in HeLa, NP69 and two EBV-negative NPC cells, HK1 and NPC-53T. The BRCA1 was also repressed in the BART17- and BART19-expressing HK1 stable clones. In the rescue experiment, the BRCA1 expression was increased when the C666-1 cells transfected with individual miR-BARTs or miR-182-5p inhibitors. In Objectives 2 and 3: We have previously reported that ATM, an upstream regulator of BRCA1 in the ionizing radiation (IR)-induced DNA damage responsive signaling pathway, is consistently downregulated by another set of miR-BARTs. Because HK1 is the only available NPC cells with all ATM, BRCA1 and p53 expressions, we examined the post-IR recovery ability of HK1 by measuring the number of positive γ-H2AX and RAD51 nuclear foci. After exposing the cells with 2-Gy and 5-Gy of IR, the percentage of both γ-H2AX and RAD51 positive cells were significantly reduced in the BRCA1-knockdown HK1 cells. The finding suggested that the IR-induced DNA damaged repair capacity of HK1 was impaired by reducing BRCA1 level. Either suppressing ATM or BRCA1 expression was reported to make the cells hypersensitive to olaparib, an FDA approved PARP inhibitor, treatment. Unfortunately, all 6 NPC cell lines (C666-1, NPC-43T, C17-C, HK1 and NPC-53T) and normal NP69 cells are highly resistant to olaparib treatment even after suppressing endogenous BRCA1 activity. We subsequently determined the IC50 of 2 chemotherapeutic agents, cisplatin (CDDP) and doxorubicin (DOX), in 4 NPC cell lines (NPC-43T, C17-C, NPC53T and HK1) and dissected the involvement of BRCA1 using siRNA. Compared to the control siRNA, BRCA1-specific siRNA transfected HK1 was more susceptible to CDDP (IC50 from 15.59µM to 10.59µM) and DOX (0.48 µM to 0.11 µM) treatments, whereas no obvious effect was observed in other NPC cells, in which no protein expression of p53, a key molecule in the cellular response to chemotherapy-induced DNA damage, was detected. To further investigate the importance of BRCA1 in the response to DNA damaging agents, we transfected the BRCA1-specific siRNA, BART17-5p and BART19-3p mimics separately into the HK1 and NP69 cells for analysis. In the flow cytometry analysis, no apparent changed in cell cycle and apoptotic rate were observed in the cells after siRNA or miRNA mimics transfection. However, significant cell cycle arrest at S-phase and G2-phase in the transfected cells was detected in CDDP and DOX treatments. The cell cycle arrest was also confirmed by the increasing expression of phosp-CHK1 in western blot analysis. The DNA homologous recombination repair (HRR) capacity of the transfected cells was analyzed with RAD51 nuclear foci immunofluorescence staining. After 4 hours recovery from the 16 hours exposure of CDDP (HK1 = 15 µM; NP69 = 4 µM) or DOX (HK1 = 1 µM; NP69 = 0.5 µM), the number of positive RAD51 nuclear foci was significantly reduced in all BRCA1-specific siRNA and miRNA mimics transfected cells (p > 0.05 in all cases). In addition, the long-term clonogenic survival of the miRNA mimics and BRCA1-specific siRNA transfected cells were significantly reduced after CDDP (HK1 = 7.5 µM; NP69 = 2 µM) and DOX (HK1 = 250 µM; NP69 = 0.1 µM) treatments (p > 0.05 in all cases). Although both BRCA1and miR-BARTs are highly expressed in C666-1 cells, manipulating BRCA1 expression by introducing BRCA1-expression vector or BRCA1-specific siRNA in C666-1 cells could alter the long term clonogenic survival of the cells after the treatment of 16 µM CDDP (44.51%, p=0.0117 for BRCA1 overexpression; -40.56%, p=0.0106 for BRCA1 reduction) and 1.25 µM of DOX (19.12%, p=0.0313 for BRCA1 overexpression; -14.3%, p=0.0081 for BRCA1 reduction) accordingly. In the in vitro study, we found that HK1 is the only suitable NPC cells for in vivo study. Thus, we isolated two independent BRCA1-specific shRNA-expressing cells from HK1 and C666-1 and planned to assess their drug sensitivity in in vivo experiment. However, HK1 is a well differentiated carcinoma cell line and generally produces small xenograft with extensive necrosis (~20-30mm3). We were unable to overcome the problem by increasing the cell number with matrigel matrix for inoculation. We were also fail to produce xenograft with sh-BRCA1-expressing C666-1 cells. For the above reasons, we unavoidably decided to suspend the in vivo study in the project.

14104415.label: Major findings and research outcome
14104415.value: We identified that BRCA1, a tumor suppressor gene which responsible for DNA double-strand break-repair (DSBR), is the cellular target of BART2-5p, BART12, BART17-5p and BART19-3p. The BART17-5p and BART19-3p constitutes ~8.6% of the total viral miRNAs in NPC samples and they were the most abundant Ago2-associated viral miRNAs in C666-1 cells. Besides the abundant miR-BARTs expression, downregulation of BRCA1 in NPC primary samples and xenografts were validated by IHC staining and western blotting analysis, respectively. On the other hand, the specific target sites of BART2-5p, BART12, BART17-5p and BART19-3p located on the 3’untranslated region and the coding region of BRCA1 transcript were characterized using a series of reporter assays. Transfection of these 4 miR-BART mimics into EBV-negative epithelial cell lines (HeLa, NP69, HK1 and NPC-53T) or the HK1 cells stably transfected with BART17 or BART19 expressing vector led to repress endogenous BRCA1 expression. Conversely, suppression of endogenous miR-BARTs function with individual specific oligonucleotide inhibitor in C666-1 cells result in enhanced the endogenous BRCA1 expression. We revealed that inhibition of BRCA1 expression in p53 expressing NPC cells could make them more susceptible to the cisplatin (CDDP) and doxorubicin (DOX) treatments. Under the treatment of CDDP and DOX, more significant in cell cycle arrested and more impaired in homologous recombination repair capacity were observed in HK1 and NP69 cells that transfected with BRCA1 specific siRNAs, BART17-5p or BART19-3p mimics individually. Notably, the long term clonogenic survival of the transiently transfected HK1 and NP69 cells were significantly reduced if compared with the controls. Although high BRCA1 and miR-BARTs expressions were detected in C666-1 cells, the most representative cells for NPC research worldwide, manipulating BRCA1 expression by transfection of siRNA or BRCA1 expression vector could also affect the long term survival rate of the cells in response to CDDP and DOX treatments. In our recent whole-genome sequencing study on 70 NPCs, we uncovered a new NPC mutational signature associated with DSBR (signature 3 in 45/70 tumors). We also found that NPCs with somatic DSBR defects (TP53, ATM, BRCA1 and BRCA2) were significant associated with high rate of SVs (p=0.0029) and have significantly poor overall disease-free survival. Together with this project, our work further suggested the negative regulatory roles of miR-BARTs on ATM and BRCA1 expression in NPC development. We believed that all of these findings can facilitate the development of effective NPC therapies.

14104415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14104415.value: We have identified the roles of miR-BARTs in regulating the expression of two essential molecules (ATM and BRCA1) in the DNA homologous recombination (HR) repair pathway. The repression of ATM and BRCA1 can make the cells more susceptible to ionizing radiation and DNA damaging agents, respectively. In addition, our recent exome-sequencing data in primary NPCs revealed that patients with mutations in critical DNA damage response genes had significantly shorter survival than those with null mutation (KWL unpublished data). Therefore, it is worth to further investigate the correlation between the expression of ATM, BRCA1 and the response to DNA damaging agents in NPC. However, there is no good NPC cell line model for the in vivo experiment. Most recently, we collaborated with other teams to establish a number of newly NPC cell lines and patient derived xenografts. We hope we will eventually find some of the useful materials in our study. In the meantime, we can try to use the present NPC patient derived xenografts in the in vivo study. We can correlate the expression level of miR-BARTs, BRCA1 and ATM and the response of individual or combination treatment in the in vivo experiment.

14104415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14104415.value: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is a common EBV-associated malignancy and is particularly prevalent in Southern China including Hong Kong. In NPC, 40 EBV-encoded microRNAs, miR-BARTs, are abundantly expressed and function as the negative regulators to modulate gene expression. With our long-term research interests in unveiling the involvement of EBV infection in molding NPC behaviors, we previously demonstrated the functional roles of miR-BARTs in regulating both viral and cellular genes to facilitate cancer development. With the support of RGC, we are making a big progress in understanding the role of EBV infection in DNA damage responses. We previously demonstrated the suppressive effect of 4 miR-BARTs on ATM signaling pathway and the expression of these miR-BARTs can make the cells more susceptible for ionizing radiation treatment. And in the present project, we identified that another 4 miR-BARTs (BART2-5p, BART12, BART17-5p and BART19-3p) can directly suppress the expression of endogenous BRCA1, a tumor suppressor which responsible for DNA damage repair, in NPC cells. Moreover, we clearly demonstrated that suppressing BRCA1 by BART17-5p and BART19-3p in EBV-negative NPC and normal NP cell lines significantly enhance the cells sensitivity to the common drugs used in chemotherapy, such as cisplatin and doxorubicin.

14104515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104515.value: 為什麼不同細胞可以对相同的激素有不同的生物学反应是生物學一個根本的問題。這個問題对醫學，特別是癌症研究领域非常重要。例如，組織特異性雌激素的反應可以被多種遺傳和表觀遺傳因素的影響，如轉錄因子活性，DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾。然而，植物细胞是如何實現組織特異信号传导的則至今也沒有被解釋清楚。 乙烯是一種植物激素，可以調控植物生長髮育的許多方面，如葉片衰老和躍變型果實成熟。McMurchie在70年代提出，乙烯的反應的確是在在葉和果實有不同之處，並稱之為系統I和II乙烯。在2013年，我們進一步表明，表觀遺傳因子的改變是I和II乙烯信號系統之間的切換過程中的一個重要因素。我們的初步研究數據表明，番茄EIN3轉錄因子是一個乙烯信號傳導途徑中的關鍵，它可以激活系統II乙烯應基因。 EIN3還有組織特異性結合模式，並且和那些已知的表觀遺傳標記相關聯。 我們推測這種組織特異性乙烯信號是由轉錄因子控制。表觀遺傳標記如DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾的功能也可能發揮關鍵的作用。為了理解這個過程中，我們會使用基因組測序技術來研究EIN3的組織特異性（1）乙烯調控的基因，（2）4個EIN3級轉錄因子的結合位點;（3）DNA甲基化和（4）的組蛋白修飾，并（5）使用生物信息學工具來研究這些因素如何相互作用，建立組織特異性乙烯信令網絡。 我們相信該研究將提供一個機會給我們洞察組織特異性乙烯信號的分子機制，並在激素信號，發育生物學和表觀遺傳學領域起到廣泛影響，也為未來的實驗驗證和基因工程改良植物打下了堅實的基礎。

14104515.label: Realisation of objectives
14104515.value: Objective 1: We have identified the tissue-specific (root, leaf and fruits tissues at different developmental stages) ethylene responsive genes using time-course RNA-Seq. Objective 2: Using ChIP-Seq, we have also identified the binding sites of tomato EIN3, TAGL1 and RIN transcription factors. Objective 3: We have performed BS-Seq to profile DNA methylation genome-wide during tomato fruit development. We have used bioinformatic analysis to show that DNA methylation changes in the tomato fruit tissues are indeed associated with promoter open chromatin changes and transcription factor binding changes. Objective 4: Histone modification ChIP-Seq (H3K27me3) showed that the key ripening genes such as ACS2 and RIN are repressed by H3K27me3 in the leaf and immature fruit tissues. Hence, even when the transcription factor targeting those genes are expressed in fruit, those ripening genes could not be activated. Objective 5: With these results, We have proposed new ripening model, in which a MADS-type positive feedback loop is formed between ethylene, TF EIN3 and TF complex RIN/TAGL1 to generate the ripening gas ethylene in an auto-catalytic manner . The downstream ripening genes are coupled to this loop directly, as they are targeted by RIN/TAGL1.

14104515.label: Major findings and research outcome
14104515.value: Fleshy fruits using ethylene to regulate ripening have developed multiple times in the history of angiosperms, presenting a clear case of convergent evolution whose molecular basis remains largely unknown. Analysis of the fruitENCODE data consisting of 361 transcriptome, 71 accessible chromatin, 147 histone and 45 DNA methylation profiles reveals three types of transcriptional feedback circuits controlling ethylene-dependent fruit ripening. These circuits are evolved from senescence or floral organ identity pathways in the ancestral angiosperms either by neofunctionalisation or repurposing pre-existing genes. The epigenome, H3K27me3 in particular, has played a conserved role in restricting ripening genes and their orthologues in dry and ethylene-independent fleshy fruits. Our findings suggest that evolution of ripening is constrained by limited hormone molecules and genetic and epigenetic materials, and whole-genome duplications have provided opportunities for plants to successfully circumvent these limitations. The aforementioned results have been published in Lv et al 2018 Nature Plants.

14104515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14104515.value: We have begin to examine what might be regulating (activating) the DNA demethylase as well as the H3K27me3 demethylase. They might be the trigger of ripening.

14104515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14104515.value: Fleshy fruits, though a latecomer in evolutionary terms, enjoy advantages in the propagation of the species over the dry varieties in that their nutrient-rich fleshy contents provide better incentives for animals to eat them and thereby spread the seeds to far-off places. Scientists have long wanted to fathom the mechanism which regulates the ripening of fleshy fruits. Like the gestation of a human foetus followed by labour, nature seems to have encoded when and under what conditions a fruit should ripen. By elucidating the genetic and epigenetic mechanism of fruit ripening, our research could pave the way for a healthier and steadier food source in future. With greater understanding of the genomes of fruits and their ripening regulators, it is also possible to manipulate and engineer fruits to enhance the nutritional value, consumer appeal and shelf life.

14105915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14105915.value: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic progressive illness affecting a substantial percentage of the general population. While pharmacotherapy remains the mainstay of treatment, around 60% of patients cannot achieve the recommended goals for diabetic control. This is often related to obesity, and may lead to disabling morbidities including blindness, renal failure, coronary artery disease, stroke, ischaemic feet, fatty liver and even malignancy. These complications are devastating at both individual and socioeconomic level. Thus there is a desperate need of developing strategy to complement medical treatment for the condition. Weight control is a well-known essential component in normalizing blood glucose level in T2DM. However, life-style modification, physical exercise and dietary adjustment are ineffective measures to achieve adequate and sustained weight loss for the truly obese. Large scale long-term follow-up studies, on the other hand, have confirmed not only a durable weight reduction but also remarkable diabetic improvement after bariatric surgery. The term metabolic surgery is recently introduced and it is now increasingly accepted as a valid option for obesed T2DM patients with poor glycemic control despite optimal medical therapy. While laparoscopic roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGBP) is the gold-standard bariatric/metabolic procedure in many countries, it is not widely accepted in Asia. Dumping syndrome, diarrhea, stomal complications and micronutrient malabsorption are not uncommon after RYGBP. The worry of delaying diagnosis of malignancy in the excluded gastric remnant is another major concern in some Asian countries with a high gastric cancer incidence. Recently, a novel bypass technique called single loop duodenojejunal bypass with sleeve gastrectomy (SLDJB-SG) has been developed trying to tackle most drawbacks of RYGBP. However, all the claimed advantages of SLDJB-SG over RYGBP have not been proven in a randomized control trial setting, and the underlying mechanism on how SLDJB-SG works remains an enigma. Realizing there is a knowledge gap in applying the new duodenojejunal bypass procedure to obese T2DM patients, we propose to investigate and compare the efficacy of glycemic control and functional outcomes of SLDJB-SG with conventional RYGBP. Through this prospective randomized trial the safety, quality of life and changes in gut hormone profiles after SLDJB-SG and RYGBP will also be assessed. The evidence generated shall lay a scientific foundation for better understanding of this procedure which may become the metabolic surgery of choice in the future.

14105915.label: Realisation of objectives
14105915.value: Objective 1: Prospective randomized trial comparing LRYGBP with the novel LSGDJB for poorly controlled type 2 DM patients: Patient recruitment for this project was started right away once grant was approved in October 2015. The first eligible patient was operated on 3rd November 2015. By the end of 2018, our team of researchers had already screened over 300 new referrals for the randomised trial. There was a period of time (mid 2017 to mid 2018) during which the case recruitment was slow due to a lack of suitable cases fulfilling the inclusion/exclusion criteria. Yet a total of 45 operations were performed up to the end of last reporting period. Extension of the project was thus sought from the Grant Council in March 2019. With approval of project extension, we initially aimed at recruiting enough subjects to meet the intended sample size. However, it was increasingly difficult to recruit cases by mid-2019 due to the escalating intensity of social unrest in Hong Kong. Despite our keen endeavour in screening of over 100 additional new referrals (average 2 new referrals per week) since January 2019, the heightened societal tension and intermittent disruptions of traffic caused by the street conflicts severely compromised patients’ willingness to attend our clinic, participate in physical assessment and workup, or to be enrolled for the investigational surgery. The situation was further complicated by the COVID-19 pandemic starting in January 2020. All operating rooms under entire Hospital Authority were shut down between February and June 2020. Only cancer or life-threatening emergency operations could be proceeded. Essentially no metabolic surgery could be arranged by late 2019. To date, we managed to recruit 60 cases for the study and have already performed the randomized interventions in 52 patients. Of the 52 patients operated, 24 underwent Sleeve Gastrectomy & Duodenojejunal Bypass (SGDJB) and 28 had conventional laparoscopic roux-Y Gastric Bypass (LRYGBP), with a mean age (SD) of 48.5 (5.6) years and 49 (7.3) years, respectively. There were no differences in their background demographics. The baseline mean body weight (BW), mean BMI and mean HbA1c of the SGDJB and LRYGBP groups were 101.9 (15.4)kg vs 103.2 (14.3)kg, 35.94 (3.54) kg/m2 vs 36.50 (3.77) kg/m2, and 8.47 (1.0)g/L vs 7.95 (1.0)g/L (p=0.09), respectively. Their early postoperative outcomes, changes in biometric parameters and glycemic control at different time points of follow-up were all prospectively recorded for comparison (between-groups and within-group) per protocol. Though the grant allocated by RGC is used up and a completion report has to be submitted now, our team decided to continue patient recruitment until reaching target sample size, based on the institutional funding in the coming 12 months. Objective 2 – Functional Outcomes: To determine and compare the prevalence of dumping syndrome, gastroesophageal reflux, stomal ulceration and nutritional status between the two groups of patients in first year after the two types of operation: 44 out of the 52 operated patients had completed 1 year follow-up with clinical assessment of symptoms related to dumping and gastroesophageal reflux using 3 sets of questionnaires (GERD-QoL, Dumping Symptom Rating Scale and Gastrointestinal Symptoms Rating Scale-self). All 44 patients also had endoscopic examination performed per protocol at postoperative 1-year and findings were compared between the groups. Changes in nutritional status including macro- and micronutrients disturbances were measured at preset time points and compared between the two groups (Please see Research Outcomes session below for details). Objective 3 – Quality of Life: To assess the changes in different domains of quality of life after the two types of operations, and to determine potential predictive factors for improvement in quality of life after metabolic surgery: All 52 patients had been interrogated with the validated Chinese version of SF-36 questionnaire for quality of life assessment at preset time points, ie, before surgery, 1-month, 6th month and 12th month after the assigned operation. Eight domains of QoL were determined and compared between the two groups of patients for different time points per protocol. Objective 4 – Gut Hormone Profile: To measure the pattern of gut hormone changes and to study their correlation with glycemic control after the two types of bariatric operation: Of the 52 patients recruited and operated on, the first 20 patients were also subject to measurement of their baseline and 12-month HbA1c, Mixed Meal Test for glycemic response, insulin surge, GLP-1 and GIP. All these information were collected and compared within-group and between-group per protocol.

14105915.label: Major findings and research outcome
14105915.value: Part-1 Of the 52 patients operated, none required conversion to open surgery and there was no mortality. One patient randomized to SGDJB needed cross-over to RYGBP due to technical difficulties intraoperatively. There were no differences in mean(SD) operative blood loss[26.9 (26.5)ml vs 24.3(22.2)ml, P=0.77), major postoperative complications[12.5% vs 3.6%, P=0.32), and mean hospital stay[4.75(1.42)days vs 4.29(2.42)days, p=0.06]. However, SGDJB has significant longer operating time than LRYGBP[248.0 (33.3)mins vs 190.1(31.2) mins, P<.001]. By 1 year, both groups got significant %EBWL when compared to their corresponding baseline (SGDJB:89.6%, RYGBP:94.5%), but there was no between-group difference in the changes in BW, BMI and %EBWL at 6-month and 1 year. The mean HbA1c of SGDJB group dropped significantly from 8.5%(baseline) to 6.5%, 6.3%, and 6.4% (p<0.001) at 3-month, 6-month and 1-year, respectively, while RYGBP group from 8.0% to 6.6%, 6.4% and 6.0% (p<0.001). The two operations had no significant difference in the proportion of achieving HbA1c< 6% by 1 year (SGDJB:47.6% vs RYGBP:60.9%, p=0.38). Part-2: a) GERD-QoL: No significant findings were seen in all four categories(daily activity, treatment effect, diet and psychological well-being) in both within-group or between-group comparison at various time-point. b) DSRS: RYGBP group had significantly worse diarrhoea rating than SGDJB group at 6-month(P<0.001) and 1-year(P< 0.01). RYGBP also led to higher palpitation rating (P=0.014) and fainting rating(P<0.01) by 1 year. Both groups had significantly more nausea ratings at 1-year when compared to baseline. c) GSRS-self: RYGBP group had significantly more frequent abdominal pain(P=0.048) and belching(p=0.008) when compared to its own baseline. RYGBP also had significantly a higher abdominal pain score than SGDJB at 1 year(0.38 vs 0.17, P=0.03). d) Endoscopy: SGDJB patients reported significantly more reflux than RYGBP group(47.6% vs 8.7%, P=0.006) at 1-year. Anastomotic erosion/ulceration were seen in 1 SGDJB and 4 RYGBP patients without statistical significance. More bilious gastritis were seen in the SGDJB group(33.3% vs 0%, P=0.003). Part-3 Using SF36, significant improvement was seen in all domains except "role limitation due to emotional problems" in both groups of patients when compared to their own baseline. No difference in various SF36 domains was observed between the two groups. There was also no significant difference between the two groups in various nutritional parameters in the first year follow-ups. Part-4 Compared to baseline, only SGDJB had significant reduction in post-stimulation serum glucose AUC at 1-year. While both groups showed significant improvement in HOMA-Insulin Resistance, Insulinogenic Index and GLP1/glucose ratio, only the RYGBP group had significant improvement in GIP/glucose ratio.

14105915.value: In order to consolidate the above findings with stronger statistical power, though the grant allocated by RGC is used up and a completion report has to be submitted now, our team decided to continue patient recruitment until target sample size is reached. This initiative will be based on our institutional funding in the coming 12 months.

14105915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14105915.value: In summary, this project proves that the investigational SGDJB is a safe but technically more demanding procedure associated with a much longer operating time when compared to the more conventional RYGBP. While both procedures are able to provide satisfactory weight loss and diabetic control for obese metabolic syndrome patients, SGDJB does not confer additional benefit over the conventional RYGBP in terms of improvement in overall quality of life, changes in gut hormone profile and nutritional status. The advantages of SGDJB were less dumping and a lower rate of non-specific abdominal pain but it is at the expense of more gastro-esophageal reflux symptoms and more endoscopic bilious gastritis. Based on our study, laparoscopic SGDJB cannot be recommended as a standard metabolic procedure for Asian obese patients with suboptimal diabetic control despite the proclaimed benefits previously reported in the literature. Its benefit of less dumping is clinically marginal and does not justify the increase in technical difficulty, longer operating time and higher rates of gastroesophageal reflux and endoscopic bilious gastritis .

14106415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14106415.value: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and its pathologically more severe form non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), increases risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) that is commonly featured with poor outcomes and limited therapeutic options. Although the percentage of patients diagnosed annually with NASH-associated HCC (NASH-HCC) is still relatively low, this actual number is high due to a large global population of individuals with obesity and diabetes. To date, the molecular basis behind the NASH-mediated liver carcinogenesis is still unknown. We have recently performed transcriptome sequencing (RNA-Seq) analysis on 18 pairs of human NASH-HCC tumor samples and their adjacent non-tumor tissue counterparts. Notably, squalene epoxidase (SQLE), a key rate-limiting enzyme in the cholesterol metabolic process, showed evidence as a metabolic driver in promoting liver tumorigenesis. We found SQLE showed distinct overexpression in 14 out of 18 (77.8%) NASH-HCC tumor tissues compared with their adjacent non-tumor tissues (> 2.5 fold increase). This was further affirmed in an independent validation series, which suggested SQLE was frequently overexpressed in human NASH-HCC tumor samples compared with their adjacent non-tumor tissues (63%, 17/27). In addition, higher expression level of SQLE could be induced by higher cholesterol level in liver cells and was also found to be associated with fatty liver in obese mouse models. Our preliminary in vitro and in vivo functional studies supported a strong oncogenic role of SQLE in HCC development, possibly through the role of SQLE in promoting cell growth via the accumulation of cholesteryl ester in liver cells and inducing oxidative stress associated epigenomic alterations. Collectively, we propose to investigate the role of SQLE as a novel tumor-promoting gene which may link abnormal cholesterol metabolism to the malignant progression of NASH-HCC with three specific objectives: 1) to characterize the tumor–promoting role of SQLE in NASH-HCC; 2) to investigate the mechanisms underlying the oncogenic role of SQLE; and 3) to study the clinical significance of SQLE in NASH-HCC. These research objectives will be tackled with a multidisciplinary approach combining biochemistry, metabolomics, molecular and cell biology, and animal models. The new knowledge gained from this proposed study will provide considerable insight into the role of SQLE in cholesterol modulation during NASH-HCC progression, advance our understanding of liver cancer metabolism, and facilitate early diagnosis and more effective therapeutic strategy for NASH-HCC patients. 摘要： 肝癌常有的特徵是較差的預後和有限的治療方案。非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）以及其病理上更嚴重的形式非酒精性脂肪肝（NASH），增加了肝癌發生的機率。雖然每年確診為NASH相關的肝癌病人（NASH-HCC）在肝癌病人裡所佔的比例比較低，但是由於全球數量龐大的肥胖和糖尿病患者，每年患NASH-HCC的病人數量是非常高的。我們所面臨的問題是到現在為止，NASH引起的肝臟腫瘤的分子機制還不是很清楚。 前期我們對18例NASH-HCC病人的肝癌組織以及臨近的癌旁組織分別進行了轉錄組高通量測序。值得注意的是，測序結果顯示角鯊烯環氧化酶（SQLE）作為膽固醇合成的一個關鍵限速酶，是可以作為代謝相關的驅動來促進肝臟腫瘤的發生。我們發現在18例NASH-HCC病例中，與其癌旁組織相比SQLE在其中14例病人的肝癌組織中有顯著高表達（大於2.5倍）。在另外一組獨立的NASH-HCC病人樣本中，我們進一步證實了相較於對應的癌旁組織，SQLE的表達量在肝癌組織中顯著升高。此外，SQLE的表達可以被肝臟細胞內過高的膽固醇水平誘導，同時在肥胖老鼠模型中SQLE的表達水平也和脂肪肝相關。我們初步的體內體外功能試驗也都證實了SQLE在肝癌發展中的致癌作用。 SQLE的致癌作用可能是通過引起肝細胞內膽固醇酯的堆積而促進肝細胞的生長。另外，SQLE也可誘導氧化應激壓力導致表觀遺傳的改變而促進肝癌的發生髮展。 總的來說，我們計劃調查研究SQLE作為一個新型促腫瘤發展的基因在鏈接膽固醇代謝紊亂到NASH-HCC惡性發展中的作用。我們有三個具體的目標: 1) 鑑定和證實SQLE在NASH-HCC中的促腫瘤發生作用；2) 研究和探索SQLE可能的致癌機制；3) 探討SQLE在NASH-HCC中的臨床意義。我們將運用多種學科包括生物化學、代謝組學、分子和細胞生物學和動物模型等相結合的實驗方法來實現和完成這些研究目標。這個課題所可能獲得的成果將會讓我們更深入的了解在NASH-HCC的發展過程中，SQLE對膽固醇代謝以及促進NASH-HCC發展的作用。從而加深我們對肝癌代謝的了解，促進對NASH-HCC病人的早期診斷以及提供更有效的治療方案。

14106415.label: Realisation of objectives
14106415.value: Objective 1: Characterize the tumor–promoting role of SQLE in NASH-HCC a) examine the tumor-promoting functions of SQLE using NASH-HCC cell line models; b) study roles of SQLE in NASH-HCC progression in SQLE conditional transgenic animal models; c) delineate the molecular mechanism by which SQLE is activated. 1a) We performed RNAseq analysis of 17 paired NAFLD-HCC tumor and adjacent normal tissues, revealing that SQLE was highly expressed in NAFLD-HCC. To assess the oncogenic effect of SQLE in human NAFLD-HCC, we constructed LO2 and HKCI10 (NAFLD-HCC) cell lines stably expressing SQLE. SQLE expression promoted cell growth, as evidenced by cell growth curve and colony formation assays. Conversely, knockdown of SQLE in HKCI2 (NAFLD-HCC) cells by shRNA inhibited cell proliferation compared with shControl. Moreover, LO2 and HKCI10 cells over-expressing SQLE showed an increase in S phase cell population, with a concomitant decrease in cells in G1 phase. In contrast, SQLE knockdown in HKCI2 cells induced G1 arrest, indicating that SQLE accelerated G1-S progression. SQLE also regulates apoptosis. SQLE overexpression suppressed apoptosis in LO2 and HKCI10 cells and reduced the protein expression of cleaved forms of caspase-7 and caspase-9; whereas SQLE knockdown had an opposite effect in HKCI2 and BEL-7404 cells. These results suggest that SQLE promoted cell proliferation by activating cell cycle progression and inhibiting apoptosis. 1b) We constructed liver-specific, SQLE-transgenic mice and demonstrated that SQLE significantly increased the incidence of NAFLD-HCC, together with hallmarks of fatty liver disease such as hepatocyte ballooning and inflammatory cell infiltration. Ki-67 staining, TUNEL staining and Cytokine & Chemokines PCR array analysis showed that SQLE overexpression exacerbates HFHC diet-induced NAFLD and promotes NAFLD-HCC formation in mice by inducing inflammation and cell proliferation. 1c) We observed that the copy number amplification of SQLE was positively correlated with its mRNA expression in human NAFLD-HCC, indicating that copy number gain may contribute to up-regulation of SQLE. We further identified that SQLE expression also be regulated by transcription factors, especially SREBP2 and MEIS1 in NAFLD-HCC. Gene amplification together with transcription factors are therefore the main drivers of SQLE overexpression in NAFLD-HCC. Objective 2: Investigate the mechanisms underlying the oncogenic role of SQLE a) determine effects of SQLE-mediated alteration of cholesteryl ester; b) explore SQLE-associated oxidative stress in epigenomic regulation; c) study the influence of SQLE in oncogenic and inflammatory pathways. 2a) Given that SQLE is one of the rate-limiting enzymes for cholesterol biosynthesis, we hypothesized that its overexpression may deregulate cholesterol metabolism in NAFLD-HCC. We observed that Sqle transgenic mice showed markedly enhanced accumulation of liver free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester compared to wild type littermates with a normal diet or high-fat, high-cholesterol diet. In vitro, overexpression of SQLE increased intracellular free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester levels in LO2 and HKCI10 cells compared to their respective control cells, especially for cholesteryl ester (>7-fold). Conversely, SQLE knockdown in HKCI2 and BEL-7404 cells reduced free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester concentrations. 2b) SQLE functions as a monooxygenase that uses an oxygen atom from O2 to oxidize squalene and simultaneously reduces the other oxygen atom using reducing equivalents from NAPDH to generate NADP+. Because NADPH is essential for redox homeostasis, the exhaustion of NADPH by SQLE overexpression resulted in induction of oxidative stress. Consistent with this notion, overexpression of SQLE significantly increased the NADP+ to NADPH ratio in vitro (P<0.01) and in vivo (P<0.01). Many studies indicated an important role of oxidative stress in shaping the epigenetic landscape. To identify epigenetic enzymes deregulated by SQLE-induced oxidative stress, we performed Epigenetic Chromatin Modification Enzymes PCR Array on LO2 and HKCI2 cell lines expressing empty vector or SQLE. SQLE overexpression in LO2 and HKCI2 cells increased mRNA expression of DNA methyltransferase 3A (DNMT3A) and histone deacetylases 5 (HDAC5); but suppressed histone deacetylase 9 (HDAC9). qPCR and Western blot confirmed the up-regulation of DNMT3A mRNA and protein in LO2 and HKCI10 cells overexpressing SQLE, whereas silencing of SQLE in HKCl2 and BEL-7404 cells repressed DNMT3A expression. Activation of DNMT3A by SQLE leads to promoter hypermethylation, resulting in the transcriptional silence of PTEN. PTEN loss was subsequently followed by activation of oncogenic AKT-mTOR signaling. 2c) We investigated the downstream molecular mechanisms underlying the oncogenic function of SQLE using luciferase reporter assays. We found SQLE significantly suppressed FOXO3 reporter (PI3K/AKT pathway-responsive reporter) activity, consistent with its effect on AKT-mTOR signaling. On the other hand, Cytokine & Chemokines PCR array indicated that Sqle overexpression increased the mRNA expression of pro-inflammatory mediators, including Ccl-12, Ccl-20, Ccr-5, Cxcl-9, Cxcr-4, Il-2, Il-4, Il-18r1, Osm, and Spp1. Hence, SQLE promoted AKT-mTOR and pro-inflammatory signaling in NAFLD-HCC. Objective 3: Study the clinical significance of SQLE in NASH-HCC a) determine associations between SQLE protein expression and clinical status; b) investigate serum SQLE and cholesterol levels in clinical serum specimens; c) correlate serum SQLE and cholesterol levels with the risk of NASH-HCC. 3a) In three independent HCC patient cohorts, SQLE was commonly overexpressed in tumor tissues, and high SQLE expression was associated with poor survival in HCC patients. 3b) We observed that serum SQLE level was significantly increased in patients with NAFLD as compared to healthy individuals (P<0.001), but serum cholesterol level was not significantly different in NAFLD patients compared to healthy individuals (P>0.1). In NAFLD patients, serum SQLE was significantly and positively correlated with body mass index (BMI) (r=0.249, P=0.000), steatosis (r=0.161, P=0.017), lobular inflammation (r=0.180, P=0.026), and fibrosis (r=0.161, P=0.048), the latter two of which are the major histologic features of NASH. Multivariate logistic regression analysis was performed and serum SQLE was identified as an independent risk factor for steatosis and steatohepatitis patients in all subjects (odds ratio 0.952, 95% confidence interval 0.917–0.988, P=0.009) after the adjustment for potential confounding factors, including BMI, ALT and fasting glucose. To evaluate the utility of serum SQLE as a biomarker in the diagnosis of NASH, a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve was constructed. Serum SQLE levels exhibited a high overall accuracy in discriminating NASH subjects from control subjects with the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.781 (95% CI: 0.706–0.855). Thus, serum SQLE can be a novel biomarker for the clinical diagnosis of NASH. 3c) In NAFLD-HCC patients, we found that both serum SQLE and cholesteryl ester levels are positively correlated with tumor number and tumor stage. Moreover, high serum SQLE or cholesteryl ester levels were associated with poor survival. To further confirm the correlation of cholesteryl ester with NAFLD-HCC, we measured the free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester levels in 10 pairs of NAFLD-HCC tumors and adjacent normal tissues. We observed significantly increased levels of cholesteryl ester (P<0.05) and free cholesterol (P<0.05) in primary NAFLD-HCC compared to adjacent normal tissues. We also observed a positive correlation between free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester in adjacent normal tissues (R=0.7354, P=0.015), but not in HCC (R=0.5379, P=0.100). Our data therefore indicate that SQLE induces cholesteryl ester biosynthesis, which contributes to the pathogenesis of NAFLD-HCC. Collectively, serum SQLE might be a useful biomarker for diagnosis of NAFLD and NAFLD-HCC.

14106415.label: Major findings and research outcome
14106415.value: In the present study, we performed RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) analysis of 17 paired human NAFLD-HCC and adjacent normal tissues and revealed that SQLE was highly expressed in NAFLD-HCC. In three independent HCC patient cohorts, SQLE was also commonly overexpressed in tumor tissues as compared to adjacent normal tissues. Moreover, high SQLE expression was associated with poor outcomes in HCC patients, indicating that SQLE might play an oncogenic role in NAFLD-HCC. To ask if SQLE functions in NAFLD-HCC tumorigenesis, we developed a genetically engineered mice model specifically overexpressing SQLE in hepatocytes. Consistent with our hypothesis, we demonstrated that SQLE transgenic mice fed a high-fat, high-cholesterol diet had significantly increased incidence of NAFLD-HCC, suggesting that SQLE is an oncogenic factor that promotes NAFLD-HCC. Mechanistic investigations in cell line and mice models also shed light on the molecular mechanism of SQLE in NAFLD-HCC. SQLE overexpression promoted accumulation of free cholesterol and cholesteryl ester, which in turn induced cell proliferation. SQLE requires NADPH as a cofactor and its up-regulation leads to depletion of NADPH and an increase in reactive oxygen species (ROS). Increased ROS triggered a cascade of events, which involved up-regulation of DNMT3A, promoter DNA hypermethylation and transcriptional silence of PTEN, which in turn, activated downstream AKT/mTOR pathways. Collectively, our results indicated that SQLE have cholesterol dependent and independent-mechanism that promotes the development of NAFLD-HCC. Terbinafine (SQLE inhibitor) is a FDA-approved drug used for treatment of fungal infections. We observed that Terbinafine suppressed SQLE-induced cholesteryl ester and oxidative stress accumulation, leading to reduced cancer cell proliferation. Besides, terbinafine treatment in mice with HCC xenografts arrested tumor growth and extended survival. Finally, terbinafine treatment in SQLE transgenic mice effectively reduced incidence of NAFLD-HCC. These results indicate that Terbinafine might be useful for the prevention and treatment of NAFLD-HCC. These data were published in Science Translational Medicine [1] as the cover story, and was covered by several new outlet such as Medical Xpress, xinhuanet, sina, etc. Reference: 1. 14106415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14106415.value: Our study showed that the cholesterol biosynthesis gene SQLE is essential for the pathogenesis of NAFLD-HCC. Our work also showed that Terbinafine can be repurposed for the treatment of NAFLD-HCC. We will continue to investigate the efficacy of Terbinafine, as well as other SQLE inhibitors, in NAFLD-HCC using preclinical models. Moreover, we are pursuing the potential use of serum SQLE as a potential non-invasive biomarker for NAFLD-HCC. These studies, if successful, will lead to further translation of our findings to benefit the livelihood of NAFLD-HCC patients.

14106415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14106415.value: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)-induced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is an emerging malignancy in the developed world. However, the molecular mechanism of NAFLD-HCC remains poorly understood and no therapeutic drug is currently available for prevention or treatment of NAFLD-HCC. In this study, utilizing next-generation sequencing platforms, we comprehensively profiled 17 pairs of NAFLD-HCC and normal liver tissues, revealing that SQLE is highly expressed in NAFLD-HCC. We constructed SQLE-transgenic mice and demonstrated that SQLE significantly increased incidence of NAFLD-HCC, suggesting that SQLE functions as an oncogene in NAFLD-HCC. Importantly, we found that Terbinafine (SQLE inhibitor), a U.S. FDA-approved drug commonly used for treating fungal infection, can be repurposed for the targeting of NAFLD-HCC. Terbinafine suppressed SQLE-induced oncogenic cascade, leading to reduced cancer cell proliferation. Terbinafine treatment in mice with HCC xenografts arrested growth and extended survival, and it reduced the incidence of NAFLD-HCC in SQLE transgenic mice with no apparent adverse effects. Our study has characterized a previously unappreciated role of SQLE in NAFLD-HCC, provides a new direction for targeting NAFLD-HCC. We will continue to evaluate Terbinafine efficacy in NAFLD-HCC, and to translate our findings to the clinic to benefit patient care.

14106715.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14106715.value: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is the most common gastrointestinal (GI) emergency requiring surgical intervention in preterm infants. NEC occurs in 2.5-10% of admissions in neonatal intensive care units (NICU) and has an overall mortality of 20-30%. Those who survived may suffer long-term complications, including impaired neurodevelopment and poor physical growth. Early clinical manifestations of NEC are often nonspecific and difficult to differentiate from other neonatal conditions, such as septicemia with ileus or functional GI dysmotility of prematurity. However, NEC could progress in a fulminant manner leading to severe inflammation of the bowel, septic shock, multi-organ failure and death within days of onset if appropriate treatment is not timely instituted. To date, there is no effective biomarker for surveillance and/or diagnosis of NEC, especially distinguishing this condition from neonatal sepsis. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are non-coding RNAs that exhibit negative regulation on gene expression. Specific miRNAs are associated with acute and chronic human diseases, and hold great potentials for clinical applications as biomarkers and therapeutic agents. In our hypothesis-free profiling and quantitative study of dysregulated miRNAs in human intestinal tissues of NEC, we demonstrated that miR-223 and miR-451 were increased 25.2-fold and 22.8-fold compared with non-inflamed human intestinal tissue specimens. Further quantitative analysis of fecal specimens showed that miR-223 and miR-451 were also significantly increased before and at the onset of illness. Importantly, their levels were already raised 7 days prior to disease onset and subsequently subsided upon recovery. Our hypothesis is that fecal miR-223 and miR-451 are potential biomarkers for surveillance as well as for early diagnosis of NEC. The objectives of our study are: (1) to investigate the usefulness of fecal levels of miR-223 and miR-451 as “surveillance” biomarkers for predicting the development of NEC before clinical suspicion. This will be achieved by twice weekly fecal collection from preterm infants at birth to 10 weeks of postnatal age, and longitudinal analysis of miR-223 and miR-451 comparing their levels between infants who develop NEC and those who do not; and (2) to determine the diagnostic utilities (sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values) of fecal miR-223 and miR-451 as non-invasive “diagnostic” biomarkers at the onset of NEC. If proven, these novel non-invasive biomarkers could be developed to improve patient care by early targeting the at-risk group of infants (i.e., as surveillance biomarkers), and for accurate diagnosis of NEC at the onset of clinical suspicion (i.e., as diagnostic biomarkers). 壞死性小腸結腸炎(NEC)是早產兒常見及最嚴重的胃腸道急症，經常需要手術治療。此病在重症監護病房的發病率為2.5-10%，死亡率更是高達20-30%。即使倖存的新生兒亦可能遭受神經發育受損和體質較差等並發症的長期影響。壞死性小腸結腸炎的早期臨床表徴往往沒有特異性，很難和敗血症、腸梗阻以及功能性胃腸蠕動障礙等其他新生兒疾病區分。然而，如果在發病的初時沒有得到及時適當的治療，病情就會迅速發展並且導致嚴重的腸道炎症，膿毒性休克，甚至多器官功能衰竭，最終導致死亡。 迄今為止，還沒有有效的生物標誌物能夠監測或診斷壞死性小腸結腸炎，尤其缺少能夠將壞死性小腸結腸炎與新生兒敗血症有效區分的生物標誌物。微核醣核酸是一種非編碼的小片段核醣，它們有着負向性的基因調節功能。一些特定的微核醣核酸在體內表達量的變化與急慢性疾病密切相關，因此微核醣核酸在預測疾病的預後及建立分子診斷標誌方面具有極大的臨床應用價值。 我們在沒有建立假設的情況下運用基因表達的方法去檢測微核糖核酸在壞死性小腸結腸炎腸組織中的表達，結果得出核醣核酸miR-223和miR-451在壞死性小腸結腸炎腸組織中的表達水平比正常腸組織增加了20倍以上。並且，我們對患兒的糞便標本作了進一步定量分析，發現miR-223和miR-451的表達量在發病時或發病7天前已經增加。 我們的假設是糞便微核醣核酸miR-223和miR-451能夠作為新生兒壞死性小腸結腸炎早期診斷的非侵入性生物標誌。所以這項研究的目標是：（1）考查糞便微核醣核酸miR-223和miR-451在臨床症狀出現之前，作為"監視"生物標誌對預測疾病發展的作用。為達到這個目標，我們收集了早產兒從出生到出生后10周的糞便樣本（每週收集兩次），並將對這些樣本中miR-223和miR-451的表達量進行縱向分析，比較NEC患兒和非NEC早產兒糞便中這兩種微核醣核酸含量的差異。（2）通過考察miR-223和miR-451作為生物標誌的敏感性，特異性，陽性和陰性預測值，探討它們作為壞死性小腸結腸炎的"診斷"生物標誌是否可行。 如果能夠證明上述理論，新的非侵入性生物標誌物可能被開發為能夠準確識別早期高風險的嬰兒("監視"生物標誌) 和真正的壞死性小腸結腸炎病例("診斷"生物標誌)的生物標誌 。這些研究結果能夠幫助兒科醫生為患兒提供針對性治療，具有極高的臨床應用價值。

14106715.label: Realisation of objectives
14106715.value: All the objectives were completed. A manuscript entitled: “A prospective cohort study on fecal miR-223 and miR-451a as non-invasive biomarkers for early diagnosis of necrotizing enterocolitis in preterm infants” is under preparation. (Appendix 1) Our novel findings and deliverables are described as follows: 1. To determine the usefulness of fecal miR-223 and miR-451 as “surveillance” biomarkers for predicting the development of NEC in preterm infants before clinical suspicion. Deliverables (i) Levels of miR-223 and miR-451 in stool specimens collected twice weekly from preterm infants at birth to 10 weeks of postnatal age, with longitudinal comparison between the NEC group and non-NEC group. Within the study period, 250 infants were recruited. Of these infants, we obtained samples from 24 NEC cases including 4 outborn infants. Fecal miR-223 and miR-451a levels of these specimens were compared with those from control (CTL) infants who showed no signs/ symptoms indicative of NEC/infection or no workup performed during hospital stay (n=28). Our data demonstrated that fecal miRNAs of CTL infants at different postnatal ages were significantly lower (miR-223 median levels 4.5-76 copies; miR-451a 0-3 copies) than those in NEC specimens collected at disease onset (miR-223, 347 copies; miR-451a, 33 copies; P<0.05) (Appendix 2, Figure 1A, 1C). Large overlapping of concentrations between NEC and CTL infants at any age of sampling decreased their potential as target markers. Longitudinal comparison was performed between a subgroup of NEC (n=12) and non-NEC patients (with workup performed) with gestational and postnatal age matched (n=12) and control infants (CTL, n=28) (no workup group) (Appendix 2, Figure 1B, 1D: Black lines represent NEC, color lines represent non-NEC and CTL). Due to the practical problem that many preterm infants did not pass stool from the onset of GI conditions (such as NEC, peritonitis or sepsis-induced ileus), complete serial sample collections could not be achieved in some cases. Furthermore, levels of miRNAs in NEC/CTL infants demonstrated great variability, a limitation for their effectiveness as biomarkers for screening or prediction of NEC occurrence before the onset of clinical signs and symptoms. (ii) The optimal timing, cut-off levels and diagnostic utility (sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values) of using fecal miR-223 and miR-451 for “surveillance” and predicting the development of NEC before clinical presentation. To determine the diagnostic utility of fecal miRNAs for predicting the development of NEC before clinical presentation, the samples were stratified into groups of day 3 (Day -3), day 5 to 7 (Day -5 to -7), and day 9 to 11 (Day -9 to -11) before the onset date of NEC. However, there were no significant differences between NEC and non-NEC groups (P>0.05). Median concentration (copies/ mcg feces) were found to be 202 (Day -3), 27 (Day -5 to -7), 4 (Day -9 to -11) for miR-223 and 8, 3, and 2 for miR-451a. The analysis of receiver operating characteristics (ROC) was performed and the area under the ROC curve (AUROC) values are summarized in Table 1 (Appendix 2). 2. To determine the usefulness of fecal miR-223 and miR-451 for early “diagnosis” of NEC at the onset of clinical presentation. Deliverables (i) The optimal cut-off levels and diagnostic utility of fecal miR-223 and miR-451 for accurate differentiation of NEC infants from non-NEC infants. In this prospective cohort, we recruited over 250 preterm infants. Samples were collected within 24 hours of sepsis workup. Among the samples, 218 episodes were included in the analysis and subsequently classified into NEC (n=24) and non-NEC (n=194) groups based on our previously published criteria (Ng PC et al., 2018). The non-NEC group comprised patients with spontaneous perforation/intestinal obstruction (n=5), clinical sepsis (n=36), proven sepsis (n=49) and those without infection (i.e., BPD, apnea of prematurity, GI dysmotility) (n=104). The fecal miR-223 and miR-451a levels were found to be significantly higher in NEC infants compared with non-NEC infants (3.2-4.6 fold, P<0.05). The AUROC of fecal miR-223 and miR-451a were 0.663 and 0.680, with P=0.009 and 0.004, respectively. The optimal cut-off levels of fecal miR-223 and miR-451a were found to be 130 and 9.5 copies per microgram feces. The highest diagnostic odds ratios (DOR) were found to be 4.86 and 4.46. (ii) Comparison of the diagnostic utilities of fecal miR-223 and miR-451 with those of fecal calprotectin. (Calprotectin has been suggested as a diagnostic biomarker but not a surveillance biomarker of NEC[9]). The diagnostic utilities of fecal miR-223 and miR-451a as non-invasive “diagnostic” biomarkers at the onset of NEC were found to be comparable to fecal calprotectin and plasma CRP (Day 0 or Day1). Furthermore, correlation of fecal calprotectin levels with gestational and postnatal ages in the non-NEC group was observed. (iii) Identification of a single or combination of stool biomarkers most accurate for diagnosing NEC. The combination of fecal miR-223 (>130 copies/mcg) and miR-451a (>9.5 copies/mcg) or plasma CRP (>50 mg/L) at day 1 achieved the highest DOR of 18.23 with sensitivity of 0.92 and specificity of 0.62 for diagnosing NEC. Despite a lower DOR of 12.32, combination of fecal miR-223 (>130 copies/mcg) or miR-451a (>9.5 copies/mcg) and calprotectin (>140 mg/g) improved specificity to 0.71 with a sensitivity of 0.83 for diagnosing NEC.

14106715.label: Major findings and research outcome
14106715.value: Major new findings: (1) Quantitative analysis of fecal specimens showed that miR-223 and miR-451a were significantly increased at the onset of illness. Optimal cutoffs of miR-223 and miR-451a were selected as 130 and 9.5 copies/ g feces, respectively. The diagnostic utilities of these miRNAs as non-invasive “diagnostic” biomarkers at the onset of NEC (Day 0) were found to have > 0.75 sensitivity and > 0.60 specificity. The performance of these two novel miRNA markers was similar to that of fecal calprotectin and plasma CRP (Day 0 or Day 1). Using the decision tree, the combination of fecal miRNAs (miR-223 >130 and miR-451a >9.5 copies/ g feces) and plasma CRP at day 1 (>50 mg/L) achieved the highest DOR of 18.23 with a sensitivity of 0.92 and a specificity of 0.62 for diagnosing NEC. (2) To our knowledge, this is the first report that investigated the expression characteristics of fecal miRNAs in preterm infants from birth to 3 months of life. Only a limited number of patients provided fecal samples that coincided with the time of collection who did not exhibit any signs of infection during hospital stay (n=28). In this cohort, we measured the levels of fecal miR-223 and miR-451a 1-2 times a week and found no correlation of their fecal levels with postnatal age. Although the levels of both target miRNAs were significantly higher in NEC infants than in the control patients at any timepoints or non-NEC groups at the time of sepsis workup (P<0.05), the usefulness of these miRNAs alone as surveillance markers for predicting NEC before clinical features develop was of limited clinical usefulness, mainly due to the high variability of concentration within- and between-patients. Publications: (a) A manuscript entitled: “A prospective cohort study on fecal miR-223 and miR-451a as non-invasive biomarkers for early diagnosis of necrotizing enterocolitis in preterm infants” is under preparation for review and publication. (Appendix 1) (b) Oral presentation in Conference: 18th Perinatal Symposium 2018 (Oct/2018; Hong Kong) Biomarkers for Neonatal Infection- the Journey. (Appendix 3) (c) Oral presentation in Conference: The Neonate 2018 (Nov/2018; Shanghai) NEC-What is new in biomarkers. (Appendix 4)

14106715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14106715.value: miRNAs are small RNAs are emerging candidate biomarkers and therapeutic agents. In this study, the 2 target miRNAs (miR-223 and miR-451a), which were discovered from our study on the miRNA profiles of NEC bowel tissues (Ng PC et al., 2015), were quantified in stool specimens. Although the inter-individual and intra-individual variability of miR-223 and miR-451a might have precluded their clinical application as sole biomarkers, the method that we acquired from the current study would allow further biomarker discovery and development of ‘non-invasive’ biomarkers for diagnosis of NEC. It is anticipated that our research could provide the basis for further development of these biomarkers for bedside use by frontline clinical personnel. Based on a preliminary trial (n=4), we found the over 50 miRNAs were detectable in these samples. For further studies, we propose to conduct miRNA array screening on the stool samples of the matched cohort of 12 NEC and 12 non-NEC cases to identify new targets. The differentially expressed miRNA would represent new targets for future validation in another prospective study.

14106715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14106715.value: This project aimed to discover and validate specific ‘non-invasive’ biomarkers for early diagnosis of a gastrointestinal condition (necrotizing enterocolitis, NEC) in preterm infants. NEC is the most common entity in neonatal surgery with high mortality and morbidity rates worldwide. Early indication of NEC in high-risk infants would alert neonatologists to closely monitor for early signs of NEC and initiate necessary precautions, such as withdrawal of milk feeds, which could theoretically reduce continuing tissue damage and development of severe NEC. Our findings demonstrated that the two target miRNAs in fecal materials at the onset of NEC were significantly higher compared with those in non-NEC infants, indicating their usefulness as early diagnostic biomarkers. Their diagnostic utilities were further improved when used in combination with other stool/plasma markers, indicating their potential applications in adjunct to other biomarkers for early diagnosis of NEC. However, due to the variable and overlapping range of miRNA concentrations in stool specimens preceding the onset of NEC, the usefulness of these biomarkers alone for prediction/surveillance of the disease has not been clearly established. Our findings have paved the way for development of bedside reagent kits and their incorporation into clinical protocols.
