14304915.label: Major findings and research outcome
14304915.value: This project led to several new findings. One of the major discovery is the reverse binding mode that SH2 proteins adopt. The difference between normal versus reverse binding modes is not discernible by traditional methods. Our proximity reaction however can covalently lock different binding modes, allowing the normal and reverse binding modes to be separated. Screening a panel of SH2 domains that contain cysteines allowed us to discover a group of SH2 domains that bind to peptides with reverse mode. This was further supported by computational studies. The second major discovery is an Nck peptide blocker that can inhibit the invasion of bacterial cells through a mechanism-based specific inhibition in the host cells. This peptide as an important cellular probe illustrates a new antibacterial mechanism that prevents bacterial infection through inhibition of intracellular signal. This peptide also showed impressive efficacy inside animals, a potential drug lead to an undruggable target, a signalling protein. The third major discovery is a set of new lysine methylation sites that are discovered for the first time, which greatly expands the pool of known lysine methylation sites. Several papers have already been published to report the results above including an invited review paper. One paper is still under revision and is expected to be published in a well-respected journal. Because of this work, we were invited to write a review article to introduce this novel chemistry and its applications to the community. This work was also reported in international conferences as invited talks. A total of four PhD students received training under this project, with two have graduated with PhD degree during the period.

14304915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14304915.value: Affinity-guided covalent reactions of protein binding domains represents a new research frontier of chemical biology. It significance lies in potential biomedical applications. Reaction of non-active residues in a site-specific manner enables the development of a new classes of inhibitors towards protein – protein interactions are normally considered undruggable. These inhibitors may develop into drug leads that will inspire drug development. We are planning to apply some of these inhibitors in animal studies to show that these peptides have low toxicity, high efficacy, and high bioavailability. The reactive peptides have also been successfully applied to proteomic studies through collaboration with proteomic specialists. Both directions have led to a series of funding applications and collaboration with research groups in mainland China and abroad, and several papers are under preparation. Furthermore, we will seek opportunities to apply for patents, or to commercialize the covalent peptides as a proteomic tool for site-specific covalent immobilization.

14304915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14304915.value: Enzymes are naturally evolved catalysts that can react with the substrate at a precise position inside cells. Mimicking nature, we have developed covalent peptides that can precisely react with one single residue at a natural protein, a goal not attainable otherwise. This opens a wide possibilities in drug development – proteins that normally considered undruggable now can be effective blocked. Although still remaining in the laboratory, further extension of this work will greatly benefit drug development to treat diseases such as infection and cancer.

14305015.label: Project Objectives
14305015.value: To prepare potassium complexes of diaryl-substituted triazenide anions [ArNNNAr]– (Ar = 2,6-iPr2C6H3 or 2,4,6-tBu3C6H2) as ligand-transfer reagents for the synthesis of the corresponding lanthanide(II) derivatives. The potassium complexes will be characterized structurally by X-ray diffraction analysis, NMR spectroscopy and elemental analysis. To synthesize Sm(II), Eu(II) and Yb(II) complexes of monoanionic triazenide ligands [ArNNNAr]– (Ar = 2,6-iPr2C6H3 or 2,4,6-tBu3C6H2) by the reactions of an appropriate LnI2(THF)2 with the corresponding potassium triazenides. The lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes will be characterized by X-ray crystallography, elemental analysis and various spectroscopic methods. A detailed investigation on the reactivity of the lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes with an array of inorganic and organic compounds will be carried out, including their reactivity as reductants towards a series of common oxidizing agents such as silver(I) halides, copper(I) halides and iodine. In addition, their reactivity towards reductive cleavage of the dichalcogenide bonds in diaryl dichalcogenides, the nitrogen-nitrogen double bond in azobenzene will be examined. Furthermore, the reactions of these lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes with organohydrazines and organic azides will also be carefully studied. A systematic comparison on the coordination behavior of four related nitrogen-coordinating ligands, namely 2-pyridyl amides, amidinates, guanidinates and triazenides, with Sm(II), Eu(II) and Yb(II) will be carried out. Effects concerning the steric and electronic properties of these four ligand systems on the structures and reactivity of the corresponding lanthanide(II) complexes will be examined.

14305015.label: Realisation of objectives
14305015.value: With respect to the project objectives as per original application: (1) Potassium triazenide complex KL(THF)0.5, where L = [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– and Dipp = diisopropylphenyl, was successfully prepared in good yield by metallation of triazene [(Dipp)N=NNH(Dipp)] (HL) with potassium hydride in THF under ambient conditions. The formulation of the KL(THF)0.5 complex was confirmed by 1H and 13C NMR spectroscopy as well as elemental analysis, though single crystals of the complex suitable for X-ray diffraction analysis could not be obtained. (2) Mononuclear lanthanide(II) bis(triazenide) complexes [LnL2(THF)n] (Ln = Eu and Sm, n = 2; Ln = Yb, n = 1; L = [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]–) were successfully synthesized by metathesis reactions of an appropriate lanthanide(II) diiodide LnI2(THF)2 (Eu(II), Sm(II) and Yb(II)) with 2 molar equivalents of the potassium reagent KL(THF)0.5 in THF. The formulation of these lanthanide(II) bis(triazenide) complexes was confirmed by elemental analysis and their solid-state structures were determined by X-ray crystallography. To the best of our knowledge, the [SmL2(THF)2] complex is the first Sm(II) triazenide complex to be structurally characterized. Besides an exploratory study on the coordination properties of the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand with vanadium was also carried out in this work. Two mononuclear V(III) complexes, namely [V(L)Cl2(TMEDA)] and [V(L)Cl2(THF)2], were successfully synthesized. Their subsequent reactions with lithium acetylides, potassium triethylborohydride and zinc metal, respectively, led to isolation of the corresponding trivalent and divalent vanadium complexes. They represent first examples of vanadium triazenide complexes to be isolated and structurally characterized. (3) It is noted that lanthanide(II) complexes are strong reductants, which readily undergo one-electron oxidation to the form the corresponding lanthanide(III) species. Accordingly, the reactivity of the present lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes [LnL2(THF)2] towards various types of reagents including AgCl, benzyl chloride, elemental iodine, diaryl dichalcogenides ArEEAr (Ar = C6H5, 2,4,6-tBu3C6H2; E = S, Se) was studied in this work. In addition, reactions of the most reducing Sm(II) complex [SmL2(THF)2] and phenyl-substituted hydrazines (PhNH–NH2 and PhNH–NHPh) have also been examined in this study. Results of our study revealed that the [LnL2(THF)2] complexes are strong one-electron reductants, which readily reacted with appropriate reagents, leading to formation of the corresponding lanthanide(III) complexes. The lanthanide(III) products were structurally characterized by X-ray crystallography. (4) Results of the present research work and those of our recent studies have shown that all of the four related nitrogen-coordinating ligands used in our studies are good candidates for stabilizing the corresponding Eu(II) and Yb(II) complexes, whilst only amidinates, guanidinates and triazenides can stabilize the more reducing Sm(II) derivatives. It is worth to note that a subtle modification of the steric and/or electronic properties of these ligands can lead to variation in their coordination properties with the lanthanide(II) ions. Results of our work on these four nitrogen-coordinating ligand systems have provided a general picture on their coordination properties with lanthanide(II) ions. Difficulty encountered in this work: The main difficulty that we encountered in this part of our study is a relatively low stability of the lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes. Apart from their extremely high sensitivity to air and moisture, these lanthanide(II) complexes were found not to be robust. It may be attributed to the relatively unstable triazo core of the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand. This renders their isolation and characterization difficult to carry out. A considerable amount of time and effort has gone into the isolation and purification of the compounds in order to collect analytical and spectroscopic data for complete characterization. Together with the unrest of society last year and the worldwide pandemic this year, all these unexpected happenings have led to a slow progress of this work behind our original schedule. During the submission of this completion report, one manuscript reporting on the chemistry of the vanadium triazenide complexes has been submitted to a peer-review journal whilst another manuscript reporting our work on the lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes is in the final stage of its preparation.

Divalent Eu(II), Sm(II) and Yb(II) complexes supported by the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand were successfully synthesized by direction reactions of an appropriate LnI2(THF)2 (Ln = Eu, Sm, Yb) with 2 equivalents of the potassium reagent [KL(THF)0.5]. The formulation of these lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes was confirmed by elemental analysis and their solid-state structures were determined by X-ray crystallography. All these related anionic systems are good candidates for stabilizing europium(II) and ytterbium(II) complexes. However, a slight modification of the steric bulkiness of the ligands can greatly influence their coordination behavior towards the more reducing Sm(II) ion. We hope that the results of our studies can provide more understanding on the coordination chemistry of these nitrogen-donor systems with lanthanide(II) ions.

14305015.label: Major findings and research outcome
14305015.value: Organolanthanide chemistry has been dominated by lanthanide(III) complexes supported by cyclopentadienyl ligands. In contrast, the chemistry of lanthanide(II) complexes stabilized by non-cyclopentadienyl ligands has received relatively less attention. The present research work focused on synthesis and reactivity of lanthanide(II) complexes supported by a monoanionic triazenide ligand [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– (L). Major findings of this work include: (1) Three mononuclear lanthanide(II) complexes of the general formula of [LnL2(THF)n] (Ln = Eu and Sm, n = 2; Ln = Yb, n = 1; L = [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]–) were successfully prepared and characterized. It is noteworthy that only a few examples of lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes have been reported in the literature and mononuclear derivatives are rare. Our work has demonstrated that the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand is capable of supporting highly reactive lanthanide(II) complexes. It can also suppress the formation of ate-complexes, which are commonly observed in lanthanide chemistry. (2) It is also noteworthy that a detailed investigation on the reactivity of lanthanide(II) triazenides has not been documented in the literature. The reactivity of the present [LnL2(THF)n] complexes as one-electron reductants with a range of reagents has been investigated in this work. (3) The reactions of [SmL2(THF)2] and phenyl-substituted hydrazines (PhNH–NH2 and PhNH–NHPh) were also examined in this work. Hydrazine is generally believed to be a nitrogenase-relevant substrate. A number of transition metal complexes containing substituted and unsubstituted hydrazine or hydrazido ligands have been reported as models for understanding the binding modes of hydrazine to the metals and relevant activation mechanisms (see for example, Limberg and co-workers, Inorg. Chem. 2012, 51, 9740). To our knowledge, only one lanthanide(II) complex, namely [SmCp*2] (Cp* = C5Me5–), has been employed to study the reduction of phenyl-hydrazines (Evans and co-workers, Inorg. Chem. 1992, 31, 3592). We have demonstrated that the [SmL2(THF)2] complex could reduce PhNH–NH2 and PhNH–NHPh, respectively, leading to formation of the corresponding phenylhydrazido(1-) ligand and a diphenylhydrazido(2-) ligand. (4) The chemistry of triazenide complexes of early 3d metals has not been examined in detail. Accordingly, we have carried out an exploratory study on the coordination properties of the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand with vanadium. A series of vanadium(II) and vanadium(III) complexes derived from the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand were synthesized and structurally characterized in this work. Mononuclear V(III) complexes [V(L)Cl2(TMEDA)] and [V(L)Cl2(THF)2] were prepared and their reactions with lithium acetylides, potassium triethylborohydride and zinc metal, respectively, were studied. To our knowledge, they are first examples of vanadium triazenide complexes to be structurally characterized.

14305015.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14305015.value: The successful isolation of the highly reactive lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes in this work prompts us to extend our study to the d block elements. An initial study by our group has led to successful isolation of several vanadium triazenide complexes. Further development of our research work will be laid on the coordination behavior of the triazenide system with late 3d metals, such as iron, cobalt and nickel. Although amidinate and guanidinate complexes of iron, cobalt and nickel have been documented in the literature, reports on their triazenide counterparts are rare. Therefore, it is worth to carry out an investigation on the chemistry triazenide complexes of these late 3d metals. Moreover, the electronic properties of the triazenide ligands can be tunable by incorporation of appropriate electron-donating or -withdrawing substituents.

14305015.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14305015.value: The development of organolanthanide chemistry has been dominated by the use of cyclopentadienyl ligands with the lanthanide metal ions in their common +3 oxidation state. In contrast, lanthanide(II) complexes derived from non-cyclopentadienyl ligands have received relatively less attention. Triazenide anions having a general formula of [R-NNN-R]– (R = organic substituents) are nitrogen-coordinating ligands which can bind metal ions in different coordination modes. Despite their interesting coordination properties, there are only few reports on the use of triazenide ligands in the lanthanide chemistry. The present research project focused on synthesis, structural characterization and reactivity of samarium(II), europium(II) and ytterbium(II) complexes supported by monoanionic triazenide ligand [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– (Dipp = 2,6-diisopropylphenyl). Results of our study have demonstrated that the [(Dipp)NNN(Dipp)]– ligand is capable of supporting highly reactive lanthanide(II) complexes. It is worth to note that lanthanide(II) complexes are potent single-electron reductants. Therefore, the redox reactivity of the present lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes towards various reagents has also been studied in this work. Results of our work may provide insights to future applications of lanthanide(II) triazenide complexes in various chemical transformation.

14305315.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14305315.value: 一維可壓縮歐拉方程組的週期解

14305315.label: Project Objectives
14305315.value: One of the main objectives is to derive some optimal estimates for the growth rate of the total variation over each period for a space-periodic entropy weak solution to the one-dimensional 3 x 3 non-isentropic Euler equations. The aim is to derive an optimal lower bound estimate for the life-span of a periodic entropy weak solution in terms of its initial total variation on a period. This will be first crucial step to address the basic question whether the theory of Glimm-Lax theory holds true for the non-isentropic ease, i.e. whether entropy weak periodic solutions for the full 3 x 3 Euler system exist and decay with a rate to the constant average in each period, and if not, to what do they decay. It should be noted that this is not just a technical issue and the global existence and decay to a constant are not imminent as indicated by some important recent studies, and the global existence cannot be obtained easily without taking into account the structure of the unknown time-asymptotic limits. We will develop some techniques to quantify the dissipative effects which will be used to control the cancelation of the shocks and rarefactions and to improve the estimate of the growth of the entropy waves even in the presence of entropy variation. Another main objective is to study the finite time formation of shocks for the one-dimensional non-isentropic Euler system with smooth periodic initial data. It should be noted that in contrast to the isentropic Euler system for which every non-trivial spatial periodic solution develops shocks in finite time, there are non-trivial global in time smooth spatial-periodic solution to the full compressible Euler equations. On the other hand, if the initial variation of the entropy wave is much smaller than that of the sound waves in each period, then shocks must form in finite time. So our main talk is to study the finite time formation of shocks for the non-isentropic compressible Euler system with general smooth periodic initial data which contain sound waves.

14305315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14305315.value: The dynamics of periodic solutions to the compressible Euler equations is an extremely interesting, important fundamental problem for the mathematical theory of shock waves. Indeed, evolution of space-periodic solutions of the compressible Euler system describes the nonlinear sound wave propagation, and the linearized theory of sound and harmonics (based on periodic solutions) has been the starting point of acoustics since the time of Euler. The problem of the growth and decay of the propagation of periodic sound waves when the nonlinear effects and entropy variations are taken into account remains open, despite the celebrated breakthrough of Glimm-Lax which established the important result that space periodic solutions decay at an optimal rate to the constant state average in each period under the key assumption that the entropy is constant. In this project, we propose to study some basic questions on the dynamical motions of space-periodic solutions of the full one-dimensional non-isentropic Euler system. We will focus on two issues: one is the finite formation of shocks from the smooth periodic initial data; another is to establish better estimates for the growth rate of the total variation for space-periodic weak solutions with the goal to establish the large time existence of such periodic weak solutions. These studies will lead to some deeper understanding on nonlinear interactions of sound waves and entropy waves and possible phenomena of resonance. 可壓縮歐拉方程週期解的動力學是激波的數學理論中極有意思和極為重要的基本問題。事實上，可壓縮歐拉系統空間週期解的演化描述了非線性聲波的傳播。自歐拉時代起，以聲音、諧波的基於週期解的線性理論的研究為起點建立了聲學理論。對於非線性情形，儘管Glimm-Lax取得了一個值得紀念的重大突破，他們在引入熵為常數的關鍵性假設下，建立了如下的重要結果：空間週期解在每個週期內，以最優速率衰減到平均值平衡態。但考慮一般非線性效應及熵變差時，週期聲波在傳播中的增長/衰減仍然是公開問題。 在本項目中，我們將研究一維完整非等熵歐拉系統週期解動力學行為的一些基本問題。我們著重於兩類問題，一類是光滑週期初值的有限時間激波形成；另一類是對於週期弱解建立更好的總變差的增長速率的估計，以此進一步建立這類週期弱解的長時間存在性理論。通過這些研究，將進一步加深對於聲波、熵波間的非線性相互作用以及可能的共振現象的理解。

14305315.label: Realisation of objectives
14305315.value: We have achieved the objectives of this proposal fully by carrying out the following research activities. First, the effects of resonant wave interactions in the presence of spatial periodicity and entropy variations have been realized. We have obtained a long time estimates for the spatial periodic entropy weak solutions to the full 3x3 compressible Euler system in one space dimension which are achieved by some elaborate estimates of the interactions of nonlinear sound waves and entropy waves based on cancellations of shock waves with expansion waves and effective control of the entropy production. Second, deeper understandings on large time behavior and resonances have been achieved by studying the finite time shock formation and large time existence of spatial weak solutions for the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system obtained from the full Euler equations by the weakly nonlinear geometric optics. Furthermore, we have focused on precise sufficient conditions in terms of the ratio of total amount of initial nonlinear waves and linear waves in each period so the finite time formation of shock waves occur. The global existence of entropy weak periodic solutions to the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system solves a long standing open problem in this area. Next, we have also achieved the objective to understand the asymptotic behavior of basic nonlinear waves (shock and rarefaction waves) under periodic perturbations by establishing the nonlinear asymptotic stability of shock waves and rarefactions waves under generic periodic perturbations for general nonlinear convex conservations (both inviscid and viscous case are studied) which are important protype models for sound wave propagations in gas dynamics.

14305315.label: Major findings and research outcome
14305315.value: With the support of RGC grant 14305315, the PI has established the following results. (1) A longer life span estimate is obtained for spatial entropy weak solutions to the full 3x3 compressible Euler system in one space dimension provided that the total variation of the initial data in each period is suitably small. This span is substantially longer than the previous known theory. This is achieved by overcoming the difficulty that the total variation may increase in time due to the interactions of nonlinear sound waves with the linear entropy waves. For global dynamics and possible resonances, we have derived a sharp condition for the finite time shock formation from smooth periodic data, and established the global existence of spatial periodic weak solutions to the well-known weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system obtained from the full Euler system by the weakly nonlinear geometric optics. This has solved a long standing open problem in this area. These results are published in [3]. (2) We have made important progress to understand the asymptotic stability of basic nonlinear waves under spatial periodic perturbations for both inviscid and viscous hyperbolic conservation laws. For scalar convex conservation laws, which are protype models of sound wave propagation for gas dynamics, we have obtained the asymptotic nonlinear stability for both shocks and rarefaction waves under generic periodic perturbations with optimal rates of decay. More importantly, for the viscous case, the global oscillations make it impossible to determine the phase slight a priorily from the initial perturbation, which is completely different from the localized perturbations. All of these results are published in [15, 19]. (3) By the partial support of this grant, the PI has made important progress on some related problems. In particular, the PI and his collaborators have developed a theory on vacuum dynamics for multi-dimensional compressible fluids, including the global well-posedness theory, the finite time blow-up theory, the well-posedness of entropy bounded solutions with only far field vacuum, the asymptotic stability of Lame-Emden solutions, and characterizations of singularities. These results are reported in papers [14, 8, 2, 9, 13, 20, 17, 11]. For steady compressible Euler equations, the PI and his collaborator have solved several long open problems on both smooth and non-smooth transonic flows. These results are reported in [1, 12, 16, 10, 5, 18, 6]. Some new results on boundary layer theory have been also obtained in [4, 7].

14305315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14305315.value: The methods developed here to obtain the longer time estimates on the life span of spatial periodic entropy solutions to both the full compressible Euler system and the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system should share light on the global in time existence of spatial periodic solutions for the ideal gas dynamics equations and its resonant behavior. Especially, the precise conditions for shock formation and estimate for the cancellation of compression and expansion waves and mild growth rate of the entropy production for the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system can provide important insights on the resonant behavior of solutions to the 1-dimensional full compressible Euler system. I plan to apply these insights and the weakly nonlinear geometric optics method to study the global existence of weak spatial periodic solutions and characterize the set of data for shock formation by using the solutions obtained for the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics as the first order ansatz. I also plan to use the basic ideas and technique developed here to study the nonlinear asymptotic stability of basic waves under periodic perturbations for general system of hyperbolic conservation laws.

14305315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14305315.value: The dynamics of periodic solutions and stability of basic waves under spatial periodic perturbations for nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws such as compressible Euler equations are extremely important fundamental problems for the mathematical theory of shock waves. The studies on the effects of resonance and entropy variations are some key issues in the long time wave dynamics. In this project, we have resolved some of these basic questions on the dynamical motions of spatial periodic solutions for the full one-dimensional non-isentropic Euler systems and some of its important variations. In particular, we have established the theory of shock formation and accurate estimates on interactions of waves and thus global existence of spatial periodic solutions for the weakly nonlinear gas dynamics system, and have shown the nonlinear stability of shocks and rarefaction waves under generic periodic perturbations for scalar conservation laws. These results will lead to deeper understanding on nonlinear interactions of basic waves and possible phenomena of resonances.

14305515.label: Project Objectives
14305515.value: To quantify the magnitude of soil-atmosphere exchange of greenhouse gases, including CO2, CH4 and N2O, in a subtropical secondary forest in Hong Kong; To investigate the seasonal variations and environmental controls of soil greenhouse gas fluxes from the secondary forest; To examine the effects of experimental throughfall and litterfall manipulations on the dynamics of soil greenhouse gas exchange in the secondary forest.

14305515.value: 森林生態系統雖作為一個陸地的碳匯，但其對氣候變化的整體影響亦取決於溫室氣體在土壤與大氣間交換的方向及強度。有關土壤溫室氣體通量及其控制因子的研究於熱界原始林早已廣泛開展，然而相關研究於受季風氣候影響的亞熱界次生林卻寥寥可數。另外，除著人類活動日益頻繁，全球大氣及氣候變化預期在二十一世紀會越趨劇烈。在中國南部，降水預測會於短期及長期分別下降和上升，而大氣二氧化碳濃度上升則有可能刺激植物生長，繼而增加土壤的植物源碳供應。但是迄今為止仍鮮有研究探討降雨及碳源供應量改變對亞熱界森林土壤溫室氣體通量的影響。 本研究旨在：﹝甲﹞監測香港一亞熱界次生林土壤溫室氣體﹝包括二氧化碳、甲烷及一氧化二氮﹞通量的強度；﹝乙﹞研究次生林土壤溫室氣體通量的季節性變化及其環境控制因子；及﹝丙﹞調查穿降水及枯落物控制實驗對次生林土壤溫室氣體通量的影響。本研究將設立五種不同實驗，包括控制、枯落物增加、枯落物減少、穿降水增加及穿降水減少，每月定期於二十個試驗地測定氣體通量，同時於田野測量一些輔助環境參數以研究它們與土壤溫室氣體通量隨時間變化的關係。 本研究所得的結果將有助揭示土壤於亞熱界次生林整體輻射強迫中所扮演的角色。另外，本研究建立的土壤溫室氣體通量及其環境控制的關係，能改善生物地球化學模型的參數設定，以模擬次生林於未來數十年越趨普遍下，所造成土壤溫室氣體通量的變化。田野控制實驗的結果能幫助了解於全球變化的影響下，枯落物及穿降水如何改變土壤溫室氣體通量，進而影響生物地球化學循環對氣候變化的反饋。本研究的結果有助制定適當的生態系統管理策略，將亞熱界次生林對緩解未來氣候變化的潛力最大化。

14305515.label: Realisation of objectives
14305515.value: This project involved the establishment of throughfall and litterfall manipulation experiments in the field in a subtropical secondary forest in Hong Kong. We have successfully obtained permission from the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department of the HKSAR Government to set up our field experiment at the Tai Po Kau Nature Reserve, and subsequently established a total of 20 experimental plots, with four replicate plots for each of the five treatments, including control, throughfall addition, throughfall reduction, litter addition, and litter removal. Soil-atmosphere exchange of greenhouse gases, including CO2, CH4, and N2O, as well as other ancillary environmental variables have been regularly measured in all 20 plots at roughly weekly intervals starting from January 2016 for three full years. Based on this large and unique dataset, the annual average as well as the seasonal and inter-annual variations of soil-atmosphere greenhouse gas exchange in this subtropical secondary forest have been successfully characterized. The key environmental controls of soil greenhouse gas fluxes in the secondary forest have also been examined. Moreover, the effects of changing throughfall and litterfall on the rates of soil greenhouse gas exchange in the secondary forest over both short and long terms have been investigated by comparing the flux rates between the treatment and the control plots. We have involved six undergraduate students for a total of 8 man-months as well as one Ph.D. student in the implementation of this project. The undergraduate students were instrumental in providing assistance to the maintenance of our manipulation plots, the collection of field samples, as well as the laboratory analysis of samples. The Ph.D. student used the data collected in this research project as the core component of her thesis research.

14305515.label: Major findings and research outcome
14305515.value: We found that the soils in our subtropical secondary forest were generally net sources of CO2 and N2O, but net sinks of CH4. Significant seasonal variations were observed for the soil-atmosphere exchange of greenhouse gases at our site, with higher CO2 and N2O emissions during the hot-humid season but higher CH4 uptake rates during the cool-dry season. The rates of soil-atmosphere greenhouse gas exchange were strongly affected by soil temperature, moisture, and nutrient availability. We observed a positive response of soil respiration to litter addition, and the litter-induced priming effect strengthened with experimental duration. Litter addition enhanced soil CH4 uptake rates by 15%, while the effect of litter on soil N2O emissions gradually turned from negative to positive during the study period. Overall, litter removal reduced the global warming potential of forest soils by 14.9%, while litter addition enhanced the global warming potential by 9.6%. This suggested that enhanced litter input in response to increased atmospheric CO2 level could aggravate climatic warming. Our results of throughfall manipulation showed an overall decrease in soil CO2 efflux in response to drought during the cool-dry season. On the other hand, changing throughfall amounts had no significant overall impacts on soil CH4 uptake rates, although the prevailing soil moisture and nitrogen levels might play a role in modulating the response. The positive effects of throughfall amount on soil N2O emissions diminished during the later stage of this study, which could be related to the acclimation of microbial community to changing moisture availability. Overall, throughfall reduction reduced global warming potential of forest soils by 8.7%, while throughfall addition had a minor enhancement of global warming potential by only 0.8%. This suggested that a reduction in throughfall amount in future could help alleviate future climatic warming.

14305515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14305515.value: This research has initiated a field manipulation experiment to examine the impacts of changing throughfall and litterfall on soil greenhouse gas fluxes in a subtropical secondary forest for over three years. Data generated from the intensive field measurements have generated interesting results demonstrating that the treatment effects could vary with experimental duration. We hope that this field manipulation can be maintained for a longer time period as far as practicable, such that treatment effects could be investigated over a longer time period. Such long-term manipulation is severely lacking in the research community and can make a valuable contribution to our scientific understanding of the biogeochemical response of soils to global change. Moreover, it is suggested that future studies could be done to examine the change in microbial community in these experimental plots to improve our knowledge about the underlying causes of varying response of soil-atmosphere greenhouse gas exchange to changes in throughfall and litterfall.

14305515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14305515.value: This study examines the magnitude, seasonal variations, environmental controls of greenhouse gas fluxes from the soils of a subtropical secondary forest, as well as their response to experimental manipulation of throughfall and litterfall. Our results showed that the forest soils generally emitted CO2 and N2O into the atmosphere, while at the same time remove CH4 from the atmosphere. Significant seasonal variations were observed for soil greenhouse gas fluxes, with higher CO2 and N2O emissions during the hot-humid season but stronger CH4 uptake during the cool-dry season. We found that litter addition generally enhanced CO2 emission and CH4 uptake, leading to an overall increase in warming impacts. On the other hand, throughfall reduction reduced the climate warming impacts of forest soils by 8.7%, while throughfall addition had a minor enhancement of warming impacts by 0.8% only. Our findings suggested that increased litterfall stimulated by increasing atmospheric CO2 level could intensify climate warming, while a reduction in precipitation amount in future could reduce the warming impacts caused by soil-atmosphere greenhouse gas exchange.

14306015.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14306015.value: The proposed research aims to investigate the factors that have shaped and will shape East Asian dust events, and examine the implications for air quality and climate via various feedback mechanisms. Ubiquitous in the atmosphere, mineral dust aerosols not only contribute to severe air quality deterioration, but also influence climate through their radiative and biogeochemical effects. East Asia is one of the world's major dust source regions, producing substantial amounts of dust every year from the deserts and semi-arid regions in northern/northwestern China and Mongolia. Climate change and land cover change including desertification are suggested to be the key factors controlling the trends and variability of East Asian dust, but their relative importance, how they interact and the underlying physical mechanisms are largely uncertain. Mineral dust contains a significant amount of iron, an essential nutrient for marine phytoplankton. East Asian dust outflows and deposition to the North Pacific downwind, therefore, have the potential to enhance marine primary productivity and ocean carbon uptake, but this potentially significant modulating effect on climate via ocean biogeochemistry has yet to be quantified. To address this gap of knowledge, we will implement in the GEOS-Chem chemical transport model a set of improved representation of key dust processes to account for the variability of surface winds, geomorphology and vegetation cover, as well as dust iron chemistry coupled with other air pollutants. We will conduct full-response and sensitivity simulations to identify the key factors (e.g., winds, precipitation, vegetation) controlling the historical 30-year trends and variability of East Asian dust, cross-validated with an ensemble of dust observations. The relationship between simulated dust iron deposition and observed marine biological productivity in different regions of the North Pacific will be examined and parameterized for efficient use in Earth system models. Finally, we will implement the above optimized schemes including the dust-biome relationship into the Community Earth System Model to derive a more realistic set of mid-21st century projections of dust aerosols, which can be used to evaluate the impacts on visibility and public health and to quantify the dust-mediated climate feedbacks necessary for more reliable climate projections. Such findings are essential for better policy formulation concerning air quality, land use and climate management. The proposed modeling work, especially the development of online linkage between terrestrial dust, ocean biogeochemistry and climate, also represents an important contribution to geoscientific model development. 這個研究計畫的目的是探討各項因素在過往和將來如何影響東亞的沙塵暴，並檢視沙塵暴如何通過各種反饋機制影響空氣質素和氣候。礦物粉塵於大氣層裡面無處不在，它們不僅使空氣質素惡化，並可通過它們的輻射和生物地球化學效應來影響氣候。東亞是世界上主要的沙塵源區之一，每年從中國北部及西北部和蒙古的沙漠和半乾旱地區產生大量粉塵。氣候變化和土地覆蓋變化（包括沙漠化）被認為是控制東亞沙塵趨勢和變異的關鍵因素，但這兩項因素的相對重要性，它們之間的相互作用，以及背後的物理機制仍存在很大程度的不確定性。礦塵含有顯著量的鐵質，對於海洋浮游植物是必需的營養素。因此，當東亞沙塵順風流出並沉積到北太平洋，便有可能加強海洋的初級生產力和碳吸收，而這個通過海洋生物地球化學以顯著調節氣候的潛在作用到現在還沒有被量化。 有鑑於此，我們將會在GEOS-Chem大氣化學輸送模型實施一系列改進沙塵過程的措施，以更準確模擬出地面風、地貌和植被變化對沙塵的作用，以及沙塵鐵化學和其他空氣污染物的關連。我們會進行一系列的模擬，來推敲有甚麼關鍵因素（例如風，降水，植被等）控制過去三十年東亞沙塵暴的發展趨勢和變遷，並以沙塵暴的觀測數據來交叉驗證。我們將會檢視沙塵鐵沉積的模擬與北太平洋不同地區的海洋生物生產力觀測之間的關係，並將之建成參數，以能夠有效地利用於地球系統模型裡面。最後，我們會將最優化的沙塵與生物群落關係的參數方案，實施到CESM地球系統模型裡面，推算出一套更準確的二十一世紀中葉沙塵氣溶膠的預測，以之來估計沙塵暴對能見度和公眾健康的影響，並量化沙塵介導的氣候反饋，以致可以更可靠的預測氣候。這些發現對有關空氣質量、土地利用和氣候管理的政策制定至關重要，而所提出的建模工作，尤其是沙塵、海洋生物地球化學和氣候之間的聯繫，也會對地球科學模型的發展做出重要貢獻。

14306015.label: Realisation of objectives
14306015.value: The research plan and activities set forth in the proposal have been followed closely and conducted accordingly, and the three objectives have been achieved to a highly satisfactory extent. Some aspects of the project have also been further expanded beyond the original objectives, leading to significant results. The findings of this project have led to four manuscripts, one currently under review, one submitted and two in preparation. Objective #1 and Objective #2 have been successfully achieved by: 1) implementing into the GEOS-Chem chemical transport model a revised dust emission scheme that correctly accounts for land cover dependence of dust emission and subgrid wind variability, as well as a revised dust size distribution specific for East Asia, and validating the model with observations; 2) using the model to simulate East Asian dust trends and probe into the dominant factors (climatic vs. land cover) shaping East Asian dust variability over the past three decades. The manuscript presenting these results have been submitted to a high-ranking journal in the atmospheric and climate sciences: Tai, A. P. K., Ma, P. H. L., Chan, Y.-C., Chow, M.-K., Ridley, D. A., & Kok, J. F. (2020). Impacts of climate and land cover variability and trends on springtime East Asian dust emission over 1982–2010: A modeling study. Atmospheric Environment, submitted. Objective #3 has also been mostly achieved by examining the simulated dust transport and deposition outputs from Objective #2, correlating them with observed marine chlorophyll concentrations in the North Pacific, and attributing the interannual variability to climatic modes. The findings of this part is now being prepared into a manuscript: Xiao, S., Chow, M.-K., Tai, A. P. K., & Tam, C.-Y. (2020). Interannual variability of springtime East Asian dust activities: Connections to climate variability and impacts on North Pacific biological productivity. In preparation. The examination of land cover and climatic variability and their impacts on dust has led us to look further into how they as well shape co-occurring fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and ozone air quality. The investigation of the climatic and land cover factors contributing to the interannual variability of PM2.5 in China, in particular, has contributed to Objective #2 of the project. These results are included in two manuscripts: Leung, D. M., Tai, A. P. K., Mickley, L. J., Moch, J. M., van Donkelaar, A., Shen, L., & Martin, R. V. (2020). Statistical models for daily and interannual variability of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and effects of 2000–2050 climate change on PM2.5 air quality in China based on an ensemble of global climate models. In preparation. Wang, L., Tai, A. P. K., Tam, C.-Y., Sadiq, M., Wang, P., & Cheung, K. K. W. (2020). Impacts of future land use and land cover change on mid-21st-century surface ozone air quality: Distinguishing between the biogeophysical and biogeochemical effects. 14306015.label: Major findings and research outcome
14306015.value: Mineral dust is an important player in global air quality and climate, but little is known about its variability and trends under the simultaneous influence of climate and land cover changes, particularly in East Asia where intense land cover change has occurred in recent decades. We thus revised dust emission algorithms in a chemical transport model to with better represent dust dependence on climate and vegetation, and conducted simulations to quantify the impacts of climate and land cover variability and trends on springtime dust emission over 1982–2010 from the major deserts in East Asia [Tai et al., submitted]. We found that dust emission from Gobi Desert decreased substantially from the 1980s to 2000s by ~40%, driven mostly by weakening winds. Dust emission from Teklimakan Desert decreased only by ~20% with large interannual variability, attributable to both enhanced vegetation density and weakening winds. Overall, climate is the predominant driver of East Asian dust variability and trends, with the land cover playing secondary but locally important roles, especially in the surrounding non-desert regions undergoing rapid desertification. By analyzing simulated dust transport and deposition with observed climatic and ecosystem data, we further found that dust deposition onto the North Pacific correlates significantly with biological productivity there [Xiao et al., in preparation]. Their co-variability is strongly associated with the Northern Annular Mode and El Niño-Southern Oscillation, which affect both dust emission from East Asian source regions and upper-level dust transport by predominant westerlies. We extended the analysis to investigate how the climate and land cover changes important for dust may also affect the interannual variability and trends of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and ozone air quality in East Asia. We found that for PM2.5, land cover change plays insignificant roles, while annual mean temperature is a dominant driver, with a PM2.5-to-temperature sensitivity of more than 8 μg m-3 K-1 in northern China [Leung et al., in preparation]. We projected a strong increase in PM2.5 by ~20 μg m-3 in central and northern China due to temperature rise by year 2050. Meanwhile, land cover change by year 2050 has relatively modest impact on surface ozone in East Asia (+1-2 ppbv), but larger impact elsewhere, e.g., in North America and Western Europe (+3-6 ppbv) [Wang et al., in review].

14306015.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14306015.value: A major finding of the research is the dominant control of climate variability and trends on East Asian dust emission, transport and deposition, and subsequent impacts on air quality in East Asia and marine biological activities in the North Pacific. One obvious further development is to examine how future changes in weather patterns due to climate change may further modulate East Asian dust activities, and the subsequent climate feedbacks via the radiative effect of dust particles and the biogeochemical effect of dust fertilization on oceanic carbon uptake. The modeling framework already developed (improved dust emission algorithms for East Asia in GEOS-Chem) is well suited for these objectives. We will implement the revised dust algorithms in the latest version of GEOS-Chem that can be coupled with the GISS ModelE global climate model, and conduct simulations for the mid-21st-century climate to examine the future trends of dust activities, and its subsequent impacts on air quality and climate. We will also use the same modeling framework to examine whether simultaneous land cover change driven by agricultural development in China and Mongolia may further modulate dust emission and its air quality and climate impacts.

14306015.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14306015.value: Mineral dust is an important player in global air quality and climate. Understanding the variability and trends of dust activities under the simultaneous influence of climate and land cover changes is crucial not only for allowing better predictions of air quality and climate under global change, but also for providing a scientific basis for sustainable land use management to reduce dust-related environmental and health risks, especially for East Asia where intense land cover change has occurred in recent decades and will likely continue. In this project, we used an atmospheric model, with improvements in its ability to simulate East Asian dust, to quantify the impacts of climate and land cover variability and trends on dust emission from the major deserts in East Asia over the past three decades. We found that climatic changes especially in the overlying wind patterns is the predominant driver of East Asian dust activities, with land cover changes playing secondary but locally important roles. The subsequent transport and deposition of dust onto the North Pacific in turn shape the temporal variability of marine biological productivity there, illustrating the mediating roles of dust in the interactions between climate, atmospheric chemistry and the biosphere.

14306115.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14306115.value: 以數值模型研究氣候變化對香港風暴潮的影響

14306115.label: Project Objectives
14306115.value: To investigate climate change impacts on potential storm surges in Hong Kong, and to study the role of various physical processes in such impacts, based on idealised atmospheric and hydrodynamic model experiments. To assess changes of storm surges in Hong Kong in the later part of 21st century, by combining high-resolution IPCC climate projections with hydrodynamic model predictions.
rows: To investigate climate change impacts on potential storm surges in Hong Kong, and to study the role of various physical processes in such impacts, based on idealised atmospheric and hydrodynamic model experiments.
To assess changes of storm surges in Hong Kong in the later part of 21st century, by combining high-resolution IPCC climate projections with hydrodynamic model predictions.

14306115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14306115.value: It is well known that tropical cyclones are associated with strong wind and heavy rainfall. When making landfall, these powerful weather systems can also bring huge surges to coastal locations. Being a coastal city, Hong Kong is affected by 6 tropical cyclones per year, and is vulnerable to storm surge hazards. Storm surges in 1906 and 1937 brought great casualties to Hong Kong. Typhoon Wanda in 1962 led to sea level rise of 2m or more in the Victoria Harbour and other locations, resulting in devastating flood in part of the territory. According to the latest Intergovernmental Panel for Climate Change (IPCC) report, sea level extremes are expected to become more frequent towards the end of the 21st century, due to sea level rise in a warmer background climate. In addition to the rising sea level, tropical cyclone wind speed will also be enhanced due to global warming; the combined impact of sea level change and storm intensification means cyclone-induced surges will become even more severe in future. Yet, there are still limited studies on the effect of climate change on coastal flooding. Scientific questions including how climate change may influence storm surges through sea level rise, tropical cyclone strength, size or other physical characteristics, over East Asia or South China Sea coastal locations, still need to be addressed. Assessment of potential storm surges in Hong Kong under a changing background climate is also lacking. In this proposed study, we seek to address these scientific issues by using computer models to reproduce atmosphere and ocean conditions during tropical cyclone landfall, and to study storm surges that affect Hong Kong. By controlling various environmental factors in these models, such as the mean sea level, ocean temperature and atmospheric flow conditions, idealized numerical experiments will be conducted, and their results should shed light on the role of different physical processes in climate change impacts on potential surges. Moreover, state-of-the-art IPCC climate models capable of reproducing tropical cyclones will be combined with an ocean storm surge model for the Hong Kong Waters, in order to simulate future cyclone-induced surges in a quasi-realistic setting. Overall, it is envisaged that this study will lead to better understanding of the physics of how climate change can affect storm surges, and it will also be the first assessment study of potential storm surge threat in Hong Kong under a warmer climate in future. 作為一個沿海城市,香港每年平均受6個熱帶氣旋影響, 而熱帶氣旋往往帶來巨大的浪湧或風暴潮。根據最新的政府間氣候變化委員會（IPCC）的報告,海平面會在全球變暖背景下上升, 而熱帶氣旋的風力也將增強;這意味著熱帶氣旋引起的風暴潮在未來將更為嚴重。本研究試圖利用數值模型,重現熱帶氣旋登陸時的大氣和海洋條件，以探討氣候變化如何影響在香港水域發生之風暴潮。透過控制各種物理因素，如平均海平面，海洋溫度和大氣環流，我們將進行數值模擬試驗，以模擬各種物理因子如何影響在未來環境的風暴潮。

14306115.label: Realisation of objectives
14306115.value: For objective #1, it was achieved by setting up the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model at the convection permitting resolution of 3 km x 3 km, which was able to realistically simulate the (tropical cyclone) TC physical structure. The Sea, Lake, and Overland Surges from Hurricanes (SLOSH) model for simulating storm surge, driven by WRF outputs, such as the surface winds, sea level pressure, was also adopted. Using these numerical modelling tools, we investigated how various physical processes, including sea surface temperature (SST) change, background air temperature and moisture increase, might influence the intensity of landfalling TC and the associated storm surges in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) region. For objective #2, it was achieved by using the above modelling tool to reproduce 20 historical storms causing some of the largest storm surges recorded in Hong Kong Waters. With the so-called pseudo-global-warming (PGW) technique, the same storms were then re-simulated by superimposing far-future (2075-2099) temperature and humidity changes, derived from the IPCC climate projections, onto the background climate. Using the SLOSH model, changes in storm surge amplitudes were assessed.

To assess changes of storm surges in Hong Kong in the later part of 21st century, by combining high-resolution IPCC climate projections with hydrodynamic model predictions.

14306115.label: Major findings and research outcome
14306115.value: Using the so-called pseudo-global-warming (PGW) technique, TCs under far-future (2075-2099) climate conditions based on the Representative Concentration Pathway (RCP) 8.5 scenario were reproduced by the WRF model. Using the WRF outputs, SLOSH was then used to simulate the corresponding storm surge fields. Based on the TC cases considered, it was found that their peak intensities (maximum 10-m wind speed) are projected to increase by ~10% by the end of this century. In the far future, associated storm surges are also estimated to increase by about 8.5%. Further experiments showed that, by imposing SST warming alone in the model environment, much greater intensification of TCs was found, due to enhanced sea surface heat fluxes. On the other hand, a warmer (and moister) atmosphere alone acts in the opposite way by increasing the atmospheric stability.

14306115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14306115.value: In this study, there is no feedback from the ocean to the atmosphere; yet TCs are know to affect the ocean surface temperature during their passage, by inducing 'cold wakes'. Such SST perturbations might affect TC evolution and hence its intensity. As a further development, the WRF model can be coupled with a regional ocean model, in order to represent the full atmosphere-ocean interaction. Such a model is now being developed at CUHK, and will be tested based on historical TC cases.

14306115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14306115.value: According to the Intergovernmental Panel for Climate Change (IPCC) report, sea level extremes are expected to become more frequent towards the end of the 21st century, due to sea level rise in a warmer background climate. In addition, tropical cyclones- and hence their related storm surges- will become even more intense in the future. Here we used computer models to reproduce atmosphere and ocean conditions during tropical cyclone landfall, in order to study storm surges affecting Hong Kong under various climate background conditions. It was found that, for the 'business-as-usual' future climate scenario, storm intensities will increase by ~10%, while storm surges will increase by about the same amount by the end of this century.

14500015.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500015.value: 国际贸易摩擦对会计信息可比性的作用

14500015.label: Project Objectives
14500015.value: We want to compile a dataset containing industry-level import and export flows, including both quantity and value, for each 4-digit SIC industry in each country. We aim to supplement our anti-dumping database with private firms’ financial information. We have provided initial matches of public firms in the anti-dumping database with COMPUTAT/Worldscope. To do so, we manually checked the name of every firm appearing in litigation case to identify whether the firm can be found in COMPUSTAT/Worldscope. We will examine whether a foreign firm’s exposure to trade opportunities makes its financial statement more comparable to those of its industry peers in the export market. In particular, we will examine whether a EU private firm will switch from Local GAAP to IFRS when trade opportunities arise. We are also interested in the benefits of financial statement comparability in a context of antidumping lawsuits. In particular, we want to examine whether comparability can make litigated exporters lose less during the course of investigation.

14500015.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500015.value: 在过去几十年里，监管者和学者们大力强调会计信息可比性(Financial Statement Comparability)对于资本市场的重要性。最典型的例子就是国际会计准则（International Financial Reporting Standards, IFRS）的全球化。近年来，大量关于IFRS的研究发现国际会计准则对资本市场起到了非常积极的作用。其它的研究也从另外角度得出了相同的结论。 本研究项目试图研究会计信息可比性对于产品市场的积极作用。这是一个与资本市场完全不同的角度。具体来说，我们研究出口商是否会通过增加与进口国同行业公司的会计信息可比性来降低国际贸易中的摩擦。特别地，我们强度会计信息在反倾销税中的作用。反倾销税的征税基础是出口商在多大程度上以低于成本的价格在国外市场销售自己的产品。 根据现行的世贸组织（WTO）协议，进口国政府有权通过会计信息来判断出口商是否存在倾销行为。如果出口商的会计报表和进口国的会计准则相一致，美国和欧盟等发达国家会给予出口商 税收优惠。 我们通过一系列的数据试图来回答以下一些重要问题。第一， 随着贸易机会越来越多，出口商是否会会增加与进口国同行业公司的会计信息可比性？第二，通过增加会计信息可比性，出口商在反倾销战中的损失是否会降低？第三，在同一个国家内，对出口商和非出口商实行同一种会计准则是否有害？

14500115.value: 勞動力成本習性之政治經濟學分析：來自中國的證據

14500115.label: Project Objectives
14500115.value: To examine whether political forces shape labor cost behavior. To examine whether the above results vary with factors that strengthen the effect of political forces. To examine the mechanisms and economic consequences of politically driven labor cost stickiness.

14500115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500115.value: We propose to investigate how political forces shape the labor cost behavior of firms. The literature on political economy suggests that politicians pursue excessive labor spending to accomplish their political objectives. Meanwhile, the literature on cost behavior suggests that labor costs are sticky in that they decrease much more slowly when activity declines than they increase when activity expands at the same rate. However, these two areas of research have not yet been linked. We plan to fill this gap by studying Chinese firms. In China, government officials are incentivized to maintain social stability and avoid the problem of unemployment. Moreover, they could intervene into corporate decisions through ownership control or by appointing managers with a government background. We hypothesize that the presence of state ownership and politically connected managers is positively associated with labor cost stickiness. We will also examine whether this relationship varies by two largely exogenous factors. First, we expect the effect of politics on cost stickiness to be concentrated in regions that are less developed and experience more government intervention. Second, we expect political forces to be significantly stronger when local political leaders are to be promoted, as sustaining social stability then becomes crucial to the evaluation of their performance. We also plan to study the mechanisms through which firm labor costs are adjusted according to political agendas, e.g., whether intervention causes a firm to respond to a decline in activity by firing employees or by reducing average wage rates for labor. Finally, we will also investigate whether excessively sticky labor costs explain the poorer performance of state firms, especially those headed by politically connected managers. To our knowledge, this will be the first study of how political forces shape the cost behavior of firms. Importantly, the evidence to be obtained will show that in addition to firm-specific economic factors, an analysis of the political environment in which a firm operates will enhance our understanding of cost behavior. The outcomes of the study will also contribute to the privatization literature. Most of the Chinese state firms became listed through the government’s partial privatization program in the 1990s. To the extent that politics distorts these firms’ employment decisions and lowers firm value, the evidence suggests that partial privatization fails to cure the government pathologies. 本研究計劃考察政治力量如何影響企業的勞動力成本習性。政治經濟學文獻表明，因追求政治目標，政客傾向于過多雇傭勞動力。同時，成本習性文獻表明，成本有著粘性特徵，即作業量下降時成本的降幅顯著低于同比作業量上升時成本的升幅。然而，這兩類研究之間幷無交集。我們計劃研究中國企業以填補這一空白。中國的政府官員有動機去維持社會穩定幷降低失業率。與此同時，他們也會通過所有權控制或者在企業管理層中任命經理人員的方式來幹預企業的日常决策。我們認爲國有控股以及政治關聯經理人員的存在與企業的勞動力成本粘性顯著正相關。 我們也將檢驗這種相關關係是否與兩個基本外生的因素有關。首先，我們預計政治力量對勞動力成本粘性的影響更多地集中與政府幹預較嚴重的欠發達地區。其次，我們預計在當地政府官員被提拔之際，這種政治影響更强，因爲此時評價當地官員政績時社會的穩定程度成爲非常重要的考量。我們也將研究政治力量是如何影響企業勞動力成本的機理，比如政治幹預是否會導致企業在業務量下降時傾向于裁員或者是降低員工的平均薪酬。最後，我們也將研究這種勞動力成本粘性是否能够解釋國有企業、尤其是政治關聯經理人員所管理的企業業績相對較差的現象。 就我們所知，這是第一篇研究政治力量如何影響企業成本習性的研究。更爲重要的是，該研究的證據會幫助我們理解除了企業特定的經濟因素外，政治環境也會對企業的成本習性産生影響。該研究成果也將對私有化文獻進行補充。在上個世紀九十年代，中國大多數的國有企業通過政府的部分私有化方案而成爲上市公司。若政治力量在一定程度上扭曲了企業的雇員决策幷且降低了企業價值，這一證據將表明政治化體制下的局部私有化無法治愈政府幹預的頑疾。

14500115.value: The project went very well. Soon after we started the project, we collected data for empirical analyses. The results strongly support our hypotheses. After presenting the paper in several conferences, we revised the paper according to the comments received. All of the project objectives have been achieved. In the last reporting period, we further revised the paper attentively to address all the comments from the reviewers and editors of Management Science. After three rounds of revisions, the paper has now been accepted for publication in the journal.

14500115.label: Major findings and research outcome
14500115.value: In China’s transitional economy, one of the major objectives of the government is to maintain social stability. Labor layoffs pose significant threats to social stability. Local governments and officials thus have strong incentives to limit labor layoffs through ownership control and appointment of executives in state-owned enterprises (SOEs). We study the role of government in Chinese firms’ labor-employment decisions through the lens of cost stickiness, which occurs when costs change more rapidly for an increase in activity relative to a decrease. Based on a sample of public firms in China, we document the following findings. First, all else being equal, SOEs’ labor costs are sticky whereas non-SOEs exhibit an anti-sticky pattern. Second, SOEs run by politically connected executives have even stickier labor-cost patterns. By contrast, non-SOE managers’ connectedness has little effect on labor-cost stickiness. Third, the political effects on labor-cost stickiness are concentrated in less developed regions with stronger governments and clustered during time periods shortly before local political leaders’ promotions, reinforcing the argument that such effects stem from government intervention. By decomposing the total labor costs into two the number of employees and the average wage per employee, we find that the sticky average wage per employee can only be observed among SOEs that are headed by connected managers. This evidence suggests that in politically connected SOEs, executives need to maintain not only the size of the labor force, but also labor welfare in terms of per-capita income. We also find SOEs’ labor-cost stickiness is positively associated with subsequent subsidies from the governments, consistent with reciprocity between SOEs and the governments. We have completed a paper and presented it in several international conferences. The paper has been accepted for publication by Management Science in March 2019.

14500115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14500115.value: A byproduct of this project is that we identify a novel data source for measuring labor expenditures. China adopts the direct method for cash flow statement and data for cash paid to and for employees can thus be retrieved from this source. The data can be used to study labor employment decisions in other settings.

14500115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14500115.value: Our findings reflect the interactions among the state as the controlling shareholder with a social objective, and government officials and managers with personal career objectives. These findings suggest that, in addition to the economic factors considered in the literature, an in-depth analysis of the political environment of firms is also important for the understanding of managerial decisions with respect to labor employment. They also enrich the literature on how the government’s visible hand distorts firms’ economic decisions. Chinese state firms became listed through the government’s partial privatization program in the 1990s. Consistent with the notion that partial privatization with politicized institutions does not cure the government pathologies, the presence of state ownership and politically connected executives retards firms’ labor employment adjustment to activity decline and likely impairs economic efficiency. State intervention in firms’ decisions is ubiquitous, although the specific forms may vary by country. Our setting is important given China’s influence in the world economy. China has the largest labor force in the world. A better understanding of labor-cost behavior in China would be relevant to many economic decisions both in China and elsewhere.

14500215.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500215.value: 承諾最低累計購買量契約下的聯合庫存與定價策略研究

14500215.label: Project Objectives
14500215.value: Develop simple yet near-optimal heuristic policies for a basic model for dynamic inventory and pricing control problems under total minimum commitment contracts and conduct an extensive numerical study to evaluate their performances Conduct an extensive numerical study to provide managerial insights into various important questions on effective management of total minimum commitment contracts Study two important model extensions to allow more general demand functions and lost-sales models

14500215.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500215.value: 承諾最低累計購買量契約是一類供應链契約。在此契約下，買家承諾在契約規定的時間內向賣家至少累計購買一定數量或價值的產品。由於同時為買家提供了購買時間上的靈活性和為賣家提供了累計銷售量的最低保障，這類契約在许多行業（如：電子產業、航空業和醫藥行業）獲得了廣泛地應用。鑒於這類契約的重要性，研究人員自從二十世紀九十年代便對其進行了研究；但至今尚無文獻探討在這類契約下的聯合庫存與需求管理策略問題。鑒於聯合庫存與需求管理對有效管理這類契約的潛在重要性，以及動態定價是需求管理的行之有效的工具，这一项目將對在這類契約下的聯合庫存與定價策略問題進行深入研究。通過初步研究，我們已建立了一個基本模型來研究在这类契約下的動態庫存與定價策略問題并獲得了關於最優庫存與定價策略的兩個基本結果。這些結果部分刻畫了最優策略的結構，並且對当訂貨提前期較短时最优策略的计算提供了便利。但受限于動態規劃中的“維數災難”，当訂貨提前期較長時最優策略的計算仍然是不可行的。在这一项目中，我们将对这一基本模型进入深入研究以设计出简单且近似最优的启发式算法，并通过大量的数值实验以评估其绩效。另一方面，我們將開展全面的數值实验对管理者关心的许多重要问题（如：聯合庫存與定價的有效性，承諾量、價格折扣、訂貨提前期以及需求不確定性对期望利润的影響）进行探讨并提供管理見解。為進一步擴展模型的應用範圍，我們还將研究模型的兩個重要拓展以涵蓋更一般的需求模型以及缺貨損失模型。如果獲得成功，這一項目的研究成果將不僅填補學術文獻中的一項重要空白，並且會對使用承諾最低累計購買量契約的行業實踐者在如果更有效地管理這類契約方面產生積極影響。

14500415.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500415.value: 員工認同與企業志願計劃

14500415.label: Project Objectives
14500415.value: 1. To investigate employees’ motives for joining corporate programs within their organizations. Specifically, to test whether the volunteer function inventory developed by Clary et al. (1998) can be used in China. 2. To investigate the causal order of corporate volunteering participation and organizational identification of employees. We wish to ascertain whether CVP participation leads to identification, or vice versa. A third possibility is that they are reciprocally related. 3. To test the job outcomes of CVP participation. Specifically, to test whether CVP participation affects the in-role and extra-role behavior of employees. 4. To test how the participation and identification relationship is affected by the motives of the corporate volunteers.

2. To investigate the causal order of corporate volunteering participation and organizational identification of employees. We wish to ascertain whether CVP participation leads to identification, or vice versa. A third possibility is that they are reciprocally related.
3. To test the job outcomes of CVP participation. Specifically, to test whether CVP participation affects the in-role and extra-role behavior of employees.

14500415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500415.value: Corporate social responsibility is a key concern for many large corporations all over the world. To get participants in labor-intensive corporate social responsibility activities, many firms recruit volunteers among their employees. Corporate volunteer programs (CVPs) refer to formal organizational efforts in support employees to volunteering their time and skills to community work. The employees who participate in CVPs are called corporate volunteers. There are many forms of CVPs. Some firms sponsor their employees to organize these activities, while some firms plan for these activities through their human resources department. Some firms allow their employees to participate in these activities during office hours, while some employees volunteer after office hours. Regardless of the form of the CVP, a common nature of these programs is that the activities are organized under the name of the company, and the employees volunteer to participate. We explore the causal relationship between participation of corporate volunteers and their identification to their organization in this study. We propose to test two opposite causal relationships. It is possible that those who have participated in CVPs would be more identified to the firm. However, it is also possible that those who are more identified to the firm would participate in CVPs. The answer to these two reverse causations would affect planning of CVP tremendously. We also study the effects of both CVP participation and identification on in-role and extra-role performance of employees. Finally, we investigate how these relationships would be affected by the motives of the employees who join the CVPs. 企業志願計劃在世界各地正日漸流行。為了提高企業的社會責任，很多企業正積極向員工發起志願服務計劃。企業志願計劃是企業招募員工付出他們的時間與能力，參加各樣的志願性活動。參加這些活動的員工稱為企業志願服務者。有些企業贊助員工參與企業外的志願活動，有些企業卻透過人力資源部門，自己設計組織志願服務計劃。有些企業讓員工在工作時間參加這些計劃，有些卻要求員工在工餘時間參加。無論如何，企業志願計劃的特徵是志願活動是透過企業名義舉行，而員工的參與是自願性的。 我們希望研究企業志願服務者對企業志願計劃的參與，與他們對企業的認同之間的關係。我們提出了兩個完全相反，卻都有理論根據的假設。首先企業志願服務者可能因為對企業認同，所以才參加企業志願計劃。但是，企業志願服務者也可能是因為參加了企業志願計劃，因而對企業日漸認同。我們用研究設計同時驗證這兩個因果相反的假設。同時，我們也會研究企業志願服務者的工作表現，及影響這些關係的因素。

14500415.label: Realisation of objectives
14500415.value: We have finished the first three objectively completely. We collected data on employees' motives for joining corporate programs, and the results generally matched with our expectation. Except the enjoyment motives are cross loaded with learning motive, the rest of the data matched Clary et al. specification. Our data supported our prediction that identification and volunteering participation are reciprocally related. Our data also supported our prediction that identification and participation in corporate volunteering predict in-role and extra-role performance. With respect to the last objective, we have collected the data, but only finished testing the model of Objective #3. For the fourth objective of testing the effects of motives on participation and identification, we have the data but have not finished analyzing it. The motives of participation would be added to our final paper as possible moderating variables.

14500415.label: Major findings and research outcome
14500415.value: Organizational identificaiton is confirmed to be the core motive of participation in corporate volunteering programs. For objective two, we found confirming evidence that identification is reciprocally related to participation in corporate volunteering programs. We also tested the effects of participation on in-role and extra-role performance. The indirect effect of participation on both inrole and extra-role performance are both significant.

14500415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14500415.value: The key contribution of this study is our confirmation that not only organizational identification would affect participation in corporate volunteering, the reverse effect is also significant. That is, those employees who participate in corporate volunteering programs would result in higher identification with their organization. While we used the sensemaking theory to justify this hypothesis, we did not test it explicitly. Since we found positive evidence for this relationship, a follow-up study would be to validate the intevening mechanism leading to this relationship.

14500415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14500415.value: Following the literature, we found that participation in corporate volunteering leads to employees higher organizational identification. We propose that employees who participated in corporate volunteering programs of their organization would try to make sense out of their actions and generate positive attributions to the organization. A direct result is that they will have positive views of their organization and be more identified with their organization. Organization can, therefore, use corporate volunteering programs to achieve two goals. On top of the usual results of a positive CSR corporate image, corporate volunteering programs can be used to increase participants' commitment and identification to the firm. Two indirect results of the increase identification are that the in-role and extra-role performance of employees would be increased.

14500715.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500715.value: 在线个人对个人（P2P）借贷的信息不对称与競投成效

14500715.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14500715.value: Prof Cui, Xiling Prof Lai, Siu King Vincent

14500715.label: Project Objectives
14500715.value: This study believes that there must be other signaling and screening methods that could be used to evaluate P2P loan listings. Therefore, we propose to test linguistic cues as a signal and imitation as a screening method to determine their effectiveness in P2P lending decisions. We believe that a borrower-provided loan description is a very important signal because it reveals critical information regarding the borrower’s creditworthiness and honesty. We also believe that lenders can imitate or learn from each other when screening subprime borrowers. Therefore, we aim to explore whether these signaling and screening approaches are applicable to P2P lending decisions. The proposed study will investigate the integrative effect of creditworthiness, social capital, signaling, and screening on information asymmetry reduction and loan performance in the online P2P lending market. We believe that all the aforementioned variables are critical to online P2P lending and they must be investigated in chorus, rather than independently, for a more realistic understanding of their relative effect on information asymmetry reduction. This study believes that when lenders are more risk-taking, they may tolerate riskier loan listings in return for higher investment utility. However, more risk-averse lenders may think otherwise by investing more safely to avoid losses. Thus, for a more realistic understanding of P2P bidding, we aim to explore the differential effect of lenders’ risk preference associated with information asymmetry and lending decisions.
