14615015.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14615015.value: Energy is required to extract, collect, pump and deliver water for human consumption and industrial use, and also for wastewater treatment before its reuse or its return to the environment. For example, the US alone uses at least 521 million MWh a year for water-related operations, and this is equivalent to 13% of the country’s total electricity consumption. According to US Environmental Protection Agency, the massive energy consumption in water/wastewater treatment and delivery add over 45 million tons of greenhouse gases annually. To reduce further damage to the environment and at the same time to meet water demands sustainably, one of the most effective approaches relies on usage of renewable energy resources. However, these resources, such as solar, wind, etc., are highly unpredictable and intermittent due to weather conditions. Meanwhile, water demands are also highly uncertain depending on the future population growth and climate changes. A large-scale integration of renewable energy into water systems faces the uncertainties in these two infrastructures. To overcome these challenges, we propose a research to develop optimization-based models and algorithms for policy makers to integrate renewable energy as a major energy source, and to optimally operate sustainable water systems. To achieve these goals, we plan to conduct the following research activities: (1) Quantifying the uncertainties of water demands and renewable energy resources through data mining and data analytics. (2) Designing multistage stochastic programming models and algorithms for renewable integration to water systems, and also for management and operations of the water/wastewater treatment facilities. (3) Evaluating the proposed techniques for practical test in a real water system. Different from previous studies, this research is unique. First, instead of only considering the energy efficiency in a water system, we concentrate on large renewable integration for both planning, and management and operations of the water system. Second, the proposed multistage stochastic programming model will have the capability to incorporate the uncertainties because of renewable integration. Finally, the success of this project will be a practical and methodological evidence for the concept of onsite energy generation to promote the adoption of renewable energy in other industries.

14615015.label: Realisation of objectives
14615015.value: The following activities have been conducted to realize the project objectives: 1. An underground to above-ground communication system and an above-ground communication system have been developed. The network includes underground devices, above- ground access points, network servers and application servers. 2. Sensing devices for underground channel have been developed. Both the length, angle and orientation of the devices can be adjusted according to installation position and the type of manhole cover. 3. An underground device, which can communicate with access points by 27MHz low-frequency signal, has been developed. The device has four data interfaces which can connect with up to 4 types of sensors at a time. 4. An above-ground communication device, Access Points, for receiving data from the underground devices has been developed. The access point is composed of a very high sensitivity low communication module, LTE modules and tunable low-frequency antenna. 5. A handheld device is developed for collecting nearby signals transmitted by underground devices. The handheld device collects data and shows the most updated received data on the screen. With the help of the handheld device, the site engineers can install and inspect the underground device even when the connection between underground devices and fixed location access points haven’t established. 6. In order to transmit signals inside the underground manhole, a compact, low profile and low-frequency adaptive tuning antenna is developed for the underground devices. The antenna can automatically adjust its coupling circuits according to the installation position of the underground device in a manhole. 7. Two different types of passive RFID tags have been mounted in manholes for the purpose of manhole identification. One types of passive RFID tag is a high gain metal tag, which is mounted inside a manhole. Another type of passive RFID tag is an extremely small ceramic tag that is glued to a manhole cover. 8. An application software for managing the sensor data and the sensor network has been developed. The software provides map view, table view, chart view and sensor view for the users to access the sensor data. The users can configure underground devices, view sensor data, set up alerts, create new accounts, configure these accounts and monitor the network condition through the console. 9. An Android app has been developed for users to access to the sensing network through mobile phones. The Android App implements most of the functions as the desktop version software except the alert engine function. The mobile app is mainly for users to browse data rather than conduct complicating operations such as setting up the alert rules, networks configuration. 10. We have developed a series of programming models and algorithms for detecting critical components in a supply system (e.g., a water system). In such systems, some components are critical as their malfunction may adversely affect the operations of the whole systems. Our work examines several models based on the median problem for identifying these components in a service system. In addition to the existing exact solution methods, we propose meta-heuristics to tackle this computationally hard problem. Our hybrid approach combines the strengths of both meta heuristics and exact solution methods. The experiment shows that the combination of solution methods signiﬁcantly cut down the computational requirement for ﬁnding the critical components in a service network for protection. 11. During the pilot implementation, 33 underground devices have been installed. The implementation scale is much larger than what we proposed in the proposal. By deploying the underground devices on the critical and strategic spots in Hong Kong in a long run, we can analysis the wastewater discharge of the nearby building, identify possible illegal discharge, find out the possible pipe blockage in advance and track down the main spots that generate hazardous gasses.

14615015.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14615015.value: In this work, we have developed several practical tools for site engineers to build a monitoring system for a supply network. The challenge of the work is to overcome underground to above-ground communication problem. We have shown a proof of concept prototype for an implementation in Kowloon Bay of Hong Kong. The monitoring area is about 1.30 square kilometers. We believe that we have an application which can be scaled up for a wider monitoring scope. In addition, we have also developed models and algorithms for detecting critical components for reliable operations of a supply network.

14615515.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14615515.value: 動力之知：王陽明道德哲學的當代意義

14615515.label: Project Objectives
14615515.value: To argue that Gilbert Ryle’s knowing-that and knowing-how do not exhaust all types of knowledge. What makes Wang’s liangzhi, the innate moral knowledge, unique is that it is not merely knowing-that, the knowledge of what is good and what is evil, but also knowing-to, the knowledge to love the good and hate the evil; To show that, while Wang’s liangzhi, as knowing-that and knowing-to in one, is indeed also belief (knowing-that) and desire (knowing-to) in one and thus is the single mental state of besire (belief+desire), it is not bizarre, as claimed by contemporary Humeans. To argue, against a common perception, that Wang provides a best solution to the problem of evil, which takes into consideration both moral luck (it is out of one’s control whether one is born in the unfavorable environment and/or with impure vital force, qi, without which evil is impossible) and moral responsibility (one’s will still functions even in the worst possible environment and with the worst possible vital force); To defend Wang’s virtue ethics against the situationist challenges in contemporary moral psychology by explaining the various ways, both for moral education and for self-cultivation, that Wang develops to help people acquire knowing-to and thus become virtuous; To argue that Wang has a much richer conception of empathy than can be found in the contemporary psychological and philosophical literature on empathy, which includes not only our empathy with people suffering physical pain, accompanied by our desire to relieve them of such pain, but also with people suffering internal pain, i.e., with evil people, accompanied with our desire to relieve them of such pain, i.e., to help them cease to be evil people; To show that, in the contemporary debate between realism and anti-realism in moral theories, Wang’s unique view of moral qualities as stimulation dependent is more plausible than not only the radical realism and radical anti-realism but also McDowell’s response dependent theory as a via media.

To show that, in the contemporary debate between realism and anti-realism in moral theories, Wang’s unique view of moral qualities as stimulation dependent is more plausible than not only the radical realism and radical anti-realism but also McDowell’s response dependent theory as a via media.

14615515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14615515.value: Gilbert Ryle has made the famous distinction between knowing-that and knowing-how. An example of the former is our knowledge that the moon turns around the earth, and that of the latter is our knowledge about how to play piano. By drawing this distinction, Ryle purports to call our attention to the latter, since philosophical discussions of knowledge have been almost exclusively directed to the former. Recognizing that knowledge, particularly moral knowledge, in Confucianism is clearly different from the intellectualistic knowing-that, many scholars have claimed that Confucianism is concerned about knowing-how. In this research, by focusing on Wang Yangming's liangzhi, the innate moral knowledge, the PI argues that what makes Confucian moral knowledge unique is its power to incline a person to act accordingly. For example, a person who knows that one ought to be filial is naturally inclined to be so. However, this inclination to act is not included in either knowing-that or knowing-how as Ryle describes. The PI argues that this is a unique type knowledge: knowing-to. In addition to this central argument, which is made in the first chapter of the proposed research, the PI answers a series of questions arising thereby, each in a subsequent chapter. First, if Wang's liangzhi includes both knowing-that, belief, and knowing-to, desire, liangzhi would include both belief and desire, which seems bizarre: belief is supposed to fit the world, and the world is supposed to fit the desire; so should liangzhi fit the world or vice versa? Second, since everyone is born with liangzhi, which naturally inclines one to act, why are there still people who don't act virtuously or even act viciously? Third, by emphasizing knowing-to, which is a natural inclination to act virtuously, Wang holds a robust conception of stable and global character, which, however, has been denied by a number of situationist psychologists today, based on some well-known experiments. How would Wang Yangming respond to them? Fourth, a person with liangzhi for Wang not only has empathy with people suffering the physical pain but also for people suffering the lose of the heart/mind. The rich contemporary literature on empathy acknowledge the former but is silent about the latter. So is empathy with "devil" really possible? Fifth, since Wang argues that liangzhi is something that everyone is born with, does this mean that, in the contemporary debate between realism and anti-realism, Wang is a radical moral anti-realist? 萊爾在命題之知與能力之知之間做出了有名的區分。舉例來說，“我知道月球繞著地球轉”是命題之知，而“我知道如何彈琴”則是能力之知。之所以要在這兩者之間做出區分，萊爾試圖讓我們關注后一種知，因為關於知的傳統的哲學討論所關心的幾乎都是命題之知。看到儒家所討論的知，特別是道德之知，與理智主義的命題之知明顯不同，幾乎所有學者都認為儒家所關心的能力之知。 本研究以王陽明的良知概念為例說明，儒家的道德之知的獨特性在於其能使其持有者按照這種知去行動。例如一個知道應該孝順父母的人一定會去孝順父母。但這種使人行動的動力既不包含在萊爾的命題之知中，也不包含在其能力之知中。本研究員認為這是一種獨特的第三種知：動力之知。 除了在本研究的第一章所要論證的這個核心問題以外，本研究員還會研究由此引申出來的一系列其他問題，這些問題將在本研究的其他各章中逐一討論。首先，王陽明的動力之知同時包含了信念和欲望，這似乎是一種非常奇怪的現象：信念要與世界相適合，而欲望則要求世界與其相適合，那同時包含了兩者的良知與世界到底應該誰適合誰呢？其次，既然王陽明認為每一個人都生來就有良知，而良知有會使人去按照良知行動，那麼為什麼還有人作惡呢？第三，王陽明以良知為核心的倫理學本質上是一種美德倫理學，但當代道德心理學中的情景主義則認為不存在美德（或惡德），那王陽明能夠對這樣的批評做出什麼樣的回應呢？第四，王陽明所討論的具有良知的人不僅對他人身體上的痛苦能感同身受，而且也對他人因良知的喪失而（應該）感到的道德的痛苦感同身受。當代西方道德心理學和倫理學主要討論的是比較容易理解的前一種感同身受，那後一種感同身受到底是否可能和如何可能呢？第五，王陽明認為每一個人生來就有良知，那是否表明，在關於道德實在論和反實在論的爭論中，王陽明就是一個極端的反實在論這呢？

14615515.label: Realisation of objectives
14615515.value: In the finished book manuscript, consisting of 6 chapters, I have realized the stated objectives. In Chapter 1, I first presented Gilbert Ryle’s distinction between knowing-that and knowing-how and defended it against two contemporary objections on the one hand and presented Wang Yangming’s notion of oneness of knowledge and action and defended it against some contemporary misunderstanding of it. Then against the common conception that Wang’s knowledge belongs to Ryle’s knowing-how, I argue that it is a third type of knowing, knowing-to, a unique feature of which is that a person with knowing-to (for example, knowing to love one’s parents) will act accordingly (for example, love his or her parents), while neither knowing-that (for example, the knowing that one ought to love one’s parents) nor knowing-how (for example, the knowing how to love one’s parents), whether separately or combined, will dispose or incline the possessor of such knowledge to act accordingly (for example, love one’s parents). In chapter 2, I situate Wang Yangming’s philosophy in the debate between Humeanism and anti-Humeanism in contemporary philosophy of action. The Humeanism upholds belief-desire model to explain action: an agent is motivated to act if the person has a desire, which is coupled with a means-end belief of the agent that this desire can be served by a particular action. There are two Anti-Humean groups, with one arguing that action can be explained belief alone and another that it can be explained by desire alone. I argue that Wang Yangming’s view is unique in the sense that it agrees with Humeans that both beliefs and desires are needed to explain action but disagrees with them that beliefs and desire, instead of being two separate mental states, form one single unitary mental state of besire. Against some Humeans’ objection, I argue that such a mental state is not bizarre, as there is no conflict of direction of fit between this mental state and the world: besire as both belief and desire has the world-to-mind direction of fit. This is because belief in besire is normative belief, and a normative belief shares the same direction of fit with desire. Chapter 3 starts from where chapter 2 ends: to say that normative belief has the same direction of fit as the desire apparently implies that such a belief is purely subjective. This is confirmed by not only many scholars’ characterizations of Wang’s philosophy as idealistic as well as a number of passages in Wang that claim that moral knowledge is not outside in the external world but right inside in one’s heart-mind. In this chapter, I argue that, in the debate between moral realism and anti-realism, Wang is a moral realist. However, unlike those in the Western tradition, Wang as a moral realist holds the view that moral property is indeed in the heart-mind but it is not something that is created by the heart-mind but is something constitutive of heart-mind, something that one is born with, and something that characterizes human beings as human beings. It is in this sense that moral properties are still objective. In chapter four, I focus on Wang’s related notion of being in one body with ten thousand things, stressing that it conveys the same idea of empathy in contemporary moral psychology. While it has been commonly recognized that Chinese philosophers started to pay attention to the phenomenon of empathy far earlier than in the West, in this chapter, I emphasize the contribution Wang Yangming makes to the contemporary discussion of empathy: empathy with the unempathic person, or, simply, empathy with the devil, something missing in the current scholarship on empathy. Just like a person with empathy with a person suffering physical pain can feel the person’s pain and is motivated to help the person get rid of the pain, a person with empathy with a devil is one who feels the person’s conscience pain (the pain the devil could, would, or should feel) and is motivated to help the devil get rid of such a pain and thus become a good person. In chapter 5, still drawing on Wang’s idea of being in one body with ten thousand things, I argue that Confucian environmental virtue ethics can avoid some pitfalls of deontological and consequentialist approaches to environmental issues as well as versions of environmental virtue ethics, particularly the Aristotelian ones, developed in the West. In Wang’s environmental virtue ethics, a virtuous person feels the pain and itch of ten thousand things, just as he or she feels the pain and itch on his or her own back, because he or she feels to be in one body with ten thousand things; or reversely, the person feels to be in one body with ten thousand things, because he or she feels their pain and itch. Such an ability to feel either (both) the pain and itch of ten thousand things or (and) to be in one body with ten thousand things is ren, the cardinal Confucian virtue that characterizes a human being as a human being. Despite its appearance, I argue that such a person is not self-centered, as there is nothing outside the person, or, to put it another way, everything is part of the person, while egoism assumes the separateness of the self from others. In chapter 6, against the scholarly view that Wang fails to provide a non-circular, satisfactory, and plausible explanation of the origin of evil, I argue that Wang is largely successful in attributing human evil to two causes, the environmental xi and the inborn qi, which are roughly equivalent to what John Rawls calls natural accidents and social accidents respectively. In the sense of what kind of environmental xi one is born and grows up in and the qi one is born with are out of one’s control, Wang does think that luck plays a role in one’s moral quality. However, unlike Williams and Nagel, who claim morality and luck cannot go together without paradox, Wang can accept the idea of moral luck without any problem. This is because, for him, one’s luck, whether natural or social, does not determine one’s moral quality. What is crucial here is one’s will. The unfavorable xi and qi can lead one to be (do) evil only because one’s will is not firm; and as soon as one establishes a firm will, one can cease to be (do) evil.

14615515.label: Major findings and research outcome
14615515.value: This research has made a series of findings. (1) Most importantly, it has identified an additional form of knowledge. Traditionally, theory of knowledge deals with only propositional knowledge, “knowing that" (knowing that earth turns around sun); in the middle of last century, Gilbert Ryle made a convincing case for a non-propositional form of knowledge: "knowing-how" (knowing how to play chess). This research argues that there is a third form of knowing: knowing-to (knowing-to help people in need). What is unique about this knowing is that it includes the motivation to act according to the content of the knowing, which is absent in either knowing-that or knowing-how. This main finding, which is reflected in the title of this research, leads to a series of other findings: (2) in philosophy of mind and philosophy of action, it is commonly believed that belief and desire are two separate mental states. However, knowing-to is a single mental state that includes both belief and desire, it is a state of the so-called besire; (3) to defend that this single mental state of besire is not bizarre as claimed by contemporary Humean philosophers, this research develops a new type of moral realism. Commonly moral realism focuses on action, arguing that moral property is either a property of the action or supervenes upon it. This research defends a more plausible moral realism that is based on the agent instead of action: moral property is the property that is constitutive of healthy and non-defective human agent; (4) Since knowing-to is both cognitive and affective, it is essentially a kind of empathy, a phenomenon that has attracted attentions of many moral psychologists and moral philosophers. However, this research develops a conception of empathy that is not only about other people's external well-being (an almost exclusive focus of all discussions of empathy) but also their internal well-being: an empathic person is also concerned about other people's being immoral; (5) Moreover, the type of empathy developed in this research is not only directed to human beings, but also to animals and plants. Along this line, this research develops a type of environmental virtue ethics that is not anthropocentrial; (6) to explain the origin of evil given that moral knowing-to is constitutive of human agent, this research develops a conception of moral luck that is not an oxymoron (as in Williams) or paradox (as in Nagel).

14615515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14615515.value: The current project is completed and, a manuscript consisting of 6 chapters is being prepared and to be submitted to an appropriate and reputable publisher, preferably a university press. (When it is published, a full acknowledgement to the GRF grant will be made; previously, drafts of four chapters were already published; While I made acknowledgement to GRF for the two papers published later, I forgot to do the same for the first two published.) While this research has been completed, some findings of this research, particularly the unique type of moral realism: the agent-based moral realism, can be further developed, as this current study is drawing on the neo-Confucian Wang Yangming's work exclusively. By paying attention to other neo-Confucian philosophers, especially Zhu Xi, such findings can be more systematically developed and defended. I plan to prepare a new GRF grant application on Zhu Xi in a near future.

14615515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14615515.value: One of the things we all human beings do is to acquire knowledge, and one of the things that we philosophers always do is to conduct study about knowledge. When we say we know something, we often express our knowledge in the form of a proposition, the so-called knowing-that, for example, "I know that the sun turns around the earth." This is the type of knowledge Western philosophers had been almost exclusively focusing on. In the middle of the last century, however, the English philosopher Gilbert Ryle made a revolutionary discovery: there is another form of knowing that does not appear in the form of a proposition, the so-called knowing-how, for example, I know how to ride a bicycle. This research argues that this is a third type of knowing that is entirely neglected in the Western philosophical tradition. It appears in the form of "knowing-to," for example, "I know to help people in need when I can." Neither a person who knows that he/she ought to help people in need nor one who knows how to help people in need is necessarily motivated to help the person, but a person who knows to help people in need will.

14615715.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14615715.value: 本研究項目將援引「承襲」此一概念，探討康拉德筆下主角建構自我身份和立身社會的人生軌跡和生命抉擇。「承襲」一詞在維多利亞時期的小說專指物質的繼承及遺產，至康拉德筆下則發展出嶄新而深遠的意義。「承襲」在本研究項目的範疇裡有兩個面向，個人的天賦和長處為其一。在此方面，康拉德透過其筆下英雄展開「名」與「實」的思索，作出剛美之材是否必然為世所識的詰問。然而，在康拉德的小說世界裡，名實相符只是虛妄的理想，個人外在的名位價值與其本身的材質特長往往不相稱，若沒有適合的環境和條件，個人的天賦便顯得無從發揮。本研究以為，康拉德的主角皆認定一個切合的專業身份能助其施展內在的天賦特質，展現別樹一幟的男性氣概和風采。在財富及權位世襲式微的時代，出身再不能斷定在社會的身份和地位，取而代之的便是標榜用人唯才的精英主義。康拉德的英雄將「承襲」去物質化，轉為反躬求己、著重開發個人禀賦，並透過本身努力將其轉化為金錢、名聲及社會地位，便是一種確立自我的全新方式。 精英主義是現代人的「無何有之鄉」，透過專業身份去彰顯自身價值和換取社會認同常常功敗垂成，但工作的豐饒意義，以及馬勞在《黑暗之心》提及其賦予人「遇見和尋找自己的機會」的正面意義仍為康拉德早期小說的核心精神。然而，作家後期兩篇小說——《在西方的目光下》和《勝利》卻對此看法提出嚴厲的拷問：就算能在社會覓到施展抱負的一夕之地，人還須周旋於社會「乘襲」下來的各種文化、制度和偏見，不能置身事外，因為這些制約猶如人的賦性一樣，是自我的一部分。而這便是小說裡質問的「承襲」的第二意義：隨人到世上而來的社會桎梏，如國藉及道德價值觀等在基因以外的決定因素。在成就自我的英雄之旅，這些社會制約呈現的方式亟需當事人重頭思量甚至揚棄。 本研究項目所探討的，為康拉德的英雄人物面對個人和社會「承襲」的各色內容中建立自我的迷思、奮鬥和掙扎，而此也是十九世紀末以至二十世紀初現代社會瀰漫身份危機及自我認同焦慮的寫照。內在和外在、先天和後天在「承襲」意識和現代場境裡的連場角力，反映的是人類似近還遠的千古之問：人可以成就甚麽？人的極限在哪裡？建立自我的過程中，甚麽是不可拂的逆鱗，甚麽是人力可改變和成就的變數？這些恢宏的命題超越康拉德的歷史時代，為現代社會關於人的潛能的哲學爭辯提供重要啟示。此研究將為康拉德與當代思潮作一對話，以點出其作品對現代社會的啟發和意義。

14615715.label: Realisation of objectives
14615715.value: Objectives 1 to 4 were achieved for mainly four of Joseph Conrad's protagonists, although other important characters were also analyzed: Jim in Lord Jim, Nostromo in the eponymous novel, Razumov in Under Western Eyes, and Heyst in Victory. Two articles have been published, and a third one is about to, in fulfillment of objective 5. I describe how the objectives were realized for each article below, with the objective number in parentheses behind each relevant sentence. The first article on Jim explores how Conrad reworks the nineteenth-century trope of inheritance in expressing Jim’s crisis of self-making (1). Conrad moves away from the conventional emphasis on familial inheritance of social status and wealth to focus on inherited abilities, which Jim tries to prove in building his heroic status (2, 3). However, there are limits to this process of self-creation: inheritance is, as the word’s root suggests, innate to oneself, yet can also be extrinsic since it still needs to be expressed to call it one’s own, and be unstable since it is open to interpretation (2, 3). Such complexities embodied in the notion of inheritance contribute to a modernist aesthetics in the novel that simultaneously harbours continuity (such as gradualism, predictability, and succession) and discontinuity (such as narrative rupture and the breakdown of causality), allowing the perils of modern self-making to be more fully revealed (4). The essay links this to Hannah Arendt’s notion of natality, and reads Patusan as an “opportunity society” for Jim, where he can realize his romantic dreams of himself (4). Innate ability, in line with the idea of natality—or new beginnings symbolized by birth—seems to allow for a break from the traditional constraints of parental inheritance (in Jim’s case humdrum, as the novel emphasizes) as it can come out of nowhere. However, it is also extremely difficult to live up to the unlimited potential embodied in the concept because of the uncertainty in making one’s self-perceived abilities—which constitute the identity one believes one truly holds—manifest in the outside world (2, 3, 4). In addition, the interpretation of what inner aptitudes one has is unstable because of the ultimate unknowability of the full spectrum and extent of one’s inherent talents (2, 3, 4). The concept of natality is both confirmed and criticized by the novel’s treatment of the idea of inheritance, because natality’s openness is both the very seed for Jim’s dreams, and for the destruction caused by his arguably delusional beliefs in himself (4). Thus the simultaneous freedom and limitlessness, and determinism and fatalism, in the novel, its intermeshing of realist and romantic perspectives, and its ambiguous evaluation of Jim as simultaneously “capable of anything” and not “good enough.” The second essay on Nostromo explores the relationship between the ideas of work and of inheritance. It again shows that inheritance trope is relevant to Nostromo in both of the two senses in which it often appears in nineteenth-century literature: ﬁrst inheritance that is owned in material form, for instance as a ﬁnancial legacy; and second, that which is owned personally or morally, in the form of innate abilities and worth (1). Nostromo’s path shares some similarities with the Victorian inheritance plot. His great expectations of social status and wealth—to “get something great for [his exceptional work] some day”—derive from the idea of a deserved (but deferred) inheritance, where one proves one is intrinsically worthy of obtaining great rewards, of coming into one’s own (1, 2, 3)—just as nineteenth-century protagonists prove their worth through tribulations and trials, with the two forms of inheritance of inborn merit and material legacy often translating into each other. But one difference is that Nostromo’s great expectations are an inheritance that he actively tries to forge for himself through his work—the rewards themselves (ﬁrst to be well-regarded, and then more concretely to get his fortune) are his goal (2). The idea of inheritance marries the idea of work, creating a different mode of remuneration which combines both patterns of legacy and work (2). Coming into one’s own is self-fashioning through work, under the meritocratic terms of obtaining commensurate well-earned rewards for exercised ability and eﬀort (2, 3). Nostromo’s failure to earn his deserved inheritance, another departure from the Victorian inheritance plot, is used to express the troubled relationship between work and identity in the modernist context (2, 3). By showing how the process of claiming one’s inheritance goes awry, Nostromo calls the meritocratic premise of these claims into question, as have more contemporary philosophers such as John Rawls: merit evidenced through work does not necessarily create concrete moral desert (4). This conclusion is thus highly relevant to contemporary debates on the validity of meritocratic ideals (4). Through Nostromo, Conrad critiques emergent meritocratic ideals on which idealized, romanticized notions of work are based in the modern context, and the very shaky foundation they provide for constructing the heroic masculine identity Nostromo yearns for (3, 4). The third article focuses on Conrad’s portrayal of sympathy as an innate inheritance in Razumov and Heyst (1). This innate sympathy generates social encumbrances and allegiances that both characters try to deny once they discover it, because it clashes with other inheritances that they more fully acknowledge and embrace as theirs: for Razumov, the “natural abilities” on which he “depend[s] entirely . . . for his place in the world”; for Heyst, his paternal inheritance of the philosophy of ascetic renunciation (1, 2). Their innate sympathy needs to be affirmed in a Nietzschean sense: embraced, willed, and repurposed as their undeniable inheritance as part of the project of self-becoming (2, 3). Through owning up to their innate sympathy, Razumov and Heyst become what they are (to use a Nietzschean expression), come into their own—an inheritance previously unknown to them (2, 3). The essay thus demonstrates how sympathy as inheritance is both key to the characters’ self-discovery—the “self” here being latent, unknown, and needing to be brought to light—and self-destroying—the “self” here being one’s desired self (1, 2, 3). The latter, for Razumov, is to merely be “a worker”; and for Heyst, “to be a masterpiece of aloofness.” Their processes of affirming their sympathetic responses—to Haldin and then his sister Natalia for Razumov, and to Lena for Heyst—allow them to acknowledge external obligations that make them grow into more morally mature human beings than they were before; but the processes are also portrayed as so overbearing that they cannot be ignored, even when both protagonists try in an attempt to preserve their desired selfhoods (1, 2, 3). The essay links this discussion on self-becoming to contemporary philosophical debates on individual ownership even over the parts of the self that are the product of contingency (4). Razumov and Heyst try to attain moral immunity from inheritances they have not chosen. They subscribe to the view that there is a moral distinction, in the terminology used in contemporary philosophy of justice, between “between choice and luck” (G. A. Cohen) in what they should be held responsible for; that is, that choice creates responsibility, and that non-choice abnegates it. But Conrad shows how choice cannot be the sole determinant of moral responsibility or the constitution of selfhood, in a depiction that adds a unique angle to contemporary debates on self-constitution and individual potential (4).

14615715.label: Major findings and research outcome
14615715.value: The work for this project demonstrates the significance of the notion of “inheritance,” a relatively unexplored topic in Conrad studies, to four of Conrad’s protagonists. Apart from material legacy, “inheritance” for this project specifically includes acquired gifts and traits, and social obligations and allegiances. The two essays on Jim and Nostromo show that Conrad reworks the inheritance trope in nineteenth-century fiction, where the idea of inheritance is used to mete out just deserts, to make internal worth roughly equal to external rewards. The protagonists’ life journeys instead problematize this equivalency. Jim tries to realize his self-perceived inheritance—his abilities and the heroic identity to which he feels entitled—in the external world. But his worth is never fully ascertained, its ambiguity amplified by the novel’s modernist aesthetics. Nostromo’s exceptional labour demonstrates his innate abilities, for which he expects to come into “something great.” When this does not happen, he takes matters into his own hands, stealing the silver he was meant to rescue as his deserved but illegitimate inheritance. For both protagonists, the notion of “inheritance” therefore shows up the conflicts and difficulties in translating (believed) inner worth into the external world that comprise the process of self-establishment. The third essay on Razumov and Heyst focuses on Conrad’s depiction of sympathy as inherited. Both characters initially try to deny this innate sympathy, which generates social encumbrances and allegiances that both characters try to turn away from, because it clashes with other inheritances they have more fully acknowledged. By embracing, or using Nietzsche’s term “affirming,” this inheritance of sympathy, Razumov and Heyst undergo a moral transformation, coming more fully into their selves despite the destruction this wreaks on their lives. The three articles relate to more contemporary debates on human potential in society. The first essay links innate ability to Hannah Arendt’s concept of natality, or new beginnings symbolized by birth. The idea of natality allows for a break from the traditional constraints of parental inheritance (which is humdrum in Jim’s case) because, being partially the result of contingency, it makes innate ability unpredictable. But it also sets Jim up for destruction: the boundless hermeneutics the notion allows encourages Jim to fixate on an inheritance of heroism that might not be justified. The second essay shows how the representation of the mismatch between the actual rewards Nostromo gets for his exceptional labour and his expected rewards questions the validity of meritocratic ideals—ideals that are commonly used to justify or deny material rewards due to a person’s work in contemporary debates. Based on its analysis of how Razumov and Heyst at first deny, and then affirm, their inherited sympathy, the third essay shows how Conrad’s representation of the two protagonists emphasizes the involuntary nature of self-making. Conrad shows how choice cannot be the primary determinant of moral responsibility or the constitution of selfhood, adding a valuable angle to contemporary debates on identity and individual potential.

14615715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14615715.value: One of the important findings from examining Jim, Nostromo, and Razumov is that Conrad refashions the literary trope of inheritance so that coming into one’s own is a process of demonstration of one’s innate ability via work and labour—a process that Conrad represents as fraught with uncertainties and undesired outcomes, reflecting later anxieties about the relationship between work and identity-creation. Characters believe that they can work for and earn their inheritance, a belief that the project has shown underpins the actions of the protagonists examined, where this claim alternates from being delusional to well-justified. This belief gives rise to major characters’ identity conflicts. Using these insights, and using existing criticism on the rewards and discontents of work in Conrad’s fiction, I plan to explore some of Conrad’s other works next, covering his oeuvre more extensively. Texts I intend to look at include The Outcast of the Islands, Almayer’s Folly, “The Secret Sharer,” The Shadow Line, and The Secret Agent. I will continue to explore in these works the ramifications of inheritances—or what can be called characters’ great expectations—that cannot be properly earned through the vehicle of work, that cannot become their desert.

14615715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14615715.value: The project has demonstrated the importance Conrad placed on the concept of “inheritance,” first as innate gifts and traits, and second as social encumbrances and allegiances, in the fiction of the major Modernist author Joseph Conrad. Conrad represents the perils in the process of translating self-perceived inherited abilities into external markers and rewards such as money, reputation and social prestige through effort and hard work for some of his protagonists, even as he depicts it as an essential way of coming into one’s own and of self-making in the modern context. In addition, some of his protagonists also struggle to come to terms with the notion of “inheritance” as social encumbrances and obligations that are so much part of their selves that they prove unexpectedly essentialist and inevitable, unable to be opted out of rather than escapable and optional constructs. The above two senses of “inheritance” then become fraught sites for negotiations of identity for his protagonists. In reworking the inheritance trope in nineteenth-century fiction in such ways, Conrad renders it uniquely relevant to the modernist context and emergent meritocratic values underpinning the notion of work. Conrad’s unique representations of the difficult process of realizing one’s self-perceived potential and of the involuntariness of some of one’s social obligations are also directly relevant to contemporary debates on the validity of meritocratic ideals and questions on moral ownership over one’s inherited assets and social ties.

14615915.label: Realisation of objectives
14615915.value: Overall speaking, the project objectives have been largely achieved. In fact, we have over-achieved some stated targets. For instance, we stated the in the proposal that we would conduct public opinion surveys before and after the Legislative Council election that took place in September 2016. It turned out that we were able to use the awarded GRF to conduct five waves of public opinion surveys during three elections: the 2015 District Council election, the 2016 Legislative Council election, and the 2017 Chief Executive election. These five waves of surveys have laid down a solid foundation for election study in Hong Kong, which meets the first Proposal Objective (i.e. Usher in a multi-wave study of Hong Kong’s elections at different levels). Because we use a common core questionnaire over time, which allows us to track the changes of voting behavior and political attitudes (i.e. Proposal Objective 2). The fact that we were able to achieve more waves of survey than what was stated in the proposal because we adopted a new mode of survey: Internet survey, which is more cost-effective than conventional survey modes as stated in Proposal Objective 3. An additional advantage of Internet survey is that its user interface is more interactive, thereby allowing for sophisticated survey designs such as experiments. Indeed, in most survey waves, we have conducted survey experiments (as stated in Proposal Objective 4) alongside the common core questionnaire. It is also worth emphasizing that our database has provided an important resource for researchers to conduct empirical election study. We have shared our data and/or collaborated with researchers from a number of local, regional, and international research institutes including the City University of Hong Kong, the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Academia Sinica, University of Technology in Sydney, University of Ottawa, University College Dublin, and Duke University. As our research project becomes more internationally known, we look forward to more international collaborations in years to come. The only objective that we were not able to achieve completely was Proposal Objective 5: Develop “apps” for iPhone and Android devices to allow voters to gain easy access to sophisticated election data, and hence become politically informed. The reason is that developing a native app is fairly expensive, and we would rather spend the money on conducting more waves of election survey, which is the core objective of this proposal. In addition, we found that the value added of a native app is paltry after we have set up a project Web site (www.hkelectionstudy.org), where the public can gain easy access to some of our original data. In short, despite the lack of a native smart phone app, we did strived to honor our pledge of adopting an open data policy by making our data freely available to the public.

14615915.label: Major findings and research outcome
14615915.value: The election surveys are intended to gauge public opinions over a variety of dimensions, including, but not limited to, political efficacy, regime support, democratic values, welfare attitudes, etc. It is therefore impossible to come up with an exhaustive list of findings from all these surveys. However, we can highlight a few interesting observations based on publications using the survey data: (1) Income is positively correlated with the electoral support for localist parties (2) Asset ownership is negatively correlated with the electoral support for localist parties (3) There is a clear generational gap in political identification and voter turnout in Hong Kong (4) Immigrants tend to be more pro-establishment than native Hong Kong people (5) Using a conjoint analysis, we find that most respondents prefer a constitutional reform that reins in the number of immigrants.

14615915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14615915.value: Thanks to the successful implementation of these five waves of election survey, we were able to secure more fundings to conduct election surveys during the two by-elections held in 2018. These additional surveys strengthen the core research objective of this proposal; that is, to develop a multi-wave, high-quality election study in Hong Kong. For many years to come, the PI will continue to apply fundings to sustain this meaningful research project.

14615915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14615915.value: Elections are an important facet of civic life in modern society. Electoral participation has existed in Hong Kong for more than three decades. However, much remains unknown. For instance, why would some citizens identify with a certain political camp but not the other? Why would citizens bother to vote at all? The media have no interest in answering these questions, as they tend to focus on predicting winners. The current research is intended to fill this void by developing a multi-wave, theoretically driven, high-quality survey database that allows academics, policymakers, and journalists alike to gain a deeper understanding into Hong Kong people’s political attitudes and voting behavior. We are committed to an open data policy by making our data freely available to the public.

14616015.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616015.value: In this project, I aim to make use of data on slave trade to contribute to the study of the African slave trade on two fronts: 1) the economic history of the slave trade; and 2) the impacts of the slave trade on current African development. First, I study the role of slave voyage captains in the slaving industry. Slave trading was a risky business. Mortality rates of both slaves and crews were high. Slave revolts were not infrequent. The quality and supply of slaves in Africa were uncertain. Captains determined the success of slave voyages. In this project, we attempt to quantify the importance of captains’ ability, based on another paper of ours which quantified the impacts of various distortions on slave trade outputs. I am confident that our study will contribute to the understanding of slave trade history. It will also contribute to the literature on the understanding of the importance of managers in general. Second, I study the impacts of the slave trade on the prevalence of civil wars in Africa. Studies have shown that slave trade, despite its ending more than one and a half centuries before, still has impacts on current economic development. In particular, countries which were more exposed to slave trade are growing at a slower rate. Explanations on why slave trade has such a long lasting impact abound. In another paper, we found the trans-Atlantic slave trade, which exported more male than female slaves, has led to a prevalence of polygyny. Because polygyny is shown to reduce economic growth, our findings suggest one channel which links the slave trade and current economic development. In this project, I attempt to study the relationship between polygyny and civil war. On the one hand, evolutionary psychological theory suggests sexual competition, which is fiercer in polygynous societies, increases men’s tendency to engage in violent activities. On the other hand, occurrence of civil wars might lead to sexual imbalance and hence emergence of polygyny. Therefore, it is difficult to tease out the causal relationship. I plan to circumvent the problem by building on our previous research to use slave trade as an instrument to assess the effect of polygyny on civil war. I believe my study will contribute to the understanding of the happenings of civil wars and also to the understanding of the channels of how slave trade impact current development. 在這研究項目中，我準備利用非洲奴隸數據進行兩方面的研究：1)非洲奴隸的經濟歷史; 2)非洲奴隸歷史對現今非洲發展的影響。 首先，我準備研究運送奴隸的人員在整個行業的重要性。運送奴隸是一項風險十分高的行業。奴隸以及船員的死亡率十分高。奴隸在船上反抗是常有之事。而在非洲所能供應的奴隸數目和質量都沒有絕對保證。運送奴隸的船長以及背後的金主的角色十分重要。在這研究項目中，我準備利用我以往的研究作為基礎，然後分析運送奴隸的船長以及背後的金主在行業的重要性。 另外，我亦會研究奴隸歷史對非洲內戰的影響。不少研究發現即使奴隸歷史已過去了超過一百年，但這段歷史仍然對現今非洲發展有深遠影響。歷史上輸出奴隸較多的非洲國家的現今發展愈是落後於人。有不少研究嘗試找出奴隸歷史對現今發展的影響的渠道。我之前的研究發現輸出奴隸較多的非洲國家，它們的國民一夫多妻的比例亦較高。在這研究項目中，我會嘗試找出一夫多妻與內戰的關係。有關兩者關係的理論並沒有明確指出兩者的因果關係，但我會嘗試利用奴隸歷史對一夫多妻的因果關係來解決當中的問題。

14616015.label: Realisation of objectives
14616015.value: 1. With the help of a research assistant, we obtained the slave voyages from the Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database. We made use of the captains and owners' name in the data to construct a panel of captains' and owners' voyages for the empirical analysis. We have also constructed various variables, such as size of the ship and some variables about owners' characteristics for the empirical analysis. 2. We follow our previous paper, Dalton and Leung (2015), to adopt a Lucas-span-of-control approach by assuming a production function of slave voyage with captain/owner fixed effect. In particular, the slave output is a function of owner/captain's managerial input (the captain/owner fixed effect), capital (proxied by the ship size), labor (proxied by the number of crew), and the TFP of the voyage. 3. We follow the literature on evaluating teacher effects on students' academic performance to estimate owner/captain value-added to slave voyage output. While we are not able to quantitatively trace the management practices serving as sources of value-added of owner/captain to slave voyage output, we find that slave voyage output would be significantly higher if we replace owners/captains with the ones with higher managerial quality in Britain and France. 4. Our data on slave exports is taken from Nunn and Wantchekon (2011). The dataset contains an estimate of the number of slaves exported from each Murdock ethnic group for each century between 1500 and 1900. The dataset contains a separate estimate for the Atlantic Ocean slave trade and the Indian Ocean slave trade. Our data on conflict locations originally comes from Brecke (1999) who constructs a dataset of conflicts occurring across the globe from 1400-2000 with at least 32 fatalities. The Brecke (1999) is known to be incomplete, but is the best known dataset on conflicts during this time period in Africa. The original dataset does not have latitude and longitude associated with the conflicts. We therefore construct a geocoded dataset of conflicts that occurred in Africa using three sources. For conflicts occurring between 1400 and 1700, we use Besley and Reynal-Querol's (2014) geocoded dataset. For conflicts occurring between 1700 and 1900, we use Fenske and Kala's (2017) geocoded dataset. For conflicts occurring between 1900 and 20000, we construct out own geocoded dataset. Given the goecoded dataset, we can assign each conflict to its corresponding ethnic group based on the longitude and latitude locations. 5. Our primary interest so far is to understand the manner in which the slave trade shaped Africa's propensity for conflict and how this relationship has changed overtime. We use an instrumental variables strategy for our empirical specification. In particular, we follow Nunn and Wantchekon (2011) to use an ethnic group centroid's distance to the African coast as the instrument. Our results so far suggest that slave trade-conflict relationship responds to political and economic shocks-- increasing at the waning moments of the slave trade and at the end of colonialism while lying dormant during the colonial period.

14616015.label: Major findings and research outcome
14616015.value: Role of slave captains in slave trade: We make use of the Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database to answer two questions: 1) How important was the managerial quality of owners and captains in slave trading? and 2) What explains the substantial variation in managerial quality? For the first question, we find that both owners' and captains' managerial quality are important. In particular, slave voyage output would be approximately 15% higher if we replaced all owners with the 90th percentile owner than if we replaced them with the 10th percentile owner in Great Britain and in France. It means almost 200,000 more slaves would have been exported over the course of the 18th century via British slave voyages. Similarly, if we replaced all captains with the 90th percentile captain, the slave voyage output would increase 28% in Great Britain, or approximately 270,000 more slaves would have been exported. For the second question, we find that owner value-added is negatively associated with family business and positively associated with the level of competition. The unexpected outbreak of the Seven Year's War led to an exogenous decreased (increased) competition in the French (British) slave trade. We compare the owner value-added before and after the war and argues that competition's effect on owner value-added might be causal. Impact of slave trade on civil war: We use geocoded conflict data from 1400 to 2000 and an instrumental variables framework to shoat that participation in the African slave trade increased conflict propensity in the pre-colonial period. We validate our distance to coast instrument by showing that it is unrelated with conflict propensity before the onset of the trans-Atlantic slave trade. We also examine the dynamic nature of this relationship over time. We show that the slave trade-conflict relationship responds to political and economic shocks-- increasing at the waning moments of the slave trade and at the end of colonialism while lying dormant during the colonial period.

14616015.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14616015.value: Role of slave captains in slave trade: One potential robustness check to the results is to find other historical events that might affect market structure exogenously. We can use this exogenous variation in market structure to test the impact of such variations on owner/captain managerial quality. Impact of slave trade on civil war: We are working to examine potential mechanisms for the slave trade-conflict relationship, along with its heterogeneity and dynamics overtime. Some potential mechanisms include polygamy, state centralization/militarization etc.

14616015.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14616015.value: Role of slave captains in slave trade: Studies have shown factors such as geography, the "gun-slave" cycle, distortions in product and input markets, and conflict among ethnic groups have significant impact on the demand and supply dynamics of the slave trade. Few have utilized the micro-level voyage data to understand the role by the important players in the trade-- voyage owners and captains. We use a micro-level voyage database to quantify the importance of both owners and captains in the trade. The research provides us a better understanding on one of the largest scale slave trade in history. Impact of slave trade on civil war: Violence and conflict were integral parts of the slave trading industry in Africa. Raiding was used to capture people for enslavement, and, of course, violence was used to protect against raiding, both forces giving rise to the familiar gun-slave cycle. It is estimated that conflict was the primary means by which slaves were acquired during the trans-Atlantic slave trade. Despite the strong anecdotal connections between conflict and the slave trade, our empirical work is among the first to estimate the causal impact of the slave trade on conflict propensity in Africa during the pre-colonial period.

14616115.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616115.value: A Study on Supplements of the Hong Kong Lih Pao (1938–1941)

14616115.label: Project Objectives
14616115.value: 通過比較香港《立報》三個副刊與幾種著名的報紙副刊，了解《立報》副刊在文學生產上的定位及變化。 通過選擇的個案研究探索「南來文人」在文學生產的多種力量間如何選擇其路向。 本計劃的成果預期包括最少三篇刊登於隱名評審學報上的論文。 本計劃將製作網上「香港《立報》副刊條目索引」，免費供大眾使用。

通過選擇的個案研究探索「南來文人」在文學生產的多種力量間如何選擇其路向。
本計劃的成果預期包括最少三篇刊登於隱名評審學報上的論文。

14616115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616115.value: 本計劃以香港《立報》(1938-1941)的三個副刊為研究對象。1937年抗日戰爭開始不久，內地大城市相繼淪陷，大量人口流向南方。由於英國採取中立的立場，英治的香港成為避難和策動宣傳攻勢的重要地方，為數眾多的報刊在香港創辦，生產出大量文學作品。 香港《立報》是其中一張新辦的報紙，由南下的文化人主持，以秉承上海《立報》的精神為號召，在1938年至1941年間，發表了數量可觀的小說、散文和翻譯作品。以往不少學者忽略了香港《立報》副刊裡不同的聲音，而把它視為單一陣營的喉舌。本計劃由材料分析出發，重新描繪《立報》三個副刊的面貌，特別注意副刊之內和副刊之間各種不和諧之處，由此探討當時文學生產過程中不同力量的對抗、協商和合作。 本計劃的意義在於引入新的研究方向，以考察文學生產的機制來呈現香港文學的特點，突破過往對作者是否具備「香港意識」、「香港身份」的長期爭辯。同時，本計劃也會發掘南來文人多樣化的文學實踐，以期改變學術界對這些作者的單一印象。 The aim of this project is to conduct research into the supplements of the Hong Kong Lih Pao (HKLP) in the period between 1938 and 1941. After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War in 1937, many of the major Chinese cities fell in succession into the hands of the Japanese, and an enormous number of migrants fled to the South of China. Great Britain’s neutral policy during the War allowed Hong Kong to become a safe haven for political propaganda, catalyzing the expansion of the news media and the subsequent flourishing of literatary endeavor. The HKLP was one of the newspapers which was newly established in these circumstances. It was led by the Southbound literati from Mainland who inherited the spirit of the Lih Pao of Shanghai. Between 1938 and 1941, numerous fictions, essays and translated works were published in it. The supplements of the HKLP are generally considered by scholars to be the mouthpiece of a single political group, and therefore the different voices in the supplements were downplayed. This project will attempt to depict and relocate the different forces in these three supplements. By analyzing the various texts, especially regarding their inconsonance, the research will examine how different forces confront, negotiate and cooperate in the process of literary production, and it will identify the distinguishing features of Hong Kong literature in relation to its production mechanism. This project aims to introduce a new dimension on the research of Hong Kong Literature. Through studying the production mechanism of literature, the features of Hong Kong Literature can be revealed. It may be seen as a breakthrough to the previous researches, which constantly argue on the subjectivity of the author, whether he/she possesses the ‘consciousness of Hong Kong’ or the ‘Hong Kong identity’ becomes a determine factor for Hong Kong Literature. Moreover, this project will also explore on the diversity of literary practices and achievements of Southbound literati, so as to change the apparently unitary impression of Hong Kong Literature in the academic field.

14616115.label: Realisation of objectives
14616115.value: 1.本人在研究助理協助下，廣泛蒐集了有關香港《立報》的研究成果，並往台北「舍我紀念館」、廣州中山圖書館查閱相關報刊。深入分析資料後，本人發現前人的研究與報紙原刊呈現的面貌頗有距離，其中一點是香港《立報》的政治取向及意識形態。過去的研究者倚賴薩空了1980年代的口述回憶，把香港《立報》描述為中共的文宣喉舌，其副刊順理成章為左派抗戰文學的生產基地。本人的研究指出薩空了的回憶和他實際行事有微妙的不同，左派的勢力從來未能壟斷香港《立報》的主導權。事實上該報三個副刊的主事人，政治立場並不一致，但在抗日的共同目標下，並沒有出現1950年代以後國共兩黨針鋒相對的情況。因此，對於香港《立報》副刊的文學生產，宜以個案研究的方式，作更細緻的了解。 2. 第一個案例是推動在香港復刊《立報》的薩空了。他在口述回憶裡強調香港《立報》和中共文宣政策的無間配合，但覆核《立報》原刊，發現口述回憶因應1980年代的官方觀點剪裁事件，只交代了史實的一部份。薩空了當時雖然屬於左派，但他所設想的未來中國是在憲法基礎上的多黨制，無論在上海還是在香港的《立報》，薩空了主編副刊的精神都是致力建設公民社會。由這種思想出發，薩空了雖然是外地來客，但他沒有忽略香港本地的社會問題，民族主義和在地關懷在薩空了的辦報方針裡相輔相成。此一案例有助反省如下成見：「南來文人」必然漠視在地，或需要一個轉化過程才能對在地有所關注。在此案例中，蕭乾和楊剛先後主編的香港《大公報‧文藝》是有意思的共時對照。 第二個案例是香港《立報》另一個副刊的主編葉靈鳳。葉氏以風格前衛的小說成名於上海，其後與左派關密切，南下香港之後，主編《立報‧言林》，宣布繼承前任主編茅盾的精神。但比較「言林」刊載的內容和葉氏個人的創作、譯作，可以發現他對文藝和抗戰關係的理解，並不完全與茅盾及中共政策一致，進一步對比他發表在香港《星島日報‧星座》的作品，葉氏在遵守左派紀律和追求個人文藝理想之間，其實隱含張力。這種張力也程度不同地表現在戴望舒(「星座」主編)、徐遲等親左作家身上。 本研究通過這兩個案例，展示「南來文人」與影響文學生產的不同力量如何發生關係。 3. 本人已有兩篇論文(〈香港《立報》主導權問題重探〉、〈抗戰時期南來香港文化人的國家想像與在地關懷──薩空了主編香港《立報》「小茶館」副刊的個案〉)刊登於學報上，第三篇論文(〈文藝與抗戰──葉靈鳳主編香港《立報‧言林》 的側面觀察〉)在研討會宣讀後，已投稿學報。又，上述三篇論文將收入由北京中華書局的個人論文集《諦聽雜音──報紙副刊與香港文學生產(1930-1960年代)》，預計在2019年底出版。 4. 本人所編製的香港《立報》副刊條目索引，已交予香港中文大學圖書館，由該館安排匯入網上「香港文學資料庫」(http://hklitpub.lib.cuhk.edu.hk/)，免費供大眾使用。

14616115.label: Major findings and research outcome
14616115.value: 1.重新檢視有關香港《立報》政治取向的研究資料，比對《立報》原刊的內容，發現以往的說法不是認為完全跟從中國共產黨、就是完全支持國民黨，實在過於片面。當時的左右派分野，不能以1950年代之後國共對立的框架來理解，香港《立報》的主導權也並非一個政黨所能壟斷。(〈香港《立報》主導權問題重探〉) 2.進一步說，推動《立報》在香港復刊的核心人物薩空了，一向被視為左派人物，但分析他所主編《立報‧小茶館》副刊的內容，發現當時的左派對國家民族前途的構想並非只有一種模式，薩空了通過關懷在地以壯大公民社會的方案，從上海實踐到香港，後來卻湮沒於歷史中，令人惋惜。(〈抗戰時期南來香港文化人的國家想像與在地關懷〉) 3. 另一位香港《立報》副刊主編葉靈鳳，也被視為親近左派的「南來文人」，但從他在《立報》和另一份香港報紙的言論比較，具見「文藝追求」和「抗戰責任」的張力，與一般理解的「抗戰文學」大有分別。(〈文藝與抗戰〉)

14616115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14616115.value: 抗戰時期南來文人在香港的文化事業不止一個方向，既有專注於政治和意識形態，也不乏其他追求，國家、民族、地方的關係並不單一。在本計劃現有成果的基礎上，可繼續探討南來文人處理國家民族和在地關係的不同方式，本人目前正在構思〈從香港《立報‧小茶館》看抗戰時期粵方言寫作的實踐〉論文，將於本年夏天在香港大學「在地因緣：香港文學及文化國際學術研討會」上報告。

14616115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14616115.value: 本計劃通過一份抗戰時期從上海轉移到香港出版的報紙，探討國內政爭、世界局勢、新聞專業、文化傳統等因素與香港文學生產的關係。報刊材料具有強烈的即時性，非常適合用來對照研究者後來的論述。本計劃運用報刊材料質疑了以往研究者受限於1950年代後國共二元對立局勢的觀點，以及當事人日後的回顧言論，重新展現抗戰時期香港社會及文化的複雜面貌。

14616815.label: Realisation of objectives
14616815.value: The project objectives were fully achieved. We employed a four-stage (design, enactment, analysis, and redesign) design-based research (DBR) methodological approach that was composed of 2 iterative research cycles (1 cycle per year, namely Cycle 1 and Cycle 2) to carry out this project. As of the original plan, this DBR was done in the context of formal curriculum learning and teaching of LS (Liberal Studies) upon different school settings in Hong Kong. There were 9 participating secondary schools at the 3 different academic bandings, involving a total of 9 LS teachers and 555 secondary-4 students. Design Based on the previously proposed framework, LOCALE (Location Oriented Context-Aware Learning Environment) and the pedagogic notion of educational gamification, we revamped the EduVenture-X (i.e., the GPS-supported mobile app) of the EduVenture system, and renamed it as GAMES (Gamified Authentic Mobile Enquiry in Society). Stripling’s social enquiry learning model and Lee et al.,’s gamified learning model were adopted in the design and implementation of GAMES to transform (mobilise and gamify) the process of outdoor social enquiry learning into a number of context-aware gamified missions in the form of explorative, data-collecting and reflective tasks. The 4 enquiry learning phases involved in GAMES were (i) CONNECTION—getting an overview of the societal issue via acquiring the related background information, and articulating the information to one’s prior knowledge; (ii) INVESTIGATION—probing into the issue via searching for and evaluating new information to answer the questions related to the issue, and illuminating new questions; (iii) CONSTRUCTION—developing new views on the issue via articulating the information on hand to one’s prior knowledge, and drawing conclusions grounded with evidence; and (iv) REFLECTION—reflecting on one’s learning via identifying the strengths and weaknesses of the enquiry process, and setting goals for improvement. The 3 gamified domains involved in GAMES were (i) COGNITIVE ENGAGEMENT—a system of rules connecting to learning tasks that lead learners to master thereof; (ii) SOCIAL ENGAGEMENT—learning tasks that facilitate social interactions among learners; and (iii) EMOTIONAL ENGAGEMENT —provision of “success” and “failure” feelings in the learning process. Further, according to the LS curriculum, we re-developed the GPS-supported outdoor learning materials (i.e., the digital scaffolds) to be run on GAMES for scaffolding students to enquire into the societal issues concerned. The alignment between the materials and the curricular aim of the issues was validated by an ad-hoc review committee consisting of 2 education faculty members from 2 different local universities, 6 LS teachers from 3 different non-participating high schools, and 1 curriculum officer from the government’s education department. Enactment We recruited 9 LS teachers from 9 different secondary schools (3 at Band-1, 3 at Band-2, and 3 at Band-3). Each of the teachers possessed a master’s degree and had around 5.5 years of experience in LS teaching. Before the Enactment stage of Cycle 1 (in the first year), we discussed the research purpose with the teachers and familiarised them with the pedagogical aim and technical operation of GAMES. In Cycle 1’s Enactment, each of the 9 teachers in his/ her school facilitated a secondary-4 class to conduct an outdoor social enquiry fieldtrip with GAMES and the materials developed in the Design stage. A total of 281students from the 9 schools were involved in Cycle 1. In Cycle 2’s Enactment (in the second year), again, each of the 9 teachers in his/ her school facilitated another secondary-4 class to conduct an outdoor social enquiry fieldtrip. However, in this cycle the students learned with the new version of GAMES together with the new teacher facilitation acts which had been developed/ derived in the Re-design stage of Cycle 1. A total of 274 students from the 9 schools were involved in Cycle 2. Analysis After the Enactment stage of each cycle, the students took the knowledge test. The test and marking scheme were validated by the ad-hoc review committee. Every test paper collected in each cycle was individually marked by 3 post-graduate students who were studying the LS education. All school information had been hidden before the papers were passed to the markers. The Kappa values of the interrater reliability in Cycle 1 and Cycle 2 were 0.85 and 0.89 respectively. In addition to analysing the students’ performance in the knowledge test in each cycle, we conducted in-depth interviews with the students to probe into their experience in learning with GAMES after the Enactment stages of Cycle 1 and Cycle2. We employed Creswell’s (2018) analytical approaches of theme layering and theme interrelating to studying the collected qualitative data. Redesign In the technical aspect, we developed a new version of GAMES in which we introduced a new gadget, namely Caution. Similar to the operational mechanism of other scaffolds (e.g., the sub-tasks of a mission at an enquiry spot) pre-embedded in a context-aware outdoor learning material run on GAMES, the Caution scaffolds, according to the received GPS signals, will pop up to draw students’ immediate attention through the sounding and vibrating functions of the tablets on the potential dangers at the fieldtrip site. In the pedagogical aspect, we set up 3 working groups with the teachers to optimize the pedagogical use of GAMES through addressing the problems unfolded in Cycle 1. The 3 teachers from the same schools’ academic band were grouped together; for example, the 3 Band-1 teachers joined the Band-1 group, and so on. Via face-to-face meetings and electronic communications (e.g., emails and WhatsApp group chats), we (i) discussed the findings obtained in Cycle 1 with the groups, and (ii) worked together to brainstorm and derive new interventions for improving the empirical implementation of GAMES through integrating teacher facilitation into the process of gamified outdoor enquiry learning for different academic-banding students.

14616815.label: Major findings and research outcome
14616815.value: - In Cycle 1 of the DBR, comparing with the conventional approach, GAMES had significant desirable pedagogical effects on the high, moderate, and low academic-achieving students. Notwithstanding the positive findings, a number of common/ unique problems that emerged in the different banding schools impeded the students’ learning process with GAMES. - To address the problems, interventions (the new version of GAMES and the new teacher facilitation acts) were enacted in Cycle 2. The quantitative analyses of comparing the students’ test performance in Cycles 1 and 2 indicated that the enacted interventions significantly advanced the pedagogical effectiveness of GAMES, yielding positive effects on the high, moderate, and low academic-achieving students (with medium to large effect sizes). These positive results were further triangulated with the data collected in the post-enactment student interviews in Cycle 2. - As evidenced, the administrative, technical and pedagogical facilitation acts implemented by the teachers in Cycle 2 successfully resolved the common/ unique impeding problems. - Resolution of the common problems: Allowing the tablet-inexperienced students to prepare themselves for learning with GAMES before the fieldtrip was an important administrative manipulation. This technical manipulation of co-designing the Caution scaffolds was shown both efficient and effective to alert the students to the potential dangers at the fieldtrip site. The pedagogical manipulation of moving the Connection phase of social enquiry learning before the fieldtrip released more time for the students to pursue the sub-tasks of Investigation, Construction and Reflection at each enquiry spot during the fieldtrip. - Resolution of the unique problems. The positive effect of the administrative manipulation of “formative assessment” enacted in the Band-1 schools echoed the importance of providing a “legitimate reason” for the “mark-oriented” achieving students to motivate their full participation in the context of formal education. The desirable scaffolding effects were induced by the pre-fieldtrip pedagogical manipulations enacted in the Band-2 and Band-3 schools, such as (i) letting the students preview and question about the enquiry sub-tasks, (ii) pre-explaining to the students the enquiry sub-tasks, and (iii) equipping the students with the interview protocols and skills. The technical manipulation of “harnessing the ‘Guided Access’ function” helped cease the Band-3 students’ off-learning activities. The pedagogical manipulation of “grouping and leader assignment” enacted in all schools resolved the students’ conflict problems and changed their unserious attitude occurred in Cycle 1.

14616815.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14616815.value: Regarding the positive results of the pedagogical use of GAMES obtained in this project, we will further explore the possibility of extending its application for learning and teaching of (i) other enquiry modules in the LS curriculum, and (ii) other subjects which emphasise outdoor fieldwork. We plan to change the teacher role associated with GAMES from “consumers” to “creators” by further granting them access to the web-based composing platform which allows them to design and create their own school-based GAMES materials for other LS enquiry modules. Also, we are now collaborating with a number of curricular experts in different domains to develop some GAMES exemplars for studying other subjects (e.g., Geography, History, Biology, etc.). Further research on evaluating GAMES’s pedagogical effectiveness on other subjects is crucial before broadly introducing it to other subject teachers. In Cycle 2 of the present DBR, the flipped classroom strategy (moving the Connection phase of social enquiry learning to online and before the fieldtrip) was integrated into the pedagogical implementation of GAMES in the 3 Band-1 schools and in turn yielded positive results. In fact, it is also interesting in looking into if the same flipped approach is workable in schools at other bandings.

14616815.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14616815.value: The integration of gamifed mobile learning into formal education and the importance of teacher facilitation therein have received little attention in the field. In this project, we (researchers) collaborated with teachers (practitioners) to derive and enact what and how they could do in order to optimise their students’ social enquiry experience in the course of gamified, technology-enhanced outdoor mobile learning. Our work makes (i) grounds for a wider adoption of gamified mobile learning in social humanities education, and (ii) a contribution to empirical evidence in the field by designing, implementing and evaluating gamified mobile learning in the context of formal schooling. It provides: - researchers and commercial developers of gamified mobile learning with both pedagogical and technical insights into appropriating their initiatives for school education; - education policy makers and school administrators with a real example (the first example in Hong Kong) of the integration of gamified mobile learning into formal curriculum teaching; - teachers with a reference to implement similar innovations in their teaching practice; - LS teachers with optimized, curriculum-focused context-aware social inquiry learning materials; - pre-service and in-service teacher educators with insights into designing related teacher training programmes.

14616915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616915.value: We propose a new theory of firm growth. The existing literature has a primary focus on the production-side fundamentals such as firm productivity and barriers to productivity growth. By contrast, our focus will be on the non-production-side fundamentals. The theory is motivated by a phenomenon “Non-Production-Based Growth” (NPBG henceforth) that emerged from our pilot survey on forty Chinese footwear manufacturers in 2013. The pilot survey finds that many firms exhibit the patterns that characterize NPBG: (i) fast size expansion, (ii) strong revenue productivity growth but (iii) relatively weaker physical productivity growth. The survey also reveals how NPBG can be achieved. Investing in sales capital leads to both size expansion and revenue productivity growth by alleviating demand-side frictions. Based on the observations, we build a dynamic model that formalizes NPBG and distinguishes it from the standard theory. The model unfolds the underlying mechanism through which firms balance resources allocated to production and sales activities. For firms with a comparative advantage in sales, they would choose to invest in sales capital and, hence, grow their size and revenue productivity without physical productivity gains. We design a unique questionnaire to collect detailed information on firm sales channels and will survey 600 Chinese manufacturing firms from various industries to test empirically our theory. 我们研究一种新的公司增长理论。现有研究往往关注生产性因素，比如生产率和阻碍生产效率的各种因素。相反，我们关注非生产性方面的因素，比如产品销售渠道等等。本研究将调查600家中国制造业企业，从理论和实证两个方面建立非生产性增长的分析框架。

14616915.label: Realisation of objectives
14616915.value: Objective 1: We have conceptualized NPBG (Non-Production-Based Growth) in the working paper “The Rise of Modern Retail in China”. Specifically, NPBG consists of two components: (i) the structural transformation from manufacturing to retail and (ii) the reallocation from traditional to modern retail technology within the retail sector. Objective 2: See Section 4 in our working paper “The Rise of Modern Retail in China”. Objective 3: We have done a unique survey on Chinese footwear manufacturers about their production and sales activities. A big advantage of the survey is to understand how products are sold to consumers. We explain sales channels in details in Section 2 and 3 in our paper. Objective 4: We have surveyed 300 Chinese footwear manufacturers and tried very hard to complete survey on another 300 firms. Unfortunately, our partners at Zhejiang University failed to convince the consulting company to extend the survey with reasonable price. Objective 5: We test our theory in Section 3 and then quantify the welfare implications in Section 5 of our paper.

14616915.label: Major findings and research outcome
14616915.value: This project investigates Non-Productivity-Based Growth. We focus on the rising modern retail segment in China -- i.e., the transition process from a traditional, localized retail system to "modern retail" that primarily relies on chain stores. We combine administrative and survey data to document the related empirical patterns in the Chinese footwear industry. We characterize the individual firm-level manufacturing and retail activities both in the cross-section and overtime. Our analysis proceeds in three steps. We first provide descriptive evidence that the Chinese footwear producers substantially increased their retail activities in the past decade. We also show that the firms which build on their retail stores increasingly specialized and outsourced a large share of the goods sold. Overall, the industry also had much faster growth in its domestic sales relative to exports. Second, we use a set of regressions to empirically illustrate that entrepreneurs differ in terms of their comparative advantage both within retail and versus manufacturing. We find that, firms with larger retail capital tends to outsource while firms of higher physical efficiency focus on production. As a consequence, for firms that use primarily the modern retail technology, their physical efficiency explains little of the variation in domestic sales. Their retail capital, on the other hand, is highly correlated with domestic sales both in level and growth. In contrast, physical efficiency is the key determinant of firms which specialize in goods production and exporting. Third and most importantly, we develop a model to quantify the importance of capital accumulation, labor cost escalation, and export demand in the transition from manufacturing to retail. In our model, the modern retail technology is more capital intensive than the traditional channel. Capital accumulation, tighter labor market, and declining relative export demand all contribute to the rising modern retail in the Chinese footwear industry. We implement the Simulated Method of Moments to estimate the structural parameters of our model. Our estimates imply that rising wage rate and falling interest rate play an important role in the rise of modern retail. Quantitatively our model mechanisms can account for half of the rising share of retail sales vs production in the Chinese footwear industry from 2006 to 2013. It can also account for about two-thirds of the growth of the modern retail sector during the same period.

14616915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14616915.value: We have been witness the importance of NPBG. The broad transformation from the goods producing manufacturing sector to the service sector happened in a large number of developed economies (Herrrendorf et al, 2014). Although our focus is on the retail segment of a specific industry, we believe our theoretical channels are applicable to a much broader set of consumption goods industries. We also expect our survey data to be used in other studies and to inspire research along the line.

14616915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14616915.value: We analyze the structural change from manufacturing to retail within a set of Chinese footwear manufacturing firms. We combine administrative and survey data to document the substantial increase in these firms' retail activities, primarily driven by the establishment of local retail stores. We empirically illustrate that entrepreneur's comparative advantage determines their growth and specialization patterns in manufacturing vs. retail. We then construct and quantify a model of entrepreneurial heterogeneity, retail technology, and industry dynamics that account for the salient features of this transition process. We find that capital deepening contributed to about two-thirds of the rise of modern retail in the data.
