16214415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214415.value: 当今高速因特网和无所不在的接入设备把我们带入了大数据急速增长的年代 – 每天全世界数据中心处理的客户呼叫的数据量达到了2.5艾字节之多。这个数据量已经远远超出了所有人类分析师的分析能力之外。结果只有大约20%的客户呼叫真正被人类分析师处理。近年来在线呼叫中心业务越来越转向为依靠情绪分析，来为用户的各种情绪进行分类，例如正面、负面、快乐、愤怒或中性等各种情绪。这些各类的情绪经常表现于视觉图像、话语和用词之中，亦会随着时间和空间位置的改变而变化。然而，比起识别用户的各种情绪来说，更为重要的是帮助商家理解和预测客户的趋势和行为模式，以便能够采取相应的措施来提高销售额和运作效率。 这就不仅需要研究一些方法来识别离散的、逐句（段）表现的情绪和情感，更需要研究一些方法来模拟人类情绪、情感的动态变化趋势，并进行前瞻性的预测。 我们提出研究一揽子状态空间模型，它们用来从用户的发言和评论之中预测其情绪和情感。我们认为，就像金融数据一样，用户的情绪和情感反映在其语音话语和书面评论之中，也同时具有时变（长时）和时不变（短时）的特性。我们提出把声音，语音和文字的特征呈现为可观测到的动态时间信号。而隐藏的状态定义为情绪和情感的类型。给出过去记录到的信号，这些模型要能预测未来的用户反应。我们提出研究多种类型的隐马尔可夫模型（Hidden Markov Models）和条件随机场模型（Conditional Random Fields），来模拟离散的用户情绪类型，比如正面/负面，快乐/愤怒等。我们还提出应用卡尔曼或粒子滤波（Kalman and Particle filtering）等相关方法来模拟评价值（Valence）和唤起程度（Arousal）的连续数字值。和隐马尔可夫模型类似，卡尔曼和粒子滤波器也是根据已知的观察序列，以一种迭代和更新的方式，来预测隐藏的状态。不同前者的是，后者的可观测变量和隐藏状态都是用高斯分布来表达的连续值。 我们在这个项目中研发的方法也会有益于其它领域的多模态数据分析。可以基于这些方法开发应用于政府，金融和健康护理行业等的应用，用以预测多模态数据的趋势以及预防潜在灾害。 最后，我们提议为这个研究从呼叫中心和在线视频网站收集、转抄和标注多模态数据。这项工作我们将与一家和呼叫中心有联络的商业公司合作完成。

16214515.label: Project Objectives
16214515.value: Summary-based model checking Model checking is a highly precise technique to reveal obscured bugs and it can generate the bug triggering path to aid developers in debugging. However, it is always considered non-scalable to real size software, because traditional model checking techniques aggressively inline all the callees to main function and generate a tremendously large main function. In contrast, our model checking technique executes on the call graph in a bottom-up manner: It checks a function at a time and generates a function summary that produces the same side effects to its callers as its source code. This modular approach can leverage escape analysis to eliminate the variables that are invisible to callers and keep the summary concise. Moreover, the modular approach can utilize the parallel power to analyze non-interfered functions concurrently. This is the key enabling technique for efficiently processing industry software with millions lines of code. Using combined must-aliasing information and value expression graph to precisely reason pointer expressions Imprecisely modeling the effects of pointer expressions can degrade the precision of model checking. Our vision is using storeless model for memory locations and computing must-aliasing information for these locations at every program point. By using the must-aliasing information, we can perform strong updates to even heap locations and eliminate spurious value flow through pointer expressions. The must aliasing and the must points-to information is encoded together in a novel pointer value graph and the graph edges are constrained by path conditions. We use value expression graph (VEG) to represent the value of a variable by a symbolic expression composed of interface variables, and arithmetic and bitwise operators. Combined VEG with an SMT solver, we can precisely reason, for example, which if-else branches are correlated.

16214515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16214515.value: 基於軟件的計算日益滲透現代生活的各個方面。軟件可靠性越來越重要。有充分的證據顯示保證軟件的可靠性是最困難的工程任務之一。例如，Knight Captial 由於它的交易系統發送不正確的訂單而損失了4.4億美元。因此，大量的時間和金錢投資都致力於解決軟件漏洞。據IDC的報告顯示，約40％ - 60％的研發預算都用於測試和軟件缺陷的修正。軟件的正確性很難達到。這是因為軟件的製作本身，本質上是一個人類程序員預測將要發生的事情，然後指示機器如何反應。人類的預測，無論再怎麼細緻小心，都是有限和容易出錯的。這是因為現代計算的應用場景通常是非常複雜的。我們項目的目標是開發一個高度自動化的，精確的，可擴展的平台，來預測工業級軟件當中的嚴重漏洞。我們的方法是使用靜態分析來模擬軟件系統的運行行為，而無需程序員手動構造和執行測試用例。雖然靜態分析方法已經經過了幾十年的深入研究工作，我們觀察到一個不幸的事實，就是目前的方法是不全面而且不適合解決工業級軟件開發的實際需要。換句話說，對於軟件開發者採用靜態分析解決方案，我們需要将多个設計目標集合在一起考虑。我們不僅需要用數百萬行代碼的程序一起工作，我們還需要有效地模擬精確的執行順序。我們不僅要認識到現代軟件通過庫和模塊的組織，我們也需要避免由于軟件微调整产生的重复计算。这里所列每個屬性本身就是一個具有挑戰性的研究和工程任務，而且已經出現了許多專門的解決方案。然而，據我們所知，目前沒有研究如何將所有工程目標放置在一個共同的分析框架互相交互。基於解決這些問題的現有技術，並結合我們新的技术，我們的項目有一個雄心勃勃的目標：讓静态分析的結果对软件開發者有用。我們的平台无干扰地和非侵入性的与编译環境交互，並充分利用基於雲的計算集群來并行分析源代碼。我們的研究團隊擁有豐富的靜態分析算法和高性能並發系統的經驗。我們有充分的準備来從事相關研究，从而大大提高我們在軟件錯誤孵化之前找到它们的能力。

16214515.label: Realisation of objectives
16214515.value: The objectives are achieved as we have successfully demonstrated experimentally that path/flow/context sensitive static analysis can, for the first time, scale to software systems of millions of lines of code. We have designed a compact form named symbolic expression graph which enables the on-demand aggregation of memory operations through summaries for functions. We have also blended the points-to analysis as a regular value flow problem so as to forgo the cost of the whole program analysis of pointers, a primary prohibitor of being scalable for previous techniques. A limitation still to be overcome is the transformed function interface, representing the side-effects, still can cause the exponential explosion in memory space. Therefore, our current analysis are still quite limited in the number of contexts involved in the analysis. This is a foreseeable difficulty that we, in the duration of this project, cannot come up with a satisfiable solution.

16214515.label: Major findings and research outcome
16214515.value: This project has successfully demonstrated that all sensitive static analysis can have large scale applications, contrary to many common observations made by earlier research. We showed that, through a holistic on-demand approach, we can break the layered design commonly used in the traditional methodology and enable much more efficient computation. This result has been published in a premium academic conference, namely the International Conference on Programming Language and Implementation (PLDI). It is notable that our paper is one of the few that address classic problems, which are difficult to have breakthroughs and publish at PLDI. We have shown, in the paper, that all sensitive analysis can scale up to seven levels of calling context for software such as Firefox, which has over 2 millions of lines of code. We have discovered over a hundred confirmed software vulnerabilities and over 10 CVEs in major open source software systems. We have also collaborated with industrial partners in applying our research results to help improving the quality of industrial products. We received positive feedbacks.

16214515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16214515.value: A significant limitation of our approach is that the side-effects through pointers need to be pre-analyzed to enable that holistic approach. Although our on-demand approach can significantly reduce the base of the exponential explosion, the remaining number can still grow very quickly for large programs. Therefore, further research is still needed to address this issue. There are a few options. First, we can use permanent storage to ease the demand for space to store the partial analysis results on disk. Second, we can explore the possibilities of a featherweight analysis to identify the need to inline for a specific problem because many of the side-effects are irrelevant to problems at hand.

16214515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16214515.value: This research relates to a technique called static analysis, which can emulate how computer computes without the actual execution. This emulation is abstract and mathematical in nature as it can deduce contradictions which represent execution problems of the software. By reporting these contradictions to software developers, they can inspect their software and fix the problems before software is executed. The significance of our research is that prior methods suffer from scalability problems as they cannot precisely analyze software systems that are very large, which, unfortunately, include most of the real world software that we use today. We, for the first time, bring a more precise set of analysis to programs of large scales and, therefore, make a significant advance in improving the reliability of real world software systems.

16300215.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16300215.value: Ultacold atoms that are laser-cooled and maintained at below microkelvin temperature have offered unique opportunities to study various strongly-correlated phases of matter with high-precision control. Such experimental emulation of exotic quantum phenomena inspires our hope to simulate and validate theoretical models explaining many-body phenomena in condensed-matter systems, for example, high-temperature superconductivity or a topologically insulating phase. In this proposal the PI seeks to address the following challenging question: "What new insight can an ultracold atomic system bring to strongly-correlated material?". The study of novel quantum material has changed from observing, detecting and understanding the underlying principles to systematically designing and synthesizing quantum material from first principles. Recent trends in cold-atom physics have led to a proliferation of studies in which synthetic quantum phases have been realized with a synthetic gauge field, with a nontrivial topology, and with a novel lattice geometry. All these efforts open the door not only to improving our understanding of many-body phenomena occurring in condensed-matter systems but also to developing unprecedented quantum systems with ultracold atoms. Along these lines, we propose to study new quantum phenomena emerging from the SU(N) symmetry in nuclear spins of two-dimensional interacting ytterbium Fermi gases. The independence of nuclear spins in interatomic collisions, leading to SU(N) symmetry with N as large as 6 for ytterbium, inherently stems from the strong decoupling between nuclear and electronic spin degrees of freedom. Such high-spin SU(N>2) symmetry is rare in traditional condensed-matter systems so the proposed work should shed light on a new quantum material with SU(N) spin symmetry. We plan to experimentally investigate the Fermi liquid properties of a two-dimensional SU(N) fermionic system, a two-dimensional SU(N) fermionic Mott insulator in a lattice, and the ferromagnetic properties of SU(N) fermions trapped in a flat-band lattice. That work will lead to deeper understanding of how the increased degeneracy by virtue of SU(N>2) spin symmetry affects the many-body state of the interacting fermoins. Indeed, our work may cast light on the two-dimensional Fermionic-Hubbard model which may represent the physics of high-temperature superconductivity. Our study will dramatically advance the development of new quantum materials by shedding light on two-dimensional fermionic system. 通过激光冷却而得到微开尔文温度的超冷原子，为研究丰富多样的强关联材料相变提供了高精度可控的平台。这些独特的量子特性模拟，对我们在凝聚态物理中多体作用的研究和对理论模型验证提供了帮助。 在这个方案中，实验领导者试图去解答，“超冷原子系统会对强关联材料带来什么新的视角”。对新奇的量子材料研究，是从发现，观测，直到理解原理，并通过第一原理，系统地去设计和产生量子材料。前沿冷原子领域的发展激发了对量子材料，通过合成规范场，利用非平凡的拓扑结构和新奇的光晶格结构去实现。这些努力不仅为理解多体现象在凝聚态物理中的产生开启了大门，同时也为研究超冷原子量子系统本身，提供了空前的发展。 我们准备实验地去研究二维 SU(N) 费米系统的费米液体性质，二维 SU(N) 在光晶格中费米 Mott 绝缘特性，以及 SU(N) 费米子在平面势阱中的铁磁特性。这项工作会深入了解，退简并通过 SU(N>2) 自旋对称是如何影响费米子的多体相互作用的。事实上，我们的工作更加明晰二维 Fermionic-Hubbard 模型，这一关于高温超导的理论。我们的研究，通过借助对二维费米系统，会很大程度上推进量子材料的发展。

16300215.label: Realisation of objectives
16300215.value: (Objective 1) We experimentally demonstrated a holographic optical trap and realized various geometries including a box potential trap. [Reference] PhD thesis, Bo Song 2019, HKUST (Objective 2) We fully characterized the collective excitation of two-dimensional SU(N) Fermi liquid with repulsive interactions. Our investigation is the first experimental characterization in a 2D SU(N) system, leading to the better understanding of the SU(N) Fermi liquid. [Reference] Chengdong He et al. Collective excitations in two-dimensional SU(N) Fermi gases with tunable spin Under Review, arXiv:1905.10815 (2019) (Objective 3 and 4) We have substantially achieved Objectives 3 & 4 and expect to completely accomplish them soon once the laser system for generating a sufficiently deep lattice is available. During the project, we successfully demonstrated the realization of the 2D SU(N) Fermi system and experimentally characterized the ferromagnetic property of the system. These developments would lead us to successfully investigate physical properties of 2D Fermi gases for Objectives 3 and 4 by the end of year 2021. Reason for under-achievements The remaining challenge for Objectives 3 and 4 is that a new high-power laser system needs to be equipped to realize a periodic optical lattice potential on top of the existing 2D system. We originally requested to procure the laser system in the proposal, but the approved budget did not cover this procurement. Outline attempts Currently we have been seeking alternative (internal) fund to procure the proposed equipment. In parallel, we had built a home-made laser system with low output power, and already demonstrated a proof-of-principle experiment. [References] Chengdong He et al. Collective excitations in two-dimensional SU(N) Fermi gases with tunable spin Under Review, arXiv:1905.10815 (2019) B. Song et al., Nature Physics 15 911-916 (2019) S. Zhang and G.-B Jo Scientific Reports 8 18005 (2018) (Objective 5) We have partially achieved Objectives 5. Reason for under-achievements We figured out the experimental method to generate sawtooth lattice structure using the superlattice technique. However, it turned out that this method may cause unavoidable heating induced by the light scattering. Since this heating may limit our experimental study of the ferromagnetism in a Fermi gas, we developed alternative method to generate a flat band using spin-orbit coupling. Outline attempts Instead of engineering lattice geometry, we developed a new approach to achieve flat bands using spin-orbit coupling. By coupling hyperfine spins and momentum with the two-photon Raman transition, we could flatten the bands as much as possible with minimal heating compared to the conventional method. The remaining challenge is that the magnetic property of the SU(N) Fermi gas is investigated in spin-orbit-coupled lattices. [Reference] T. Zhang et al., Scientific Reports 5, 16044 (2015) Bo Song et al., Science Advances 4, eaao4748 (2018)

16300215.label: Major findings and research outcome
16300215.value: (1) Realizing a sawtooth optical lattice with a nearly flat band We demonstrated an alternative method for exploring interaction-driven phenomena in flattened band structure realized by the one-dimensional sawtooth lattice. In spite of its obvious importance, the creation of an optical sawtooth lattice has not yet been proposed to the best of our knowledge. Unlike the kagome and Lieb optical lattices there were demonstrated recently, the realization of the flat band in the sawtooth lattice requires the subtle control of intra- and inter-unit-cell tunneling. In this work, we illustrated a complete method for controlling all tunneling matrix elements and finally realizing a nearly flat band in the sawtooth optical lattice. [Reference : T. Zhang and G.-B. Jo, Scientific Reports 5 16044 (2015)] (2) Observation of nodal-line semimetal with ultracold fermions in an optical lattice For a long time, it has been an open challenge in ultracold atom experiments to realize and observe 3D topological matters. While numerous schemes have been proposed, the experimental complexity and the characterization of the 3D band structure acted as a barrier against experimental groups achieving this outstanding goal. Our group for the first time realized and observed the 3D topological band with ultracold atoms. In our work, we realized a 3D topological semimetal with nodal lines by an innovative approach to implement 2D SO coupling in an optical lattice together with a 1D linear SO coupling, and develop a fundamentally new technique to successfully observe the topology of the 3D semimetal In addition, we proposed a novel topological phase (known as a symmetry-protected topological phase) and experimentally observed such topological phases with ultracold fermions for the first time. Our work highlights the remarkable potential of realizing and exploring new topological states with ultracold atoms and beyond natural conditions. [References: Song et al., Nature Physics 15 911-916 (2019), Song et al., Science Advances 4, eaao4748 (2018)] (3) Two-dimensional SU(N) fermions beyond Landau Fermi liquid In typical condensed-matter system, most of exotic phenomena readily arise in a two-component (i.e. spin=1/2) Fermi system, which is based on so-called s=1/2 Landau’s Fermi liquid picture. The PI’s group addressed large-spin Fermionic systems beyond Landau’s approach. For the purpose, we used 173Yb atoms that support SU(N=1,..,6) symmetry with tunable spin. We reported the first realization of SU(N) Fermi gas in two-dimension (2D), and the measurement of collective excitations with tunable spins. Despite increasing interests in 2D Fermi gases, a large spin system (s>1/2) with SU(N) symmetry has not been experimentally realized in 2D settings. Our work highlights the remarkable capability to characterize the unprecedented 2D fermionic system with SU(N) symmetry in 2D, which provides an important insight into the concept of large-spin fermionic system. A liquid of SU(N) fermions would become a promising platform on which to explore a number of exotic phenomena, such as the spin incoherent Luttinger liquids, the spin-orbit-coupled SU(N) fermions and the itinerant ferromagnetism. [References: He et al., Collective excitations in two-dimensional SU(N) Fermi gases with tunable spin, arXiv:1905.10815 (2019) ]

16300215.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16300215.value: Following up the developments made, we will set up the periodic optical lattice potential and prepare a SU(N) Fermi gas in the lattice. This will allow us to apply the measurement scheme we successfully had demonstrated in the project, and investigate the magnetic properties of the sample on demand. We are now in the process of developing such lattice potential in the system, and expect to try out the experimental measurement accordingly. As an immediate follow-up development of the project, we anticipate that our collective measurement scheme can be generalized to the 1D or 3D SU(N) Fermi gases as well.

16300215.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16300215.value: The project has been aimed at emulating complex quantum system beyond nature condition with ultracold atoms. Owing to the unprecedented controllability of ultracold atoms, novel properties of quantum matter can be systematically investigated in a controlled manner. In the project, we successfully realized and experimentally studied a multi-component fermionic system that is difficult to be realized in solids using the table-top a quantum gas apparatus. Particularly, we investigated the collective property of SU(N) fermions in 2D, spin-orbit-coupled fermions in optical lattices and unconventional lattice geometries including sawtooth lattice. This project shows how quantum-enabled technology leads our better understanding of complex physical system.

16300415.value: 重量很少的线性码及其在密码学中的应用

16300415.label: Project Objectives
16300415.value: To construct linear codes over finite fields with a few weights for applications in secret sharing and authentication codes, which are two topics of cryptography. To investigate properties and applications of the linear codes constructed in this project.

16300415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16300415.value: Linear codes have applications in communications systems, computer systems, consumer electronics and cryptography. Linear codes are also a subject of mathematics and are related to a number of mathematical areas such as algebra, algebraic function fields, algebraic geometry, algebraic number theory, association schemes, combinatorial designs, finite geometries, finite fields, and number theory. The objective of this project is to construct linear codes over finite fields with a few weights for cryptographic applications. We will use algebraic, combinatorial, geometrical and number-theoretic tools in this project. The outcome of this project is expected to contribute to not only the theory of error correcting codes but also their applications in cryptography. 线性码在通信系统，计算机系统，消费电子产品和密码学中有广泛的应用。线性码也是数学的一个分支，也与众多的其它数学领域紧密相关。例如，与编码学相关的数学领域有代数，代数函数域，代数几何，代数数论，结合方案，组合设计，有限几何，有限域和数论。 本研究项目的目标是构造有限域上只有几个重量的线性码和探讨这些线性码在密码学和其他领域的应用。在这个项目中我们将使用代数工具，组合工具，几何工具和数论工具。本项目的研究结果将进一步完善现有的编码学理论，并促进编码学在密码学中的应用。

16300415.label: Realisation of objectives
16300415.value: A general construction of binary linear codes with Boolean functions was proposed and many families of binary linear codes with a few weights were obtained with special families of Boolean functions. Several families of BCH codes with a few weights were also produced. A sequence construction of linear codes was developed, and many families of linear codes were obtained with this approach. Several families of linear codes were constructed. Another generalisation of the binary Reed-Muller codes were done and linear codes with interesting parameters were produced. Linear codes with a few weights were also obtained with maximal arcs and ovoids. Several families of linear codes were obtained with the puncture technique. So the first objective of this project was fully realised. The secret sharing schemes from some of the codes were studied and t-designs from some of the linear codes were obtained. Hence, the second objective was also realised. During the project, we encountered many difficult problems, but were eventually able to overcome them.

16300415.label: Major findings and research outcome
16300415.value: Many families of linear codes with a few weights were constructed in this project. Special Boolean functions (such as bent and almost bent functions) and sequences were used to construct some of the codes. The weight distributions of the linear codes constructed with a Boolean function were given in terms of the Walsh spectrum of the underlying Boolean function. Minimal linear codes with a few weights were constructed. Such codes have important applications in cryptography (secret sharing). Some connections between linear codes and maximal arcs were discovered. Linear codes with a few weights were obtained by punching irreducible cyclic codes. Several families of BCH codes were studied. The classical binary Reed-Muller codes were generalised into a new type of linear codes. Properties and parameters of these codes were determined. Many families of t-designs were obtained with linear codes produced in this project. In general, the linear codes obtained in this project are very good, many of the linear codes are optimal to almost optimal. A conference paper and thirteen journal papers were produced in this project. Most of the papers were published in top journals. In addition, a research monograph titled "Designs from Linear Codes" (World Scientific, 2019) was published. Some of the papers in this project have been highly cited. Remark: A paper is a product of a RGC project if the date on which the paper is first in the public domain is within the project period. This is the current RGC policy.

16300415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16300415.value: Some of the codes produced in this project may have further applications in engineering, combinatorics and finite geometry. We will look into such applications in the future.

16300415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16300415.value: Linear codes are widely used in computers, communication systems and consumer electronics. Most people use a linear code indirectly daily, as they have a mobile phone where a linear code is implemented. Linear codes have also applications in cryptography and several areas of mathematics. The objectives of this project are to construct linear codes with a few weights and study their parameters and properties. Many families of linear codes with a few weights have been constructed with special functions and sequences. Their parameters and properties have been obtained. In general, the codes have very good parameters and properties. Some of the codes are optimal. The codes have important applications in computer and data storage systems, security systems, and combinatorics.

16300715.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16300715.value: 聯合國預測在2008年底世界一半的人口生活在城市裡，到2050年，據預測，64.1％發展中國家和85.9％的發達國家將城市化。科學證據顯示城市空氣污染會直接影響城市居民的健康。空氣污染的控制以及污染物的傳輸與擴散（T＆D）已備受科研界和政府決策者的關注。區域尺度空氣質量，不同於小尺度，由於其在對城市居民健康影響評估的優勢一直是關注的焦點。隨著人口老齡化，越來越多的健康減弱的居住在密度高的內城小區的居民可能受到較差空氣質量更嚴重後果的個人。然而已有的稀疏的路邊觀測和城市空氣動力學小尺度模型結果顯示在城市局地需要考慮區域(或城市)尺度模型與實際空氣質量統計數據相當大的偏差。短期曝露於高濃度的局地污染可加劇易感人群某些疾病。利用完善的區域特徵量化模型量化城市氣候和空氣質量的局地偏差是提高健康風險評估以及其在特定的高密度城市環境的經濟成本的估計的基礎。 該項目將嘗試定義香港城市高密度商業/住宅區在氣候和空氣質量的次網格尺度（SGS）變異。對由於對“未知領域”和計算資源的限制等引起的參數化的不確定性導致中尺度對流城市氣象模型無法直接計算的高空間分辨率我們將進行數值實驗。這項研究將集中在沿港島北岸的城市走廊。歐拉- 拉格朗日大渦模擬模型EULAG將被用來重現詳細的城市氣象和顆粒物（PM）的T＆D。初始條件和邊界條件將從中尺度氣象模式化學WRF-CHEM提取。 WRF模型的建築環境參數（BEP）的物理選項將被用來準確地反映了行星邊界層（PBL）內城市對氣象的影響。這將實現在不需要復雜化學傳輸模型的前提下的對中尺度PM濃度的模擬。通過EULAG模擬的SGS氣象和PM濃度示踪劑將與WRF-CHEM模擬進行比較。我們會統計分析平時、個案和不同季節的地表和三維上的誤差信息。此外，中尺度和SGS模型結果會與香港天文台的記錄，香港環境保護署香港環保署）路邊站的觀測，和利用電車固定路線開展的持續移動城市空氣質量監測活動中收集的PM2.5數據進行比較。辨識觀測和SGS氣象對比結果認為需要係統性調整BEP設置的的情況，嘗試得到基於城市形態，地形和大氣條件的經驗修正函數。

16300715.label: Realisation of objectives
16300715.value: The realization of the objectives is listed below: Objective 1: Configure tracer-mode WRF-Chem/BEP and the micro-scale flow model Urban Air Quality Management System, ADMS-Urban, to focus on the north shore of Hong Kong Island where spatially continuous PM concentrations are measured. During this study, the WRF-BEP was configured using the available building morphology data, WUDAPT dataset and modified land cover dataset in Hong Kong. The model’s performance was evaluated and an optimum setting of the WRF-BEP model was identified in order to extrapolate the implementation to the whole PRD region. Due to computational power, instead of using the coupled WRF-Chem to study the air pollution transportation pattern, we used WRF-BEP/CMAQ to study transportation pattern instead. The forecast of air pollutants from CMAQ was significantly improved by employing a set of ARIMA models. Then the microscale ADMS model was also configured to couple with the WRF and CMAQ models. Tram data of pollutants were also collected and analyzed to understand the temporal variation of pollutant along the road with a lot of high-rise buildings in the north shore of Hong Kong Island. Objective 2. Develop and implement a downscaling method for coupling WRF- Chem/BEP to ADMS-Urban With a series of modifications on the software architecture of the models, the ADMS-Urban model was configured to ingest the output of WRF-CMAQ for detailed street-canyon adjustment. The coarse resolution WRF-CMAQ output were used to provide meteorological conditions and background concentration for the micro-scale ADMS-Urban model (Hood et al. 2017). Objective 3. Produce WRF-Chem/BEP and ADMS-Urban tracer predictions for typical seasonal climates In this study, the concept of air parcel residence time (APRT) was raised and the APRT was investigated to study its potential application in air pollution prevention and control in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) region. For simplicity and the advantage of less computational cost compared to the WRF-Chem/BEP tracer mode, the HYSPLIT model was used inside for the tracer predictions. The HYSPLIT is a complete system for computing simple air parcel trajectories as well as complex transport, dispersion, chemical transformation, and deposition simulations, thus fulfilling the objective of this study with less man-power. Through the tracer predictions the hourly APRT in whole year of 2012, 2014, and 2015 was calculated to study its relation to typical seasonal climate. Objective 4. Evaluate the relative performance of WRF-Chem/BEP and ADMS- Urban tracer predictions with respect to dominant spatial patterns of measured PM concentration By using the roadside air quality observation stations, we evaluated relative performance of WRF-CMAQ and ADMS-Urban predictions for 7- to 72-hr PM2.5, 4- to 72-hr NO2, and 4- to 6-hr O3. The spatial pattern of the street canyon pollutant concentration was also analyzed as shown in the attachment (Hood et al. 2017).

16300715.label: Major findings and research outcome
16300715.value: There were a number of meaningful findings and research outcome achieved from this project. Firstly, the WRF-BEP multilayer urban model is evaluated in Hong Kong region and improved performance was found (particularly wind speed) compared to the traditional bulk scheme and an optimum model configuration was determined (Wong et al. 2018). This is very useful to provide a better initial and boundary condition for driving the CMAQ model. The CMAQ model’s forecast of air pollutants (including PM2.5, NO2, and O3) was also improved by employing a set of autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) models with numerical forecasts (Liu et al. 2018). Then, the ADMS-Urban was configured to couple with the WRF and CMAQ model to simulate the hourly NOX, NO2, PM10, and PM2.5 concentrations (Xie et al. 2018). Tram data of pollutants were also collected and analyzed to understand the temporal variation of pollutant along the road with a lot of high-rise buildings in the north shore of Hong Kong Island. Multivariate statistical analysis was conducted to correlate the PM2.5 data and morphological data and the critical building morphological design factors were identified, which provide a scientific basis for urban planning optimization (Shi et al. 2018). Based on the coupled WRF/CMAQ-ADMS models, a high-resolution air quality forecasting system was also developed for Hong Kong (Hood et al. 2017). This system provides a solid foundation for future assessment of the risks of air pollution exposure in the community. Then, the concept of air parcel residence time (APRT) was raised and the APRT was investigated to study its potential application in air pollution prevention and control in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) region. Through the tracer predictions the hourly APRT in whole year of 2012, 2014, and 2015 was calculated to study its relation to typical seasonal climate. The seasonal APRT results revealed that long APRT was mainly distributed in southern PRD in the summer half year, but in north eastern PRD in the winter half year. This is related to the prevailing wind directions in the summer and winter monsoons. This result indicates that the emission reduction strategy should be implemented in the key areas, namely the eastern and central Guangzhou, western Huizou, and the border between Foshan and Jiangmen, and the construction of new factories should not be allowed in these areas (Huang et al. 2019). By using the roadside air quality observation stations, we evaluated relative performance of WRF-CMAQ and ADMS-Urban predictions for 7- to 72-hr PM2.5, 4- to 72-hr NO2, and 4- to 6-hr O3. The results show drastic improvement of the roadside air quality prediction after the downscaling of the WRF-CMAQ model by ADMS-Urban, compared to using the much coarser resolution WRF-CMAQ alone (Hood et al. 2017). This is due to the capability of the ADMS-Urban to resolve detailed buildings and roads’ dimensions in the street canyons of Hong Kong, which has the aspect ratio larger than 1.5 (H/W > 1.5), under which the number of vortices in the street canyon is usually lager than 1.

16300715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16300715.value: Based on the knowledge acquired from the research outcome, we believe that there is a number of aspects that deserves further detailed studies. Firstly, the coupled system can be used to access the health impact of roadside pollutants under different atmospheric conditions and that would in turn gives corresponding insight on regional and local emission restriction policy. Secondly, the turbulent vertical fluxes measurement campaign could be carried out in the urban environment to further evaluate and improve the turbulent scheme in the WRF-BEP model. Its relationship with urban air pollutant dispersion could then be further explored. Then, the developed system could be further coupled with the global climate model to project the pollution concentration level in future cities under different scenarios and to assist mitigation and adaptation policies.

16300715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16300715.value: In this project, a sophisticated modeling system is developed to study the transport and dispersion of air pollutant. The air quality forecasting skill is improved by this system. For larger scale, the developed system was used to study the relationship between regional pollutant dispersion and seasonal climates. For local scale, the study also investigated the spatial and temporal pattern of street-level pollutant concentration and its relationship to the atmospheric condition and the urban landscape feature in Hong Kong. The research outcome and findings (including the improved air quality forecasting ability by the developed modeling system and the knowledge acquired about the regional and street-level pollutant dispersion behavior) added value to the academic community which would facilitates future research studies in the related area. The research findings also give significant insights to emission reduction strategies and future urban planning policies.

16300915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16300915.value: Hybrid organic/inorganic perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have great promise to meet the need for high power conversion efficiency (PCE) while allowing for low-cost solution processable manufacturing. A typical PSC is no different from a quasi-solid state dye-sensitized solar cell (DSC) except for the replacement of the molecular dye with a thin layer of perovskite. In a way similar to DSC, photogenerated electrons are injected into the mesoporous TiO2, but perovskite itself can also effectively transport electrons to the current collector, which is advantageous for obtaining a higher open-circuit voltage (Voc) due to the higher conduction band edge (CBE) of perovskite than that of TiO2. However, this may compromise the photocurrent density because the electron accumulation in perovskite would increase charge recombination. Therefore, controlling the degree of electron accumulation in perovskite is an important determinant to high-performance PSCs. The immediate question is how the electron injection/recombination dynamics and the degree of electron accumulation in perovskite can be controlled by interface engineering with a view to optimizing cell performance. To address these questions, we propose to systematically study the effects of interface structural modifications of mesoscopic TiO2/CH3NH3PbI3 films on the interfacial electron transfer dynamics and the photovoltaic performance. Three interfacial structural modification strategies will be investigated. First, we will introduce a thin insulating layer on a TiO2 mesoporous film before filling it with CH3NH3PbI3 to tune the interfacial electron transfer rates. Second, we will further study how the crystallinity of a TiO2 mesoporous film can affect the interfacial electron transfer between it and the adjoining perovskite film. Finally, we will investigate how the CBE position influences the interfacial electron transfer to and from the perovskite films by choosing electron transporting metal oxide semiconductors with different CBE positions. The successful execution of this project will advance our understanding of the key question about how materials interface engineering influences interfacial electron transfer, and thus provide guidelines to control the electron transfer dynamics at the TiO2/CH3NH3PbI3 interface and to ultimately optimize the solar cell performance. We will also gain important insight into the relationship between the degree of electron accumulation in the CH3NH3PbI3 layer and the overall photovoltaic performance. More generally, this work will generate new knowledge on the electron transfer dynamics at nanomaterials interfaces and promote the exchange between theory and experiment to synergistically unravel the interfacial electron transfer dynamics underpinning the high performance of the most promising PSCs. 有機/無機雜合鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池有實現高能量轉換效率以及低成本溶液處理生產工藝的巨大潛力。典型的鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池與傳統的準固態染料敏化太陽能電池十分相似。不同之處是，在鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池中，鈣鈦礦薄層取代了染料敏化太陽能電池中的染料分子。對這兩種電池而言，由光激發產生的電子均被轉移到介孔結構的二氧化鈦當中。但鈣鈦礦層本身不僅能夠產生光電子，也能有效的將電子傳輸到集流體。這意味著鈣鈦礦層具有比二氧化鈦更高的導帶邊緣， 從而使得鈣鈦礦電池能夠具有更高的開路電壓（Voc）。 然而， 電子在鈣鈦礦層的積累會加劇電荷的復合，導致光電流密度降低。因此，控制電子在鈣鈦礦層的積累是構建高效鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池的關鍵。 目前的問題是，如何通過界面工程學方法控制鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池中電子轉移/復合以及電子的積累來提高太陽能電池的能量轉換效率。 為此，我們計劃系統性地研究三種對介觀TiO2/CH3NH3PbI3薄膜界面進行結構性修飾的策略如何影響界面電子傳輸動力學和光電性能。 首先在沉積鈣鈦礦之前在TiO2介孔薄膜上引入壹層薄層絕緣材料，以此調控界面的電子轉移效率。第二，我們將進壹步研究TiO2薄膜的結晶度對氧化鈦薄膜和相鄰的鈣鈦礦之間界面電子轉移效率的影響。 最後，我們將通過采用不同的金屬氧化物半導體作為電子傳輸材料來研究金屬氧化物的導帶邊緣位置對其與鈣鈦礦界面的電子轉移效率的影響。 這項研究的成功將會推動我們對材料界面工程學方法在界面電子轉移效率的認知，進而指導我們通過修飾TiO2/CH3NH3PbI3薄膜界面來調控制電子轉移動力學，最終達到優化太陽能電池性能的目的。此外，我們將會深入了解到鈣鈦礦層中電子積累對整個太陽能電池性能的影響。 總的來說，這項工作不僅會加深人們對納米材料界面電子轉移動力學的了解，而且將結合理論與實驗，為研究高效鈣鈦礦型太陽能電池打下良好的基礎。

16300915.label: Realisation of objectives
16300915.value: 1. To control the electron injection dynamics from CH3NH3PbI3 to TiO2 in a mesoporous film through interface engineering and materials combinations. In our work “Hierarchical Dual‐Scaffolds Enhance Charge Separation and Collection for High Efficiency Semitransparent Perovskite Solar Cells”(Article 2 in Part C), we attempt to address the core issue by introducing hierarchical dual scaffolds into the perovskite layers in order to create optimum electron transport paths orthogonal to the hole transport paths. A quasi‐mesoporous TiO2 film was used as the inorganic scaffold, while a phenyl‐C61‐butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM) network embedded in situ in the entire perovskite layer, including the TiO2 scaffold layer and the adjoining capping layer, was applied as the organic scaffold. Compared with the conventional planar reference cells in the ST mode (semitransparent), this dual scaffold design considerably enhanced the charge separation and improved the charge collection efficiency, affording an absorbed photon‐to‐electron conversion efficiency (APCE) close to 100%. As a consequence, with a very thin perovskite layer thickness of ≈100 nm, the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the FTO/dual scaffold/perovskite/Sprio‐OMeTAD/Ag PSCs have leaped from 7.86% (for the conventional reference cell) to 12.32%, yields about 57% improvement. Further, for the real ST‐PSCs fabricated by replacing the Ag electrode with the PEDOT:PSS transparent electrode, a PCE as high as 8.21% was achieved with an average visible light transmittance (AVT, mean value from 390 to ≈700 nm wavelength) of 23%. 2. To establish the relationship between the electron injection/recombination dynamics (or electron accumulation degree in perovskite) and the overall photovoltaic performance. No.5, 8, 16 and 18 papers listed in part C collectively contribute this objective. In article 5, a new fullerene derivative named C5-NCMA is introduced as an electron transporting material (ETM) to replace the commonly used PCBM in the planar p-i-n perovskite solar cells (PVSCs) for better electron injection. Compared with PCBM, this fullerene derivative features a higher hydrophobicity, higher LUMO energy level and higher ability of self-assembly. With the device structure of FTO/NiOx/MAPbI3/ETM/Ag, the C5-NCMA showed power conversion efficiency (PCE) of up to 17.6% with negligible hysteresis, which is higher than PCBM (16.1%). It was found that a higher LUMO energy level was obtained for C5-NCMA compared to PCBM, which favored a higher open-circuit voltage (Voc) in PVSCs with C5-NCMA than PCBM. Besides, the higher electron mobility, photoluminescence (PL) quenching efficiency and quenching rate of C5-NCMA led to more efficient electron transport and charge extraction in the device, thus resulting in a higher fill factor (0.79). Most importantly, the stability of PVSCs to moisture is significantly enhanced for C5-NCMA compared to PCBM due to the hydrophobic nature of C5-NCMA. Thus, we believe that the present work provides an important guide for the further development of ETMs for stable and efficient PVSCs. In article 8, we reveal the role of mixing cesium (Cs), methylammonium (MA) and formamidinium (FA) in the energy band alignments at electron transporting side in NiO p–i–n PSCs. By systematic optimization of the triple-cation perovskite layer, the NiO-based inverted PSCs achieved a PCE of up to 18.6% with superior ambient stability to TiO2-based n–i–p structured devices. In addition, controlled experiments were carried out to study the composition-dependent stabilization of FA-based perovskites by MA and Cs. It is revealed for the first time that the ratio of MA/Cs is critical in shaping the chemistry of perovskite intermediates and thus can be used to control the phase purity of the resulting perovskite film. In article 16, we show that in common with hysteresis, the LSE (light-soaking effect) is owed to the ion migration in PVSCs. Driven by the photovoltage, the mobile ions in the perovskite materials (MA+/I–) migrate to the selective contacts, forming a boosted P-i-N junction resulting in enhanced charge separation. Besides, the mobile ions (MA+) can soften and suture the PCBM/perovskite interface and thus reduce the trap density during electron injection, in keeping with a higher open-circuit voltage. Finally, almost LSE-free PVSCs can be prepared by using 0.1 wt % MAI-doped PCBM as the electron transport material, whereas overdoping (1 wt % MAI doping) makes the LSE even more pronounced due to excess mobile ions that need time to migrate to reach a new quasi-static state. In article 18, a 3D–2D (MAPbI3‐PEA2Pb2I4) graded perovskite interface is demonstrated with synergistic advantages. In addition to the significantly improved ambient stability, this graded combination modifies the interface energy level in such a way that reduces interface charge recombination, leading to an ultrahigh Voc at 1.17 V, a record for NiO‐based p‐i‐n photovoltaic devices. Moreover, benefiting from the graded structure induced continuously upshifts energy level, the photovoltaic device attains a high Jsc of 21.80 mA cm−2 and a high fill factor of 0.78, resulting in an overall power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 19.89%. More importantly, it is showed that such a graded interface structure also suppresses ion migration in the device, accounting for its significantly enhanced thermal stability. 3. To enhance the solar cell performance by manipulating the degree of electron accumulation through interfacial modifications and materials combinations. Interfacial engineering for less electron accumulation and better transport are studied in article 2, 8, 17 and 18. In article 17, we report the design of a tailor-made, amino-functionalized perylene diimide polymer (PPDIN6) and its demonstration as a new interlayer material for interface engineering in planar p-i-n PVSCs. With the device structure of FTO/NiO/CH3NH3PbI3/PCBM/PPDIN6/Ag, we have achieved a PCE of up to 20.43% with a record fill factor of 83.4%, compared to only 17.38% PCE for the control device without PPDIN6. The remarkable performance enhancement is ascribed to the reduced trap density at the PCBM/Ag interface as elucidated by temperature dependent admittance spectroscopy measurement, which facilitated electron extraction and suppressed electron recombination at the PCBM/Ag interface. Moreover, the amine groups in PPDIN6 can neutralize the migrating iodide ions and inhibit the formation of the insulating Ag–I bonds on the surface of the Ag electrode, resulting in highly stable PVSC devices by inserting PPDIN6 between the PCBM layer and the Ag electrode.

16300915.label: Major findings and research outcome
16300915.value: This project has not only realized the intended objectives but also achieved additional outcomes, resulting in a large number of high-quality publications. 1. We studied crystal growth of perovskite thin film and its effect on device performance. In article 3, 8, 9 and 11 (Part C), we investigated the crystallization dynamics and develop new method controlling film formation of perovskite material for promoted solar cell efficiency. 2. A series of studies on ion migration which plays essential role in the operation of perovskite solar cell were carried out. We examined the relationship between ion migration and the anomalous hysteresis effect (article 1), profiled the organic cation-dependent degradation of organolead halide perovskite solar cells (article 6) as well as the light soaking effect and its correlations with ion migration (article 16). 3. Carbon based perovskite solar cell (C-PSCs) is well-known for its great potential in industrialization for low-cost processing and high device stability. In this project, we promoted the efficiency of C-PSCs by systematically engineer the material and study the charge transport dynamics in (article 10 and 15). 4. Inorganic perovskite, for its lack of volatile organic substance, is believed to have tremendous opportunities towards stable perovskite solar cell. In article 14 we reported a key finding in stabilizing inorganic perovskite CsPbI2Br. 5. Last but not the least, we carried out literature study on perovskite solar cell in article 7,12 and 13. Significant scientific work were reviewed and summarized with future perspectives made.

16300915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16300915.value: Device efficiency and stability are two main concerns for perovskite solar cell. Based on research output from this project, further development on perovskite, charge transport and interface materials by means of material engineering and mechanistic studies are necessary. For perovskite material, formamidinium cation (FA)-based perovskite is a more ideal choice than current methylammonium (MA) system due to its higher stability and absorption property. As we examined, more efforts are required to understand the specific crystal growth dynamic for FA perovskite to achieve better film quality. There are also room to improve in terms of organic charge transport materials currently used by molecular engineering as well as material design. For example, organic molecules bind with inorganic charge transporting oxides can be leveraged as more stable charge transporting layer. As the development of perovskite solar cell, we also need to perform research on perovskite at large scale to enhance its industrial potential. Deposition, film formation and device fabrication at large scale are significantly different from that at small size. Slot-die coating, doctor blade coating and spray coating techniques will be possible techniques towards industrialization.

16300915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16300915.value: Solar cell harvests solar energy by transforming it into electricity and will be an important tool to sustainability for all human beings. In this project we focus on the latest type of solar cell that based on an earth-abundant, cost-efficient and high-performance material called perovskite. Extensive and systematic researches have been carried out which significantly improves our understanding of the nature of perovskite solar cell. We also utilized knowledge and methodologies from material science to boost the power-conversion performance of perovskite solar cell to around 20% which is comparable to commercialized solar cell product. Novel materials, fabrication processes and theories were concluded with publications in highly impacted scientific journals.

16301115.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16301115.value: 磁畴壁动力学中的缺口效应

16301115.label: Project Objectives
16301115.value: To simulate and analyse DW structure changes near a notch. The goal is to understand why notches can help the adiabatic spin-transfer torque to depin a DW so that the depinning current density is smaller than the intrinsic threshold current density of the DW in a homogeneous wire. We would like to answer following questions. a) How does DW displacement depend on the notch geometry as well as the current density? b) Is the depinning process triggered by a vortex/antivortex generation? c) What is the lifetime of a vortex/antivortex? How is the DW displacement related to the vortex/antivortex motion? e) What is the optimal notch geometry for the smallest depinning current density? To study the notch effect on DW dynamics when both adiabatic and non-adiabatic spin-transfer torques are presented. We will find out whether one can use notches to lower the current density for a DW propagating at a fixed average speed. If the answer to the above question is yes, then what is the optimal notch design, in regard to notch shape and notch-notch separation, for the lowest current density? How do the results depend on the relative relation between the non-adiabatic STT strength and damping constant ?

16301115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301115.value: Notch effects on magnetic domain wall (DW) dynamics such as DW pinning and DW propagation and structure transformations are the focus of this theoretical proposal. Notch effects on DW dynamics are fundamentally interesting, and it is foreseeable that notch effects on DW dynamics would play a very important role in future spintronic devices like magnetic logic gates, sensors and data-storage devices, where information is encoded in the magnetization direction of the domains or the polarity of DWs, making it also an important practical problem. These applications require precise knowledge of DW positions and notches are often used for this purpose and, in general, for manipulating DW dynamics. Unfortunately, our current understanding of DW pinning/depinning is very limited even though it is known that nanostructure geometry has profound effects on DW dynamics. The purpose of this project is to theoretically study DW physics involving notches and antinotches. In particular, we would like to find out how an electric current as well as a field depin a DW near a notch. What is the pinning current/field for a given notch in a magnetic wire? How is depinning related to the vortex/antivortex generation? What is the optimal notch geometry for a high DW speed or a low depinning current? A good understanding of DW pinning should generate new knowledge about DW manipulations. The outcomes of this study could have a significant impact in condensed matter physics in general and in the field of spintronics in particular. 本理论研究计划主要关注磁畴壁动力学中的缺口效应 如缺口对磁畴壁钉扎、运动与结构变化等的影响。磁畴壁动力学中的缺口效应有其基本的科学意义，而且可以预见，在未来的磁畴壁相关自旋电子学器件中，缺口效应也将充当重要角色（此类器件包括但不限于，用磁畴的磁化方向或磁畴壁的极性来编码信息的逻辑门、传感器、数据存储器件等）。因此，磁畴壁动力学中的缺口效应亦是一个重要的实际问题。通常而言，上述实际应用中为了操控磁畴壁运动，需要精确知道缺口与磁畴壁的位置等信息。然而，尽管已经知道纳米结构的几何形状会对磁畴壁运动产生极大影响，现今我们对磁畴壁钉扎和去钉扎的理解仍十分有限。本项目的主要目的是从理论上研究与缺口（或尖角）相关的磁畴壁动力学。具体地，我们希望明了磁场或电流如何使缺口附近的磁畴壁去钉扎。给定纳米线与缺口，如何确定去钉扎电流或磁场？去钉扎过程如何与磁涡旋/反涡旋的产生相联系？为了达到更高的磁畴壁运动速度或更小的去钉扎电流（或磁场），如何优化设计缺口形状？对于磁畴壁钉扎的更好理解将衍生出更多对磁畴壁操控的新认知。本项研究的成果和产出将对自旋电子学领域乃至整个凝聚态物理学产生重要影响。

16301115.label: Realisation of objectives
16301115.value: We have launched investigations in areas related to our objectives. The project objectives have been fully achieved. In detail, it was found that the domain wall (DW) depinning from a notch by both magnetic field and electric current is facilitated by the anti-vertex formation. For magnetic field-induced DW propagation, antivortex formation is an intrinsic process of a strawberry-like transverse DW originated from magnetostatic interaction. Under an external magnetic field, DW in a wider width region tends to move faster. This speed mismatch tilts and elongates DW centre line. An antivortex is periodically born near the tail of the DW centre line and then either moves along the centre line and dies on the other side of the strip, or grows to its maximum size, detaches itself from the DW, and vanishes eventually. The former route reverses the polarity of DW while the later keeps the DW polarity unchanged. A general relationship between an external field and a DW structure for a given notch geometry is found. By estimating the field below which this relationship holds, we obtain the depinning field theoretically. Our theoretical estimate of the depinning field compares well with simulation results. Our theory explains well why the depinning field of a transverse wall of one chirality is larger than that of the opposite chirality. These findings should be important in applications, especially for those DW-based devices made of soft magnet. For current-induced DW propagation, notches in an otherwise homogeneous magnetic nanowire can boost propagation. DW motion in notch-modulated wires can be classified into three phases: A DW is pinned around a notch when the current density is below the depinning current density. DW propagation velocity is boosted by notches above the depinning current density and when nonadiabatic spin-transfer torque strength β is smaller than the Gilbert damping constant α. The boost can be multifold. DW propagation velocity is hindered when β > α. It was found that notches can help electric current to depin a DW with the assistance of vortex generation. The DW depinning and displacement at a notch is often facilitated by antivortex generation. The DW displacement is insensitive to notch geometry and current density. Through this mechanism, notches can even boost DW propagation. This phenomenon is explained by the Thiele equation. We have also investigated both static and dynamical properties of other spin textures such as spin waves and skyrmions both with and without disorders. In particular, skyrmion, structure, generation and manipulation are studied with a couple of publications. Topological spin waves and their applications were found with a number of publication listed below.

By estimating the field below which this relationship holds, we obtain the depinning field theoretically. Our theoretical estimate of the depinning field compares well with simulation results. Our theory explains well why the depinning field of a transverse wall of one chirality is larger than that of the opposite chirality. For current-induced DW propagation, notches in an otherwise homogeneous magnetic nanowire can boost propagation. DW motion in notch-modulated wires can be classified into three phases: A DW is pinned around a notch when the current density is below the depinning current density. Through this mechanism, notches can even boost DW propagation. This phenomenon is explained by the Thiele equation. On the topic of topological magnonics, it was found that topological spin waves can exist on the surface of a sample that does not dependent on the geometry of the sample, and is immune from disorder effect. Magnonic devices such as beamsplittter and interferometer were proposed.

16301115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16301115.value: On the notch effects on spin structures and dynamics, all investigations so far in the field are on the soft magnets. More and more spintronic experiments, including those involve DWs and skyrmionn, are using hard magnet. It is important to find way to pin spin structures. So far, at least small notches is not effective to locate a DW position. The notch effects on spin structures involving hard magnet need to be full investigated. Also, it shall be interesting to experimentally realize our proposal of magnonic devices based on the topological spin waves.

16301115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16301115.value: Various notches are often introduced in spintronics to trap a domain wall (DW). Common wisdom would expect notches to strengthen DW pinning and to hinder DW motion. Interestingly, our simulations show that notches help electric current to depin a DW with the assistance of vortex generation. The DW displacement is insensitive to notch geometry and current density. Moreover, a current density below the intrinsic threshold value, which is the minimum current to sustain continuous DW motion in a uniform nanowire, can induce a continuous DW propagation along a wire with a series of notches. In the presence of a non-adiabatic spin-transfer torque, notches in an otherwise homogeneous magnetic nanowire can boost current-induced domain wall (DW) propagation. DW motion in notch-modulated wires can be classified into three phases. Easy creation and manipulation of skyrmions is important in skyrmion based devices for data storage and information processing. We show that a nano-second current pulse alone is capable of creating/ deleting and manipulating skyrmions in a spin valve. Furthermore, in this project, we found that many magnetic materials support topological chiral spin waves that exists only on the sample surfaces. Such exotic spin waves that are robust to the sample geometry and disorders should have interesting application in magnonics.

16301315.label: Project Objectives
16301315.value: Design of a multimodule synthesis strategy using macrolactonization as the ring closure step. Other option(s) for formation of the macrolide skeleton may be considered and carried out if feasible. Synthesis of the key 2,3,5-trisubstituted tetrahydrofuran fragments possessing the requisite stereogenic centers and functionalities. New chemistry will be explored for construction of the unique hexahydrofuro[3,2-b]furan subunit, including the alkyne-facilitated epoxide ring-opening for formation of tetrahydrofuran ring and transformation of but-3-ynoic acid into beta-keto acid. Assembling the key 2,3,5-trisubstituted tetrahydrofuran fragments and other smaller fragments into the iriomoteolide-13a skeleton. The order in building up the molecular skeleton will be carefully considered for achieving maximized synthetic efficiency. Determination of the absolute configuration of iriomoteolide-13a by comparison of optical rotation data of our synthetic sample with those of the natural product. There is a high chance that the proposed structure is the mirror image of iriomoteolide-13a. Synthesis of the opposite enantiomer may be considered although the awarded manpower budget is very limited. If sufficient amounts of samples, including various advanced intermediates and the end product(s), are available, preliminary screening of these samples for cytotoxicity using cancer cell lines will be performed.

16301315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301315.value: Marine microorganisms are a rich source of novel molecular entities which are referred as to marine natural products. These marine substances often deliver unique biological activities and are promising candidates for development of effective medicine such as anticancer agents and antibiotics. One challenging task in marine natural product research is to determine the correct molecular structures of the isolated compounds in few milligram quantities. Chemical synthesis provides a powerful tool to confirm or revise the proposed structures. Iriomoteolides are a novel family of marine macrolides of different ring sizes. Seven members of iriomoteolides have been reported and all of them were isolated from the benthic dinoflagellate Amphidinium species. The originally proposed 20-membered macrolide skeleton for iriomoteolide-1a is a new structural type and, together with its highly promising cytotoxicity, it attracted many laboratories around the world to undertake its total synthesis. Unfortunately, these efforts eventually confirmed that the proposed structures for iriomoteolide-1a, -1b, and -1c were wrong. It remains for further total synthesis studies to figure out their correct structures. In early 2014, the structure of iriomoteolide-13a was reported; it was proposed as a novel 22-membered macrolide which contains fourteen stereogenic centers, one hexahydrofuro[3,2-b]furan ring, one tetrahydropyran ring, two tetrahydrofuran rings, and two double bonds. A total amount of 4.0 mg of iriomoteolide-13a was obtained from the 350 L cultivation medium together with iriomoteolide-1a and -3a. However, the new macrolide decomposed during chemical derivatization, rendering its absolute configuration unassigned. Iriomoteolide-13a has the most complex molecular architecture within the known iriomoteolides and it serves as an excellent target molecule for total synthesis. As a continuation of the PI’s previous studies on diverted total synthesis of macrolides including iriomoteolide-1a stereoisomers, a multimodule synthesis strategy will be developed for total synthesis of iriomoteolide-13a. In particular, new chemistry will be explored for synthesis of different building blocks; these include (a) alkyne-facilitated epoxide ring-opening for 2,3,5-trisubstituted tetrahydrofuran formation; and (b) transformation of but-3-ynoic acid into beta-keto acid. The possible outcomes of the proposed research are multiple, such as verification of the proposed structure of iriomoteolide-13a, determination of its absolute configuration, and access to synthetic materials related to iriomoteolide-13a for biological study. 海洋微生物是新型分子實體的重要來源，這些源自海洋的物質被稱為海洋天然産物，常具有獨特的生物活性，是開發有效的抗癌藥和抗生素等醫藥品的有價值的候選物質。分離到的海洋天然産物盡有毫克級的量，確定其正確的分子結構是一項具有挑戰性的任務，而化學合成就成為確認或修正初始建議結構的一種強有力的手段。Iriomoteolides 是一個含不同大小環的海洋大環內酯新家族，已有七個結構類型見諸報道，都是從底棲前溝藻屬甲藻分離得到的。初始報道的iriomoteolide-1a含有一個新結構類型的20元環內酯骨架，並具有極強的細胞毒性，因此吸引了世界各地衆多實驗室從事它的全合成。不幸的是這些研究最后證實初始報道的iriomoteolide-1a、-1b、和 -1c的結構全是錯的，還有賴于進一步的全合成研究來破解它們的正確結構。2014年初報道了iriomoteolide-13a的假設結構，它是一個新的22元環內酯，具有14個立體手性中心、一個六氫呋喃[3,2-b]並呋喃環、一個四氫吡喃環、二個四氫呋喃環、及二個雙鍵。從350升發酵液中得到4.0毫克iriomoteolide-13a，由于它在化學衍生過程中分解，導致它的絕對構型未能確定。Iriomoteolide-13a的分子結構在已知的iriomoteolides中最為復雜，使它成為全合成的絕好目標分子。作為前期進行大環內酯（包括iriomoteolide-1a立體異構體）多樣性全合成研究的延續，本項目負責人將開發一種多模塊合成策略用于iriomoteolide-13a的全合成。還將特別注重探索新化學用于不同建築砌塊的製備，這些包括：炔烴輔助環氧開環形成2,3,5-三取代四氫呋喃、及丁-3-炔酸轉化成為3-酮酸。本項目預期成果是多重的，諸如確認iriomoteolide-13a的假設結構、確定它的絕對構型、及得到與iriomoteolide-13a相關的合成樣本用于生物學研究。

16301315.label: Realisation of objectives
16301315.value: Iriomoteolide-13a is a very challenging macrolide for chemical synthesis due to its high oxidation state. In this project the linear form of iriomoteolide-13a, after opening of the lactone ring and the two cyclic hemiacetal subunits, is disconnected into the C1–C15 and C16–C30 fragments; the former possesses a 2,3,5-all-cis-trisubstituted tetrahydrofuran (THF) ring while the latter features a rare and unique bis-THF skeleton with an additional substituent (Me or OH) on each THF ring. The naturally occurring form of the macrolide contains a total of 13 oxygenated carbon atoms among which 12 are the oxygenated stereogenic centers. In addition, there are two non-oxygenated stereogenic carbon centers. A successful synthetic design would rely on controlling the correct stereochemistry of the proposed structure of iriomoteolide-13a out of 16,384 possible choices. Our original synthetic design, i.e. Objective 1, aims at assembling the 22-membered lactone ring via macrolactonization which has been achieved by reaction of the C3-keto ester with the C21-OH group in refluxing toluene. The fully functionalized macrolactone has been obtained except for the C3 and C15 hemiacetals. Transformation of the obtained macrocyclic compound into iriomoteolide-13a is highly achievable once a sufficient amount of the compound is accumulated in further study. Objective 2 has been achieved with successful synthesis of the C1–C15 and C16–C30 fragments. For synthesis of the C16–C30 bis-THF skeleton, an access to the stereochemically defined C21–C24 stereotetrads is required and various approaches have been extensively explored by combination of asymmetric dihydroxylation (AD) with stepwise double intramolecular SN2 reaction [See section 10, Hui ZHAO’s PhD thesis]. The key steps center on dihydroxylation of the C21–C22 double bond to generate the C21–C24 stereotetrads possessing three continuous hydroxy groups. In this project it has been confirmed that the AD reaction becomes sluggish or even suppressed when bulky alkyl substituents are appended on the double bond. The C19–C22 THF ring has been constructed by an AD–SN2 sequence when no substituent or a simple alkyl group is attached to the C19 position. However, formation of the C23–C26 THF ring via an SN2 reaction of the C26-allylic mesylate results in complete racemization at the C26 position. In order to avoid this problem, an intramolecular palladium-catalyzed oxypalladation of an allylic alcohol has been successfully employed to generate the C23–C26 THF ring with good diastereoselectivity. By using the AD–SN2 sequence followed by the intramolecular palladium-catalyzed oxypalladation of an allylic alcohol moiety, the C17–C30 bis-THF skeleton has been constructed with good stereocontrol [See section 8, journal publication #1]. However, this synthetic route fails in installation of the C16-allylic functionality which is essential for coupling reaction with the other fragment. Incompatibility of the AD reaction with a C16 -substituent is the major problem. The final solution has been established by performing the AD reaction at an early stage and the resultant diol is temporally protected. Thus, the C23–C26 THF ring is first assembled using an intramolecular palladium-catalyzed oxypalladation. It is followed by incorporation of the C16–C18 allylic chloride via a modified Leighton asymmetric allylation and formation of the C19–C22 THF ring via an intramolecular SN2 reaction to furnish the C16–C30 bis-THF fragment. For synthesis of the C1–C15 THF fragment, a palladium-catalyzed vinyl epoxide ring-opening cyclization with a neighboring hydroxy group has been successfully conducted to afford the C3–C11 all-cis-trisubstituted THF product. The absolute stereochemistry of the cyclization product has been confirmed by X-ray single crystal structural analysis of its tri(4-nitrobenzoate) derivative. The C12–C15 subunit is then incorporated onto the C3–C11 THF-containing thioester followed by stereoselective ketone reduction to secure the C9,C11-anti-diol relationship [See section 9, conference paper #1]. The obtained C15-nitrile is reduced to the corresponding aldehyde and the C3¬–C4 double bond is subjected to cross metathesis (CM) with methyl 3-butenoate and DBU-mediated double bond rearrangement to furnish the C1–C15 fragment possessing a C1–C3 conjugated ester moiety. The latter is finally transformed into the 3-keto ester via Cu-catalyzed borylation and oxidation. It is emphasized that the protection-free aldehyde moiety at C15 survives from the CM, borylation, and oxidation conditions as mentioned above. Objective 3 has been achieved by first non-stereoselective coupling the C1–C15 aldehyde fragment with the C16–C30 allylic chloride fragment in the presence of indium powder in aqueous media. The resultant two C15-diastereomers of the C1–C30 linear product are separated into pure diastereomer over silica column and are used in the following transformations. After protection of the C15-OH as the TES ether, the C21-OH is released for macrolactonization with the 3-keto ester in refluxing toluene. The 22-membered macrolactone has been confirmed by 1H NMR and HRMS data. The C15-OTES ether is selectively removed and the C15-OH group is oxidized to the C15-ketone. The remaining step is the global cleavage of C6-, C9-, and C11-OTBS ether groups and formation of the C3 and C15 hemiacetal subunits [See section 10, Haichen MA’s PhD thesis]. Objective 4 has been largely achieved. For confirmation of the absolute stereochemistry of the synthesized C1–C15 fragment, the X-ray single crystal structural analysis of the derivative has been performed. Also, the stereochemistry of the synthesized C16–C30 fragment should be correctly assigned on the basis of the used asymmetric reactions and transformations. There are two steps remained toward the final structure of iriomoteolide-13a at the time of submission of this report. It will be possible to assess the absolute configuration of the naturally occurring iriomoteolide-13a by measuring the optical rotation data when the synthesized molecule is fully constructed. The delay of the experimental work is the result of significant underfunding of the project with only 40% of the originally required dollar amount. Objective 5 is a general purpose of organic synthesis. As mentioned above, the project fund is not enough for conducting studies other than synthesis of iriomoteolide-13a. The bioactivity screening would be performed in the following up work with additional funding supports from other sources. In this project, synthetic methods for accessing a number of THF and bis-THF compounds have been established. Some of these THF-containing compounds have been prepared and they can be screened for biological activity in the following studies.

16301315.label: Major findings and research outcome
16301315.value: The 12 oxygenated stereogenic centers of iriomoteolide-13a pose a significant challenge for its total synthesis design. In this project, macrolactonization via an intramolecular transesterification of 3-keto acid methyl ester with the C21-OH group has been successfully realized in refluxing toluene, providing a new example of this strategy in total synthesis of structurally complex macrolides. The linear form of iriomoteolide-13a, after opening of the lactone ring and the two cyclic hemiacetal subunits, is then disconnected into the C1–C15 and C16–C30 fragments via an indium-catalyzed allylation in aqueous media. This serves as a remarkable example of using indium-catalyzed allylation in the fragment coupling reaction of densely functionalized substrates [See section 10, Haichen MA’s PhD thesis]. Synthesis of the C1–C15 THF fragment features a number of elegant synthetic reactions and transformations. These include (a) the palladium-catalyzed vinyl epoxide ring-opening cyclization with a neighboring hydroxy group to secure the C5–C8 all-cis-trisubstituted THF ring; and (b) incorporation of the C1–C3 keto ester moiety via a sequence of CM, double bond rearrangement, copper-catalyzed borylation, and oxidation [See section 9, conference paper #1]. Construction of the C16–C30 bis-THF fragment highlights a strategically combined sequence of reactions. This has been achieved by (a) installation of the C21–C24 stereotetrad possessing three continuous hydroxy groups using the AD reaction of the C21–C22 double bond at an early stage; (b) assembly of the C23–C26 THF ring via an intramolecular palladium-catalyzed oxypalladation of an allylic alcohol; (c) incorporation of the C16–C18 allylic chloride via a modified Leighton asymmetric allylation; and (d) formation of the C19–C22 THF ring via an intramolecular SN2 reaction [See section 8, journal publication #1 & section 10, Haichen MA’s PhD thesis]. In addition, many unsuccessful results observed during this study are of useful reference value for synthetic chemists in synthesis design. Racemization of a chiral allylic mesylate occurs during an intramolecular SN2 cyclization to form a mixture of diastereomeric THF products but a chiral propargylic mesylate gives a single THF product. Interference of additional -substituents with an AD reaction of the densely functionalized internal double bonds has been confirmed and the observations are an addition to the collection of suitable AD substrates [See section 10, Hui ZHAO’s PhD thesis].

16301315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16301315.value: The established macrolactonization strategy offers, for the first time, a suitable synthetic route to the highly oxygenated iriomoteolide-13a; the remaining 2–3 steps toward the target macrolide should be highly achievable and they will be examined in the immediate future. In the case that the synthesized compound of the proposed structure does not match with the naturally occurring molecule, synthesis of other candidate structures is logically considered. However, in view of the huge effort and cost required for the synthetic work, it is not likely to pursue follow up study without providing additional funding supports. Nevertheless, the knowledge accumulated during this study should provide the basis for future synthesis of iriomoteolide-13a and other related macrolides.

16301315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16301315.value: Iriomoteolide-13a is a novel and structurally complex molecule produced by a marine dinoflagellate Amphidinium species. The substance possesses many oxygenated carbon atoms, most of which form the 5- and 6-membered rings as well as the 22-membered skeleton. This marine-derived substance is collected only in a tiny quantity that is not sufficient for complete structural assignment and comprehensive investigation of its cytotoxicity against cancer cell lines. In this project, a chemical synthesis strategy has been established to access the proposed structure of iriomoteolide-13a by a logically combined use of various reactions with control of the correct shape of the molecule. In particular, three types of reactions are elegantly employed in the assembly of the trisubstituted tetrahydrofuran rings. Closure of the 22-membered lactone ring is also uniquely performed within the 3-keto acid methyl ester. The outcome of the demonstrated synthetic transformations in this project enables access to iriomoteolide-13a and its structural analogues and is of significant reference value for future chemical synthesis of complex natural products.

16301415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301415.value: 5–10納米長的分子導線被視為未來分子微電子學的關鍵原件。由於有機分子導線的電導隨長度指數衰減，長分子導線導電性很弱。在分子骨架中加入金屬中心可以提高電導性。因此，有機金屬導線是一類頗有希望的電荷傳導體系。但因技術難度高，關於有機金屬導線電荷傳導的實驗研究非常稀少。 我們計畫探究單分子有機金屬導線的電荷傳導。方法是首先在超高真空中將自由卟啉前驅單體沉積在乾淨的金，銀或銅的（111）表面。然後通過表面共價耦連反應生成分子線。接下來，用過度金屬（錳，鐵，鈷，鎳，銅，錫或鉛）將卟啉核金屬化。第二步是使用低溫掃描隧道顯微鏡（STM）分析分子線的結構和電子學特徵。本研究計畫的主要部分是第三步：使用STM實現分子操縱將單分子線懸掛在探針和襯底之間，在這種構型下測量單分子電導。下一步，NO或CO氣體分子被放入真空器，這些分子有可能吸附在金屬中心。我們可以研究電荷傳導如何被吸附的分子影響。 我們將分析不同變數下電荷傳導的特性，包括偏壓，分子軌道能級，分子構型，分子線長度，金屬中心等等。我們的研究焦點是衰減係數，共振傳導，負微分電導，振動效應，分子吸附導致的電導開關，磁性原子導致的近藤效應以及重原子導致的自旋軌道耦合效應。一個理論合作組將用第一性原理模擬和解釋實驗資料。一個有機合成組將負責合成前驅單體。通過系統性的實驗和緊密的合作，這個研究計畫將有望揭示有機金屬導線的電荷傳導的豐富物理性質和深入的機理。

16301415.label: Realisation of objectives
16301415.value: Object 1 has been partially completed. We have synthesized molecular wires containing Fe, Pb, Cu and Ni. Specifically, the first type of wires are porphyrin-based wires of a linear backbone or a branched backbone. The porphyrin core is metallated with various transition metals (Pb, Cu and Fe). The second type of wires are based on coordination of Fe or Ni with tetrahydroxybenzene linker molecules. Then we spent the rest of the time focusing on Object 2 and 3 to characterize the properties of these wires. Objects 2 and 3 have been successfully completed. We have thoroughly Since we found they exhibit very rich, and unexpected, properties, we devoted most of the time here. characterized the molecular conformation and electronic structures (molecular orbitals) of the individual molecules and the molecular wires using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy. We We also measured the I-V characteristics on single-molecule charge transport in the single molecules and single molecular wires. We discovered long-range coherent charge transport in linear wires and negative differential conductance in junction wires. We collaborated with the theorists to shed lights on the mechanism of these transport properties. We achieved spin-state manipulation at single molecules and molecular wires by mechanical and electronic excitations. We have started some preliminary test on object 4. Since we have discovered some unexpected but very interesting new phenomena in our research on objectives 2 and 3, we spent more time to thoroughly investigate these phenomena. The remaining time is not sufficient for us to fully explore object 4. We are continuing to study objective 4 beyond the project completion date.
