18300715.label: Major findings and research outcome
18300715.value: Regiospecific regeneration of the active NAD(P)H from NAD(P)+, which are important for industrial biotransformation processes, were extensively studied using precious-metal (Rh and Ir) catalysts. However, cobaloximes was the only 3d metal organohydride-regeneration catalyst, so far, reported to yield 1,4-BNAH (TON = 4.8–14) via the hydrogenation of BNA+ under H2 atmosphere (19.4 –77.4 atm) in methanol and generate NADH photochemically from NAD+ at low efficiency (1.38 TON and 36% yield) in aqueous solutions. In this project, two novel classes of 3d metal organohydride regeneration catalysts have been designed and studied. The catalytic generation of 1,4-BNAH from its conjugate cation (BNA+) by the cobalt diimino-dioximes (1 and 2) and the BF2-bridged derivative (3) in both acetonitrile and aqueous solutions have been studied under a precious metal-free conditions (Kwok et al 2020). 1–3 are also active for the regeneration of NADH in aqueous solutions and successfully applied in biocatalysis (Kwok et al, in preparation; Directing Biosynthesis VI 2021). In addition, the cobalt macrocyclic iminopyridine complex (4) is also found to be active catalyst for 1,4-BNAH regeneration under similar conditions (Kwok et al, in preparation). Despite the activity of our catalysts are lower than their precious-metal counterparts, they represents the some of the very rare examples of 3d metal organohydride regeneration catalyst and they are more efficient, in terms of activity and energy consumption, when compared to the reported cobaloxime catalysts. Though some of 3d compounds (5–14) studied are inactive for the regeneration of organohydrides, their activity towards the reduction of carbon dioxide (Guo et al. 2017) and water (Leung et al 2018), as well as their photophysical (Hu et al 2017 & Jin et al 2018) and magnetic properties (Xiang et al 2019) were studied. In particular, 7 catalyses the photoreduction of CO2 in the presence of [Ru(bpy)3]2+ and TEOA/BIH (BIH = 1,3-dimethyl-2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-1Hbenzo[d]imidazole) in acetonitrile. It exhibits the highest catalytic efficiency amongst reported molecular (homogeneous) 3d CO2-reduction catalysts and is the first Cu CO2-reduction catalyst reported so far, producing CO selectively (97%) with a TON of approx. 3000 without added water and a TON of 12,600 in the presence of 10% water. The photocatalytic water reduction mediated by 5 and 6 has been investigated with an Ir photosensitizer and triethylamine (TEA) in aqueous acetonitrile (10%). The catalysis is homogeneous and a H2 TON of 16,440 could be obtained with 5, which is amongst the highest for related Co catalysts.

18300715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18300715.value: Two classes of novel organohydride regeneration catalysts bearing earth-abundant metal, i.e. cobalt diimino-dioxime (1–3) and imino-pyridine (4) complexes, were developed. While the reaction pathway for 1,4-BNAH regeneration by 1–3 was investigated, further study on the regeneration of the biologically active NADH could be carried out, particularly in combination of different enzymatic reactions using not only 1–3, but also with 4. Apart from the biocatalysis with L-glutamate dehydrogenase we studied, biotransformation with other oxidoreductase could also be performed to widen their application. The use of novel Ru photosensitizer (Ho et al 2019) synthesized in this project for similar photocatalysis will also be explored. Given our experience in catalysis for energy conversion, we are interested to couple the catalysis of NADH regeneration by 1–4 with the enzymatic reduction of carbon dioxide to formate and subsequently to formaldehyde and methanol, using such enzymes as formate, formaldehyde and alcohol dehydrogenase. Apart from the current photocatalytic approach, the incorporation of our catalysts onto a thin-film electrode in combination with different enzymes and NADH will also be explored. Collaboration with researchers in related areas of biocatalysis will be currently sought via participation in international conference in April 2021 (Directing Biosynthesis VI, Edinburgh, originally scheduled in 2020).

18300715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18300715.value: Our industrial is reliant on the use of chemical reductants (dihydrogen and metal hydrides) produced unsustainably. Instead, organohydrides, e.g. nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH), are used in biochemical reactions mediated by enzymes, namely oxidoreductase. However, the recycling of the active organohydrides consumed by the enzymes limits their application in the biosynthesis of valuable compounds at preparative scale. Organohydride regeneration was widely studied with precious metal catalysts, but these catalysts are expensive and susceptible to poisoning during the enzymatic reactions. Thus, the development of related earth-abundant (3d) metal catalysts are highly desirable. In this project, two classes of novel organohydride regeneration catalysts of earth-abundant metal, i.e. cobalt diimino-dioxime (1–3) and imino-pyridine (4) complexes, were developed. Their activity were verified under a precious metal-free photochemical conditions. In combination with suitable organic light-harvesting and sacrificial reagents, 1–4 catalytically regenerate a synthetic analogue of the natural organohydride (NADH) in biochemical systems, upon irradiation with visible light. In addition, 1–3 were found to catalyse the regeneration of NADH under similar conditions and were successfully applied to enzymatic biosynthesis. Besides, other compounds investigated in the project were also found to be efficient photocatalysts for the conversion of water and carbon dioxide to fuels.

18600015.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600015.value: 陳寅恪是20世紀享負盛名的史學大師，也是中國實證主義文學研究的重要代表人物，其別樹一幟的文史互證研究，在中國文學研究的領域內，一直有廣泛而深遠的影響。 過去不少學者嘗探討陳寅恪的研究方法，成果頗多。然而，這些論述多從較為宏觀的學術研究或史學方法著眼，致力展示文史互證的跨學科特色及其詮釋學意涵，較少涉及陳寅恪的文學批評觀念，以致一些基本問題至今仍未得到妥善的解決。現在學界對陳寅恪如何理解文學的性質和作用，以及他的批評方法和評鑑標準等問題，仍然缺乏足夠的認識，尚有深入討論的空間。 有見及此，本計劃試圖從現代中國文學研究史的角度入手，全面整理陳寅恪有關文學的論述，闡明他的文學觀念，並且深入辨析他的研究方法與前人的異同。除理念層面外，我們還會爬梳散見於陳寅恪著作的評論文字，重構他的實際批評和鑑賞方法。本研究不但能夠揭示陳寅恪在中國文學批評理論方面的貢獻，亦能深化大家對20世紀中國文學研究現代化進程的理解。 Chen Yinke was not only a renowned master of historiography of the 20th century, but also one of the most influential figures of Chinese positivism in literary research, whose distinctive studies on mutual verification between literature and history have extensive and far-reaching influence on Chinese literary research. Despite the fact that a considerable amount of achievement regarding Chen’s research method has been explored by many scholars, the researches, however, are mostly derived from historiography methods or the macro-perspectives of academic studies. Thus, the focus of researches is striving to reflect the inter-disciplinary features and hermeneutical implications of verification between literature and history, yet it seldom addresses Chen’s viewpoint towards literary criticism. Hence, some fundamental questions are still left unanswered. The current academia still lack adequate understanding of issues towards Chen’s perception on the nature and functions of literature, as well as his criticism methodology and aesthetic criteria; hence there is a room for further in-depth discussion. Against this backcloth, this research attempts to, from the approach of history of modern Chinese literary studies, arrange thorough discussions concerning Chen’s literary reviews and interpret his relevant viewpoints, together with an in-depth investigation into the difference and similarity of the methodology between Chen and his predecessors. Apart from theoretical elucidations, this study will also gather and organize phrases scattered throughout Chen’s work on criticism, so as to re-establish and articulate his methodology of practical criticism and appreciation. This research not only reveals Chen’s contribution to the theoretical development of Chinese literary criticism, but also deepens our understanding of the modernization progress of Chinese literary studies in the 20th century.

18600015.label: Realisation of objectives
18600015.value: 原訂四項目標已全數完成，首席研究員全面歸納和分析了陳寅恪的著作及相關文獻，並且針對原訂目標，把研究成果整理為兩篇學術文章，發表在所屬大學評定為最高級別（A級）的學術期刊上。 研究員針對目標1及目標2，寫成〈文學鑑賞與歷史詮釋：陳寅恪批評觀念探析〉，發表於臺灣師範大學《國文學報》，2017年，第62期，第237-282頁。 該文由錢鍾書對陳寅恪的評論引入，全面整理陳氏傳世學術著作中涉及文學的論述，闡明其文學觀念（目標1，100%完成），並且通過對比前人有關詩史的論述，聚焦考察了文學與歷史在陳氏文史互證研究中所佔的位置，逐一探討歷史研究與文本解讀、文學鑑賞之間的關係，客觀和深入地評估了陳寅恪在文學領域內的意義和貢獻。（目標2，100%完成） 研究員針對目標3及目標4，寫成〈陳寅恪典故考釋批評觀念及其實踐方法析論〉。論文已順利通過兩位學者的匿名審查，將發表於臺灣政治大學《政大中文學報》第三十期(2018年12月)或三十一期(2019年6月)內，確認信函已附於論文之上。 該文把陳寅恪的典故研究安置在文學批評的脈絡中，全面整理和重構這種方法的形成過程、觀念意蘊和評鑑架構，由此闡明陳氏的實際批評和鑑賞方法（目標3，100%完成）。此外文章亦對這套詮釋方法的局限和問題作出客觀的評析，檢討陳寅恪以實證主義為基礎的文學研究，是否足以回應五四以來學界對古典文學的批評，由此深化大家對20世紀中國實證主義文學研究的理解（目標4，100%完成）。

18600015.label: Major findings and research outcome
18600015.value: 一、釐清陳寅恪文史互證研究中歷史與文學的關係：在陳寅恪文史互證研究中，文學與歷史究竟處於甚麼關係？學界對這個問題過去一直未有一致的理解。本研究歸納前人的相關說法，深入探討各種主張的優劣，並從詮釋效果的角度釐清了文學與歷史的深層關係。 二、闡明陳寅恪文學研究的學術預設及審美架構：文學與史學分屬不同範圍，陳寅恪究竟是怎樣把二者連結起來？本研究通過大量材料的歸納和分析，揭示陳寅恪視文學文本為歷史存有的基本預設，並考察他如何通過時序關係的重構，建立其獨特的鑑賞理論。 三、深化有關陳寅恪文學批評及現代中國文學研究進程的討論：陳寅恪對文本的實際批評散見於不同著述，一直缺乏系統的整理。本研究把這些評論文字匯集起來，並以「典故批評」為軸心，說明陳氏實際批評的主要依據，並且對其詮釋方法的漏洞和局限作出客觀的評析。這些討論不但能夠拓闊過去有關陳寅恪文學批評的研究，還可以深化學界對20世紀中國文學研究進程的理解。

18600015.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18600015.value: 在撰寫陳寅恪典故批評論文期間，本人注意他的說法其實針對胡適提倡白話文時所說的「不用典故」一項而發。為了對照胡適與陳寅恪論述的差異，本人重頭翻閱胡適傳世著作和新刊材料，並且精讀當中涉及實際批評的部分，發現「自然主義」在胡適的文學觀念中實佔相當獨特的地位，正是20世紀上半葉中國古典文學知識化的另一重要案例。鑑於過去學者鮮有深究胡適對自然主義的理解，亦未嘗論及自然主義與其文學批評之間的關係，本人擬針對這些問題作系統的專題個案研究。

18600015.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18600015.value: 過去學者多從宏觀的角度考察陳寅恪文史互證的跨學科特色，本計劃則從現代中國文學研究史的角度入手，全面整理陳氏涉及文學的論述，闡明其文學觀念，並且爬梳散見於不同著作的評論文字，重構他的實際批評和鑑賞方法。本研究不但(1)釐清了陳寅恪文史互證研究中歷史與文學的關係、(2)闡明其文學研究的學術預設及審美架構，還(3)深化了學界有關陳氏文學批評以至現代中國文學研究進程方面的討論。

18600415.label: Project Objectives

18600415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600415.value: This project will investigate the experiences of eight English language teachers in Hong Kong during their initial years of full-time teaching. Using a qualitative multiple case study approach and guided by a theory of teacher identity construction, the project will examine the challenges that early career teachers (ECTs) confront as they construct their identity as professional English language teachers. The results of in-depth interviews will provide detailed descriptions of the ways in which power relations position the participants as particular types of teachers, reveal their capacity to exercise teacher agency in taking up and potentially challenging such positionings, and explore reasons for their possible failure to establish their preferred teacher identity. The findings will expose and problematize these positionings in order to allow stakeholders, teachers, school officials, and teacher educators, to establish new spaces for ECT identity construction that allow for the meshing of different teacher identities. Finally, this research will provide concrete policy guidelines for teacher education courses and school-based professional development programs designed to support the identity construction of ECTs in Hong Kong and other analogous settings around the world. 本研究將探討香港八名英語教師在初入職時期的工作經驗。本研究為多重個案的質性研究(qualitative multiple case study)，並參考教師身份建構(teacher identity construction)的理論建立研究框架。本研究旨在了解初任教師(early career teachers, ECTs)所遭遇的挑戰，以及他們如何從中建構自己作為專業英語教師的身份。深度訪談的結果將描述初任教師在工作中的權力關係、在崗位上應對挑戰的能力、以及他們難以建立所期望的教師身份的可能原因。 本研究所顯示的初任教師工作困難，將有助相關持份者、教師、學校領導、學者等為初任教師建立專業身份，以及如何與其他教師身份協調提供更適切的幫助；另一方面，研究結果亦會為本港及海外關於初任教師身份建構的教師教育及校本專業發展課程，提供具體的政策建議。

18600415.label: Realisation of objectives
18600415.value: The project has revealed the processes of identity construction among early career teachers, in particular the constraints and enablements that early career teachers confront as they construct their professional identities following graduation. The project revealed a series of discourses that position these teachers in particular ways by making available and denying them certain identity positions. Suggestions have been made for how professional development programs and teacher education courses can act to support early career teacher agency in the construction of their professional identities.

18600415.label: Major findings and research outcome
18600415.value: Early career teachers confront a struggle between different discourses in the establishment of their professional identities. Many teachers experience a lack of agency as they engage in this discursive struggle. This struggle has negative emotional impacts on many of the teachers. As a result, early career teachers are at particular risk of exiting the profession. Schools and teacher education programs can provide opportunities for stakeholders to share their experiences and develop strategies for addressing the identity struggles of early career teachers.

18600415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18600415.value: Longitudinal research can continue to trace the identity development of early career teachers as they move into the middle stages of their careers. Their successful experiences can be used as case studies in teacher professional development programs and teacher education courses.

18600415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18600415.value: The study shows the difficulties early career teachers face and they need to be supported by different stakeholders (teacher educators, school leaders and experienced teachers) otherwise they can be at considerable risk of leaving the profession.

18600915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600915.value: 印度佛教及其文化對中國文化的巨大影響，是中國文化史研究的重要課題，對於了解中國文化的性質具有重要的歷史意義和現實意義。語言是文化的最重要載體，印度佛教及其文化對漢文化的影響，主要通過漢語來實現。因此，研究漢語中的來自印度佛教及其文化的影響是研究該影響在整個文化領域的表現的重要基礎和途徑。 本項目計劃研究漢語代詞的歷史發展與印度佛教，主要是佛經翻譯的關係，是申請者已經結束的GRF項目“漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫建設及其漢語歷史語言學研究”（HKIEd844710）工作的繼續。正如題目所示，該項工作包括兩個方面的內容：一是建立一個翻譯佛經漢梵語言對比分析語料庫，二是在此基礎上進行漢語歷史語言學的研究，重點在於譯文（即佛教漢語）中的原典影響和這些影響最終對普通漢語的發展演變的作用。經過40個月的工作，一個包括三部佛經的“漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫”已經基本建成，並投入使用（網絡測試版http://ckc.ied.edu.hk:8080/）；項目組成員亦開始利用這個語料庫進行進行不同專題的研究，正式出版論文12篇，發表會議論文20餘篇。項目的成果證明了“基於梵漢對勘的佛教漢語研究”這一研究理路的科學性和有效性，同時也鞭策我們利用語料庫這個新的研究平台進行更加細緻和系統的工作，就佛教和佛經翻譯對漢語產生的影響發現更多的實例，為語言接觸理論和語言變化理論的建設與完善提供更多的證據——這正是漢語歷史語言學範疇之中的“佛教漢語研究”的最終目的，也是本項目申請者的初衷。 眾所周知，漢語的代詞，包括人稱代詞和指示代詞，在歷史上發生過一些重要的變化。如從“單複數同形”到“單複數對立”（如我－我們、這－這些）的變化，專用的第三人稱代詞從無到有（即與指示代詞分離）的變化等等。這些變化發生的原因是什麼？過往沒有很好或者認真的解釋。 已往的，包括申請者自己的研究表明，因仿譯（calque）方法的普遍使用，導致佛經譯文中存大有大量因拷貝原典句法或詞法成分或結構而產生的特殊語言現象（朱慶之2000，朱冠明2013）。申請者在進行GRF/HKIEd844710項目研究時，又發現北方漢語或漢語共同語人稱代詞複數標記“們”的產生與佛經翻譯有直接的關係——外來的、母語為印歐語的佛經譯者將梵語中用“數標記”來表示名詞和人稱代詞數範疇的手段同樣用仿譯的方法移植到非母語的漢譯文中，最終使得原本以量詞為表數手段的漢語另外產生出人稱代詞以及表人名詞的複數標記（朱慶之2012/2014a）。這給人以極大的啟示。 梵語的代詞，不論是人稱代詞還是指示代詞，都有系統嚴格的單數、雙數和複數的形態變化；梵語的人稱代詞有獨立的三身系統。這些都是開始翻譯佛經時的東漢到三國時的漢語所不具備的，也就是說漢語代詞的上述變化均發生在大規模的佛經翻譯出現以及翻譯佛經在中國廣泛流傳之後。我們已經初步了解共同語人稱代詞的複數標記“們”的產生與佛經翻譯有關，那麼指示代詞的複數標記呢？獨立的第三人稱代詞呢？那些外來的傳教者是如何翻譯梵語的指示代詞的複數形式的？又是如何翻譯梵語獨立的第三人稱代詞的？漢譯文中有沒有受到梵語影響的證據？若有影響，這些影響與漢語代詞後來的變化有沒有關係？以上就是本項目打算系統和深入探究的幾個問題。我們還要把目光從共同語擴大到方言，除了共同語，其他各主要方言，尤其是粵語的相關情形如何？可以預計，項目的完成除了可以為漢語代詞發生上述變化的原因作出解釋，貢獻於漢語歷史語法學之外，還可以加深我們對於佛教影響中國文化的認識，并且對完善“漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫”這一國際學術界唯一的原創性學術研究平台有一定的幫助。 Since Buddhism was introduced to China in Han Dynasty, plenty of Buddhist texts were translated into Chinese successively. The spreading of Buddhism in China had a great impact on Chinese culture. As language is the most important medium of culture, influences of Buddhism on Chinese culture were realized through the Chinese language. Therefore, exploring influences of Buddhist translation on the Chinese language is very important not only to the language change itself but also to the change in the culture. This project is a continuation of a previously finished project conducted by the applicant (PI): Assessing the impact of Sanskrit on the Chinese language: Creating a database of Chinese Buddhist translations and their Sanskrit parallels to facilitate research in historical Chinese linguistics through contrastive analysis (HKIEd844710). We will use the database established in this previous project to do some further researches in order to find more facts about influences of translated Buddhist texts on Chinese. This project will focus on the changes of pronouns in the history of Chinese language. We will try to find the relation between Buddhist translation and the motivations of changes of pronouns. Chinese pronouns, including personal pronouns and demonstrative pronouns, underwent some remarkable changes over time. For example, pronouns in Old Chinese originally did not differentiate singular forms and plural forms, but in the period of early Modern Chinese, pronouns obtained independent plural forms: using plural suffix men (们) for personal pronouns and plural suffix xie (些) for demonstrative pronouns. Another important change is the emergence of the third person pronouns. In Old Chinese, there were no specialized third person pronouns, instead, distal demonstrative pronouns were used to denote the third person. The independent third person pronouns emerged approximately in the period of Middle Chinese. The changes of pronouns mentioned above all occurred after the emerging of large-scaled Buddhist translation and the spreading of the Buddhism in Chinese society. There are some evidences showing that these changes that the pronouns underwent might be due to the influence of Buddhist translation. Since those translators of Buddhist texts frequently use the method of calque, i.e. word for word translation, in translated Chinese Buddhist texts, there are many special expressions that duplicate syntactic or morphological characteristics of the source language, i.e. Sanskrit. As a result, some morphosyntactic features of Sanskrit might be introduced into Chinese. It is well known that Sanskrit has a rich morphology. As for the pronouns, there are strict distinctions between singular forms and plural forms, as well as three distinct types of personal pronouns. Translating plural forms of pronouns and the third person pronouns in Sanskrit might cause the emergence of the corresponding forms in Chinese. We will explore the processes of the changes that pronouns underwent, as well as pinpoint the translation strategies used when translating plural and the third person forms of pronouns in Sanskrit, at the aim of finding the contributions that Buddhist translation made to the changes of pronouns in Chinese.

18600915.label: Realisation of objectives
18600915.value: 這項研究計劃從2016年1月開始，2018年12月結束。經過三年的工作，計劃原先設定的三個具體研究任務已經圓滿完成，不但積累了新的材料，還發現了更多的研究課題，為今後的研究工作打下了新的基礎。現將主要的工作方式和內容報告如下： 由於經費的局限，無力聘請研究員協助研究，我們根據項目的既定目標，將研究內容細化並適當擴大，邀請兩岸三地的學者以自願的方式參與項目的研究工作。 研究的內容包括： 一、中古漢語代詞專題研究綜述。針對代詞研究的某些熱點問題，撰寫研究綜述，弄清已有的研究有哪些？取得了哪些進展？不足和今後的方向是什麼，等等。 二、中古文獻代詞的專書或專題描寫。中古文獻包括本土文獻和漢譯佛經兩個大類。重要的有代表性的專書，最好是過去缺乏深入研究者，可分語體，如書面語的，口語的，或者白話文的；專題則以某個熱點問題為導向。研究的內容以描寫為主，從形式、語義和句法表現等等多角度，對研究的問題作細緻的有系統的描寫。 三、漢語代詞在中古時代的發展變化。發展指有哪些新的代詞出現，與原有代詞的關係——替換？共存？變化指與原有的代詞及其用法比較，出現了什麼不同。“原有”是相對的概念，包括上古，以及中古各個時期。 四、以梵漢對勘為基礎的中古翻譯佛經代詞的專書研究或專題研究。專書研究可就其中一部經的代詞作系統的描寫和分析，重點在說明譯經與平行原典的可能聯繫；專題研究可就代詞的某一類別在上述譯經中的表現，作系統的描寫和分析，重點同樣是譯經與平行原典的可能關係。 以上四個方面的研究都指向一個共同的目標，即了解漢語代詞在中古的變化內容和變化過程，發現導致變化的原因，總結變化的規律。其中的重中之重，當然是佛教和佛經翻譯對中古漢語代詞發展變化的影響。 參加研究的學者，連同項目的兩位主持人，共有23位，大都是漢語歷史語言學領域的頂尖和一線學者。他們是： 大陸：董秀芳、郝琦（北京大學），朱冠明、龍國富、劉愛菊（中國人民大學），王繼紅（北京外國語大學），姜南（中國社會科學院），帥志嵩、邱冰（北京語言大學），汪維輝、真大成（浙江大學），陳文杰（南京大學），陳秀蘭（上海師範大學），董志翹（南京師範大學），龔波（廣州大學），周俊勛（西南交通大學），錢珍（廣東經貿大學）； 台灣：魏培泉（中央研究院），陳淑芬（清華大學）； 香港：朱慶之、王嬋娟、王聰（香港教育大學），李博寒（香港中文大學深圳校區）。 2018年12月，上述研究者帶著各自的研究成果齊聚香港，參加了為期兩天半的「漢譯佛經與中古漢語代詞的發展與研究工作坊暨《佛經漢譯與漢語代詞的發展與研究》定稿會」，交流研究成果，討論成果的修訂，為論文的結集出版做準備。會議期間共發表論文21篇，涉及的內容除了項目的目標外，幾乎涵蓋了代詞的各個方面。 在組織團隊研究的同時，項目主持人也身體力行，圍繞三個研究目標進行研究。近四年共在學術研討會和工作坊上發表與研究計劃有關的論文或報告25篇，在學術刊物正式出版6篇（詳後）。由項目主持人編輯、收錄團隊主要成果的《佛典與中古漢語代詞研究》，共收錄研究論文25篇，已獲上海中西書局的審查通過，將於2020年上半年問世。 總之，在團隊的共同努力下，項目目標已經完全達成，取得了豐碩的成果。

18600915.label: Major findings and research outcome
18600915.value: 本項研究的主要收穫，是發現和進一步證明了，古代印度佛教和佛經翻譯影響中古漢語，其中包括代詞系統發生變化的主要途徑有兩個。一是翻譯時源頭語成分向目的語的大量負遷移，造成譯文明顯的「漢外混合」特徵；一是譯者對漢語的誤用，往往破壞了漢語原有的系統性和穩定性。這兩個途徑的形成，是因為佛經的翻譯者大都為西域東來的僧侶，他們將用母語或者與母語接近的語言寫成的佛典譯成他們不熟悉的漢語。這些途徑最初影響的是佛經譯文，隨著佛教的傳播和翻譯佛經的傳習，再進一步影響日常漢語。 第一途徑直接導致了中古時期漢語代詞系統（人稱和指示）的複數標記的產生，也就是「單複對立」的形成。這些標記如「等」「輩」原本是「類及之詞」，它們跟在代詞之後形成的「吾等」「汝輩」「此輩」「彼等」所表達的是集合量，而非語法上的複數。與漢語是一種用量詞來表示「數」的類標記語言不同，梵語是用複數標記來表示數的。譯經者為了將梵語的複數標記翻譯出來，使用了表面作用相近的類及之詞，使得這些有實際意義的詞發生了語法化。其結果，一方面造成了漢語複數表達方式的變化，即從單一的量詞語言向量詞和複數標記混用（但呈現互補分佈）語言的變化；另一方面，也導致了代詞，不論是人稱還是指示，發生了從上古的「單數同形」到中古及近代的「單複對立」的變化。 就第二途徑而論，由於譯者的漢語不精到，不能把握近義詞之間的語義和用法差別，導致在譯文中，有些常用的代詞出現在它們原本不該出現的位置上。比如在上古時代不會出現在根句主語和賓語位置的「其」，在譯中文就不受這個限制。過去認為這是漢語口語的反映。經過我們精細的統計分析，這其實是譯者對「其」的誤用。這種誤用會隨著佛經的傳習被普通民眾模仿，最終造成漢語人稱代詞的系統性變化和新成分的產生。例如，很有可能的是，「其」的方言變體「渠」在西晉前後成為專用的第三人稱代詞就是這種變異的一個結果。這個「渠」的出現，改變了漢語沒有專用第三人稱代詞的歷史。與數標記（典型的如「們」）的產生一樣，其漢語語法史的意義同樣非同小可。

18600915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18600915.value: 漢語在經過上古緩慢的發展期後，在東漢以後發生了許多重大的變化。這些變化成為導致漢語在近代和現代的新格局出現的重要原因。中古時代發生了佛教的傳入以及佛經翻譯是中古時代最大的中外文化交流事件。從社會語言學理論的角度說，這個事件與漢語在中古的變化必有重要的聯繫，應當成為中古漢語歷史語言學研究的重點。 正因為如此，在過去三十年，越來越多的學者關注於此。本項目的研究可以說是這方面的又一努力，取得的成果，再次證明了理論的正確，也為今後的研究奠定了新的基礎。 項目主持人作為這個領域研究最早的提倡者和長期實踐者，將會以此為新的起點，繼續發揮領導作用，在加深原有的研究的同時，不斷開拓新的研究課題。2020年，我們將在香港主持召開主題為「佛教傳播與語言變化」的大型國際研討會，討論佛教的傳播對東亞地區包括中日韓越的語言歷史發展變化的影響。

18600915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18600915.value: 古代印度文明與文化在佛教的加持下傳入中國，對中國文明文化的發展產生了重要的影響。然而，長期以來，上述認識在不少領域多處在假設的階段，沒有得到充分或具體的證明。其中就包括對漢語歷史發展的影響。本項研究的開展和取得的初步成果，將會令上述狀況得到重要改善。 研究選取漢語代詞系統在中古時代發生的兩個重要變化為切入點，用精細的文本研究和個案分析，揭示出漢語代詞系統在中古的變化和發展，與以外來高僧主導的佛經翻譯有密切的關係。 具體而論，一是佛經翻譯將大量的原典印度語成分羼入漢譯文，導致漢語新語法成分和手段的產生。本研究發現，漢語代詞的「單複對立」現象，最初只發生在佛經譯文當中，原因正是譯者將梵語代詞的單複對立移植到譯文中的結果。二是佛經翻譯者對漢語的誤用，導致代詞原有的用法發生變化。本研究發現的最顯著例證是，在翻譯佛經中，代詞的用法不合漢語當時的習慣，例如「其」出現在本來決不會出現的根句主語和賓語的位置上。 以上最初只發生在翻譯佛經語言中的現象，隨著佛教的傳播和佛經的流佈，會影響到人們的日常語言，最終成為漢語代詞系統在中古時代發生重大變化的基本原因之一。

18601115.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601115.value: 創意教學:幼教機構教師信念與教學實務之研究

18601115.label: Project Objectives
18601115.value: To investigate the beliefs of Hong Kong preschool teachers about creative pedagogy. To explore the pedagogical practices that preschool teachers use in the classroom to foster creativity among children. To investigate the extent to which teachers’ beliefs about creative pedagogy are reflected in their actual pedagogical practices. To identify factors that facilitate and constrain the use of creative pedagogy in preschool classrooms.

18601115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601115.value: With rapid changes in our knowledge-based globalised society, the development of creativity is seen as a vital policy underpinning the reform process in Hong Kong. Such reforms are particularly important in pre-primary education because the ages between three and five are the critical years in the development of creativity. However, many studies have found that the preschool curriculum in Hong Kong still reflects the influences of its social and cultural context that emphasises the transmission of knowledge. Developing creativity in schools requires teachers to change their familiar practices. Before this change can happen, a good understanding of teachers’ beliefs about creative pedagogy and their actual pedagogical practices for fostering creativity in the classroom is an important first step for policymakers and educators dedicated to pedagogical change. The proposed study aims to investigate both the beliefs of Hong Kong preschool teachers about creative pedagogy and the pedagogical practice that teachers actually use in the classroom to draw attention to the crucial aspects of promoting creativity in preschool settings. A mixed methods approach will be utilised to enable the researchers to establish a theoretical basis of creative pedagogy and also gain in-depth insight into the exact nature of teachers’ classroom pedagogical practices. In phase 1 of the proposed study we will use a sample of 36 Hong Kong preschools and employ an Early Childhood Creative Pedagogy Questionnaire to elicit the views of about 600 teachers regarding creative pedagogy. The creative pedagogy that preschool teachers consider highly important for fostering the creativity of children will be examined. Phase 2 will involve the selection of a sample of 24 preschool teachers from 8 preschools with different school curriculum approaches. An interpretative case study approach will be utilised to enable the researchers to gain a deep insight into teachers’ beliefs about and practices related to creative pedagogy through classroom observation and semi-structured interviews. Factors that may promote or constrain the implementation of pedagogical practice by teachers will also be investigated. The results are anticipated to advance our understanding of the crucial aspects of promoting creativity in Hong Kong preschools. In turn, this understanding may guide the development of other appropriate ways of promoting creativity in children during their early years of schooling and may direct the planning of sensitive and relevant teacher development programmes to realise the goals of developing creativity in the education reform. 18601115.label: Realisation of objectives
18601115.value: Phase 1 - Realisation of objective 1 Fifty early childhood settings took part in the survey. The self-reported questionnaire included a demographic section to collect data on school types, gender, qualifications, teaching experience, position held in schools, and teaching class; a section with 20 Likert-type items written in Chinese on five dimensions of creative personality traits; and a section with 22 Likert-type items written in Chinese on four dimensions of creative pedagogy. 880 completed questionnaires were returned to the researcher via post. The psychometric properties of the measurement scale, the Early Childhood Creative Pedagogy Questionnaire (ECCPQ), was validated using confirmatory factor analysis with Mplus version 7.2 (Muthén & Muthén, 1998-2012). The posited four-factor model had good fit to the data according to the criteria which captured and reflected four of the creative pedagogy domains and all 22 items loaded, in line with the original ECCPQ. The findings provide evidence for the four-factor, 22-item ECCPQ as a reliable measure of Hong Kong preschool teachers’ beliefs on creativepedagogy. Rating of the items was analysed to examine the extent of Hong Kong preschool teachers agreed with the items in the ECCPQ are important creative pedagogy in classroom. Among the 22 items of creative pedagogy, “stimulating thinking from different perspectives” had the highest mean and the smallest SD, followed by “encouraging children to express their opinions” , “encouraging thinking from different perspectives”, “encouraging creative behaviours”, and “encouraging children to try new things. Three items in “Teacher-Oriented Pursuits” (“stressing correct answers”, “using repeated exercise”, and “direct teaching”) were perceived as the least important creative pedagogy. Self-initiated Pursuit, Interpersonal Exchange, and Possibility Thinking had strong positive correlations with each other. These results demonstrate that teachers whose pedagogy supported more students’ self-initiation (including giving choices to children, encouraging creative behavior, and valuing children’s interests) also tended to allow more room for the students to interact with each other (including discussions, cooperation, asking questions, and making suggestions) and to be more accepting of children’s individual expressions (including mistakes, illogical answers, and failures) in their pedagogical practice. On the other hand, Teacher-oriented Pursuit had a weak correlation with Interpersonal Exchange and weak negative correlations with Self-initiated Pursuit and Possibility Thinking. These results show that teachers who consider teacher-centered creative pedagogy including direct teaching, emphasis on correct answers, and using repeated exercises) to be important might not consider allowing self-initiation, student exchange, or students expressing themselves in their own ways to be important in their creative pedagogy. A paper titled “Early childhood teachers’ perception of creative personality as predictors of their support of pedagogy important for fostering creativity: A Chinese perspective” was written to share the research findings. The manuscript was published in September 2018. Phase 2 - Realisation of objective 2, 3 and 4 A total of 26 preschool teachers and 274 children drawn from 9 preschool settings among the 50 preschools involved in Phase 1 took part in Phase 2 to examine the actual creativity-fostering pedagogy that were used in preschool classrooms. A pilot study was conducted in a preschool to gain experience in collecting, recording, and analyzing to refine the research design. According to the research proposal, the pilot classroom observation was scheduled with each teacher for three hours and 40-minute observation cycle was used to capture teachers’ actual creativity-fostering practices. The results of the pilot study found that it was difficult to capture teachers’ creativity-fostering pedagogy in free choice activity and physical activity as the teachers mainly adopted hands-off approach in these activities. It was decided to modify the research design to focus on the lessons that have been included developing children’s creativity as one of the objectives of the lesson. All participants were informed when discussing the observation schedule with the researcher. After receiving informed consent from the teachers and children’s parents/guardian, interviews and classroom observations were conducted to collect data on teachers’ beliefs and actual practice of creativity-fostering pedagogy, and teachers’ reflections about the pedagogy used and the factors that may facilitate and constrain the development of children’s creativity in the lessons. A total of 52 interviews and 26 classroom observations were audiotaped and videotaped and all the videotapes and audiotapes were transcribed. Both quantitative and qualitative analysis of data were carried out. For analyzing observation data, the coding scheme was predetermined based on the 22 items of creativity-fostering pedagogy identified in phase 1. The coded teaching episodes were then grouped and frequency counts were employed to examine the specific pedagogical practices that were most frequently used and least frequently used. In addition to teachers’ creativity-fostering pedagogical practice, children’s creative thinking behaviours were examined using the three aspects of the Analysing Children’s Creative Thinking (ACCT) framework (Robson and Rowe 2012). The framework includes 10 aspects of creative thinking behaviours, organised into three categories, i.e. exploration (exploring, engaging in a new activity, knowing what they wanted to do), involvement and enjoyment (trying out ideas, analysing ideas, speculating, involving others), and persistence (persisting, risk-taking, completing challenges). Frequency counts were used to record the number of times a particular creative thinking behaviour was performed to examine the frequency of each aspect exhibited by the children in each creative practice. Descriptions of the children’s behaviours for each count were documented as supportive evidence. The frequency of each structural code in each creative practice was then calculated, and the descriptive children’s creative thinking behaviours emerging in each creative practice were also documented. Qualitative content analysis was used to explore new insights of teachers’ pedagogical practice. Attention was paid to the teachers’ practice related to creativity-fostering pedagogy and the most salient aspects of creativity-fostering pedagogy were captured and coded (e.g., encouraging idea generation, providing supportive materials, motivating interests). Codes were then sorted into categories based on how different codes are related and linked (e.g., providing supportive environment, promoting interaction, stimulating thinking). Related categories were then grouped by theme (e.g., teacher-directed, teacher-guided, child-initiated). Content analysis of pre- and post-observation interview data were carried out to derive themes that addressed research question 2 and 4. Statements that appeared to be related to teachers’ beliefs about effective creativity-fostering pedagogy were highlighted and labeled with a code. Excerpts that is identified by the same code were then grouped into themes to the most salient aspects of creativity-fostering pedagogy from teachers’ perspectives. The analysis of the post-observation interview data was similar to that used for the pre-observation interview data with respect to teachers’ personal reflection on their practices and the difficulties encountered. One manuscript and one book chapter have been written up to share the research findings of phase 2. Dissemination of findings A dissemination seminar has been organized on October 21 2017 to disseminate the research findings. A total of 80 participants attended the seminar, including ECE inspectors, principals, head teachers and teachers. The research findings also shared in a professional development seminar organized by the Hong Kong Early Childhood Education Association on 21 April 2018. A total of 145 early childhood educators attended the seminar. The research findings were also presented in two conference keynotes and three conference presentations.

18601115.label: Major findings and research outcome
18601115.value: Phase 1 The CFA analysis provided evidence for the four-factor, 22-item ECCPQ as a reliable measure to assess preschool teachers’ beliefs about creative pedagogy in a multidimensional perspective within the Hong Kong educational context. It also provides evidence that teachers’ personality traits play a significant role in predicting the creative pedagogy they perceive as important. The descriptive analysis showed that preschool teachers in Hong Kong recognized the important creative pedagogy in the literature, however, teachers also endorsed (although not very strongly) items reflecting teacher-oriented pursuit which were found to suppress the development of creativity in the literature. The findings of phase 1 may help the policymakers and school leaders recognizing the important aspects of creativity pedagogy perceived by teachers to guide the development of culturally appropriate development programme in school. Phase 2 Interview data showed that Hong Kong preschool teachers held similar rather than different beliefs of creative pedagogy. They were aware of the important aspects of effective creative pedagogy. However, observation data revealed that teachers’ actual practices did not always correspond with their beliefs. Most teachers employed a hands-off approach. They provided a richly resourced learning environment for children to explore but did not take a proactive role in facilitating children’s ideas. Some teachers employed a teacher-guided approach. They set up a play environment for problem solving and children were guided by the teacher step by step. Through planned hands-on experimentation and collaborative work, children were given opportunities to play freely with the materials and create their own solutions. Few teachers employed a product-focused approach. Question-and-answer strategies were mostly used for guiding children to complete the creative task. The observation data revealed that the effect of children’s creative thinking behaviours varied among the three approaches. In product-focused approach, there were more signs of passive and product-oriented learning. In teacher-guided approach, children were more persisted with the creative task and able to stay focused. A willingness to take risks and learning from mistakes were displayed. Although only limited materials were given, children could generate numerous creative solutions and often interacted and expressed their ideas with others. In hands-off approach, children showed eagerness and involvement at the beginning but easily running out of ideas and becoming repetitions due to their limited ideas and skills. The pressure of insufficient time, and the need to teach a prescriptive and overloaded curriculum were found as major barriers to foster creativity in preschool classrooms.

18601115.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18601115.value: Further development of research may address the issue of cultural and contextual appropriateness of creativity-fostering pedagogy for Hong Kong preschool settings to provide more insight into the universal trends (etic) and culture-specific variations (emic) in the delivery of quality creative practice in Hong Kong preschool. Research may examine the effects of different creativity-fostering pedagogical practice on the development of children’s creative thinking behaviours. As no single pedagogy fits all contexts, by comparing the effects of different creativity-fostering pedagogical practice with different context and culture, attention of cultural and contextual sensitivity and an awareness of the gap existed among teachers’ beliefs, teacher’s professional competencies and contextual factors may be drawn.

18601115.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18601115.value: This project aimed to investigate Hong Kong preschool teachers’ beliefs about creative pedagogy and the pedagogical practice that teachers actually used in the classroom to provide insights of the crucial aspects of promoting creativity in preschool settings. The use of mixed methods approach was twofold: The quantitative phase aimed to utilize a validated instrument to elicit preschool teachers’ beliefs of important creative pedagogy as the theoretical basis of the study. An interpretative case study was used in the qualitative phase to gain a better understanding of the degree of congruence between teachers’ beliefs and actual practice. Factors that might facilitate or constrain teachers’ creative practice were also identified. Findings of the project provided important insights for policy makers and school leaders to the issues of cultural and contextual appropriateness when promoting creativity in the preschool setting. In turn, planning professional development programme that help teachers to translate their beliefs into practice by realizing own strengths and weaknesses in creative practice, acquiring necessary knowledge and skills on creative pedagogy, giving support and work together to actualize the development of creativity in the classrooms,

18601515.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601515.value: The importance of transitioning towards a greener economy has been recognised globally by different regions and countries (e.g., The European Comission, 2010; The Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, 2011). Challenges associated with the current and future shortage of resources, their inflating prices, technological development and innovation, new markets, and changes in industrial practices and consumer demands (OECD, 2011; UNEP, 2011) have led to structural economic changes, towards ‘greening’ in business and industry. Issues of climate change, health, and other aspects of personal and social well-being that are closely related to the quality of environment, have become a primary concern for governments globally, including the government of Hong Kong. The Environment Bureau and Environmental Protection Department (2013) stated that waste management, air and water pollution, and energy efficiency are the pressing issues that Hong Kong is facing. Initiatives by the Government are aimed to encourage green restructuring and to change current industry practices thus enabling the goal of a “smart green future” (Lam, 2013). Recent research in the Asia-Pacific demonstrates (e.g. Maclean, Pavlova and Smith, 2014) that these kind of actions have implications for the skills requirements, however, little is known about greening skills and its challenges in Hong Kong. The purpose of this project is to examine governments’ influences on new skills requirements, employers’ needs, and the Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) sector’s responses, with the aim of supporting skills development towards greening economy in Hong Kong. Its focus is on the improvements of collaboration between government, TVET and industry. The project employs a theoretical base developed from the Triple Helix models of Academe-Industry-Government relations (Etzkowitz and Leydesdorff, 2000) that illustrate a diversity of relationships between the entities that can range from a strong separation, to overlapping of institutional spheres. This will guide the analysis of data and development of new frameworks. Outcomes of the project, which contribute to both theory and improved policy and practice include a conceptualisation of current practices in Hong Kong that enable skills training to adapt to changing economic needs and policy initiatives towards greening; models that consolidate current partnerships pertaining to the greening of skills development; new, forward looking and innovative frameworks which seek to improve collaboration between government, industry and TVET providers towards strengthening and upgrading greening skills; and identification of patterns of TVET greening for countries at different stages of economic development. 全球不同國家和地區已紛紛轉向更綠色、更可持續的經濟 (如歐盟, 2010; The Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, 2011)。資源短缺，價格通脹，技術開發及創新，新市場，工業實際運作及消費需求的變化導致經濟結構改革，從而鼓勵了工商業綠色化(OECD, 2011; UNEP, 2011)。環境因素與氣候變化問題、健康及個人和社會福祉息息相關， 早已成為全球不同國家領袖，包括香港政府一個關心的重要議題。香港環保局和環境保護署在2013年指出，廢物管理、空氣污染、水污染、能源效益是香港面臨最逼切的環境問題。政府倡議透過綠色重組和改變目前業界指引／做法來推動智能和綠色未來(Lam, 2013)。亞太區最近亦有研究顯示這類綠色重組有助影響技能需求，然而，綠色技能及其挑戰在香港還未備受關注及討論 (如Maclean, Pavlova and Smith, 2014)。 這次項目探討政府在支持本土技能發展，推動香港綠色經濟的前提下，對以下各方面有著甚麼程度的影響力，當中包括： 新技能特性與要求，僱主需求，以及技術和職業教育與培訓（ TVET ）的回應。本項目會着重改善政府，職業教育與各行業之間的合作關係。這次研究引用了研究院--行業--政府之間關係的理論基礎（三重螺旋模型）來說明各種實體關係的多樣性 : 如關係差距大，實體間有明顯的差距，而短差距可達致實體重疊。這套理論基礎會引導整次研究的數據分析和新的框架發展。

18601515.label: Realisation of objectives
18601515.value: This study adopted a qualitative approach involving surveys, interviews and documentary analysis to examine current environmentally friendly practices, industry training practices and existing green partnership patterns in four key Hong Kong industries. It also examined ways TVET institutions are engaged to support skills development required for greening and partnership and patterns they use to be engaged with industry and other stakeholders to achieve this. All four phases have been successfully completed: Phase 1 – identification of participants, surveys with industry and TVET partners and data analysis; Phase 2 – interviews with industry, TVET partners and government representatives, and data analysis; Phase 3 – identification of existing partnerships models, development of new frameworks; Phase 4 – international comparison of TVET greening patterns identified in Phases 1 and 2, and results of a previous study on four developing Asian countries, and reporting on the project. Initial distribution of 73 surveys to companies achieved six responses. Through follow-up phone calls companies that did not respond affirmed they were not undertaking practices that would be relevant to this study. Thus, we got a 100% response rate. From this we established greening is still relatively new for many companies in the Hong Kong context. This is an important finding and highlights the significance of our research that is aimed at identifying strategies to support greening via partnerships. Follow-up strategies maximised opportunities for data collection via face-to-face surveys and interviews. Open-ended questions were used to reveal corporate practices, with respondents then asked to complete relevant survey sections. From this approach, we secured 15 responses across the four industries (hotels, finance, environmental industries and textile). The interviews were conducted with senior representatives from four hotels; three companies in the textile and garment industry; five from banking and finance industry; and three from the environmental industry. Fifty-two invitation letters were sent to all TVET institutions in Hong Kong, with 21 responses from nine institutions, and five TVET representatives interviewed. From government, one interview was conducted with a senior official from the Environmental Bureau. From the data, all objectives were achieved in full, as follows: Objective 1: In conceptualising current and future development for greening in four industries in Hong Kong, a shareholder values framework designed by Hart and Milstein (2003) has been applied to ensure a multidimensional perspective on current green practices and future needs (Pavlova, 2019a). This model allows reflection on the company’s need to manage today’s business while creating opportunities for tomorrow and understanding the company’s need to grow and protect internal organisational skills and capabilities while infusing it with new perspectives and knowledge from outside. For example, hotels need to develop or acquire skills, competencies and technologies that reposition the company for sustainable development while pursuing environmental strategies such as pollution prevention and waste management to create shareholder value for existing business through cost and risk reduction. On the other hand, sustainability governances, stakeholder engagement, CSR initiatives and transparency are external actions that hotels should look at to lower environmental impacts across the value chain and enhance legitimacy and reputation (Pavlova, 2019a). Objective 2: The mapping of current TVET practices in introducing greening skills into training programmes found that over 75% of the institutions added additional skills and competencies that do not lead to new occupations to their existing courses as a main way of greening. Although the majority of environmental related courses had been established by TVET on its own initiative, government’s green targets for the economy (85% agreed) and green training standards (75% agreed) and corporate demand were shown to be among other motivations. 40% of the institutions added additional skills or competencies that lead to new occupations. That indicates establishment of new occupations related to greening in Hong Kong that require new skills What is also important is that ‘green interventions’ were perceived to create positive impact in helping to prepare students for lifelong learning, creating positive impact on their sense of responsibility/ green behavior and their employability. Barriers in teaching environmental skills were also explored. These included the lack of any means to certify environmental skills in existing qualification standards, the lack of a "green attitude" among staff, insufficient teaching time and resources. This mapping allowed a clear understanding of the current situation. Analysis of these results from four industries will allow development of strategies that are required to further improve greening of training (article has been drafted) Objective 3: Based on the Quintuple Helix model, government policies, laws and co-ordinating roles were analysed and essential processes to influence sustainable development identified. These included, for example, the need for a strong concept of green skills, specified by industry sector; Government should legislate to establish a representative for enterprises and companies in advocating greening and should develop further policies on taxation and financial incentives promoting the use of green products and technologies; and periodically revise existing skills development policies (including national qualifications frameworks). (Pavlova, 2019c) Objective 4: Key features of partnership interactions for greening were identified and analysed in terms of components, relationships and functions (Ranga and Etzkowitz, 2000). Within the studied industries, a number of key external partners such as government departments; NGOs; private companies; industry/ business/professional associations; and universities/TVET institutions have collaborated with companies on creation and development of new learning infrastructures/ environments; leadership capacity building (within institutions to lead partnerships); innovation and creativity in relation to community; skills development; and transfer in the local community. Practices related to collaboration with TVET include: presentations at educational institutions (both universities and TVET); engagement in supporting university research, internship training places for students, students’ visits; TVET teachers gaining industry experience; and provision of feedback on student skills. Through the application of the shareholder values framework (Hart and Milstein, 2003) specific areas for partnerships for individual industries have been identified (Pavlova, 2019a and Pavlova, conference 2018b). Objective 5: Outcomes of the partnerships were explored, enabling us to identify processes required at a meso level to support and promote partnerships between industry, TVET institutions and government. This includes: Learning and advocacy for greening in each industry sector (e.g. advocacy programmes for enterprises should be designed for creating awareness of potential environmental dangers); guidelines and basis for greening in each sector to support green practices and clarifying concepts of green skills (including not only technical knowledge and skills, but holistic generic green skills and attitudes); setting up initiatives (identified through interviews with industries, e.g. establishing a platform for green skills competition and awards for successful green partnerships) (Pavlova, conference 2018b). Objective 6: A theoretical conceptualisation of partnerships and the nature of green skills was developed. The proposed triple helix model for analysing partnerships was expanded to a quintuple helix model that highlights the role of society and the environment in partnerships as well as knowledge generation and application for greening. An approach proposed by the World Bank (2014) that argued for the use of policy goals as a conceptual framework for improving practices was used to conceptualise effective government engagement in greening and partnerships (Pavlova, 2018). Objective 7: Comparison of findings from Hong Kong with other countries allowed for the formulation of a holistic framework for greening skills common for developed and developing countries that focus on five areas for which collaboration with different stakeholders is essential (Pavlova 2019b).

18601515.label: Major findings and research outcome
18601515.value: Project outcomes contribute to theory and improved policy and practice. They include: 1. Conceptualisation of current practices in Hong Kong that enable skills training to adapt to changing economic needs and policy initiatives towards greening and models that consolidate partnerships pertaining to greening of skills development. Case studies, interviews and surveys of four industries revealed differed environmentally-friendly practices utilised, varying in quantity and quality. Hart and Milstein’s (2003) shareholder values framework was applied to the greening context for understanding current practices and future needs. The model allows reflection on the company’s need to manage today’s business while simultaneously creating opportunities for tomorrow. This approach provides an opportunity to formulate directions for future partnerships with TVET and other stakeholders. For examples, for the hotel industry this includes: i.) Supporting applied research such as development of green/sustainable procurement guidelines; green operation guidelines; ii). Establishing recycling companies; iii.) Working with local community to recycle; iv.) Setting up a demonstration project on green hotel operations; v.) Developing publicity for an internet-based “Green guest experience in Hong Kong” (Pavlova, 2019a). The study mapped current TVET practices in introducing greening skills into training programmes (see Section 5.3); analysing different aspects of partnerships; and measures to improve collaboration. More than 68% of respondents agreed government offices and departments are their first partners for greening. They also initiated partnerships – 61.1% agreed), followed by industry and business enterprises (15.8%). Only 5.6% of partnerships have been initiated by industry, while TVET institutions initiated 33.3%. Therefore, there is space for industry to be more actively engaged in partnerships. Companies should be aware how this can improve different aspects of their performance (article pending). This study identified areas where TVET can contribute to industry greening. For TVET, the most important reasons for partnerships are students’ benefits, followed by industry and community. 2. New, forward looking and innovative frameworks to improve collaboration between government, industry and TVET providers towards strengthening greening skills. A model developed by this study helps conceptualise effective government engagement in greening and partnerships, based on the quintuple helix highlighting the role of society and environment in partnerships as well as knowledge generation and application and use of policy goals as a conceptual framework for improving practice (Pavlova, 2017). 3. Identification of patterns of TVET greening for countries at different stages of economic development. A holistic framework for greening skills common for developed and developing countries was formulated (Pavlova 2019b).

18601515.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18601515.value: In terms of greening TVET, this study identified a need to support professional development of teachers on developing green competencies into their practice as well as in TVET teacher training (more than 40% of respondents agreed that TVET providers do not organise any training on greening as a part of teachers’ professional development). The Principle Investigator successfully applied for an EdUHK grant to identify the concepts that should be included in teaching and learning to support greening and to develop resources based on these concepts, along with student-centered pedagogy, to support effective teaching of green skills through TVET. These resources can be also used for teacher training purposes. Another area to explore is related to the application of a shareholder values framework (Hart and Milstein, 2003) for the context of greening that has been successfully used by this study to understand current green practices and future needs in other industry sectors. So a targeted support required for each industry, including opportunities for collaboration with education sector beyond internships and study visits will be identifies. That will have a positive implication for practice.

18601515.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18601515.value: Jurisdictions, including Hong Kong, need to transition to green economies to reduce carbon emissions and protect the environment, requiring governments and industries to respond, and new skills in the labour force. Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) has a key role given its focus on middle-skill occupations and position as a transition between old and new occupations; and potential for partnerships through internships, apprenticeships, on the job training and applied research. This project provided important understanding through mapping existing greening practices in TVET, collaboration practices and barriers for collaboration. It examined practices in four industries in Hong Kong (hotels, finance, environmental industries and textile) to understand how they can be supported through partnerships and skills development. The project has contributed to theory, policy and practice, by conceptualising current practices; models that consolidate partnerships; and developing new, forward looking and innovative frameworks that can facilitate improved collaboration between government, industry and TVET providers to strengthen greening skills. Comparisons with policies and practices in other Asian countries identified a holistic framework for greening TVET, for developed and developing countries. The outcomes have potential to strengthen links between policy initiatives, education and greening industries in Hong Kong through targeted partnerships initiatives.

18602115.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602115.value: Global education (GE) is a curriculum approach that aims to expand students’ global awareness and develop skills and values to participate in an interconnected world (Hicks, 2003). As is the nature of curriculum, GE is subject to ideological perspectives that wield powerful implications on curricular intentions, schools’ roles in society, and teacher pedagogy (Apple, 2001). Since the start of the 21st century, GE scholarship has noted the ascendance of curricular ideologies with differing constructions of students’ roles in a globalized world. On one extreme, policies, discourses, and school curricula define students as nationalistic workers who are prepared for competition in the global economy, and on the other, as global citizens who consider public issues through frameworks of human rights (Parker & Camicia, 2009). As enactors of curriculum, GE teachers are positioned at the center of these divergent perspectives. Yet, few studies describe teachers’ understanding of GE and how they mitigate conflicting agendas in their classroom instruction (Zong, Wilson, & Quashiga, 2008). Because of the positioning of GE teachers in this ideological landscape, this project will investigate their conceptions about GE teaching, their actual teaching, and the societal and institutional contexts in which teaching occurs. The purpose is to examine how teachers reconcile their conceptions and curriculum expectations in their instruction and to describe hindering and supportive contextual factors. The proposed investigation informs current scholarship by focusing on Hong Kong, New York, and Singapore, global cities (Sassen, 2002) where policies encourage global curriculum innovations, but where teaching and schooling are situated within nationalistic, utilitarian societal discourses regarding students’ future global roles. To maximize variability in the project, in these jurisdictions we will attend to GE teachers in local schools operating within national directives and international schools that are often overlooked in GE literature. In this qualitative investigation, interpretive and comparative perspectives will guide analysis of data from policy and curriculum documents, interviews with school practitioners, and classroom observations. Multi-level techniques (Bray & Thomas, 1995) and triangulated data will provide the basis for creating city- and school-level profiles that describe the intersection of teachers’ instruction and curriculum expectations for students’ roles in the world. Employing comparative case study approaches (Stake, 2005), we aim to illuminate the ideologies embedded in local and international schoolteachers’ conceptions of GE and contextual factors that constrain and promote their instruction, thus serving as the basis of localized theories (Schwab, 1969) to inform international scholarship, teacher education, and GE practice. 全球教育的課程以提升學生的全球化意識為目的，旨在培養學生參與世界全球化所需的能力及價值觀 (Hicks, 2003)。全球課程有其所依附的意識形態，其對課程宗旨，學校在全球社會所扮演的角色，及教師的教學法都有重要的影響 (Apple, 2001)。始於21世紀，有關全球教育的論述逐漸擴寬，並就學生在全球化下所扮演的角色展示了兩種截然不同的闡述。從一端以培養在全球經濟中有競爭力的國家公民為首任，另一端以培養具有人權意識的全球公民為課程框架設計的理念 (Parker & Camicia, 2009)。 作為前線的教學人員，往往處於林林總總不同的觀念之中。但較少研究會指述前線老師在課堂中怎樣面對及調適對奕的觀念 (Zong, Wilson, & Quashiga, 2008)。固此，是次研究會探討老師對全球教育的理念、衍生的教學模式，以及這種種出現的學校(及有關體制)及社會背景。目的是想了解老師如何調適不同的理念及課程要求、及對此過程的有利及阻礙的環境因素。是次研究集中了解一些主張全球教育的國際城市如香港、紐約及新加坡三地 (Sassen, 2002)。 在我們的質性研究中，資料主要源於政策及課程文獻，前線教師訪談及觀課，進而進行詳細分析及比對。我們將採用多層次分析 (Bray & Thomas, 1995) 及三角驗證法對比對照城市之間和學校之間的全球教育的課程理念及教師的教學模式的關聯。通過案例的比較研究 (Stake, 2005)，我們針對於展示國際學校及本土學校教師對全球教育的認識，及限制和促進其具體實施的客觀地區因素。藉此，我們希望對全球教育的國際論述，其教師教育及教學實踐提供區域性理解 (Schwab, 1969)。

18602315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602315.value: 世界各地的教育體制正面對嚴峻的挑戰,就是以優質的職前教師教育招收和培訓高教學動機和專業能力的教師教育畢業生。我們對準教師不同的教學動機及在職前教師教育中專業學習的差異如何影響他們的專業能力所知甚少, 所以本研究針對準教師的教學動機和專業學習，進行一個有理論基礎的實徵研究，探討這兩個變项如何影響他們的專業能力。换句話説，本研究將探討準教師對三個理論建構的主觀體驗，就是專業能力、教學動機和專業學習。 在提交本研究提案之前，研究小組在2012及2014年曾進行兩項先導性研究，開發了三份配合本地情境的問卷量度上述三個理論建構，亦已確定各問卷的效度。這些先導性研究加深了我們對這三個理論建構及它們每兩者之間關係的理解，並且顯示在混合研究方法中，Creswell與Planto Clark (2011)的解釋性連續設計適用於本研究。 根據先導性研究的結果, 本研究將採用混合方式的研究設計, 以香港新學制中首屆五年制小學教師教育學士課程的畢業生為研究對象, 進行實徵研究。460位準教師(即修讀五年制教師教育學士課程的全體學生)先會接受問卷調查,之後會對26位進行個案研究，相關資料會在課程最後兩年、教學實習時收集。 這項研究可使教師教育在多方面獲得推展。一方面我們可明白準教師的教學動機類型和在職前教師教育不同專業的學習經驗如何預測他們的專業能力；另一方面，由於研究在香港進行，讓人明白上述三個理論建構如何在香港新學制中五年職前教師教育課程運作,並為教師教育文獻加入亞洲聲音。此外，混合式的研究設計可提升教師教育研究方法的多樣性；而有系統的認識教師專業能力及影響它發展的因素有助設計合宜的職前教師教育,以支持不同動機的準教師的專業學習。這些知識對於培養高專業能的準教師至為重要。

18602315.label: Realisation of objectives
18602315.value: 1. Overall achievement All project objectives have been fully achieved. Outputs include two published peer-reviewed journal articles, one manuscript submitted under review, one draft manuscript under preparation, and six conference presentations. Financial support from GRF was acknowledged for all the outputs. 2. The research process The research team invited student teachers of the first cohort of the five-year undergraduate ITE programme in the new academic structure to join the study. By the end of the 2016-17 project period, 346 student teachers participated in the survey, 23 of whom completed two rounds of interview. The research team adopted context-sensitive instruments (all using 6-point Likert scales) developed and validated in the pilot study in the GRF-funded research project to examine the three constructs, namely teaching motivation, professional learning, and professional competence. Exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analyses were conducted and results indicated consistent, stabilized factor structures (with good model fit indices) and satisfactory internal reliability. The four factors of professional learning in ITE identified include 1) Learning in ITE Fieldwork, 2) Pedagogy-related Learning Experience, 3) Previous Experience in School and Work, and 4) Undergraduate Learning Experience: Formal Learning and Non-formal Learning. In relation to professional learning in ITE, two factors regarding student teachers’ engagement with the theory-practice link were found: 1) Theoretical knowledge as a guide for professional decisions and a tool for reflection on practice; and 2) Practicalizing theoretical knowledge: adapting theoretical knowledge to practice situations. A six-factor model was generated for teaching motivation: 1) Intrinsic: promoting self-development and ideal lifestyle, 2) Fallback career: provisional, non-committed choice, 3) Optimistic view towards teaching, 4) Intrinsic: interest in subject taught and competence in teaching, 5) Extrinsic: salary, stability and obvious choice, and 6) Altruistic. Student teachers’ professional competence was found to comprise three factors: 1) Competence in Classroom Teaching, 2) Subject matter, Pedagogical and Educational Knowledge, and 3) Competence to Work in Schools: Working with Others and Understanding School-wide Matters. Results from the factor analyses formed the basis of further analysis of the relationship amongst the constructs in the quantitative study. The specific factors of professional learning (and engagement with the theory-practice link), teaching motivation, and professional competence generated from the factor analyses of the quantitative data guided the design of interview protocols and served as typologies to categorize data in the qualitative study. Taking together the quantitative and qualitative data analyses, the project objectives have been fully achieved. 3. Achievement of specific objectives Objective 1a. To measure whether the types of teaching motivation held by undergraduate student teachers in the new academic structure and various facets of professional learning predict their professional competence. a. Multiple regressions were conducted in order to measure the impact of teaching motivation and professional learning on the multifaceted professional competence. Undergraduate Learning Experience: Formal Learning and Non-formal Learning was found to be the only ITE learning factor that significantly predicted all the dimensions of their perceived professional competence. The qualitative data analysis further probed into how non-formal learning contributed to student teachers’ development of professional competence (Tang, Wong, Li, & Cheng, 2017). b. Correlations were conducted between student teachers’ engagement with the theory-practice link and their perceived professional competence. Whereas the quantitative study showed positive correlations, the qualitative data analysis was conducted to explore in-depth the two aspects of the engagement, namely 1) Theoretical knowledge as a guide for professional decisions and a tool for reﬂection on practice; 2) Practicalizing theoretical knowledge: adapting theoretical knowledge to practice situations (Tang, Wong, Li, & Cheng, 2018). c. An in-depth qualitative data analysis was conducted on the change in student teachers’ perceived professional competence in the two blocks of ITE fieldwork. The analysis focused on the development of two “context-specific” professional competence, namely Competence in Classroom Teaching and Competence to Work in Schools (paper under review). Objective 1b. To compare the relative contribution of the types of teaching motivation and facets of professional learning as predictors of student teachers’ professional competence. The factor analyses helped identify the different aspects of teaching motivation. Intrinsic motivation: promoting self-development and ideal lifestyle was found to be a unique teaching motivation generated from this study. Based on the empirical data, interview questions were asked regarding the specific aspects of student teachers’ self-development and ideal lifestyle. Results were presented in a conference paper (Wong, Tang, Cheng, & Li, 2017). The influence of different types of student teachers’ teaching motivation and facets of professional learning were tested with multiple regressions and structural equation modelling. Qualitative data analysis was conducted to find out how the three-way relationship played out in student teacher cases. Informed by the literature on the generational characteristics of millennials, the results will be reported in the paper under preparation. Objective 2. To identify ITE practices that contribute to the preparation of professionally competent teacher education graduates through an in-depth understanding of the complex and dynamic interactions between the student teachers’ teaching motivation, professional learning and professional competence. The major findings of the study reported in #1 to #4 in Section 6.1 generated important insights into identifying these ITE practices. a. Non-formal learning: i. Apart from the formal curriculum, student teachers need to be provided with opportunities to participate in non-formal learning. ii. Objects of engagement and nature of learning experience are two important aspects in designing non-formal learning programmes: - Object of engagement: school-age children, organizational and systemic matters; - Nature of learning experience: observation, professional dialogue; hands-on experience. b. ITE practices in the higher education context i. ITE coursework needs to contextualise theoretical knowledge to facilitate student teachers’ development of realistic expectations of and coping with the challenges of the teaching context, for example, adapting teaching pedagogies and classroom management strategies in face of challenging classes, settings with constraints in equipment and resources or different pedagogies from the mentor, and so forth. ii. ITE coursework that focuses on the organisational aspect of teaching needs to prepare student teachers to develop realistic expectations of the variations in school context and culture across schools and nurture an active learning stance conducive to making the most of the school context. iii. Higher education faculty can run workshops to facilitate student teachers’ understanding of the learning-to-teach process, nurture their active stance and a deliberative approach to capitalising on and integrating various sources of learning, as well as to develop a sense of agency and versatility. c. ITE practices in the fieldwork context i. Productive mentoring practices include providing lesson observation opportunities, giving affirmation, offering advice, guiding and encouraging student teachers to adapt theoretical knowledge to practice situations, etc. ii. Engaging student teachers with school-wide matters and professional learning opportunities constitute productive sites for student teachers’ learning. iii. While these practices are conducive to creating productive sites for student teachers’ learning, it is important for school personnel to understand the individual differences between student teachers. Mentor teachers need to adapt mentoring practices to accommodate student teachers’ learning needs. iv. University supervisors guide student teachers’ adaptation of theoretical knowledge to practice situations and provide supervisory feedback on student teachers’ practical experience in connection with the theoretical knowledge which they have learned in the ITE coursework.

18602315.label: Major findings and research outcome
18602315.value: 1. The study offers a new understanding of intrinsic teaching motivation by identifying Intrinsic motivation: promoting self-development and ideal lifestyle as a unique feature of the millennial generation student teachers’ teaching motivation. Student teachers view becoming a teacher as personal development of strengths, fulfilling dreams and career aspirations, as well as epitomizing an ideal lifestyle which emphasizes work-life balance (Wong, Tang, Cheng, & Li, 2017; Tang, Wong, & Cheng, paper under preparation). 2. The study provided empirical evidence on the importance of student teachers’ learning in higher education in terms of its relationship with student teachers’ perceived professional competence: 1) Competence in Classroom Teaching, 2) Subject matter, Pedagogical and Educational Knowledge, and 3) Competence to Work in Schools: Working with Others and Understanding School-wide Matters. Two specific aspects of learning in higher education were highlighted. First, Undergraduate Learning Experience: Formal Learning and Non-formal Learning was found to be the only ITE professional learning factor that significantly predicted all three dimensions of perceived professional competence (Tang, Wong, Li, & Cheng, 2017). Second, there were signiﬁcant positive associations between the three dimensions of perceived professional competence and two aspects of student teachers’ engagement with the theory-practice link which comprises: 1) Theoretical knowledge as a guide for professional decisions and a tool for reﬂection on practice; 2) Practicalizing theoretical knowledge: adapting theoretical knowledge to practice situations (Tang, Wong, Li, & Cheng, 2018). 3. The study offered a differentiated understanding of professional competence. Placing focus on the “context-specific” facets of professional competence, the qualitative findings provided important insights into developing an integrated analysis of professional competence development as constituted by the dynamic interaction of the teaching context, the school context and the student teacher’s approach to learning. Enhancing and constraining conditions of the teaching context, the school context and the student teacher’s approach to learning that influence professional competence development were identified (paper under review). 4. The study showed small but significant mediating effects from student teachers’ intrinsic teaching motivation (including promoting self-development and ideal lifestyle; and interest in subject taught and competence in teaching) on professional knowledge, via their professional learning in ITE coursework and interaction with others. Examining this three-way relationship through the lens of generational characteristics, this study revealed that millennial generation student teachers held career aspirations to become education professionals, and cherished broad professional knowledge learned from different sources of formal and non-formal learning opportunities (paper under preparation).

18602315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18602315.value: Regarding the further development of the research, future studies can be extended to: 1. examine professional competence in light of the T-Standard+ launched by the Committee on Professional Development of Teachers and Principals (COTAP) in 2018, and how professional learning in ITE contributes to the development of this competence; 2. go beyond the examination of professional competence as the sole outcome of ITE in a fast-changing societal context in which teacher education graduates have to face the everyday challenges of teaching in the 21st century while paying attention to their own well-being and work-life balance.

18602315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18602315.value: This mixed-methods study investigated how student teachers’ teaching motivation and professional learning accounted for their development of professional competence in initial teacher education (ITE). The research was conducted on the first cohort of teacher education graduates from a five-year ITE programme for the preparation of primary school teachers in the new academic structure in Hong Kong. It is of significance in advancing the field of teacher education on several fronts. First, it offers a new understanding of intrinsic motivation in the teaching motivation literature by identifying Intrinsic motivation: promoting self-development and ideal lifestyle as a specific feature of the millennial generation student teachers’ motivation to become education professionals. Second, it affirms the importance of formal and non-formal learning as well as engagement with the theory-practice link in student teachers’ professional learning in university-based ITE programmes. Third, it provides a differentiated understanding of professional competence, namely “context-specific” facets and the intellectual dimension of professional competence. Finally, the study also shows that with career aspirations to become education professionals, millennial generation student teachers cherished broad professional knowledge learned from different sources of formal and non-formal learning opportunities. These findings generate useful insights into ITE practices in the preparation of millennial generation teachers.
