21203315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21203315.value: Modern science and technology depends increasingly on the efficient representation, recovery, and processing of vast amounts of data. Surprisingly, for some problems there are simple heuristics, which work unexpectedly well in practice if the parameters of the algorithm are chosen favorably, while they almost certainly fail if the parameters are slightly off. A specific class of algorithms where this phenomenon is evident is found in the active field of compressed sensing and its relatives. A key concept is here that of convex regularization: the initial intractable problem is replaced by a convex surrogate, which is efficiently solvable. The important questions are then, if the solution of the relaxed problem in fact yields a solution for the initial problem, and if so, “how much” the original problem can be relaxed so that this approach works with high probability. The hope is that one can achieve in this way a complexity proportional to the information content of the data rather than its raw size. The goal of this research project is to work out the geometric foundations that underlie these phase transition phenomena in the space of parameters, and to elaborate simple tools that allow to exploit these phenomena algorithmically. These geometric foundations are found in the integral geometry of convex cones. In an earlier work, the principal investigator and coauthors have shown that in high dimensions convex regularization techniques in signal recovery and in signal demixing always exhibit a phase transition, which is determined by the statistical dimensions of the involved cones. The statistical dimension is the expectation of a discrete probability distribution, the conic intrinsic volumes, which broadly describe the statistical dimensionalities of a convex cone. These intrinsic volumes lie at the heart of the field of conic integral geometry and thus form the center of the proposed research project. It can be shown that, for example, the success probabilities of above-mentioned convex relaxation methods, are exactly expressible in terms the intrinsic volumes through the so-called kinematic formulas. Establishing a solid theory around these kinematic formulas (Buffon’s Needle) in their most general form, combining them with techniques from high-dimensional geometry, and applying the theory to the analysis of algorithms in fields like signal processing and statistics (Big Data) is the set goal for this project. 現代科學技術越來越依賴於對大數據的有效表示、恢復和處理。令人驚奇的是，如果算法的參數選得好，對於某些問題使用簡單試探法的結果非常好，但如果參數稍微偏離，該方法幾乎肯定失敗。對壓縮傳感及相關領域中的某些特定算法，這種現象是很明顯的。一個關鍵的概念是凸正規化，最初棘手的問題變成可以有效解決的凸替代。繼而重要的問題是，能否透過鬆弛問題的解來得到初始問題的解決方案，若可以，那原來的問題有“多少”可鬆弛以適用於高概率。我們希望，透過這種方式達到的複雜性正比於該數據的信息內容，而非它的原始大小。本項研究的目標是找出這些相變現象背後在參數空間中的幾何基礎，並制定簡單的工具以算法發掘這些現象。

21203315.label: Realisation of objectives
21203315.value: The objectives laid out in this report were chosen in a broad way to advance a field of research, conic integral geometry, that so far had attracted little attention beyond a rather small audience (convex geometers). Although all parts of the list of objectives have been addressed by the PI during the time of the project, major breakthroughs that would have helped advance the recognition of the field of conic integral geometry were admittedly not achieved. With the risk of sounding apologetic we trace one of the reason for this shortcoming to the challenging goal of raising the interest of colleagues and/or students in this field, which so far lacked any good "entrance points" for newcomers who are unfamiliar with the depths of Euclidean convex/integral geometry. Additionally, so far there also did not exist software that would allow for empirical research on conic intrinsic volumes and curvature measures. Having experienced these shortcomings and difficulties during conferences and meetings, we decided that instead of working out some of the preliminary results that we got on some of the concrete questions (like, e.g., low-dimensional analysis of the log-concavity inequalities of conic intrinsic volumes), we should focus on making the existing theory more accessible to a broader audience, and also develop software that would enable empirical research. We achieved this in the following ways: - Together with Martin Lotz we wrote a paper "Intrinsic volumes of polyhedral cones: a combinatorial perspective", published in Discrete and Computational Geometry, in which we derive the conic kinematic formulas in an elementary mostly combinatorial way that avoids using any characterization result, which is the common way to derive these and which require much more integral geometry techniques. Although this paper is mostly a survey paper, the general approach is new in its directness; we prune the thicket of existing notions and occasionally conflicting terminology to a more digestible core to ease the accessibility to newcomers. Additionally, we also derive substantial new results by extending a result from Klivans and Swartz about the connection between the intrinsic volumes of polyhedral cones and the characteristic polynomial of the corresponding hyperplane decomposition, the latter being a purely combinatorial notion. This paper thus provides a direct access to the conic kinematic formulas, and also clears up the connections between several competing classical sources of this field. - Also together with Martin Lotz we wrote a paper "Average-case complexity without the black swans", which on a first glance does not directly connect to the goals of this project, but which grew out of the discussions that we had while working on some of these questions. Concretely, we realized that some techniques employed in previous asymptotic analyses of conic intrinsic volumes are generally not useful for deriving "classical" average-case analyses. We thus introduced a new class of analyses that allow the use of powerful "concentration of measure" techniques, and showcased the usefulness of this new definition with three applications; the most important one being an analysis of the widely used power method for approximating eigenvalues of matrices. On a further technical note, log-concavity, which is also a property that we studied for the conic intrinsic volumes, played a key role in this analysis. - We derived an algorithmic approach to reconstruct conic intrinsic volumes from samples of the bivariate chi-bar-squared distribution, both as point estimates and as Bayesian estimates. This algorithmic approach is entirely new, and should make the key concepts of conic integral geometry much more concrete, allowing newcomers and people only interested in specific cones to quickly obtain the means to use the theory of conic integral geometry in their applications. We implemented this algorithmic approach in an R package, 'conivol' (see damelunx.github.io/conivol). This package includes an extensive documentation of the available functions, and three vignettes/articles (see damelunx.github.io/conivol/articles/), which not only describe the algorithmic approach, but also lay out the general theory in an elementary and accessible way, so as to ease students and non-experts the entry to this field. We see this package and its extensive documentation as a major contribution in popularizing our field of research. - We wrote another R package, 'symconivol' (see damelunx.github.io/symconivol), for the analysis of the curvature measures of semidefinite cones, which form the geometric foundation of the important field of semidefinite programming. The major algorithmic contribution is here an efficient sampling method for the Gaussian orthogonal/unitary/symplectic ensembles conditioned on the index (number of positive eigenvalues). Using this software we conducted an empirical study on the curvature measures of semidefinite cones, and we computed limiting curves based on empirically confirmed assumptions for these curvature measures. This analysis is laid out in another vignette/article (see damelunx.github.io/symconivol/articles/), included in the symconivol package. This article makes the empirical confirmation of the assumptions underlying the above mentioned computation of the limiting curves reproducible. As an attractive corollary of this study we wrote a function for the symconivol package that produces the rank probabilities of the solution of a (Gaussian random) semidefinite program. In other words, given a semidefinite program in standard form, one can predict the rank of the solution of this program. This application is particularly suited to further popularize the research field of this project. We further made an interesting observation in this study, namely that the algebraic degree of semidefinite programming, which is of an entirely different nature than the curvature measures, apparently follows the same limiting curves.

21203315.label: Major findings and research outcome
21203315.value: - A new and simpler derivation of the kinematic formulas of conic integral geometry. - An extension of a powerful result that ties the conic intrinsic volumes to purely combinatorial quantities (characteristic polynomial of hyperplane arrangement). - A new form of probabilistic analysis of algorithms that allows for employing powerful concentration of measure techniques. - Three applications of this new kind of probabilistic analysis, the most important one being on power iteration: Ignoring an exponentially small set of inputs, power iteration has polynomial expected weak average-case complexity. - An effective algorithmic approach for estimating conic intrinsic volumes from sample data. - An implementation of this algorithmic approach as an R package, including extensive documentation of methods and underlying theory. - An effective algorithmic approach for studying curvature measures of semidefinite cones including implementation in another R package. - An empirical study of the curvature measures of semidefinite cones using this implementation in R. - A derivation of asymptotic limit curves; the computation being based on certain assumptions that have been observed in the empirical study. - A way of predicting the rank of the solution of a semidefinite program. - An observation that the algebraic degree of semidefinite programming follows the same limiting curves as the curvature measures of semidefinite cones.

21203315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21203315.value: The study on the curvature measures of semidefinite cones has shown interesting asymptotic behaviors. We were able to compute the limiting curves, but we had to use certain assumptions that we could only verify empirically. Therefore, further research should address the following issues: - Derive a rigorous mathematical proof of the limiting empirical distribution of index constrained eigenvalues from the Gaussian orthogonal/unitary/symplectic ensembles. This should be achievable with large deviations techniques. - Show that the curvature measures of semidefinite cones of a fixed (proportional) rank satisfy a central limit theorem. This is so far only known for the intrinsic volumes. - Compute the asymptotic variance of these curvature measures, as conjectured in the study. - Test the applicability of the theoretical rank distribution. - Analyze how the curvature measures change in the sparse setting, that is the semidefinite programming settings where one assumes a certain sparsity pattern; this geometrically leads to different cones (faces of the semidefinite cones). Another very interesting observation in the study of the curvature measures of the semidefinite cones was their apparent relation to the algebraic degree of semidefinite programming. This phenomenon surely deserves to be further examined.

21203315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21203315.value: Convex cones are natural generalizations of linear subspaces and appear in a wide range of contexts. Certain measurements of these cones, which can be thought of as (lower-dimensional) volumes describe important statistical properties. These quantities are - in the context of cones - not widely analyzed yet, mostly due to the nonapplicability of the main techniques that are used in the Euclidean context. But the conic intrinsic volumes are deep mathematical concepts with diverse and surprising connections, as evidenced in the polyhedral context with the connection to the characteristic polynomial of hyperplane arrangements, or in the context of semidefinite programming with the probability distribution of the rank of the solution, and also with an apparent connection to quantities of an entirely different nature, the algebraic degree of semidefinite programming. The underlying theory thus touches several different areas of mathematics (geometry, statistics, combinatorics, convex programming, algebraic geometry) further underscoring its importance.

21206215.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21206215.value: 二维弹性流体的适定性

21206215.label: Project Objectives
21206215.value: Global-in-time wellposedness of classical solutions of self-gravitating Hookean compressible elastodynamics in two dimensions; Global-in-time existence of weak solutions of Hookean incompressible viscoelasticity in two dimensions.
rows: Global-in-time wellposedness of classical solutions of self-gravitating Hookean compressible elastodynamics in two dimensions;
Global-in-time existence of weak solutions of Hookean incompressible viscoelasticity in two dimensions.

21206215.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206215.value: As a fundamental model in complex fluids and plasma, the Hookean elastic fluid is the study of elastic waves and involves linear elasticity with variation in time. The original study of elastic fluids dates back to experiments by physicists Maxwell, Boltzmann, and Kelvin in the nineteenth century. Despite of its importance in physics, the global-in-time wellposedness theories of Hookean elastic fluids remain as challenging open problems in mathematics, even though a state-of-the-art small perturbation theory near an equilibrium was successfully formulated during the last decade. In this research proposal we intend to push forward the mathematical understanding of Hookean elastic fluids. The first topic in this proposal focuses on the global-in-time wellposedness of classical solutions of Hookean self-gravitational compressible elastodynamics in two dimensions with small data. This proposed problem is difficult because of the slow decay rate of solutions of two dimensional wave equations, and this phenomenon produces a hurdle to control the growth of norms of nonlinear terms. The success of this proposed problem needs a careful analysis of the nonlinear terms, and sheds lights on understanding two dimensional nonlinear wave equations. The second topic in this proposal aims to address the global-in-time existence of weak solutions to multidimensional incompressible viscoelastic flows. Due to the non-compatibility between the weak continuity and the nonlinear term, the possible oscillation and concentration phenomena of approximating solutions will be two main difficulties. To overcome these two difficulties, an improvement on the integrability of the deformation gradient is needed and a compactness argument to deal with the quadratic term is helpful. 本项目集中研究二维弹性流体的适定性问题。这个项目考虑的第一个问题是二维可压弹性流体在电场影响下的整体光滑解的适定性。对这个问题， 我们先把问题分解成可压和不可压两部份，然后仔细研究非线性项的结构和每个线性方程组的衰减估计。 这个项目考虑的第二个问题是二维不可压粘弹流体的整体弱解的存在性。对这个问题，我们需要解决弹性张量可能引起的弹性能量集中和振荡问题。

21206215.label: Realisation of objectives
21206215.value: (1) Under the collaboration with Professor Nader Masmoudi from New York University, we finished the consideration on global-in-time wellposedness of classical solutions of self-gravitating Hookean compressible elastodynamics. The result in the high dimensional space had been published in a top journal. (2) The research on global-in-time existence of weak solutions of Hookean viscoelasticity in multi-dimensional spaces was proceeded very well, and the research output in this objective had been published in a top journal. Moreover a survey paper in this direction had also been published.

21206215.label: Major findings and research outcome
21206215.value: (1) We use the space-time resonance method, combined with the vector field method, in a novel way to obtain the decay of the solution and hence global existence of classical solutions to self-gravitating Hookean compressible elastodynamics. This work has been published as follows. Hu, Xianpeng(PRC-CHK); Masmoudi, Nader(1-NY-X) Global solutions to repulsive Hookean elastodynamics. (English summary) Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 223 (2017), no. 1, 543–590. (2) The global-in-time existence of weak solutions of Hookean viscoelasticity has been considered and the associated concentration phenomenon has been discussed in detail. The research output had been published as follows. Hu, Xianpeng(PRC-CHK) Hausdorff dimension of concentration for isentropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations. (English summary) Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 234 (2019), no. 1, 375–416. (3) A survey paper had been published. Hu, Xianpeng(PRC-CHK); Lin, Fang-Hua(1-NY-X); Liu, Chun(1-PAS) Equations for viscoelastic fluids. (English summary) Handbook of mathematical analysis in mechanics of viscous fluids, 1045–1073, Springer, Cham, 2018.

21206215.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21206215.value: There are basically two potential aspects for further development of the research and the proposed course of action. They are: (1) For the compressible elastodynamics, the effect of the magnetic field might be taken into considerations and the exterior domain, rather than the whole space in this project, would be also interesting; (2) For weak solutions of the viscoelasticity, either the entropy or the temperature could be also considered. Once again the techniques developed in this project would be crucial in these new settings.

21206215.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21206215.value: The research outputs in this project provide the mathematically rigorous justification on these two objectives. The techniques developed in these research outputs will definitely be useful for the further development in the mathematical community, and also will be helpful in engineering.

21206415.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206415.value: 根据全球建筑和牛津经济研究院的预计，到2025年，全球建筑业会增长百分之七十。随着这样的增长，施工安全和效率将会成为建筑业关注的重点，因为在世界的建筑业都是事故和伤亡率最高的工业之一。在全球，每年有超过60，000起死亡事故发生在建筑行业。在香港，建筑业的死亡及重伤率约占了总数的20%左右。作为最危险的行业这一，提高建筑施工安全以应对建筑业的高速发展是具有重大的意义。 为了应对日益复杂和高挑战性的施工环境，近期的研究主要集中于利用传感器和通信技术来改变传统的施工安全管理。例如，为施工人员提供有助于沟通交流的信息工具从而更加有效的识别和报告安全隐患。此方法是一种通过“预警机制”来提高施工人员的“情景意识”从而提高安全意识的。例如，当一位建筑工人处于危险隐患中，报警器会自动向施工人员和施工主管发出警报。然而，这些应用是基于假设收集到的数据都是无误和可靠的“完美数据”，然而事实却并非如此。虽然传感器网络可提供许多益处,但传感器网络也很容易因故障而收集不完整和不可靠的数据，从而导致误报或未能及时检测出安全隐患，这会大大降低应用传感器网络的现实意义，甚至导致严重的后果。因此，非常有必要寻找新的解决办法来完善现有的手段和措施。 此研究提案的目的是为了建筑施工管理建立一个更加可靠和高性能的系统，侧重于数据处理和决策支持水平。数据融合，随机规划和优化技术将用于建立算法与决策机制。我们将利用传感器来建立一个智能施工工地作为此研究的测试平台，以实施和监测我们研究开发的自主安全监控系统的有效性。 这项研究也有极大地造福全世界其它工业的作用和意义。因为在其实行业中，也存在“不完美数据”的问题，例如，生产力分析。同时，我们会结合我们的教育资源和工业项目，让我们的研究具有更广泛的影响。

21206415.label: Realisation of objectives
21206415.value: Objective #1 Establish the industry’s expectations for autonomous safety monitoring systems At the beginning of the project, the research team conducted comprehensive literature on the recent development of autonomous construction safety monitoring systems. The research team conducted a survey with industry professionals regarding their understanding and expectations of autonomous job site safety monitoring systems. To gain an in-depth understanding of the expectation, the research team visited four construction companies/job sites. Among the various factors affecting the adoption of the autonomous safety monitoring system, reliability, accuracy, usability, and cost are their top concerns. For example, the safety professional would like to have a straight-forward guideline for selecting the appropriate technology for the application on job sites. After conducting a comprehensive literature review, the research team summarized the challenges in the technologies to support the autonomous safety monitoring system, setting the research path for the project. Objective #2 Develop algorithms and a decision-making mechanism to improve the decision making of autonomous jobsite safety monitoring The research team selected two typical construction safety monitoring tasks for developing algorithms for performance improvement: locating worker’s position to determine his/her safety status, detecting the guardrail systems at the open edges. For the first scenarios, the project team developed a Kalman filter based data-fusion approach and considered the temporal constraints to improve the performance. For the second scenario, the project team developed a convolutional neural network approach for the guardrail system development. Objective #3 Test the proposed algorithms and mechanism using computer-based simulation The research used the Monte Carlo simulation approach to test the proposed algorithms and assessed their impact on the safety monitoring decision making’s performance. Jobsite scenarios were extracted to establish a representative computer testbed for the testing. Precision, recall, and accuracy were selected as the metrics for performance evaluation. Synthetic images developed using computer modeling software were used for the CNN-based guardrail recognition algorithm testing. Objective #4 Demonstrate the autonomous safety monitoring system in a physical testbed with the proposed algorithms and test its performance The research team built a physical testbed to represent the construction jobsite environment on campus. iBeacons, cameras and IMU were deployed in the testbed to collect the data. The data (signal, acceleration, images and etc.) were collected and processed using the developed algorithms. The processed data were compared with the ground truth data to evaluate the precision, recall and accuracy of the proposed autonomous jobsite monitoring systems. The accuracy is demonstrated to be up to 97%.

21206415.label: Major findings and research outcome
21206415.value: With three years of efforts from the research project team, the research team discovered the following findings: 1) Convolutional neural network demonstrated outstanding potentials to support jobsite monitoring. As a non-intrusive technology, computer vision-based technology can be more widely used on jobsite to promote construction 4.0. With the deployed infrastructure and algorithms, the system can be expanded to support other tasks (e.g., productivity management, quality control, HVAC control and etc.) 2) By fusing the data from multiple sources (e.g., BIM, IMU, iBeacons), a more accurate location data can be computed, supporting a more reliable decision making. 3) A simulation tool was developed in this project to allow the construction professional to easily evaluate how technology with known specifications could affect the decision-making performance of jobsite safety monitoring. This simulation tool could help to save time and efforts when selecting appropriate technology and also could help the construction practitioners to place hardware requests for the technology developers. The research outcomes were published in five international peer-reviewed journals and three international conferences. In addition, the research team also presented the research outcomes in several invited talks to the academic researchers and industry stakeholders.

21206415.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21206415.value: Although this project was successfully completed, there are many potentials for improvements and technology transfers, including: 1) Impove the intelligence level of the jobsite monitoring. Ontology could be integrated into the developed jobsite monitoring mechanisms to reduce the level of human interference. In this way, efficiency and objectiveness could be improved. 2) Extending the developed algorithms to other management aspects and domains. For example, the environment learning free localization algorithms developed in this project could be extended to support productivity management, indoor HVAC control and etc. 3) Knowledge transfer. The research team can explore the collaboration opportunity with industry stakeholders to apply for applied research projects (e.g., ITF, CIC and etc.) and to develop an autonomous safety monitoring prototype for the industry deployment.

21206415.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21206415.value: The introduction of sensing and communication technologies offers an opportunity to improve safety by increasing workers’ safety awareness. Such applications can notify workers of any unsafe situation even while they are distracted during an activity or unaware of the unsafe conditions. However, the data collected by these sensors are imperfect (including missing and erroneous data), leading to reports of insufficient accuracy and reliability (e.g., false alarms) of autonomous safety monitoring systems. This has limited the adoption of autonomous safety management systems on jobsites. Although improvements in the accuracy of both sensor hardware and data filtering on the physical layer itself have improved data quality, this still cannot provide perfect sensor data to the safety monitoring application. To provide more reliable and accurate decision support for autonomous safety monitoring, the project team developed a robust and reliable framework and algorithms considering the spatial and temporal constraints, data from multiple sources to improve the decision-making process. Two different construction safety monitoring scenarios (e.g., worker near dangerous area, guard rail compliance checking) were developed to evaluate the framework’s performance. At the completion of this project, a better safety monitoring on construction jobsites was supported by achieving an accuracy rate of 97%, minimizing false alarms on site. What is more, the proposed framework and algorithms may also be applied to other decision-making problems (e.g., productivity analysis) involving data collected by sensors.

21207315.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21207315.value: 探寻能够代表一个建筑几何形态的一组最少数量的轴线的方法

21207315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21207315.value: 在一个建筑环境中，轴线是联系一个凸空间和其他凸空间的几何连线。轴线之间的联系反映了建筑内部凸空间之间的空间关系的连通性。因为这种连通性描述了建筑的几何图形，所以由许多轴线组成的一个轴线图可以用来分析线性二维形状的空间构型。由于全线图有直观性，并且易于通过计算机程序得到，所以学者们通常用全线图来寻找能代表特别建筑的轴线图。然而，在计算机程序中，用现有的贪心算法和子集算法来绘制轴线图，无法保证能够从全线轴线图中识别最少数量的轴线。由于集合覆盖问题的计算具有困难性，研究者们通常采用近似算法，但是很难保证能够找到建筑的一组最少数量的轴线。因此本项目旨在克服这一困难，真正寻找一组最少数量的轴线来充分反映建筑空间的几何形态。如果可以在算法上找到一组最少数量的轴线，这一轴线图里的线段将是最少和最长的。因此这个方法可以保证找到一个建筑物的一组最少数量的轴线。 本项目将设计一套算法来寻找在二维平面中能代表一个建筑几何形体的一组最少数量的轴线。该算法用线性程序来寻找最少数量的轴线。为了得到能够代表整个建筑几何形体的最少数量的轴线，一个线性程序问题是建立一组轴线来代表整个建筑几何形态。轴线必须至少与墙体边缘和反射角边缘的每条延长线有一个交叉点。如果存在解决这一线性程序问题的方法，必须保证它是最佳的。然而，解决这个一般线性程序问题的方案中可能包含并不希望出现在轴线分析中的孤立的线。为了避免孤立的轴线，本项目将规定一个新的公式，将一个约束加入到原有公式中。通过检查在各种建筑平面图和空间布局图中的修改后的线性程序问题，本项目将证明该算法能保证得到一组能表示一个建筑平面几何形态的最少数量的轴线。这个修改后的线性程序问题能防止在轴线减少过程中出现孤立的轴线。 本项目将提供一个新的方法来寻找能够代表整个建筑几何形态的一组最少数量的轴线。这种方法可以帮助学者和专家们有效地分析建筑环境中的空间构型，还有助于促进各学科将空间特征融入空间构型。

21207915.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21207915.value: Power supply and demand in a grid must always balance, as real-time imbalance can cause grid instability or even total grid failure. To maintain grid power balance, great efforts need to be made from the supply side. Nowadays, supply side management becomes increasingly costly and technically more difficult as more renewable energy is integrated. Hence, demand response control, i.e. efforts from the demand side, are widely accepted as a better alternative. Demand response control refers to changes in electric usage by end-users in response to electricity price changes, or to designed incentives. As a major energy consumer, commercial buildings play an important role in grid power balance. Conventional demand response controls of commercial buildings are conducted in an uncoordinated way. Through peak demand managements, conventional controls merely focus on maximizing economic benefits for individual buildings. But the overall results of a building group (e.g. overall peak demand), which are the main concerns of a grid, are overlooked and cannot be optimized for the actual need of grid power balance. Although grid and building researchers start to realize the limitation of the conventional/uncoordinated controls, no systematic studies have been carried out on a coordinated demand response control. Therefore, this project proposes a study of coordinated control for a group of commercial buildings. Two key challenges will be addressed. The first one is how to quantify ineffectiveness and inefficiency of conventional controls in relieving grid pressure caused by building peak demand. Due to lack of study, the poor performance of conventional controls has not been fully understood and a better understanding can help improve demand side management which leads to benefits for grid power balance. The second one is how to coordinate demand response controls in a group of buildings for improved effectiveness and efficiency in relieving grid pressure caused by building peak demand. The project will be carried out through systematic simulation using operation data from real buildings. A semi-physical test bed will be constructed for the reliability and stability tests of the developed control. The outputs will enable a better understanding on the limitation of the conventional controls which leads to better demand side management. The proposed coordinated demand response control can relieve the grid pressure in an effective and efficient way. Eventually, the outputs shall bring substantial benefits to cost reduction of supply side management, to improvement of grid power balance, and to less impact on the environment. 電網中電力供應和需求必須保持實時平衡，否則將導致電網電力波動，甚至電網癱瘓等嚴重後果。 通常，電網電力平衡通過電力供應管理實現。但是，隨着電力生產中可再生能源比例不斷提升，電力供應管理的成本和技術難度不斷增加。因此，需求響應控制（需求側管理）被廣泛認為是維持電網電力平衡的更好方式。需求響應控制是指電力用戶根據激勵機制（如激勵電價）控制電力使用。 商業建築是電力消耗大戶，其需求響應控制在維持電網電力平衡中發揮重要作用。常規的商業建築需求響應控制是非協同控制，通過高峰電力需求管理使得電費支出最小。非協同控制着眼於單棟建築，忽略建築群的綜合電力需求。建築群的綜合電力需求（如綜合高峰電力需求）直接影響電網電力供需平衡狀態。因此，常規的商業建築需求響應控制無法優化電網電力平衡。 雖然電網和建築相關研究人員已經意識到常規/非協同控制的侷限性，但是相關協同控制研究仍未開展。因此，本項目提出商業建築群協同需求響應控制研究。本項目主要解決兩個關鍵問題。 第一，如何定量分析非協同控制的侷限性（即無法有效消除建築群高峰電力需求對電網電力平衡的衝擊）。 由於相關研究缺乏，非協同控制的侷限性仍未能被定量分析。定量分析非協同控制的侷限性有助於改善需求側管理，促進電網電力平衡。第二，如何協同商業建築群的需求響應控制，從而有效地消除建築群高峰電力需求對電網電力平衡的衝擊。本項目通過基於實際建築運行數據的系統仿真模擬來開展，同時搭建實驗平台驗證所提出的協同需求響應控制策略。 本項目研究所得的非協同控制侷限性的定量分析有助於改善需求側管理，所提出的協同需求響應控制策略有助於有效地消除建築群高峰電力需求對電網電力平衡的衝擊。最終，這些成果將帶來可觀的電力供應管理成本的降低，電網電力平衡的提升，環境問題的緩解。

21207915.label: Realisation of objectives
21207915.value: Objective 1 has been achieved by constructing a dynamic simulation platform using TRNSYS on the basis of PI’s previous works in which the reliabilities and accuracies of the used models have been validated. The models mainly include the simplified building model and HVAC component models (e.g. chiller, cooling tower). With regard to the building model, typical light-weight buildings, medium-weight buildings and heavy-weight buildings have been constructed and verified. Objective 2 has been achieved by conducting a systematic study on building-group-level performance evaluation for a genetic algorithm (GA) based conventional demand response. To evaluate the building-group-level performance of the conventional demand response, the altered electric load profiles of individual HVAC systems are firstly added to obtain the aggregated load profile with demand response. Then, the aggregated load profile after demand response is compared with the baseline case in which no demand response is implemented. The comparisons mainly focus on the building-group-level peak demand reduction and overall energy increase which indicates the effectiveness and efficiency of the conventional demand response in relieving grid stress imposed by building short term peak demand. The study has been published as a SCI journal paper ‘Performance evaluation of conventional demand response at building-group-level under different electricity pricings’. Objective 3 has been achieved by investigating the key influential factors on the building-group-level performance of the conventional demand response controls. It is found that one of the key influential factor is that individual buildings had peak demands in different time periods and thus their individual peak demand limiting actions do not necessarily contribute to the overall peak demand at building-group-level. Objective 4 has been achieved by developing and validating a top-down coordinated control. The aim of top-down control is to adjust the operation of individual buildings to achieve the optimal performance at cluster-level. The proposed top-down control method consists of two steps. In Step 1, the cluster operation is optimized using GA for identifying the cluster-level optimal results. In Step 2, the operation of individual buildings inside the cluster is coordinated using the NLP based on the cluster-level optimal results obtained in Step 1. Practical operational constraints have already been considered. The study results have been summarized in the published SCI journal paper ‘A top-down control method of nZEBs for performance optimization at nZEB-cluster-level’. Objective 5 has been achieved by conducting the reliability and robustness tests of the developed control. Due to lack of consideration of demand prediction uncertainty, most of the demand response control methods fail to achieve the desired performance. A few methods have considered the impacts of uncertainty, but they merely perform simple and limited collaborations among buildings, and thus they cannot achieve the optimal performance at the cluster level. Therefore, the PI has proposed a control method that enables full collaborations among individual buildings and takes account of the demand prediction uncertainty. The proposed robust control method first analyzes the demand prediction uncertainty, next optimizes the nZEB cluster operation under uncertainty, and then coordinates single nZEB's operation using the cluster operational parameters. The performance of the robust control has also been studied and compared with a deterministic control. The study has been published as a SCI paper ‘A robust control of nZEBs for performance optimization at cluster level under demand prediction uncertainty’. Objective 6 has been achieved by summarizing the project major findings and research outputs and thus providing general guidelines for coordinating a group of buildings/systems. The guidelines can be used to help implementation of the developed control strategy in practice.

21207915.label: Major findings and research outcome
21207915.value: 1. A feasible way has been developed to quantify the ineffectiveness and inefficiency of conventional demand response controls in relieving the grid pressure caused by building peak demand through investigating and evaluating of their building-group-level performance. Using the cooling loads of real buildings, a study has been performed to evaluate the building-group-level performance of conventional demand response under two common electricity pricings. The evaluation results have disclosed the major limitations of conventional demand response under these two common electricity pricings. It has been found that due to lack of coordination, conventional demand response cannot effectively and efficiently reduce peak demand at building-group-level. For instance, in comparison with the conventional uncoordinated demand response, the simple coordinated case with useless demand response removed has achieved a larger building-group-level peak demand reduction but with 61% less total extra energy consumption. 2. A coordinated demand response control has been developed and validated in which the overall peak demand management desired by the grid is achieved with highest energy efficiency. A study has been performed to propose a top-down control method to optimize the performances of buildings at cluster level. The top-down control first optimizes the building cluster operation using GA (Genetic Algorithm) and then coordinates the operation of individual building using NLP (Nonlinear Programming). The collaboration benefits of top-down control have been investigated under two control strategies: maximizing load matching and minimizing grid interaction. The top-down control has been compared with a conventional individual-GA control. The major findings demonstrated the improved performance of the proposed coordinated control. For instance, the grid interaction performance can be improved by 82%. 3. The robustness and reliability of the developed control have been tested under the demand prediction uncertainty. A study has been conducted to propose a robust control method for building cluster level performance optimization. The robust control consists of six steps: predict the energy demand and supply of cluster, analyze the uncertainty in energy demand, find the control signal of cluster battery operation in the base-case scenario, generate trials of battery operation, evaluate the performance of each trial and identify the optimal one, and coordinate the operation of individual nZEB. The study results have indicated the high robustness and reliability of the proposed control. For instance, the possibility that operational cost was smaller than a given threshold was increased to 95.1% in the robust control from 15.6% in a conventional deterministic control (79.5% increase in possibility).

21207915.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21207915.value: The proposed control has significant application values. It can more efficiently and effectively reduce the peak demand at building cluster level in comparison with the conventional controls. Thus, it brings substantial benefits in relieving the grid pressure in maintaining power balance in the peak demand period. In the future, the PI and the research team will promote the coordinated control to the industry and make efforts to have operations in real buildings. Moreover, the coordinated control concept and method can be further extended to the buildings utilizing renewable energy and energy storage systems. The coordination can be used for effective renewable sharing among different buildings due to their different energy mismatch characteristics. With effective renewable sharing among buildings, those unnecessary energy imports and exports can be significantly reduced, thereby leading to more grid-friendly building cluster and more cost-effective net zero energy/carbon building cluster. Following this idea, the applicant and his research team have tried the preliminary studies which showed promising results. In the future, with the more financial supports, the research team will continue the in-depth research which will contribute to the promotion of renewable energy in a high-density city like Hong Kong.

21207915.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21207915.value: To maintain grid power balance, supply side management becomes increasingly costly and technically more difficult as more renewable energy is integrated. In contrast, demand response control, i.e. efforts from the demand side, are widely accepted as a better alternative. Conventional demand response controls of commercial buildings are conducted in an uncoordinated way. Through peak demand managements, conventional controls merely focus on maximizing economic benefits for individual buildings. But the overall results of a building group (e.g. overall peak demand), which are the main concerns of a grid, are overlooked and cannot be optimized for the actual needs of grid power balance. Therefore, this project proposes a study of coordinated control for a group of commercial buildings. The project outputs relieve the grid pressure in an effective and efficient way. Eventually, the outputs can bring substantial benefits to cost reduction of supply side management, to improvement of grid power balance, and to less impact on the environment.

21209715.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21209715.value: 從資源短缺到全球變暖再到持續的霧霾污染，環境退化已經成為一個全球性的嚴峻問題。從微觀層面而言，環境策略因此已經成為全球商業領域無法迴避的一個命題。學者們因而致力於探究企業環境策略和財務績效之間的關係，在過去若干年的研究中得出不同，甚至是截然相反的結論。有的學者認為企業環境策略會幫助企業提升財務績效，而另外一部分學者則通過實證研究證明企業環境策略會因為過高的成本投入而降低財務績效。 房地產企業同樣面臨類似的困惑，因為開發商們普遍認為做綠色地產很難盈利。學者們因此嘗試構建一個理論概念模型以探求企業環境策略和財務績效之間的關係，論證得出商業領袖選擇從事綠色地產會提升財務績效。而愈發重要的企業綠色觀念由於缺乏相應的實證數據和理論模型支撐而無從得以推廣和認同。因此，企業的環境策略（ES）和財務績效(FP) 之間的模糊關係尚需進一步的研究。本研究課題假設：房地產企業環境策略和財務績效是曲線關聯的。換言之，本研究假設從短期來看，施行環境策略（如開發綠色地產等）可能會給房地產企業帶來財務績效的遞減，而從長期來看，伴隨著不斷改進的環境策略方案，財務績效可能呈現正向提升。基於這種假設，本研究提出了兩個相互關聯的研究目標：a) 構建企業環境策略(ES)和財務績效(FP)的關系模型；b) 通過上市房地產企業研究實證檢驗ES-FP模型。研究假設模型會通過檢索2006-2014年間的208個房地產企業年報，企業社會責任報告和全球責任報告來獲取大量面板數據。本研究嘗試通過構建ES-FP理論模型並運用實證數據和方法驗證，因此體現出一定的創新性。截止目前，尚未有學者將ES-FP引入房地產行業。因此，本研究項目具有較高的學術價值和實用價值。在學術層面，本研究可望打破既有的“靜態二分法”思維，大膽設想ES-FP之間存在動態“S”型的曲線相關關係，這個發現可以實現理論研究層面的突破；在實踐層面，本研究首次将该模型引入房地产企业进行论证，作為房企業環境策略／理念的施行有助於企業高層制定相關的戰略決策（如決定是否開始建綠色住宅，履行企業社會責任等），提高持有綠色理念的第三方參與廣度和效度，也因此降低了政府層面推行環保的成本。

21209715.label: Realisation of objectives
21209715.value: The fundamental aim for this project aims to address the main concern in the trade-off between promoting the environment and the economy by helping to shape the intention and willingness of homebuilders/developers/energy-saving companies by providing a better understanding of the positive effects of environmentally orientated strategies on their financial performance. In order to achieve the above-mentioned research question, I have examined the theorization and practice of sustainability through cross-disciplinary approaches. As the growing importance of articulating green concerns to the private sector is diminished by the lack of an empirically-founded, plausible theoretical model to understand how environmental strategies affect a firm’s financial performance. I intend to address the concern, and intend to offer a theoretical critique of the conventional way in which empirical studies are caught in a “linear”, or “dichotomy”, mindset, which assumes that ES/CSR and FP are either allies or adversaries. In this project, I propose an alternative approach, hypothesizing that, as homebuilders adopt additional environmental strategies (CSRs), their financial returns decline in the short term, but then rebound as CSRs are increasingly adopted in the long term due to improved efficiencies due to economies of scale and with the increased general recognition of the benefits involved. During the research period, all these three objectives have been fully achieved. As follows: 1. To model a curvilinear link between Environment Strategies (ES) and Financial Performance (FP) In order to model a curvilinear link between Corporate Environmental Strategies (e.g., Corporate Social Responsibility Strategies; Social sustainability index) and Financial Performance, the PI completed the meta-analysis of ES-FP link first and then makes a hypothesis; This is followed by the independent variables, dependent variables, and control variables; and followed with the stationarity test. Some of them are highlighted below. •Meta-analysis of the ES-FP link As acknowledged, there are two extreme opposite views on the ES-FP link in the current literature that either stand for or against a positive/negative relationship. In order to provide a panoramic view of the academic debate, the PI has carried out a meta-analysis of ES and FP literature. This confirmed that the empirical connections between ES and FP are debatable and uncertain among academic researchers and professional practitioners. Taking “environmental strategy”, “environmental performance” and “financial performance” as keywords, the PI collected 372 journal articles published between 1990 and 2014 from the ISI Web of Knowledge and EBSCO databases. After scanning all the articles, 90 were finally identified as closely related to the connection between ES and FP. •ES-FP link and hypothesis development These perspectives suggest that the reason real estate firms with similar ES and competencies have a different FP over time may be due to the curvilinear nature of the ES-FP link. Investing in ES in the first phase leads to incremental financial costs, as the developer needs time and effort to absorb and integrate them into its normal business processes. This will involve several years’ lag between the ES investment and associated financial benefits, as the marginal costs exceed the marginal benefits during this period. A negative short-term impact of implementing ES on FP therefore occurs. In the second phase, the accumulated effect of the continued investment in ES leads to a positive impact on the longer-term FP. The main hypothesis was that a curvilinear link exists between ES and FP. More specifically, the curvilinear link hypothesis is that: H: The link between ES and FP is negative in the short term but positive in the long term The intention was to identify how ES affects FP in both the short term and long term. There are numerous ES initiatives and therefore a taxonomy is needed to make the hypotheses plausible. The one adopted was that defined by Aragon-Correa & Sharma (2003) and Zhang et al. (2011a) as classifying ES into two groups: proactive ES (ESpro) and reactive ES (ESrea). It was expected that proactive ES and reactive ES would have a different impact on FP. The above hypothesis can be further expressed as: H1a: The link between ESpro and FP in the short term is negative; H1b: The link between ESrea and FP in the short term is negative; H2a: The link between ESpro and FP in the long term is positive; H2b: The link between ESrea and FP in the long term is positive. 2. To empirically test the ES-FP model with real estate industry data •Environment Strategies To date, no consensus has been reached on the definition of ES. In this study, all ES measures were derived from the annual reports, corporate social responsibility reports, and/or green reports of listed real estate firms with their business in China. Content analysis and scaling techniques were used to derive a series of longitudinal secondary panel data (Dahlsrud, 2008), from which all the ES sub-items in the study were obtained and the real estate firms’ reactive and proactive ES values calculated. A coding template was used initially, and part of the materials from the data sources (e.g., annual reports, CSR and GRI reports) were distributed to two groups of coders who worked independently to code the data and make the necessary refinements for the coding template. The data were then crosschecked and the coding template modified and finalized. •Financial Performance Previous studies have adopted various FP measures. As concluded, three broad subdivisions of market-based, accounting-based and perceptual indicators can be used as FP measures (Orlitzky et al., 2003; Lu et al., 2014). The selection of the FP measures is subject to data accessibility and the suitability of the industry within which the companies are operating. Moreover, it is advisable to combine the different types of measures, either market or accounting-based, to probe into a company’s FP. The listed real estate firms keep very good records of their financial indicators, including market based indicators (such as dividends, stock returns, price-earnings ratios and price-to-book ratios) and accounting based indicators (such as returns on assets, returns on equity, returns on sales, earnings per share, total revenues and total assets). All the data were collected from the WIND and Morning Star financial databases for the period 2006 to 2015. 3. To interpret the practical implications of ES-FP model by using listed real estate firms in China The curvilinear relationships between ES and PBR in the nine scenarios have interesting implications. PBR is a market-based FP measure, calculated by dividing the stock price by the book value. On one hand, the stock price represents the shareholders and investors’ perceptions of firm value, and is affected by ES in a non-linear way. Under the current situation of green markets, suitable approaches to implementing ES are most beneficial to real estate firms in China, as the adaptive capabilities of transferring ES into FP and the external awareness of the importance of ES need to be gradually enhanced over time. On the other hand, book value is an accounting-based FP measure and is directly related to the total value of a firm’s assets in its balance sheet. In a firm that shareholders and investors believe to have a high growth rate and low risk, the stock price is usually estimated and meanwhile there is a high PBR. In contrast, for a firm that that shareholders and investors believe to be of low growth rate and high risk, the stock price is usually underestimated and with a low PBR.

21209715.label: Major findings and research outcome
21209715.value: The development of public construction megaprojects in China has been booming during the last decade, and projects of this type are expected to achieve sustainability economically, socially, and environmentally. Despite this, their social sustainability level is relatively low and is yet to be improved. As a prelude to the development of such a mechanism, Li, H., Zhang, X., et al. (2018) provided a thorough and comprehensive analysis of the various social sustainability indicators (SSIs) involved from a multi-stakeholder perspective. Also, the PI and team members provided the first empirical evidence on whether and how “greenness” is valued by hotel customers. Using a unique dataset comprising 156 green hotels and matched comparable non-green hotels in Beijing, we compare their performance based on online customer reviews in terms of indoor environmental quality and environmental responsibility (Zhang, L., Wu, J., Liu, H., & Zhang, X., 2017). Hazarika, N., & Zhang, X. (2019a, 2019b) investigated the factors that influence adoption of eco-innovative practices in the construction industry in context of Hong Kong. They developed a conceptual framework based on institutional theory, strategic choice theory and resource-based view and tested this framework by using data collected from 140 construction-based firms. The results revealed that regulatory instruments, managerial consent and organizational measures play an important role in influencing the firms to be eco-innovative. Wang, H., Zhang, X., & Lu, W (2018) developed a multilayered conceptual framework for improving social sustainability in construction, in which the link between the theories of social sustainability and construction could be advanced through network thinking and SNA. Based on the framework, effective operational methods could be derived to measure and analyze the working relationships involved, and the social sustainability aspects could be better embedded in relationships. Pang, R., & Zhang, X. (2019) built a framework to embed the green manufacturing system into the economic-social-eco system and divide green manufacturing research into three levels: application, organization, and system. Based on this framework, they combined the existing research architecture and research boundaries in the field and proposed possible future research directions. The PI also conducted an extensive global review of sustainable assessment systems in various industries and organizations. The proposed framework constitutes 110 key indicators covering three-dimensions of sustainability—social, environmental, and economic, respectively—and four-elements of corporate development essentials—projects, operations, governance, and stakeholders. A case study of a multi-millions construction company in China was investigated to validate this framework in practice (Lu, Y., and Zhang, X., 2016).

21209715.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21209715.value: By providing empirical evidence from the international homebuilders/construction industry, this study contributes to the long-standing debate over the necessity for companies to invest scarce and valuable resources in ES (or CSR) activities. It is reasonable to perceive the curvilinear relationship of ES and FP in the international construction industry also exists in other industries, where the relationship between costs and benefits of ES similarly apply. These findings suggest that future research into the relationship between ES and FP will move beyond the hitherto dichotomous thinking and linear relationships. Well-designed and prudently selected construct measures for ES and FP, as well as improved research methods, will undoubtedly enhance the accuracy and generalizability of the findings. Although the existing historical data in the MSCI ESG database is a good option as the ES measures for the current situation, it is arguable that a specific ES index system embedded in the construction industry could more precisely reflect the social responsible issues in this special industry. We therefore encourage future related studies to build upon this contribution by the further scientific examination of the ES-FP (or CSR-FP) relationship with more complete and qualified empirical evidence.

21209715.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21209715.value: Companies chasing legitimate profits while fulfilling their social responsibilities have become a topic that global business leaders have to pay attention to. Some entrepreneurs believe that corporate social responsibility (including environmental strategies) will increase the competitiveness of the enterprise and increase profits; while other entrepreneurs worry that corporate social responsibility will occupy limited resources of the enterprise, thereby reducing its business profits. Therefore, people have different opinions about whether a company is responsible for social responsibility (especially the environmental strategies). This study believes that in the short term, fulfilling social responsibilities (such as reducing carbon emissions, abiding by the principles of fair trade, etc.) may bring additional burdens on companies, resulting in lower financial performance. However, from the perspective of long-term development, fulfilling social responsibilities can enhance the company's image and improve business relationships, which is conducive to the long-term sustainable development of the company. Therefore, there is a paradoxical relationship between corporate social responsibility and financial performance.

21211315.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21211315.value: 蜻蜓仿生撲翼機器人的設計，製造，和控制

21211315.label: Project Objectives
21211315.value: Perform systematic study to determine appropriate vehicle size, actuation, flapping mechanisms, and corresponding fabrication process. Develop a dragonfly-inspired vehicle that possess a lift-to-weight ration higher than unity. Demonstration of a liftoff flight.

21211315.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21211315.value: With foreseeable applications such as assisted agriculture, reconnaissance operations, and exploration, research in flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles has increasingly received attention from scientists and engineers. A number of flight-capable flapping-wing robots have been developed. However, high energetic requirement for flight and and limited payload capability severely limits the operational time and practical applications of these robots. In this proposed research, we plan to tackle these challenges by taking inspirations from biological findings to design and fabricate an energetically efficient dragonfly-inspired robot. Biological studies on dragonflies found that, by modulating the phase lag between forewings and hindwings, hovering with four wings has a potential to save energy as much as 22%, while additional force could be temporarily produced via a similar strategy. This proposed research aims to leverage these two key results on a robotic platform to address two aforementioned shortcoming aspects of current flapping-wing robots. This will take place in three tasks. The first task is the study of the phasing effects on robotic wings and its implications on power and lift productions. This will be carried out on wings at different scales to complement the analysis of scaling laws for flapping-wing vehicles with the goal of determining an appropriate size of the vehicle. Second, an origami-inspired fabrication approach will be explored in order to enhance the precision and repeatability in the process of manufacturing centimetre-scale prototypes of the flapping-wing vehicle. The third task is the characterisation of the robot’s flight dynamics using a combination of modelling and empirical results from wind tunnel experiments. This will lead to a closed-loop flight demonstration of an energetically efficient dragonfly-inspired robot. This proposed research will contribute to advances in the field of engineering and, in particular, micro aerial vehicles by the implementation of strategies motivated by natural fliers. It is, therefore, quite likely that direct biological mimicry of dragonflies will produce efficient and highly manoeuvrable robots. Scientific merits will come from: (i) further insights into dragonfly flight from its robotic realisation; (ii) developed fabrication techniques for centimetre-scale flapping-wing vehicles; (iii) flight control solutions for a highly manoeuvrable four-winged robot. 在未來的農業生產，地形偵測及探測等活動中，撲翼飛行器的應用越來越受到科學工作者和工程師的重視。近年來一系列撲翼飛行器已經被成功的研發。然而，高能耗和有限的載荷嚴重的制約了這種飛行器的滯空時間和實際應用。在這個課題里，我們希望通過運用生物學的原理設計和製造高效的蜻蜓仿生飛行器。 最近的仿生學研究發現蜻蜓通過控制前后翼相差可以節省22%的能量并提高瞬時升力。在這個課題中，我們希望通過以上兩個仿生學的成果解決現有撲翼飛行器的兩點不足。這將通過三個具體課題來進行。第一個具體課題是運用機器實驗平台來學習相差對效率和升力的作用。我們將在一系列不同尺寸的翅膀上實驗以決定機器人的合理尺寸。第二，我們將通過折紙為靈感的製造方式來生產釐米級的撲翼飛行器。我們認為這種製造方式可以提高飛行器製造的精度和可重複性。第三，我們將通過風洞實驗來建立力學模型。最後，我們計劃通過閉環控制來展示撲翼飛行器的高效、穩定飛行。 這個課題通過對生物界飛蟲的仿生應用，將對工學，尤其是微型飛行器的研究與利用有推進作用。我們期待製造出一款仿生蜻蜓飛行器。這個課題的價值在於： 1) 對蜻蜓飛行原理的研究 2）對釐米級小型飛行器生產工藝的探索 3）實現四翼機器人飛行的相關算法

21211315.label: Realisation of objectives
21211315.value: 1 Perform a systematic study to determine appropriate vehicle size, actuation, flapping mechanisms, and corresponding fabrication process. This objective has been thoroughly addressed as detailed in the mid-term report. At this lengthscale, commercially off-the-shelf DC motors are viable actuators. To exploit the resonant effects as seen in insects and previous robotic examples, we decided to incorporate a helical spring to provide the elasticity in the actuator-transmission-wing system. The chosen design enables two DC motors to drive two wings directly and independently. Then, we employed a system modeling method to predict the wing trajectory and, hence, the lift force as a function of various system parameters. Together with some scaling laws, we targeted to drive a 6.5-cm wing at the resonant frequency of approximately 20 Hz. The fully assembled robot has a total weight of 3.3 grams and is tethered for power and control. The airframe of the robot functions as a mechanical ground and is printed using an SLA technology. Wings are made of thin carbon fiber rods and polyester film using the laser machining technique. Wing hinges are made by sandwiching a flexible polyimide film (Kapton) between resin sheets using the origami-inspired fabrication paradigm. 2 Develop a dragonfly-inspired vehicle that possesses a lift-to-weight ration higher than unity. After the robot components are assembled, several tests were carried out in order to verify, for example, the stiffness of helical springs and wing hinges, the strength of fabricated wings. After a number of tests, a combination of suitable components are obtained. To further characterize the robot, we construct a robot half for testing the lift force, flapping frequency, and stroke amplitude. The test setup features the robot mounted on a 6-axis force and torque sensor (ATI Nano 17). A real-time operating system (xPC Target, Mathworks) is used to generate driving signals for a motor driver circuit which powers the motor. When driven with a sinusoidal signal with a 7.5V amplitude, the peak-to-peak flapping amplitude is larger than 110 deg at 15 Hz. The lift produced is maximum at a slightly higher frequency, 17.5 Hz. In this case, the robot half produces the lift force of 2.25 g (22 mN). The combination of two wings potentially creates 4.5 g (44 mN) of lift, sufficient to support the mass of a whole robot at 3.3 grams. 3 Demonstration of a liftoff flight. To verify that the prototype is capable of lifting off, we arrange a liftoff experiment. Owing to the inherent instability of the robot, we anticipate the robot to crash upon lifting off in the absence of real-time feedback control. To achive a convincing result, we vertically arrange two guide wires for the robot to fly up, constraining the rotational motion of the robot and allowing the robot to translate only in the vertical direction. The robot successfully lifted off, attaining an altitude greater than 10 cm in three seconds. However, with recent developments in the field, the liftoff demonstration is no longer considered novel. Several research groups have made substantial progress towards untethered flights. For these reasons, we turned the focus of the research towards aerodynamics and fluid-structure interactions. The result of the liftoff demonstration has not been officially published. However, the developed flapping-wing platformed has a vital role in the subsequent studies that lead to the publication in IEEE Access provided with this completion report.

21211315.label: Major findings and research outcome
21211315.value: Major project objectives, namely the farbrication of a tethered centimeter-scale flapping-wing robot and demonstration, have been accomplished. To this end, the developed flapping-wing platform has been used to further study the aerodynamics of flapping flight, in particular, the fluid-structure interaction between the wing, wing hinge, and air. The effects of non-quiescent surrounding air on the flapping robot have an important consequence on flight dynamics and stability. Insights into these sophisticated dynamics bring researchers closer towards the ultimate goal of free flight in unstructured real-world environments. In this project, we have proposed a simplified quasi-steady model for flapping-wing robots with passively rotating wing hinges that encapsulates the contribution from constant frontal winds. This enables real-time predictions of the deviation of wing kinematics from nominal flapping kinematics and changes in lift force. The models are experimentally verified with the developed flapping-wing platform (Li et al., 2018). In addition to the main direction, the pioneered origami-inspired fabrication method has been applied to other robotic platforms. As a research direction for interested undergraduate students, this leads to another accomplished work from an undergraduate student. The work, which entails a foldable mechanism for a small rotorcraft, has been published in a reputable journal (Shu and Chirarattananon, 2019) under direct supervision from the PI.

21211315.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21211315.value: There are two promising research avenues that directly follow the findings above. First, the expansion of the aerodynamic disturbances on flapping-robot could be generalized to multiple incoming wind directions. In addition to frontal wind, lateral, vertical, and the combination of different directions can be researched. The study could also be extended to include power efficiency, which has an important implication on flight endurance. Second, the pioneered fabrication method could be applied to other small-scale robots for morphological adaptation. This does not limit to flapping-wing or flying robots. The advantage of such a strategy over 3D printing technology includes support of multiple materials, precision, and realization of large deformation.

21211315.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21211315.value: Following the emergence of small flight-capable flapping-wing micro air vehicles, efforts toward autonomous outdoor operations of these small robots outside controlled laboratory conditions have been made. For the robots to overcome wind disturbances, it necessitates better insights into the interaction between the aerodynamics of flapping wings in the presence of winds and the robot’s actuation system. The research improves our understanding when a flapping-wing robot is subject to frontal winds in terms of the impact on lift generation, drag forces, and flight stability.

21214215.label: Realisation of objectives
21214215.value: The project has successfully completed with all the objectives been addressed. The major achievements of the project were summarized in this final report. Following listed activities and achievements in detail. 1. Develop supramolecular composite gels blended with omniphobic nanoparticles. We have developed supramolecular composite gels by blending silica nanoparticles with polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) based supramolecular polymers. Protocols on the synthesis and surface modification of silica nanoparticles were developed by the PI’s lab on the surface modification of polymer brushes. The PDMS-based supramolecular copolymers were also successfully developed through the condensation reaction between bis(3-aminopropyl) terminated PDMS and the isophorone diisocyanate (IPDI). Transparent gels were obtained after the reaction. Monodispersed silica nanoparticles were added in the gel precursor to form supramolecular nanocomposite. This part form the basis of preparing damage-healable supramolecular nanocomposites, and structural colors were obtained from the nanocomposites when monodispersed nanoparticles were used. 2. Assessment on surface slipperiness and self-healing properties The PDMS copolymers were hydrophobic which is provided by the PDMS backbone. Water contact angle on the nanocomposite was around 100 degree. The measurement on water contact angle hysteresis (CAH) was used to assess the surface slipperiness. By adding silicone oil in the gel precursor, the surface of the formed gel nanocomposites turned into slippery – the CAH is smaller than 2 degree – which is caused by the overcoated oil layer. The nanocomposite films could perform repeated and fast automatic self-healing after blade cut in a couple of minutes without any noticeable traces. The self-healing properties were further assessed by using rotary rheometer. Our results indicated that silicone oils plays a key role in the surface slipperiness and damage healing of the supramolecular gel and the supramolecular nanocomposites. Firstly, the silicone oils can lubricant the gel surface, making it slippery to small droplets. Secondly, the silicone oils also swelled the polymer networks, and improved the mobility of the polymer chains, which could facilitate the recognition of the hydrogen bonding motifs and thus the self-healing ability of both the supramolecular gel and the supramolecular nanocomposites. 3. Perform parametric experimental studies on the gel nanocomposite A couple of parameters including the particle size, the molecular weight or the length of the grafted polymer brushes, the composition of the gel, and the addition of silicone oils were examined. We have prepared silica nanoparticles with different diameters from 50 nm to 2 m. The surface wettability of the silica nanoparticles were tuned by modifying silane molecules: the native silica nanoparticles, modification with 3-Aminopropyltriethoxysilane, modification with n-Propyltriethoxysilane, and modification with fluorinated silane. The modification with different silane molecules will form self-assembly monolayers onto the surface of silane nanoparticles, which will further tune the surface wettability of the nanoparticles. We have studied the effect of the ratio of nanoparticle/gel, amount of silicone oil added in the gel, and the size and surface property of the nanoparticle on the self-healing properties of the nanocomposite. We have found that the more the silicone oil added, the gel turned to softer and the faster the self-healing process. We also found that the amount of nanoparticles also affect both the gel mechanics and the self-healing speed, and the samples with more gel or less nanoparticles could restore faster from blade cutting. 4. Investigations on fouling prevention on complex fluids The fouling prevention on complex fluids including water, aqueous solutions and some biomolecular contained fluids have been studied. Our results showed that the gels or gel-coated substrates show better water repellency when there is more silicone oil added. Droplets from various aqueous solutions slid readily on the surface without any staining. This is because the silicone oil can lubricant the gel surface and makes it slippery to the impinging liquids. This is very helpful when deals with biomolecular contained fluids. For example, when place the gel into the bacterial growth medium of Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas Aeruginosa, not only very little bacteria staining will be observed after 24 hour incubation, but also the stained bacteria cells could be washed away easily. Furthermore, we also found that microdroplets deposited on the slippery gel surface could be pumped towards each other or towards a hydrogel dots pre-constructed on the substrates. 5. Investigations on the interrelation between damage-healing and surface fouling As a modeled study, the silicone oil-infused supramolecular nanocomposites were casted onto various substrates to form a coating. The healing time and the surface slipperiness of the coating were examined after each cross-cut/healing cycle, respectively. It was observed that, the healing time and the surface slipperiness were not affected after ten cycles. By continuous evaluation of the reflectance at 555 nm of the coating under repeated crisscross cut and healing cycles, the healing time after each cycles was unchanged. Meanwhile, the contact angle hysteresis to water was maintained at very low value, indicating the recovery of surface slipperiness. In a typical process of a water droplet sliding on a flat supramolecular nanocomposite coating, in the beginning, the water droplet could slide on the surface freely, and it was pinned at the damaged area made by blade razer. As the organogel nanocomposite could self-heal in tens of seconds, the damaged area got flatter, and the journey of the droplet sliding could continue. The incorporated silicone oils accelerated the recovery of the surface slipperiness through the refilling of silicone oil in the damaged region, even though it may take longer for the polymer network to reassemble and reconfigure for full restoration of material function.

21214215.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21214215.value: We have developed a new supramolecular nanocomposites composing of hydrophobic nanoparticles and supramolecular gel, featuring at damage healing and surface slipperiness. The supramolecular gel is responsible for the damage healing properties, and the blended hydrophobic nanoparticles can help improve the mechanical stability of the composite. Furthermore, when the nanoparticles are selected from monodispersed silica nanoparticles with specific diameters, the nanocomposites exhibited well-controlled structural colors due to the aggregation of the nanoparticles. A couple of parameters that may affect the surface and mechanical properties of the nanocomposites have been studied, which could be helpful to develop antifouling coatings with damage-healing, surface slipperiness and other functionality.
